src: One of the most produced Russian helicopters, Mi-17 is equipped with a 21.25m-diameter 5-blade rotary wing and 2× Klimov VK-2500PS-03 turboshaft engine, (2,400hp each). Max. takeoff weight:13,000kg (28,660lb)
zh: 俄罗斯产量最高的直升机之一，Mi-17 配备了直径 21.25m 的 5 叶旋翼和 2 台克里莫夫 VK-2500PS-03 涡轴发动机（每台 2,400 马力）。最大起飞重量：13,000kg（28,660 磅）

src: Boeing CH-47 Chinook is equipped with 2 rotors each with 3 blades (18.3m in diameter). 2 × Lycoming T55-GA-714A turboshaft engine provides 4,733shp (3,529kW) each. Max takeoff weight is 22,680kg. The rotors can be CONFIGURED to using differential cyclic for yaw control and differential collective for pitch control.
zh: 波音 CH-47“支奴干”配备了 2 具旋翼，各带有 3 片桨叶（直径 18.3m）。2 台莱康明 T55-GA-714A 涡轴发动机各提供 4,733 轴马力（3,529kW）。最大起飞重量 22,680kg。旋翼可配置为使用差动周期距控制偏航，使用差动总距控制俯仰。

src: Pratt & Whitney Double Wasp, 2250HP (2650HP wet). Water-injected radial with a strong three-speed (only 2 modeled) two-stage supercharger. Note, due to modeling issues, will only develop rated altitude horsepower when at maximum speed. Used on P-61B Black Widow.
zh: 普惠“双黄蜂”，2250 马力（加力 2650 马力）。配备强力三速（仅模拟了 2 速）二级机械增压器的注水星型发动机。注意，由于建模问题，仅在最高速度时才能达到额定高度马力。用于 P-61B“黑寡妇”。

src: Wright Twin Cyclone, 1600HP radial. Two-speed turbosupercharger. Maintains just under 1400HP until about 6km. Turbocharger adds considerable weight, complexity, and size, however. 11ft 3in 3-blade constant-speed propeller.
zh: 莱特“双风风”，1600 马力星型发动机。两速涡轮增压器。在约 6km 高度前可维持略低于 1400 马力的功率。然而，涡轮增压器显著增加了重量、复杂度和体积。配有 11 英尺 3 英寸的 3 叶恒速螺旋桨。

src:
BurstPQS could not find any burst-compiled methods!

This is not a hard error and your game is not broken. It does mean that KSPBurst was unable to successfully build a native library so some things will be much slower than they were meant to be.

For the latest advice on making KSPBurst work take a look at the BurstPQS forum thread.
zh:
BurstPQS未能找到任何通过 Burst 编译的方法。

这不是严重错误，游戏并未损坏。但这确实意味着 KSPBurst 无法成功构建原生库，因此某些处理速度会显著变慢。

有关让 KSPBurst 正常运行的最新建议，请参阅BurstPQS论坛帖。

src: After several unfortunate mishaps with confusing signage on spacecraft, The Peel-N-StikTM Corporation teamed up with Kerland-Mutani to unveil the Semiotic Standard for Kerbal Vessels, a set of standardized icons for use on ships and stations. (Based on the work of Ron Cobb)
zh: 在航天器上因标识不清导致数起不幸事故后，The Peel-N-StikTM Corporation 与 Kerland-Mutani 联手推出了坎巴拉飞船符号学标准，这是一套用于飞船和空间站的标准化图标。（基于 Ron Cobb 的作品）

src: Munar Industries Ltd. saw the wild success of the CDL-2 decal, and wanted to develop a decal set for their own line of Heluim mining bases. These decals are more explicit than the Semiotic Standard and aimed at the hazards that come with more advanced techonologies. (Based on the work of Gavin Rothery)
zh: Munar Industries Ltd. 看到了 CDL-2 贴花的巨大成功，希望为自家的氦矿开采基地开发一套贴花。这些贴花比符号学标准更明确直观，专门针对先进技术带来的危险。（基于 Gavin Rothery 的作品）

src:
How the game handle lag in CPU bound situations.
Mostly relevant with large part count vessels.

Lower value :
Higher and smoother FPS, but game time might advance slower than real time.

Higher value :
Lower and choppier FPS, but game time will advance closer to real time.
zh:
游戏在受 CPU 性能限制时的卡顿处理方式。
主要影响高部件数的载具。

较低数值：
帧率更高且更平滑，但游戏内时间推进可能慢于现实时间。

较高数值：
帧率更低且更卡顿，但游戏内时间推进更接近现实时间。

src: Repurposed from the construction equipment that was used to originally build the KSC, this general purpose industrial hydraulic leg can fill a wide range of uses when clearance and stability are needed.
zh: 改造成自最初建造 KSC 所用的施工设备，这款通用工业液压支腿可在需要离地间隙和稳定性时胜任各种用途。

src: Originally a treadmill for sharpening up lazy interns, this track unit soon fell into widespread use when a bored engineer flipped it over, strapped a battery pack to it, and set it running out of the SPH, shouting "BE FREE!"
zh: 它最初是用来督促偷懒实习生的跑步机，直到某位无聊的工程师把它翻了个底朝天，绑上一组电池，高喊着“自由啦！”并让它一路冲出 SPH，自此便被广泛投入使用。

src: After Jeb returned from a failed snack run caused by a mysterious red spacecraft, the kerbals were left with some rather large track units which fell out of a strange green hypersonic craft that flew over shortly after...
zh: 在 Jeb 因一艘神秘红色航天器而导致搜寻零食任务失败返回后，坎巴拉人从随后飞过的一架奇怪绿色高超音速飞行器上捡到了几个掉落的巨大履带单元……

src: Inspired by his favourite childhood series "Thunder Kats", Gene Kerman was inspired to created this oddly shaped track unit. Useful for smaller craft, as well as remote control snack delivery units. Snacks not included.
zh: 受童年挚爱动画《霹雳猫》启发，Gene Kerman 设计了这款形状奇特的履带单元。适用于小型载具以及遥控零食递送装置。不含零食。

src: Flying in the face of the usual "Go big or go home" philosophy, junior Kerbal engineer Dougel Kerman came up with these after looking at a larger prototype 'from far away'. Valentina thinks they're cute.
zh: 初级坎巴拉工程师 Dougel Kerman 逆“要么搞大，要么回家”的传统理念而行，“从远处”观察某个大型原型机后设计出了这款部件。Valentina 觉得它们很可爱。

src: Optimised for Kerbin straight out of its wooden crate - though tweakable for higher gravity - this wheel is designed for large, high-mobility planetary rovers. Criticised for being power-hungry, but never for being over powered! (Warning: Extremely over powered. Warranty void when used under the influence of gravity.)
zh: 拆开木箱即可直接在 Kerbin 上发挥最佳性能（亦可针对更高重力进行微调），该车轮专为大型高机动性行星漫游车设计。曾被诟病极其耗电，但从未有人嫌动力过剩。（警告：动力极度过剩。在重力环境下使用将失去质保。）

src: When trying to prank Valentina, Jeb filled the engine of her private jet with iron filings. The result was an engine the produces no thrust, but plenty of electricity.
zh: Jeb 为了捉弄 Valentina，往她私人喷气机的发动机里倒满了铁屑。结果造出了一台不产生任何推力、但能发出大量电力的发动机。

src: "Low velocity anti-lithbraking devices". Gene Kerman just calls them repulsors. Gimbal, steering, propulsion, and brakes not included.
zh: “低速防岩石制动装置”。Gene Kerman 干脆直接叫它们排斥器。不含万向节、转向、推进和制动功能。

src: KF Anti Grav motor - Surface mount
zh: KF 反重力发动机 - 表面安装型

src: A slimline surface mount repulsor. Not as stable as their bigger cousins, though just as capable and pocket sized. Though biscuit shaped, they are NOT SNACKS!
zh: 一款超薄表面安装型排斥器。稳定性虽不及更大型号，但性能同样出色且小巧便携。虽然形状像饼干，但绝对不是零食！

src: Dubbed the HypnoDrive by those fortunate enough to use it and survive its hypnotic charms, this alternate mode of amphibious propulsion comes in handy when wheels are just plain.... boring!
zh: 有幸使用过它并从其催眠魔力中生还的人称其为 HypnoDrive。当车轮显得枯燥乏味时，这种水陆两栖推进方式就派上用场了！

src: Fed up with those pesky hypnotic rotating things mesmerising Kerbals and causing accidents, kebal engineers decided to make something a little less.... hypnotic. We leave the results up to you.
zh: 由于受够了那些令人着迷并导致事故的恼人旋转物件，坎巴拉工程师决定制造一些不那么具有催眠效果的东西。实际效果如何由你决定。

src: The crate simply says: "Please fit the right way up. Enjoy any which way." Ironically, it has no "this way up" sticker. Warranty void if inverted.
zh: 板条箱上只写着：“请朝正确方向安装。任意方向尽情享用。”讽刺的是，上面并没有“此面向上”的标签。倒置安装将导致质保失效。

src: Long and powerful track. It's suited to support heavy panzer look-alikes but can be used for more civilized duties. Like flipping over on slopes.
zh: 又长又强劲的履带。适合支撑重型装甲车仿制品，但也可用于更温和的用途。比如在斜坡上翻车。

src: When messing with some old shopping trolley wheels and large rubber bands left by the postman after a delivery or rocket parts, Bill came up with this handy wheel/track thing.
zh: 在摆弄送火箭部件的邮递员留下的一些旧购物车轮子和大橡皮筋时，Bill 捣鼓出了这个方便的车轮/履带装置。

src: A very small track unit. Bed springs were used.
zh: 一款极小型的履带单元。使用了床垫弹簧。

src: Mid size wheels for serious rovers. Good suspension travel and rugged designs make these ideal for serious roving and snack runs..
zh: 适合严肃巡视器的中型车轮。优秀的悬挂行程和坚固的设计使其成为硬核巡视与跑腿采购零食的理想之选。
用于地表探测的加固型车轮。

src: A tiny set of wheel for autonomous rovers
zh: 一组用于自主巡视器的微型车轮。

src: A small but rugged wheel that can fill a wide variety of roles. The dual wheels increase load capacity compared to the single-wheel model, as well as being equipped with a higher capacity motor.
zh: 一款小巧但坚固的车轮，可胜任多种任务。与单轮型号相比，双轮提高了载荷能力，并配备了更大功率的电机。

src: A small but rugged wheel that can fill a wide variety of roles.
zh: 一款小巧但坚固的车轮，可胜任多种任务。

src: Some planet textures have failed to load. Often this means that a planet pack has broken configs, but it may also mean that you have installed it wrong. The planets listed below will likely be broken in some way. Depending on the textures involved this could be minor or the planets could be completely broken. Load your existing saves at your own risk.
zh: 部分天体纹理加载失败。这通常意味着行星包配置损坏，但也可能是安装方式有误。下方列出的天体可能会出现不同程度的异常。根据受影响的纹理类型，问题可能轻微，也可能导致天体彻底损坏。加载现有存档请自行承担风险。

src: Multi-configurable twin-arm umbilical that retracts in a folding motion, styled after the one used for the Ariane V rocket. Deploy limit sliders are used to adjust the arm spread, inner and outer arm lengths, and the rotation of the arms. The arms havr 8 color options, and each of the arm pipes have 5 color options. The umbilical retraction can be done manually or by staging.
zh: 多构型双臂脐带架，采用折叠方式收回，仿照阿丽亚娜5号运载火箭的脐带塔设计。使用开启限制滑块可调节展开幅度、内外臂长以及摆臂旋转。摆臂提供8种颜色选项，各管路提供5种颜色选项。脐带架可通过手动或分级触发收回。

src: The Large General Crew Access Arm with a mount sized for the Large General Crew Elevator, with three style variants. The arm can be retracted either to the right (default) or left (alternate) by toggling the swing direction button. There are 6 arm length variants, and the end section can be adjusted inward up to 2.5m with the deploy limit slider. The end section also has 3 types of pod hatch interfaces. There is also an optional "transfer airlock" that can be boarded and used to transfer crew to a spacecraft inside a fairing.
zh: 大型通用乘员登舰臂，配有适于大型通用乘员电梯的安装座，提供三种外观构型。通过切换摆动方向按钮，登舰臂可向右（默认）或向左（备选）收回。提供6种臂长构型，末端段可通过开启限制滑块向内收紧最多2.5m。末端段还带有3种舱门接口。另含可选的“中转气闸”，乘员可进入该气闸并转运至整流罩内的航天器中。

src: The Large General Crew Access Arm with a mount sized for the Small General Crew Elevator, with three style variants. The arm can be retracted either to the right (default) or left (alternate) by toggling the swing direction button. There are 3 arm length variants, and the end section can be adjusted inward up to 2.5m with the deploy limit slider. The end section also has 3 types of pod hatch interfaces. There is also an optional "transfer airlock" that can be boarded and used to transfer crew to a spacecraft inside a fairing.
zh: 大型通用乘员登舰臂，配有适于小型通用乘员电梯的安装座，提供三种外观构型。通过切换摆动方向按钮，登舰臂可向右（默认）或向左（备选）收回。提供3种臂长构型，末端段可通过开启限制滑块向内收紧最多2.5m。末端段还带有3种舱门接口。另含可选的“中转气闸”，乘员可进入该气闸并转运至整流罩内的航天器中。

src: The Small General Crew Access Arm with a mount for the Mini General Crew Elevator, available in 8 colors. Has 4 length variants, each with end or side hatch access styles. The end hatch access section can be adjusted inward using the deploy limit slider.
zh: 小型通用乘员登舰臂，带有微型通用乘员电梯安装座，提供8种颜色。具有4种长度构型，各构型均支持端部或侧向舱门通路样式。端部舱门通路段可通过开启限制滑块向内调节。

src: The Small General Crew Access Arm with a mount for the Small General Crew Elevator, available in 8 colors. Has 5 length variants, each with end or side hatch access styles. The end hatch access section can be adjusted inward using the deploy limit slider.
zh: 小型通用乘员登舰臂，带有小型通用乘员电梯安装座，提供8种颜色。具有5种长度构型，各构型均支持端部或侧向舱门通路样式。端部舱门通路段可通过开启限制滑块向内调节。

src: The base section for the Large General Crew Elevator tower with a 70m high elevator car. The separate elevator tower sections are attached to to the top. The base section has 8 color options and two toggleable styles of truss: General and Saturn types. Optional side panels in either 3 or 4-side configurations are also available. The elevator car's stopping height can be moved downward with the deploy limit slider. The elevator car can also be turned off. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: 大型通用乘员电梯塔的基座段，配有行程70m的电梯轿厢。顶部可连接独立电梯塔段。基座段提供8种颜色选项，以及通用型与土星型两种可切换桁架样式。可选装三面或四面侧护板。轿厢停靠高度可通过开启限制滑块向下调节。电梯轿厢亦可关闭。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入移动方式。

src: A side-mount walkway extension section for the Large General Crew Elevator. It attaches to one of the center nodes on the front of a tower section, or onto the tower section's optional side nodes, or onto the top of a tower section. The top floor is accessible, and there are optional middle and bottom floors as well. The four walls can be independently switched off to creat different walkway types. The wall trusses have two switchable styles: General and Saturn types. Optional bottom brace beams can also be separately switched on. There are also 8 color options.
zh: 大型通用乘员电梯的侧装走道延伸段。可安装在塔段正面的中心节点、塔段可选的侧节点或塔段顶部。顶层可行走，并可选装中间层和底层。四面墙壁可独立关闭以构建不同类型的走道。墙体桁架提供通用型与土星型两种样式可供切换。底部的加强梁也可单独开启。此外还提供8种颜色选项。

src: A multi-height section for the Large General Crew Elevator tower, switchable between regular tower core and crew-access types. The section has 8 color options and two toggleable styles of truss: General and Saturn types. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. The side pipes can also be turned off in different ways for use with the Extra Large General Crew Elevator.
zh: 大型通用乘员电梯塔的多高度段，可在常规塔芯与乘员通路类型之间切换。该段提供8种颜色选项，以及通用型与土星型两种可切换桁架样式。另提供多种构型的可选侧护板。侧管也可通过多种方式关闭，以便与超大型通用乘员电梯搭配使用。

src: The Core section of the Mini General Crew Elevator tower for use with all launch bases, with a 32.0m high elevator car. The core has three height options; add additional Mini Crew Elevator Tower Sections to increase the core's height. The front wall can be partial on, full on or off. Uses the Small General Crew Arm - Mini mount, the Mercury-Atlas Crew Walkway or the Mini Crew Walkway for crew access to a spacecraft. Also has 8 color options. Adjust the height of the elevator car downward with the deploy limit slider to match the height of the crew arm or walkway and to use with the Tier 1 launch pad. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: 微型通用乘员电梯塔的核心段，适用于所有发射台基座，配有行程32.0m的电梯轿厢。核心段提供三种高度选项；添加微型乘员电梯塔段可增加高度。前墙可设置为部分开启、完全开启或关闭。可配合小型通用乘员臂（微型安装座）、水星-阿特拉斯乘员走道或微型乘员走道供乘员登上航天器。另提供8种颜色。使用开启限制滑块向下调节电梯轿厢高度，以匹配乘员臂或走道高度，并适配1级发射台。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入移动方式。

src: Extra multi-height section for the Mini General Crew Elevator tower. Uses the Small General Crew Arm - Mini mount, the Mercury-Atlas Crew Walkway or the Mini Crew Walkway for crew access to a spacecraft. Also has 8 color options.
zh: 微型通用乘员电梯塔的附加多高度段。可配合小型通用乘员臂（微型安装座）、水星-阿特拉斯乘员走道或微型乘员走道供乘员登上航天器。另提供8种颜色选项。

src: The base section for the Small General Crew Elevator tower with a 50m high elevator car. The separate elevator tower sections are attached to to the top. The base section has 8 color options, and the front wall can be either partially turned off (leaving the horizontal beam), or fully removed, allowing a short elevator to be made for ground access to the deck of a launch base. The elevator car's stopping height can be moved downward with the deploy limit slider. The elevator car can also be turned off. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: 小型通用乘员电梯塔的基座段，配有行程50m的电梯轿厢。顶部可连接独立电梯塔段。基座段提供8种颜色选项，前墙可部分关闭（保留横梁）或完全移除，以便建造供地面通往发射台甲板的短程电梯。轿厢停靠高度可通过开启限制滑块向下调节。电梯轿厢亦可关闭。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入移动方式。

src: The top plate for the Small General Crew Elevator tower. There are two styles of the plate, a full-size one and a U-shaped one. The railings and an antenna mast (different for each style of plate) can be toggled on or off.
zh: 小型通用乘员电梯塔的顶板。提供全尺寸和U型两种样式。栏杆和天线桅杆（各样式顶板不同）可开启或关闭。

src: The base section for the Extra Large General Crew Elevator tower with a 130m high elevator car. The separate elevator tower sections are attached to to the top. The base section has 8 color options and optional side panels in multiple configurations; the panel color can also be changed. The elevator car's stopping height can be moved downward with the deploy limit slider. The elevator car can also be turned off. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: 超大型通用乘员电梯塔的基座段，配有行程130m的电梯轿厢。顶部可连接独立电梯塔段。基座段提供8种颜色选项，并具有多种构型的可选侧护板；护板颜色亦可更改。轿厢停靠高度可通过开启限制滑块向下调节。电梯轿厢亦可关闭。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入移动方式。

src: A multi-height section for the Extra Large General Crew Elevator tower, switchable between regular tower core and crew-access types. The section has 8 color options and two toggleable styles of truss: General and Saturn types. Optional side panels in either 3 or 4-side configurations are also available.
zh: 超大型通用乘员电梯塔的多高度段，可在常规塔芯与乘员通路类型之间切换。该段提供8种颜色选项，以及通用型与土星型两种可切换桁架样式。另可选装三面或四面侧护板构型。

src: The core for the Large General Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options.
zh: 大型通用模块化勤务塔核心节，包含底座和一个 10m 塔段。可在塔顶连接额外的塔段。塔座可关闭以允许堆叠额外的核心节。提供 8 种颜色可选。

src: A multi-height additional section for the Large General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 大型通用模块化勤务塔的多高度附加节，有 8 种颜色可选。还提供多种构型的可选侧面板。可配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: The core for the Medium General Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options.
zh: 中型通用模块化勤务塔核心节，包含底座和一个 10m 塔段。可在塔顶连接额外的塔段。塔座可关闭以允许堆叠额外的核心节。提供 8 种颜色可选。

src: A multi-height additional section for the Medium General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 中型通用模块化勤务塔的多高度扩展段，提供 8 种颜色可选。还提供多种配置的可选侧板。可配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: The core for the Small General Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options.
zh: 小型通用模块化勤务塔核心节，包含底座和一个 10m 塔段。可在塔顶连接额外的塔段。塔座可关闭以允许堆叠额外的核心节。提供 8 种颜色可选。

src: A multi-height additional section for the Small General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 小型通用模块化勤务塔的多高度扩展段，提供 8 种颜色可选。还提供多种配置的可选侧板。可配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: A large-size fallback-type service tower inspired by the transporter-erector used for the Falcon 9. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has 3 height and 2 color options. The upper clamp has two size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted vertically with its deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals are moved vertically with the upper clamp, and their length can be adjusted with their deploy limit slider, or turned off.
zh: 大型后倒式勤务塔，灵感源自猎鹰9号的运输起竖器（T/E）。具有两种后倒收起方式：仅由分级触发的单步完全收起，以及发射前先小幅后仰一部分、起飞时再单独完全收起的两步手动方式。提供 3 种高度与 2 种颜色可选。上部夹钳有 2 种尺寸可选或可关闭，且可通过开启限制滑块垂直调整位置。固定脐带缆随上部夹钳垂直移动，其长度可通过开启限制滑块调整或直接关闭。

src: A very slim and tapered fallback-type service tower. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has only one 15m height option and two color options. The upper clamp has three size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted up-and-down with a deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals can be adjusted vertically separately from the clamp, and can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit slider, or be turned off.
zh: 极其修长且渐缩的后倒式勤务塔。具有两种后倒收起方式：仅由分级触发的单步完全收起，以及发射前先小幅后仰一部分、起飞时再单独完全收起的两步手动方式。提供单种 15m 高度与 2 种颜色可选。上部夹钳有 3 种尺寸可选或可关闭，且可通过开启限制滑块上下调整。固定脐带缆可独立于夹钳垂直调整，其长度可通过开启限制滑块调整或直接关闭。

src: An even shorter and smaller fallback-type service tower. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has 5 height and two color options. The upper clamp has three size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted up-and-down with a deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals can be adjusted vertically separately from the clamp, and can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit slider, or be turned off.
zh: 更加短小的后倒式勤务塔。具有两种后倒收起方式：仅由分级触发的单步完全收起，以及发射前先小幅后仰一部分、起飞时再单独完全收起的两步手动方式。提供 5 种高度与 2 种颜色可选。上部夹钳有 3 种尺寸可选或可关闭，且可通过开启限制滑块上下调整。固定脐带缆可独立于夹钳垂直调整，其长度可通过开启限制滑块调整或直接关闭。

src: A small-size fallback-type service tower inspired by the transporter-erector used for the Falcon 9, but in a shorter, slimmer form. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has 4 height and 2 color options. The upper clamp has three size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted vertically with its deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals are moved vertically with a separate slider, and their length can be adjusted with their deploy limit slider, or turned off.
zh: 小型后倒式勤务塔，灵感源自猎鹰9号的运输起竖器（T/E），但外观更短更细。具有两种后倒收起方式：仅由分级触发的单步完全收起，以及发射前先小幅后仰一部分、起飞时再单独完全收起的两步手动方式。提供 4 种高度与 2 种颜色可选。上部夹钳有 3 种尺寸可选或可关闭，且可通过开启限制滑块垂直调整。固定脐带缆可通过单独滑块垂直移动，其长度可通过开启限制滑块调整或直接关闭。

src: The core for the Large Modular Multi Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options.
zh: 大型模块化多功能勤务塔核心节，包含底座和一个 10m 塔段。可在塔顶连接额外的塔段。塔座可关闭以允许堆叠额外的核心节。提供 8 种颜色可选。

src: The core for the Medium Modular Multi Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options.
zh: 中型模块化多功能勤务塔核心节，包含底座和一个 10m 塔段。可在塔顶连接额外的塔段。塔座可关闭以允许堆叠额外的核心节。提供 8 种颜色可选。

src: A matching top for the Modular Multi Tower, with a base plate variant for each tower size and 3 optional masts. The masts have various height and size combinations, and the top detail cab configured in 3 ways as well. The center mast is fixed, and the two outer masts can be adjusted in horizontal position in both the X and Z axis with the deploy limit sliders, and all three masts can be turned off individually as well. The masts also have 9 color options.
zh: 模块化多功能塔配套塔顶，每种塔身尺寸均配有对应底板，并带 3 根可选桅杆。桅杆具有多种高度和尺寸组合，顶部细节也可进行 3 种配置。中央桅杆固定，两侧外桅杆可在 X 轴和 Z 轴上通过开启限制滑块水平调整位置，且三根桅杆均可单独关闭。桅杆还提供 9 种颜色可选。

src: Not a launch base. A slim general-use clamp platform for mounting and attaching ground structures. The suppport beams extend downwards for a long distance for use on uneven terrain. Comes in 8 frame color options.
zh: 非发射台底座。一款用于安装与固定地面结构的轻型通用固定平台。支撑梁向下延伸很长一段距离，便于在起伏地形上使用。提供 8 种框架颜色可选。

src: Add-on multi-configurable platform for the N1 Tower, which didn't use swing arms or umbilicals as it was not a launch tower. There are 2 size and 5 length variants for the main structure. The walkway has 4 styles, and can be extended in length with the slider. Optional top railings are available as well, and all railings have 9 color options. The walkway can be retracted by staging or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: N1 勤务塔的多重可配置扩展平台，因其并非发射塔，所以未配备摆臂或脐带缆。主结构提供 2 种尺寸和 5 种长度变体。走道有 4 种样式，且可通过滑块延伸长度。还提供可选的顶部栏杆，所有栏杆均有 9 种颜色可选。走道可通过分级收回，也可手动或通过动作组收回。

src: SpaceX-inspired crew access arm for the Tundra Exploration Rodan (Crew Dragon) command pod, designed to fit on the Shuttle FSS tower crew access section. The arm uses the Rodan Crew Arm setting in the FSS crew access section, and attaches on the left main vertical beam of the section. The arm only has one retraction direction. There are 4 arm length variants, and the end section can be adjusted inward up to 1.25m with the deploy limit slider. The end section also has 2 types of pod hatch interfaces. How far the arm retracts can be adjusted using the arm's deploy limit sider.
zh: 受SpaceX启发的登船臂，专为 Tundra Exploration 的 Rodan（载人龙飞船）指令舱设计，可适配在航天飞机 FSS 塔架的人员通道段上。该臂需使用 FSS 人员通道段中的 Rodan Crew Arm 设置，并安装在该段的左侧主垂直梁上。该臂仅有一个收回方向。共有 4 种臂长变体，端部可通过开启限制滑块向内调节最多 1.25m。端部还提供 2 种舱门对接界面。摆臂的收回距离可通过其开启限制滑块调节。

src: A flat slab service mast styled after that used for the Ariane V rocket, with multiple height options and available in 3 colors. Both the lower and upper sections can be switched from zero to 10 meters in height. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 平直板状勤务桅杆，风格参考阿丽亚娜 5 号火箭所用设施，拥有多种高度选项并提供 3 种颜色。下段和上段的高度均可在 0 至 10 米之间切换。配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: A single-part version of the Delta II-style unmanned service tower, with 5 height variants. Various structural details can be configured in different ways to create alternate versions of the tower for earlier Deltas. Default color is "Delta Blue", but 7 others are also available. Uses the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 德尔塔 II 风格无人勤务塔的单部件版本，具有 5 种高度变体。可通过配置多种结构细节来构建早期德尔塔火箭的改型塔架。默认颜色为“德尔塔蓝”，另有 7 种颜色可选。配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: A 2m high core section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach the mast core sections to the top of the base. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical.
zh: 宇宙神 V 倾斜式勤务桅杆模块化版本的 2m 高核心段。将桅杆核心段安装在基座顶部。提供 8 种颜色选项。配合通用脐带缆、摆臂以及小型脐带缆使用。

src: A multi-height core section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach the mast core sections to the top of the base. Four height variants and eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical.
zh: 宇宙神 V 倾斜式勤务桅杆模块化版的多高度核心段。将桅杆核心段安装在基座顶部。提供 4 种高度变体和 8 种颜色选项。配合通用脐带缆、摆臂以及小型脐带缆使用。

src: The large angled top section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach to the highest core section. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical.
zh: 宇宙神 V 倾斜式勤务桅杆模块化版的大型倾斜顶部段。安装在最高的核心段上。提供 8 种颜色选项。配合通用脐带缆、摆臂以及小型脐带缆使用。

src: A 2.5m high section for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the tower sections to the top of the base. This section has multiple detail options, with the side panels, platforms, front poles and back detail all swichable among various settings. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical.
zh: 德尔塔 II 风格勤务塔模块化版本的 2.5m 高塔段。将塔架段安装在基座顶部。该段包含多种细节选项，侧板、平台、前立柱和后部细节均可在多种设置间切换。提供 8 种颜色选项。配合通用脐带缆、摆臂以及小型脐带缆使用。

src: A multi-height core section for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the tower sections to the top of the base. This section only has a toggle for the side panels, as it is for the main part if the tower. Add the detail section to get switchable detail options. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 德尔塔 II 风格勤务塔模块化版的多高度核心段。将塔架段安装在基座顶部。由于是塔架主体部分，该段仅有侧板开关。添加细节段可获得可切换的细节选项。提供 8 种颜色选项。配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: The top plate for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the to the top of a tower section. The top has two switchable styles of mast, or it can be turned off. There is also a toggleable detail. Eight color options for the railings and detail are available.
zh: 德尔塔 II 风格勤务塔模块化版的顶板。安装在塔架段顶部。顶部包含两种可切换样式的桅杆，亦可关闭。还包含一个可开关的细节部件。栏杆和细节构件提供 8 种颜色选项。

src: The core for the Titan III and IV Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the tower. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. The front structure can be toggled on or off. Available in 8 color options.
zh: 大力神 III 和 IV 模块化勤务塔的核心段，包含基座和一个 10m 高塔架段。在塔架顶部可安装额外的塔架段。塔架基座可关闭，以便堆叠额外的核心段。前部结构可开关切换。提供 8 种颜色选项。

src: A fixed 2.5m high additional section for the Titan III and IV Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. The front mount rail can be toggled on or off. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms
zh: 大力神 III 和 IV 模块化勤务塔的固定 2.5m 高附加段，提供 8 种颜色。前部安装导轨可开关切换。还提供多种配置的选装侧板。配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: Large-size simple beam-type animated swing arm for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and arm beam and mount have 8 color options. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 大型简易横梁式动效摆臂，适用于小型勤务塔和乘员升降梯，管路提供 4 种颜色选项。安装底座可在标准短型和具有更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，臂梁和底座均提供 8 种颜色选项。摆臂长度可通过开启限制滑块调节。动作可随分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组触发。

src: Medium-size simple beam-type animated swing arm for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and arm beam and mount have 8 color options. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 中型简易横梁式动效摆臂，适用于小型勤务塔和乘员升降梯，管路提供 4 种颜色选项。安装底座可在标准短型和具有更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，臂梁和底座均提供 8 种颜色选项。摆臂长度可通过开启限制滑块调节。动作可随分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组触发。

src: Small-size simple beam-type animated swing arm for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and arm beam and mount have 8 color options. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 小型简易横梁式动效摆臂，适用于小型勤务塔和乘员升降梯，管路提供 4 种颜色选项。安装底座可在标准短型和具有更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，臂梁和底座均提供 8 种颜色选项。摆臂长度可通过开启限制滑块调节。动作可随分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组触发。

src: Large-size animated general swing arm for the general and specialty towers, available in 8 colors. The arm swing can be done in the default or alternate direction by using the appropriate toggle; arm swing done by staging is only in the default direction. The umbilical connectors can be switched between conventional end type and Delta IV side type; side type can be on either side of the arm depending on arm swing direction. The end connecters have 5 style options, and the side connectors can be tall or short, with the center and outer sets separately toggleable. Each of the arm pipes can be switched among 4 colors. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. The spacing of the outer umbilical rails for the side style can be decreased using its deploy limit slider.
zh: 大型通用动效摆臂，适用于通用与专用塔架，提供 8 种颜色。可通过对应开关使摆臂按默认或反向摆动；通过分级触发的摆臂仅沿默认方向摆动。脐带缆接头可在常规端部型和德尔塔 IV 侧向型之间切换；侧向型可根据摆臂摆动方向配置在任一侧。端部接头提供 5 种样式，侧向接头可选高或矮，且中心组和外侧组可独立开关。每条臂管均有 4 种颜色可选。臂长可通过开启限制滑块调节。侧向样式的外侧脐带缆导轨间距可通过其开启限制滑块缩小。

src: Medium-size animated general swing arm for the general and specialty towers, available in 8 colors. The arm swing can be done in the default or alternate direction by using the appropriate toggle; arm swing done by staging is only in the default direction. The umbilical connectors can be switched between conventional end type and Delta IV side type; side type can be on either side of the arm depending on arm swing direction. The end connecters have 5 style options, and the side connectors can be tall or short, with the center and outer sets separately toggleable. Each of the arm pipes can be switched among 4 colors. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. The spacing of the outer umbilical rails for the side style can be decreased using its deploy limit slider.
zh: 用于通用和专用发射塔的中型动画通用摆臂，有 8 种颜色可选。可通过对应的开关使摆臂朝默认或反向摆动；通过分级触发的摆臂摆动仅向默认方向进行。脐带连接器可在常规端接式与德尔塔 IV 侧接式之间切换；侧接式可根据摆臂摆动方向置于摆臂任意一侧。端部连接器有 5 种样式可选，侧部连接器可选高或矮，且中心与外侧组可分别开关。每根摆臂管路可在 4 种颜色间切换。摆臂长度可通过开启限制滑块调节。侧接样式的外部脐带滑轨间距可通过其开启限制滑块缩小。

src: Small-size animated general swing arm for the general and specialty towers, available in 8 colors. The arm swing can be done in the default or alternate direction by using the appropriate toggle; arm swing done by staging is only in the default direction. The umbilical connectors can be switched between conventional end type and Delta IV side type; side type can be on either side of the arm depending on arm swing direction. The end connecters have 5 style options, and the side connectors can be tall or short, with the center and outer sets separately toggleable. Each of the arm pipes can be switched among 4 colors. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. The spacing of the outer umbilical rails for the side style can be decreased using its deploy limit slider.
zh: 适用于通用及专用塔架的小型带动画通用摆臂，有8种颜色可选。使用相应开关可让摆臂沿默认或反向摆动；分级触发的摆臂摆动仅支持默认方向。脐带接头可在常规端部型与德尔塔IV侧向型之间切换；侧向型可根据摆臂摆动方向配置在任一侧。端部接头有5种样式可选，侧向接头可选高或矮款式，中心组与外侧组可单独开关。各摆臂管路均可在4种颜色间切换。使用开启限制滑块可调整摆臂长度。侧向样式的外侧脐带导轨间距可通过其开启限制滑块进行缩小。

zh_samples: 用于对较小型火箭级段进行水平静载点火测试的通用托架式试车台。该台架具有两种尺寸和八种颜色选项。托架可配置不同尺寸的储箱环或固定夹持支撑梁。侧支撑夹具位置可通过各自的开启限制滑块在水平和垂直方向上进行调节，亦可关闭。

src: General cradle-type test stand for doing horizontal static fire testing of smaller rocket stages. The stand has two size and eight color options. The cradle can be configured with tank rings of various sizes or with a beam of fixed clamp supports. The side support clamp positions can be adjusted horizontally and vertically with their respective deploy limit sliders, or turned off.
zh: 用于对较小型火箭级段进行水平静载点火测试的通用托架式试车台。该台架具有两种尺寸和八种颜色选项。托架可配置不同尺寸的储箱环或固定夹持支撑梁。侧支撑夹具位置可通过各自的开启限制滑块在水平和垂直方向上进行调节，亦可关闭。

src: General test stand for doing static fire testing of smaller liquid fuel engines. The stand has four sizes of mount plates for attaching engines to and eight color options. Has fuel generators and on-board fuel capacity to fuel engines during testing.
zh: 用于对较小型液体燃料发动机进行静载点火测试的通用试车台。该台架具有四种尺寸的发动机安装板和八种颜色选项。内置燃料发生器与板载储罐，可在测试期间为发动机供应燃料。

src: General tower-type test stand for doing vertical static fire testing of larger and/or longer rocket stages. The stand has five tower height sizes and eight color options; the tower can also be turned off. The bottom hold-downs can be switched between side-clamp and vertical bolt types. The bottom hold-down and the top clamp positions can be adjusted with their respective deploy limit sliders.
zh: 用于对较大及/或较长火箭级段进行垂直静载点火测试的通用塔式试车台。该台架具有五种塔架高度规格和八种颜色选项；塔架本身亦可关闭。底部固定装置可在侧向夹具与垂直螺栓类型之间切换。底部固定装置与顶部夹具位置均可通过各自的开启限制滑块进行调节。

src: Droop-style animated drop umbilical with 5 color options. The umbilical can be lengthened by adjusting the deploy limit slider, and there is also an adjustable-length extension tube. The mount has 8 color options. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 下垂式带动画下落脐带，提供5种颜色选项。通过调整开启限制滑块可延长脐带，并配备长度可调的延伸管。安装座提供8种颜色选项。动画可通过分级触发，或通过手动/动作组触发。

src: Stretched droop-style animated drop umbilical with 5 color options. The umbilical can be lengthened by adjusting the deploy limit slider, and there is also an adjustable-length extension tube. The mount has 8 color options. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 加长下垂式带动画下落脐带，提供5种颜色选项。通过调整开启限制滑块可延长脐带，并配备长度可调的延伸管。安装座提供8种颜色选项。动画可通过分级触发，或通过手动/动作组触发。

src: Droop-style animated drop umbilical for the Atlas I/II Tower, with 5 color options. This is an asymmetrical umbilical that is mounted near the top of the tower and connects with the upper part of the Atlas 4m fairing. It can be lengthened by adjusting the deploy limit slider, and there is also an adjustable-length extension tube. The mount has 8 color options. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 适用于宇宙神I/II型塔架的下垂式带动画下落脐带，提供5种颜色选项。这是一种非对称脐带，安装在塔架顶部附近，连接宇宙神4米整流罩的上半部分。可通过调整开启限制滑块进行延长，并配有长度可调的延伸管。安装座提供8种颜色选项。动画可通过分级触发，或通过手动/动作组触发。

src: Large-size animated drop umbilical pipe for the general and specialty towers, available in 4 colors. The mount also has 2 size options, the normal short one and an extended beam long version, both with 8 color options. The umbilical can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 适用于通用及专用塔架的大型带动画下落脐带管，有4种颜色可选。安装座亦有2种尺寸可选：常规短款与延长梁长款，两者均有8种颜色可选。脐带长度可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。动画可通过分级触发，或通过手动/动作组触发。

src: Medium-size animated drop umbilical pipe for the general and specialty towers, available in 4 colors. The mount also has 2 size options, the normal short one and an extended beam long version, both with 8 color options. The umbilical can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 适用于通用及专用塔架的中型带动画下落脐带管，有4种颜色可选。安装座亦有2种尺寸可选：常规短款与延长梁长款，两者均有8种颜色可选。脐带长度可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。动画可通过分级触发，或通过手动/动作组触发。

src: Small-size animated drop umbilical for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and both have 8 color options. The pipe can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped.
zh: 适用于小型勤务塔与乘员电梯的小型带动画下落脐带，管道有4种颜色可选。安装座可在标准短型与净空更大的长梁型之间切换，两者均有8种颜色可选。管道长度可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。动画可通过分级触发，或通过手动/动作组触发。

src: A specialized rectangular launch plate for the new TantaresLV Energia rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A specialized rectangular launch plate designed for Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy-style rockets. Insert sections can be turned off for Falcon Heavy/tri-core rockets. The plate can accomodate the Large General Fallback Tower, attached to the node on the wider side of the plate. Use the Medium General Drop-Arm Hold-Downs for Falcon 9-sized (2.5m) rockets. There is also a special tower attach node for the Shuttle FSS Tower with Rodan Crew Arm. The plate also has rotattion options, to enable proper rotation of a non-square launch clamps. The plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A specialized giant-sized round launch plate for the new TantaresLV N1 rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

Specialized animated swing arm for the Delta IV rocket. This is the lowest arm, which provides umbilicals for the core tanks. The arm's length and spread of the outer umbilical rails can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The length of the umbilicals can also be separately adjusted, and the truss block spacers can be turned off as well, or the whole umbilical assembly can be turned off completely. The arm has 8 color options, and the two sets of arm pipes can be separately switched among 4 colors. Arm retraction is in only one direction.
zh: 德尔塔 IV 火箭专用的动画摆臂。这是最低的一根摆臂，为核心级贮箱提供脐带缆连接。摆臂长度和外部脐带滑轨展开度可通过开启限制滑块调节。脐带缆长度也可单独调节，桁架垫块可以关闭，或者彻底关闭整个脐带组件。摆臂有 8 种颜色可选，两组摆臂管路可在 4 种颜色间独立切换。摆臂仅向单一方向回缩。

src: Specialized animated swing arm for the Delta IV rocket. This is the middle arm, which provides umbilicals for the DCSS upper stage. The arm's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit slider. The length of the umbilical can also be adjusted. The arm has 8 color options, and the two sets of arm pipes can be separately switched among 4 colors. Arm retraction is in only one direction.
zh: 专为德尔塔-4（Delta IV）火箭设计的动画摆臂。这是中臂，用于为DCSS上面级提供脐带连接。摆臂长度可通过开启限制滑块调节。脐带管线长度也可调整。摆臂有8种颜色可选，两组摆臂管线可分别在4种颜色间切换。摆臂仅支持单向回缩。

src: Specialized animated swing arm for the Delta IV rocket. This is the upper arm, which provides umbilicals for the fairing. The arm's length and vertical angle can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The length of the umbilical can also be adjusted. The arm has 8 color options, and the two sets of arm pipes can be separately switched among 5 colors. Arm retraction is in only one direction.
zh: 专为德尔塔-4（Delta IV）火箭设计的动画摆臂。这是上臂，用于为整流罩提供脐带连接。摆臂的长度和俯仰角可通过开启限制滑块调节。脐带管线长度也可调整。摆臂有8种颜色可选，两组摆臂管线可分别在5种颜色间切换。摆臂仅支持单向回缩。

src: A slimline general-use launch clamp, in between the integrated launch stands and the larger general launch bases. This is the medium frame type, and has multiple sizes of both square and rectangular exhaust holes. Uses separate towers and hold-downs. Built-in ladders can be switched both in height (short or tall) or color (default or yellow).
zh: 纤薄型通用发射架，介于一体式发射台与大型通用发射基座之间。此为中型框架款，提供多种尺寸的正方形和长方形排气孔。使用独立的服务塔和系留装置。内置爬梯可在高度（短或高）和颜色（默认或黄色）间切换。

src: A slimline general-use launch clamp platform, in between the integrated launch stands and the larger general launch bases. This is the mini frame type, and has multiple sizes of both square and rectangular exhaust holes. Uses separate towers and hold-downs. Built-in ladders can be switched both in height (short or tall) or color (default or yellow).
zh: 纤薄型通用发射架平台，介于一体式发射台与大型通用发射基座之间。此为微型框架款，提供多种尺寸的正方形和长方形排气孔。使用独立的服务塔和系留装置。内置爬梯可在高度（短或高）和颜色（默认或黄色）间切换。

src: A slimline general-use launch clamp platform, in between the integrated launch stands and the larger general launch bases. This is the small frame type, and has multiple sizes of both square and rectangular exhaust holes. Uses separate towers and hold-downs. Built-in ladders can be switched both in height (short or tall) or color (default or yellow).
zh: 纤薄型通用发射架平台，介于一体式发射台与大型通用发射基座之间。此为小型框架款，提供多种尺寸的正方形和长方形排气孔。使用独立的服务塔和系留装置。内置爬梯可在高度（短或高）和颜色（默认或黄色）间切换。

src: Animated general-use truss-type fallback tower with multiple height variants and three integrated animated drop umbilicals. Each umbilical has three size variants and 5 color options, and can be separately moved down up to 15 meters and adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit sliders, and can be turned off as well. The tower also has 8 color options. The tower can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging.
zh: 桁架式通用后倾服务塔（带动画），具备多种高度构型和三个内置动画下垂脐带管。每根脐带管拥有三种尺寸和5种颜色可选，可通过开启限制滑块独立向下延伸至多15米或微调水平位置，亦可直接关闭。塔架本身拥有8种颜色选项。塔架可通过手动触发动画或分级控制进行后倾撤离。

src: Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has different shapes for 6m and 8m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the sides have 3 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladder can be toggled in 2 height variants, and the ladder and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.

Medium size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has three different shapes for 4m and 6m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.

Micro size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has a two 1.5m wide exhaust holes with square and rectangular shapes, and a 2.5m wide square shape. The base frame has 8 color options. The ladders can be toggled on or off, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.

Mini size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheels or fixed footing styles. Has a 3 shapes of exhaust holes in 1.5m and 2.5m widths, and a 3.5m square hole. The base frame has 8 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.

Small size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has two special exhaust hole variants for the BDB Atlas V and KNES Ariane 5, plus other shapes in 2m, 3m and 4m widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the side panels have 2 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.

BIG Extra Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Wider than the Sandbox/Tier 3 launch pad static, the support columns will sit in the ground. Has different shapes for 10m, 14m and 18m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.

A specialty launch stand for the Aerobee and other small sounding rockets, inspired by two versions of the real Aerobee launch tower. The Aerobee was indeed placed inside the tower onto a rail. This is actually a launch clamp, and the clamp parts can be turned off for a better look. The tower has both triangular and square styles with multiple height variants. The launch rail inside is purely cosmetic with no collider, and its position can be adjusted with the slider. The optional cover structure has 4 height variants. Tower has 9 color options.
zh: 专用于“航空蜜蜂”（Aerobee）及其他小型探空火箭的专用发射架，灵感源自两款现实中的 Aerobee 发射塔。现实中的 Aerobee 确实是置于塔架内的导轨上发射的。该部件实际上是一个发射稳定支架，可关闭支架部分以获得更美观的外观。塔架提供三角形和方形两种款式，并具有多种高度变体。内部的发射导轨仅起装饰作用且无碰撞体，其位置可通过滑块调节。可选的防护罩结构有 4 种高度变体。塔架提供 9 种颜色选项。

src: A specialized single-piece service tower for the Atlas-Agena rocket. The tower section has 6 height options. The tower has 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Atlas-Agena Umbilical Arm, which attaches to the node on the cut-out on the front of the tower.
zh: 专用于宇宙神-阿金纳（Atlas-Agena）火箭的专用一体式勤务塔。塔身部分有 6 种高度选项，并提供 8 种颜色选项。配合独立的宇宙神-阿金纳脐带臂使用，可安装在塔架前方的切口节点上。

src: Animated retracting umbilical arm for the Atlas-Centaur I/II Service Tower. This is the upper arm, and the umbilicals are placed on the flared base of the 4m fairing that was also used with the Atlas V. Alternate straight-on umbilical ends are also available. This arm retracts to the left when looking at the rocket from the tower. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging.
zh: 用于宇宙神-半人马座 I/II（Atlas-Centaur I/II）勤务塔的带动画缩回式脐带臂。此为上臂，脐带接口连接在 4m 整流罩的喇叭形基底上（该整流罩亦用于宇宙神 V）。亦提供备选的直通式脐带端头。从塔架面向火箭看时，该臂向左侧缩回。悬臂梁提供 8 种颜色选项。该臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。

src: Animated retracting umbilical arm for the Atlas-Centaur I/II Service Tower. This is the middle arm, and the umbilicals are placed so they are straddling the bottom of the Centaur stage and the top of the interstage. This arm retracts to the right when looking at the rocket from the tower. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging.
zh: 用于宇宙神-半人马座 I/II（Atlas-Centaur I/II）勤务塔的带动画缩回式脐带臂。此为中臂，脐带接口跨接在半人马座级底部与级间段顶部之间。从塔架面向火箭看时，该臂向右侧缩回。悬臂梁提供 8 种颜色选项。该臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。

src: Animated retracting wind damper arm for the Atlas-Centaur I/II Service Tower. This is the lower arm, and the end connector is placed just above the bottom of the Atlas I/II interstage. This arm retracts downwards at launch. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging.
zh: 用于宇宙神-半人马座 I/II（Atlas-Centaur I/II）勤务塔的带动画缩回式抗风阻尼臂。此为下臂，末端连接器置于宇宙神 I/II 级间段底部稍上方。发射时该臂向下缩回。悬臂梁提供 8 种颜色选项。该臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。

src: Separate standalone version of the Atlas Side Clamp Arm, for use as a hold-down with other launch bases and plates. The arm has 2 color options, and the mount can be turned off for use with the separate Atlas Side Umbilical. The retraction animation can be be done manually or via staging.
zh: 宇宙神侧夹紧臂的独立版本，可用作其他发射底座和托板的压紧装置。该臂提供 2 种颜色选项，安装基座可关闭以便与独立的宇宙神侧脐带配合使用。缩回动画可手动执行或通过分级触发。

src: Animated vertical retracting umbilical arm for the Atlas-Agena. Designed to mount on the Atlas-Agena Service Tower, but can be used with other towers as well. The arm's umbilical section has two height variants. It has four integrated animated drop umbilicals (with one being a pair), each with separate color options, and each can be turned off as well. Each umbilical is adjusted vertically and horizontally the associated deploy limit sliders. The arm also has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. Use with the Atlas Launch Stand for best effect.
zh: 用于宇宙神-阿金纳（Atlas-Agena）的垂直缩回动画脐带臂。专为安装在宇宙神-阿金纳勤务塔上设计，但也可用于其他塔架。该臂的脐带段有两种高度变体。内置 4 组带下垂动画的脐带（其中一组为双线），每组均有独立的颜色选项且均可关闭。各脐带均可通过对应的开启限制滑块进行垂直和水平调节。悬臂亦提供 8 种颜色选项。该臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。配合宇宙神发射架使用效果最佳。

src: Separate version of the tall animated vertical retracting umbilical arm for the Centaur upper stage used on the Atlas SLV-3 rocket, for attaching to the top plates or nodes of other towers. This arm normally straddled the Centaur tank-fairing junction. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. The retractor device behind the arm can be toggled on/off.
zh: 用于宇宙神 SLV-3 火箭前半人马座上面级的高位带垂直缩回动画脐带臂的独立版本，用于安装在其他塔架的顶板或节点上。该臂通常跨接在半人马座贮箱与整流罩的连接处。悬臂梁提供 8 种颜色选项。该臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。悬臂后方的缩回装置可开启/关闭。

src: Separate version of the short animated vertical retracting umbilical arm for the Centaur upper stage used on the Atlas SLV-3 rocket, for attaching to the top plates or nodes of other towers. This arm normally straddled the Centaur interstage-tank junction. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. The retractor device behind the arm can be toggled on/off.
zh: 用于宇宙神 SLV-3 火箭前半人马座上面级的低位带垂直缩回动画脐带臂的独立版本，用于安装在其他塔架的顶板或节点上。该臂通常跨接在半人马座级间段与贮箱的连接处。悬臂梁提供 8 种颜色选项。该臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。悬臂后方的缩回装置可开启/关闭。

src: A specialized single-piece service tower for the Atlas-SLV Centaur D rocket. The tower section has 5 height options. The tower has 9 color options as well. Uses the separate Atlas-Centaur Umbilical Arms, which attaches to the node on the top of the tower.
zh: 专用于宇宙神-SLV 半人马座 D（Atlas-SLV Centaur D）火箭的一体式勤务塔。塔身部分有 5 种高度选项，并提供 9 种颜色选项。配合独立的宇宙神-半人马座脐带臂使用，可安装在塔架顶部的节点上。

src: A specialized single-piece service tower for the Atlas I and II rocket. The tower section has 4 height options and 9 color options as well. Uses the separate Atlas-Centaur I/II Umbilical Arms, which attach to the two nodes on the sides of the tower. The Atlas I/II Wind Damper Arm attaches to the lower center node. The uppermost node on the Mast 3 pipe is for a drop umbilical, there is a specialized Atlas I/II umbilical available but the general umbilicals will work also. There are also optional general arm attach nodes.
zh: 专用于宇宙神 I 和 II（Atlas I/II）火箭的专用一体式勤务塔。塔身部分有 4 种高度选项和 9 种颜色选项。配合独立的宇宙神-半人马座 I/II 脐带臂使用，可安装在塔架两侧的两个节点上。宇宙神 I/II 抗风阻尼臂安装在中部下方节点。3 号桅杆管道最顶部的节点用于安装垂落脐带，可选用专用宇宙神 I/II 脐带，通用脐带亦可适用。此外还提供可选的通用悬臂安装节点。

src: A very low profile minimalist round launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A very low profile minimalist square launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. Square or rectangular exhust hole configurations can be selected. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A modified version of the Atlas Launch Stand without a frame and with separately adjustable center and side section. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A specialized launch stand for the Atlas SLV and derivatives from Bluedog Design Bureau, based on the real launch mount that the Atlas used. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

zh_samples: 带有动画的双联垂直缩回式脐带臂，用于宇宙神 SLV-3 半人马座 D 火箭的半人马座上面级。双臂夹抱半人马座级，下臂跨接在级间段与储箱的分界处，上臂跨接在储箱与整流罩的连接处。专为安装在宇宙神-半人马座勤务塔上设计，但也可用于其他勤务塔。整
用于水星-宇宙神载人电梯的专用“水星”飞船脐带柱，该电梯同时兼作发射脐带塔。它安装在电梯塔前平台正上方管道顶部的节点上。脐带可通过展开限制滑块调节长度。可通过手动操作或借助 Animated Decouplers 通过分级触发缩回。
一种小型载人飞船登船电梯，灵感源自水星-宇宙神使用的紧急撤离与脐带塔，专为 1 级发射台和宇宙神发射架设计，但也可用于部分其他发射底座和发射架。该电梯塔为固定式，有 8 种颜色可选。电梯轿厢的停靠高度可通过展开限制滑块调节。需配合水星-宇宙

src: Animated twin vertical retracting umbilical arms for the Centaur upper stage used on the Atlas SLV-3 Centaur D rocket. The arms bracket the Centaur stage, with the bottom arm straddling the interdstage-tank division, and the upper arm stradding the tank-fairing junction. Designed to mount on the Atlas-Centaur Service Tower, but can be used with other towers as well. The whole arm frame assembly can be adjusted upward by using the offset gizmo for fine positioning. The upper tall arm (Arm 1) can be adjusted in both horizontal and vertical position using the deploy limit sliders. The lower flat arm can be adjusted horizontally with its slider. The arms and frame also have 8 color options. The arms can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. Use with the Atlas Launch Stand for best effect.
zh: 带有动画的双联垂直缩回式脐带臂，用于宇宙神 SLV-3 半人马座 D 火箭的半人马座上面级。双臂夹抱半人马座级，下臂跨接在级间段与储箱的分界处，上臂跨接在储箱与整流罩的连接处。专为安装在宇宙神-半人马座勤务塔上设计，但也可用于其他勤务塔。整个臂架组件可使用平移小工具向上微调位置。较高的上臂（1号臂）可通过展开限制滑块调节水平和垂直位置。较扁平的下臂可通过其滑块调节水平位置。臂和支架均提供 8 种颜色可选。脐带臂可通过手动切换动画或通过分级触发缩回。与宇宙神发射架配合使用效果最佳。

src: A special Mercury Spacecraft umbilical for the Mercury-Atlas Crew Elevator, which also doubled as the Launch Umbilical Tower. It attaches to the node on top of the pipe that sits just above the front platform of the elevator tower. The umbilical can be adjusted in lenght with the deploy limit slider. Retraction can be done manually or via staging with Animated Decouplers.

src: A crew access elevator for small manned spacecraft, inspired by the emergency egress and umbilical tower used for Mercury-Atlas and designed for the Tier 1 launch pad and the Atlas Launch Stand, but can be used with some other launch bases and stands. The elevator tower is a fixed type, with 8 colors available. The stopping height of the elevator car is adjusted with a deploy limit slider. Use with the Mercury-Atlas Elevator Crew Walkway, which attaches to one of the front nodes, and flips up to retract. The separate Mercury Umbilical Mast attaches to a node on the front platform of the tower. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: 一种小型载人飞船登船电梯，灵感源自水星-宇宙神使用的紧急撤离与脐带塔，专为 1 级发射台和宇宙神发射架设计，但也可用于部分其他发射底座和发射架。该电梯塔为固定式，有 8 种颜色可选。电梯轿厢的停靠高度可通过展开限制滑块调节。需配合水星-宇宙神电梯人员通道栈桥使用，栈桥安装在塔架前方的其中一个节点上，可向上翻折缩回。独立的水星脐带桅杆则安装在塔架前平台的节点上。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入方式。

src: A crew access elevator for Gemini spacecraft, inspired by the erector used for the Titan II-Gemini. Designed for use with the mtaching Titan II Launch Stand, but also can be used with other Launch Stands, Plates and Bases. The elevator tower fits around the Titan II or other rocket, with the access floor in the top white room fitting close to the capsule. Both the elevator car maximum height and the access floor height can be adjusted with their deploy limit sliders so they match up with each other. The elevator tower has three height variants, and is a downward rotating type, with an exterior elevator car. The front white panels on the tower can be retracted if desired. There is only one color option for the tower. Hatches on the elevator car allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 用于双子座飞船的人员登船电梯，灵感源自大力神 II-双子座使用的起竖架。专为配套的大力神 II 发射架设计，但也可用于其他发射架、发射板和发射底座。电梯塔可环绕大力神 II 或其他火箭，顶部洁净室的登船通道地面贴合返回舱。轿厢的最大高度与登船通道地面高度均可通过各自的展开限制滑块进行调节，以实现精准对齐。电梯塔有三种高度构型，为向下旋转收放式，配有外挂式电梯轿厢。如果需要，塔架正面的白色壁板可以缩回收起。该塔架仅有 1 种颜色可选。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入方式。

src: A crew access elevator for small manned spacecraft, inspired by the rollback gantry used for Mercury-Redstone and designed for the Tier 1 launch pad and the Redstone Launch Stand, but can be used with some other launch bases and stands. The elevator tower is an animated rollback type, with 8 colors available. The stopping height of the elevator car is adjusted with a deploy limit slider. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: 一种小型载人飞船登船电梯，灵感源自水星-红石使用的后撤式门架，专为 1 级发射台和红石发射架设计，但也可用于部分其他发射底座和发射架。电梯塔为带动画的后撤式，有 8 种颜色可选。电梯轿厢的停靠高度可通过展开限制滑块调节。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种出入方式。

src: The flip-up crew access walkway for the Mercury-Atlas Crew Elevator. It also has optional mounts for use with the Mini and Small General Crew Elevators. It attaches to one of the front center nodes on the elevator tower. Has 8 color options and three configurations of the capsule hatch interface plate.
zh: 水星-宇宙神载人电梯专用的上翻式登船通道栈桥。还提供可选挂架，以便与微型和小型通用载人电梯配合使用。它安装在电梯塔正前方正中的其中一个节点上。拥有 8 种颜色选项，并提供三种飞船舱门接口板构型。

src: Stackable multi-height core section for the modular Delta IV service tower. It has six height options, and additional sections can be stacked by turning off the base frame. Optional side panels in three styles can be selected. The base frame has no colliders on it, so it can be pushed under the VAB floor to help align the tower with the Delta IV rocket.
zh: 模块化德尔塔 IV 勤务塔的可堆叠多高度核心段。拥有 6 种高度可选，关闭基座支架后可堆叠额外的节段。可选 3 种样式的侧板。基座支架没有碰撞体积，可推入 VAB 地面下方以辅助塔架与德尔塔 IV 火箭对齐。

src: Stackable top section for the modular Delta IV service tower. It has optional side panels in three styles. Both the Delta IV tower side detail and front truss structure can be toggled on or off. The attach node at top is for the Delta IV Swing Arm 3.
zh: 模块化德尔塔 IV 勤务塔的可堆叠顶段。可选 3 种样式的侧板。德尔塔 IV 塔身侧面细节与正面结构钢架均可开启或关闭。顶部的连接节点用于安装德尔塔 IV 3号摆臂。

src: A specialized service tower for the Delta IV, styled after the actual Delta IV Fixed Service Tower at the Cape. It has two height options, default Delta IV height and a 6m extended variant. The front part of the upper external trusswork can be turned off, which all replaces the default Delta IV swing arm nodes with 7 general-type nodes. The base frame has no colliders on it, so it can be pushed under the VAB floor to help align the tower with the Delta IV rocket.
zh: 德尔塔 IV 的专用勤务塔，仿照卡纳维拉尔角真实的德尔塔 IV 固定式勤务塔设计。拥有两种高度可选：默认德尔塔 IV 高度以及 6m 加高构型。上部外侧桁架的前半部分可以关闭，关闭后会将默认的德尔塔 IV 摆臂节点替换为 7 个通用节点。基座支架没有碰撞体积，可推入 VAB 地面下方以辅助塔架与德尔塔 IV 火箭对齐。

src: A specialty launch stand for the Delta IV rocket, both the single and triple-core versions. By default it is set up for the Delta IV from Bluedog Design Bureau, which has 3.125m diameter core tanks. By adjusting the positions and width of the umbilical masts and hold-down posts with the deploy limit sliders, tank sizes of 2.5m can be accomodated as well. The stand is designed to sit flush on the launch pad surface, so move the stand down until the dark band on the bottom of the large corner support columns is on or slightly extending into the floor of the VAB. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Delta IV Service Tower for the full LC-37 Delta IV recreation.
zh: 德尔塔IV号火箭专用的发射架，适配单芯级与三芯级版本。默认配置适配 Bluedog Design Bureau 的德尔塔IV号（芯级储罐直径 3.125m）。通过调节开启限制滑块来改变脐带塔和限位柱的位置与宽度，也可以兼容 2.5m 直径的储罐。该发射架设计为与发射台表面齐平，放置时请向下移动发射架，直至大边角支撑柱底部的深色条纹贴齐或略微陷入 VAB 地面。发射架配有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机。搭配德尔塔IV号勤务塔使用，可完整还原真实的LC-37德尔塔IV号。

src: A general rectangular node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters with two small side boosters. Center and optional outer hold-down support plates can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit sliders. There are different combinations of integrated hold-down bolts and clamp arms, each of which can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The bolts can also be switched between short, tall and extended heights. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一款通用矩形节点附着式发射支架，适用于生涯早期，可容纳 2.5m、1.875m、1.5m、1.25m、0.9375m 和 0.625m 直径的火箭并附带两个小型侧置助推器。中央支承板和可选的外侧限位支承板均可通过开启限制滑块调节长度。提供多种组合的一体化限位螺栓和夹臂，均可通过各自的开启限制滑块向内调节，以对齐储罐底部或发动机挂架。螺栓还可在矮、高和加长三种高度间切换。加长高度螺栓带有一个额外的高度调节滑块。该发射台还配有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机。

src: Animated "petal" cover used for the deployed Jupiter IRBM sites. It is sized for 1.5m diameter rockets, namely the Jupiter from Bluedog Design Bureau. It attaches to an optional node in the Redstone Launch Stand; adjust the height until the base ring sits on the ground. The opening animation can be be done manually or via staging.
zh: 用于已部署 Jupiter IRBM 发射阵地的带动画“花瓣”掩蔽罩。尺寸适用于 1.5m 直径火箭，即 Bluedog Design Bureau 的 Jupiter 火箭。它可附着在 Redstone 发射台上的可选节点；调节高度直至底环接触地面。开启展开动画可手动触发，也可通过分级触发。

src: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Large size rail, meant for larger rockets of size 1.25m and up. Rockets are only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has built-in a decoupler. The rail can also be switched between the default forward direction and reverse. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction.
zh: 发射底座和发射台的附加部件，提供可旋转的导轨以进行倾斜发射。此为大型导轨，适用于 1.25m 及以上的较大型火箭。火箭只能表面附着在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨还可在默认的前进方向与反向之间切换。导轨的旋转可通过 B9PD 切换器进行，或者在安装了 Animated Attachment 时通过开启限制滑块动画来调节。Animated Attachment 方法需要将导轨或发射底座/发射台设为根部件，以联动带动附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨部件不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨可向前进方向旋转 100 度，或向反方向旋转 20 度。

src: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Medium size rail, meant for larger rockets of size 0.937m and up. Rockets are only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has built-in a decoupler. The rail can also be switched between the default forward direction and reverse. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction.
zh: 发射底座和发射台的附加部件，提供可旋转的导轨以进行倾斜发射。此为中型导轨，适用于 0.937m 及以上的火箭。火箭只能表面附着在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨还可在默认的前进方向与反向之间切换。导轨的旋转可通过 B9PD 切换器进行，或者在安装了 Animated Attachment 时通过开启限制滑块动画来调节。Animated Attachment 方法需要将导轨或发射底座/发射台设为根部件，以联动带动附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨部件不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨可向前进方向旋转 100 度，或向反方向旋转 20 度。

src: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Mini size rail (actually a rod), sized for 0.3125m and 0.625m rockets; the rod can be moved with the deploy limit slider. Rockets can be only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has a built-in decoupler. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction.
zh: 发射底座和发射台的附加部件，提供可旋转的导轨以进行倾斜发射。此为微型导轨（实际为导杆），适用于 0.3125m 和 0.625m 火箭；导杆可通过开启限制滑块移动。火箭只能表面附着在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨的旋转可通过 B9PD 切换器进行，或者在安装了 Animated Attachment 时通过开启限制滑块动画来调节。Animated Attachment 方法需要将导轨或发射底座/发射台设为根部件，以联动带动附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨部件不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨可向前进方向旋转 100 度，或向反方向旋转 20 度。

src: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Small size rail, meant for smaller rockets. Rockets are only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has built-in a decoupler. The rail can also be switched between the default forward direction and reverse. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction.
zh: 发射底座和发射台的附加部件，提供可旋转的导轨以进行倾斜发射。此为小型导轨，适用于较小型火箭。火箭只能表面附着在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨还可在默认的前进方向与反向之间切换。导轨的旋转可通过 B9PD 切换器进行，或者在安装了 Animated Attachment 时通过开启限制滑块动画来调节。Animated Attachment 方法需要将导轨或发射底座/发射台设为根部件，以联动带动附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨部件不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨可向前进方向旋转 100 度，或向反方向旋转 20 度。

src: A mini-size modular truss-type service tower for the launch stands and smaller rockets, with 3 height options. Additional tower sections can be stacked to create taller towers, with the base pad turned off. There are also optional side panels available in multiple configurations. The tower section has 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Small Drop Umbilicals which are node-attached to the front of the tower.
zh: 一种用于发射台和较小型火箭的微型模块化桁架式勤务塔，提供 3 种高度选项。可通过堆叠额外的塔段来搭建更高的发射塔，底座平台可选择关闭。还提供多种配置的可选侧板。塔段同样拥有 8 种配色方案。需搭配独立的小型下落式脐带管使用，该脐带管通过节点附着在塔架前部。

src: A general round node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters. The stand can be configured as the base flat ring or with a conical extension. Support plates for the integrated hold-downs are configured separately, allowing a mix of bolts and clamp arms. The hold-down bolts are non-animated and have 4 configurations and 3 heights, and can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. There are optional integrated side clamps available in different configurations, and are also adjusted with their deploy limit slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising tiny rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.3125m or 0.625m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising small rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.9375, 1.25m or 1.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising medium rockets up from the ground. Has three height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 1.875m or 2.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.

zh_samples: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔架的模块化乘员通道段，用于通过乘员通道臂和独立的乘员登机楼层登入航天器。该段提供两种高度选项以便更好地对齐通道臂与楼层，并拥有两种颜色选项：默认灰与备选黑白。独立的乘员登机楼层安装在塔段内部的节点上，可上下移动以使楼层
航天飞机发射台FSS塔架的模块化多高度核心段。该段提供六种高度，每种高度均有两种颜色选项：默认灰与备选黑白。用于安装储箱间通道结构（仅需一个）的节点位于塔架核心的右侧。还包含可选侧板，各侧可单独切换。
航天飞机发射台FSS塔乘员通道段的独立通道平台，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部未对齐时，提供从塔架电梯通往乘员通道臂的路径。将该平台安装到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并使用平移小工具调整高度。平台具有三种配置：航天飞机通道臂、Rodan通

src: A separate crew access floor for the crew access tower section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, used to provide access from the tower elevator to the crew access arm when a command pod's hatch does not align with the bottom of the crew access section. Attach the floor to the node in the elevator shaft of the crew access section, and adjust its height with the offset gizmo. The floor has three configurations: Shuttle Arm access, Rodan Arm access and Launch Platform access. The floor also has two color options, default gray and alternate black&white.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔乘员通道段的独立通道平台，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部未对齐时，提供从塔架电梯通往乘员通道臂的路径。将该平台安装到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并使用平移小工具调整高度。平台具有三种配置：航天飞机通道臂、Rodan通道臂与发射平台通道。平台还提供两种配色选项：默认灰色和备用黑白。

航天飞机发射台FSS塔乘员通道段的独立通道平台，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部未对齐时，提供从塔架电梯通往乘员通道臂的路径。将该平台安装到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并使用平移小工具调整高度。平台具有三种配置：航天飞机通道臂、Rodan通

src: The top section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, with two color options: default gray and alternate black and white. A node for attaching the LOX Vent Arm (beanie cap) is located on mount rail on the front; the rail can also be turned off. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的顶段，提供两种配色选项：默认灰色和备用黑白。前部安装导轨上设有一个用于安装液氧排气臂（便帽罩）的节点；该导轨也可以关闭。还配备可选的侧板，每侧均可单独切换开启或关闭。

src: This is the base for the Shuttle Launch Platform, and can be also used with an accurate SLS recreation. The base attaches to the shuttle's External Tank via the large node in the center, and requires a free attach node below the center of the shuttle's External Tank in order to be attached. The base attaches to the SLS via the large attach node on the deck in the area of the SSME exhaust hole. The Fixed Service Structure Tower (FSS) base attaches to the large node off to the side of the launch base. The SLS tower base attaches to the 3rd large node opposite the SSME hole. There are 3 deck variants for different kinds of shuttle stacks and a 4th variant for the SLS. SRB hold-downs are integrated into the base and are adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The shuttle tail service masts attach on the sides of the square main engine exhaust hole, either with the two nodes or by surface attach. The whole base can be rotated via the switcher to keep the support legs in the right place.
zh: 航天飞机发射平台的基座，也可用于精确还原 SLS。基座通过中心的巨大节点连接到航天飞机外贮箱，并要求航天飞机外贮箱中心下方有一个空余的连接节点以供挂载。基座通过甲板上 SSME 喷流孔区域的大型连接节点连接到 SLS。固定勤务结构塔（FSS）基座连接到发射基座外侧的大节点。SLS 塔架基座连接到 SSME 孔对面的第 3 个大节点。共有 3 种用于不同航天飞机组合体的甲板变体，以及用于 SLS 的第 4 种变体。固体助推器压紧装置集成于基座中，可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。航天飞机尾部勤务桅杆通过两个节点或表面附着方式安装在方形主发动机喷流孔的两侧。整个基座可通过切换器旋转，以确保支撑腿处于正确位置。

航天飞机发射台FSS塔乘员通道段的独立通道平台，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部未对齐时，提供从塔架电梯通往乘员通道臂的路径。将该平台安装到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并使用平移小工具调整高度。平台具有三种配置：航天飞机通道臂、Rodan通

src: The Hinge for the Shuttle Launcher Rotating Service Structure (RSS). The hinge attaches to a large node located on the FSS Tower's base section. The RSS itself is then attached to the hinge. The hinge has two color options, default gray and alternate black&white. The hinge details (the platforms and discs) can also be turned off.
zh: 航天飞机发射台旋转服务台（RSS）的铰链。铰链安装在FSS塔基段的大型节点上，RSS本身随后安装在铰链上。铰链提供两种配色选项：默认灰色和备用黑白。铰链细节部件（平台和圆盘）也可以关闭显示。

src: The Rotating Service Structure (RSS) for the Shuttle Launcher Base, used to access and change out the orbiter's payload bay IRL; this version can not be used for that. It attaches to a large node located on the top of the RSS Hinge's central pole. The RSS support legs can be switched between the default height for the stock tier 3 pad and a shorter height for the larger LC-39 pad in Tundra's Space Center/KSC Extended. The RSS can be closed and rolled out via an animation...a slow animation, as this thing is huge after all!
zh: 航天飞机发射台底座的旋转服务台（RSS），在现实中用于接近和更换轨道器的有效载荷舱；但该版本无法实现此功能。它安装在RSS铰链中心立柱顶部的大型节点上。RSS支撑腿可在原版3级发射台的默认高度与Tundra's Space Center/KSC Extended中更大型LC-39发射台的较矮高度之间切换。RSS可通过动画关闭和展开……不过动画很慢，毕竟这东西实在太巨大了！

src: Cosmetic hold-down assembly for the space shuttle's SRBs. These attach to the nodes in the launcher base's two SRB exhaust holes. Use mirror symmetry when attaching them to the nodes. They have animated retracting bolts.
zh: 航天飞机固体助推器（SRB）的装饰性压紧组件。安装在发射台底座两个SRB排气孔内的节点上。安装到节点时请使用镜像对称。带有螺栓回缩的动作动画。

src: Two of these tail service masts are mounted on the Shuttle Launcher Base, one on each side of the orbiter's engine section. Use mirror symmetry to orient them properly so the umbilicals face towards the shuttle. The umbilicals have an animated retraction. The sparkers have to be started manually with an action group.
zh: 两个尾部服务桅杆安装在航天飞机发射台底座上，位于轨道器发动机段两侧各一个。请使用镜像对称正确放置，使脐带管朝向航天飞机。脐带管具有回缩动画。火花点火器必须通过动作组手动启动。

src: This is the Shuttle FSS tower lightning mast that was first used for the AS-210 Saturn IB launch (ASTP Apollo), mounted on the hammerhead crane. The crane with the mast was also used for a time with the Space Shuttle's FSS tower, then the crane was removed and the mast mounted directly on the top of the tower. This mast has switchable mount styles: FSS Tower, Hammerhead Crane and a General Tower mount. It attaches to the top node on a tower top section or on the top of the Hammerhead Crane.
zh: 这是航天飞机FSS塔架避雷桅杆，最初安装在锤头起重机上用于AS-210土星1B发射任务（阿波罗-联盟测试计划）。带有该桅杆的起重机也曾用于航天飞机的FSS塔架一段时间，后来起重机被拆除，桅杆直接安装在塔架顶部。该桅杆具有可切换的安装样式：FSS塔架、锤头起重机和通用塔架安装底座。它可安装在塔架顶段的顶部节点或锤头起重机的顶部。

src: Gaseous Hydrogen Vent Arm for the Shuttle Launcher's FSS Tower. This arm was used to vent hydrogen gas boiling up into the intertank area, and was dropped at liftoff. The arm attaches to the intertank access structure, on the node at the top, with the umbilical touching the External Tank's intertank at about the middle.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的气态氢排气臂。该臂用于排出蒸发进入箱间段区域的氢气，并在起飞时脱落。该臂安装在箱间段通道结构的顶部节点上，其脐带接口大致接触外储箱箱间段的中部。

src: The intertank access arm for the Shuttle Launcher's FSS Tower. It was used to allow pad technicians access to the External Tank's intertank and to attach the hydrogen vent arm. The arm attaches to the intertank access structure, on the node at the front and to the side, pointing towards the external tank.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的箱间段通道臂。用于让发射台技术人员进入外储箱箱间段并连接氢排气臂。该臂安装在箱间段通道结构前方偏向一侧的节点上，指向外储箱。

src: The "beanie cap" Liquid Oxygen Vent Arm for the shuttle launcher's FSS tower. The arm is attached to a side node on the FSS top section, with the cap centered over the top of the shuttle's External Tank and almost touching the tank. The arm was retracted at around the T-2 minute point in the countdown
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的“便帽罩”液氧排气臂。该臂安装在FSS顶段的侧面节点上，罩体居中对准航天飞机外储箱顶部并几乎贴合储箱。该臂在倒计时约T-2分钟时缩回。

src: Crew access arm for the shuttle FSS tower, allowing for crew boarding of the orbiter. It is attached to the crew access section type of the FSS tower, with the walkway lining up with the railing opening in the crew section floor's orbiter variant.
zh: 航天飞机FSS塔的乘员通道臂，供乘员登入轨道器。它安装在FSS塔的乘员通道段类型上，其走道与乘员段地板轨道器构型的栏杆开口对齐。

src: The Intertank Access Structure for the Shuttle Launcher FSS tower. This attaches to a side node on the FSS tower, and was used to access the External Tank's intertank. The intertank access arm is attached to the front node off to the sie, and the hydrogen vent arm are attached to to the top node on the walkway.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的箱间段通道结构。它安装在FSS塔的侧面节点上，用于接近外储箱箱间段。箱间段通道臂安装在偏向一侧的前方节点上，氢排气臂安装在走道顶部的节点上。

src: The "beanie cap" Liquid Oxygen Vent Arm for the SLC-6 shuttle tower. Has 3 color variants; the IRL arm was still mostly gray with some red beams at the rear. The arm is attached to a node on the front of top section, not on the square-sided mast base, with the cap centered over the top of the shuttle's External Tank and almost touching the tank. The arm was retracted at around the T-2 minute point in the countdown.
zh: 用于SLC-6航天飞机塔架的“便帽罩”液氧排气臂。拥有3种颜色变体；现实中的臂体主体仍为灰色，后部带有一些红色梁柱。该臂安装在顶段前部的节点上，而非方形截面的桅杆基座上，罩体居中对准航天飞机外储箱顶部并几乎贴合储箱。该臂在倒计时约T-2分钟时缩回。

src: Crew access arm for the SLC-6 Shuttle tower, allowing for crew boarding of the orbiter. It is attached to a node on the front of SLC-6 tower crew section, with the walkway lining up with the orbiter's hatch. The arm retracts backwards into the tower, it does not swing.
zh: 用于SLC-6航天飞机塔架的乘员通道臂，供乘员登入轨道器。它安装在SLC-6塔架乘员段前部的节点上，走道与轨道器的舱门对齐。该臂向后缩回塔内，不会进行水平旋转摆动。

src: The top section for the modular version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower. Attach to the top node of a core section. Umbilical attach node can be toggled between the Titan II Tower and General types. There is also an attach node on top of the umbilical mount rail for the Titan II Tower Mast.

src: A single-piece version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower, sized and customized for the Bluedog Design Bureaau Titan II GLV rocket. Uses separate Titan II Tower umbilicals or the General Umbilicals. Use with the Titan II Launch Stand for the full LC-19 recreation.
zh: 大力神 II GLV 服务塔的一体化版本，尺寸专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的大力神 II GLV 火箭定制。使用独立的大力神 II 塔架脐带缆或通用脐带缆。与大力神 II 发射台配合使用，可完整还原 LC-19。
