src: The auxiliary structure used for the Titan II and IV, mounted on the mobile launch platform and positioned to be directly in front of the main fixed tower. The mast has multiple height variants and 8 color options. The top portion can be swutched between the older solid structure type, the later open-truss type, and the open-truss with a small plate on the front. The center trusses have attach nodes for attaching umbilicals and swing arms if desired.
zh: 用于大力神 II 和 IV 的辅助结构，安装在移动发射平台上，位置正对主固定塔架前方。桅杆具有多种高度变体和 8 种颜色选项。顶部结构可在早期实体结构型、后期开放桁架型以及带正面小板的开放桁架型之间切换。中心桁架配有连接节点，可根据需要安装脐带缆和摆臂。

src: The companion service tower for the Vanguard Launch Stand, attaching to one of the outer nodes. The tower is sized for the BDB Vanguard rocket with the stand placed at ground level, with half-height (9m) and full-height (18m) variants. The base frame and top beam can be toggled off to allow stacking of multiple tower sections. The front detail structure can also be turned off. 9 color options are also available. Uses separate umbilicals which are node-attached.
zh: 先锋号发射台的配套服务塔，安装在外部节点之一。塔架尺寸适配放置在地面高度发射台上的 BDB 先锋号火箭，提供半高（9m）和全高（18m）变体。底座框架和顶部横梁均可关闭，以便堆叠多个塔段。正面细节结构亦可关闭。还提供 9 种颜色选项。使用独立的节点连接式脐带缆。

src: Saturn V animated retracting hold-down arm. Four were used on the Saturn Launcher Base, placed in between the F-1 engine fairings. Retraction can be done manually or by staging with Animated Decouplers.
zh: 土星 5 号带动画收回的固定臂。土星发射台上共使用四组，布置在 F-1 发动机整流罩之间。可通过手动或配合 Animated Decouplers 模组编入分级来触发收回。

src: A distinctive feature of the Saturn tower was this hammerhead crane that sat on the very top. This crane has no hoist capability, but it can be rotated up to 180 degrees via an animation; set the rotation limit to 50 to rotate only 90 degrees to the launch position. For launches, the crane was rotated 90 degree in the clockwise direction. A gray variant is also available. The lightning mast on top can be switched between the original Saturn tower mast or the new Shuttle mast, which was first used for the ASTP Saturn IB launch, or can be turned off.
zh: 土星塔架最顶端的锤头起重机是其标志性特征。该起重机没有吊装功能，但可通过动画旋转最多 180 度；将旋转限制设为 50 即可恰好旋转 90 度至发射位置。发射时，起重机会顺时针旋转 90 度。还提供灰色变体。顶部的避雷桅杆可在原始土星塔架桅杆与首次用于 ASTP 土星 1B 发射的新型航天飞机桅杆之间切换，亦可将其关闭。

src: The "Milkstool", as it was nicknamed, was a stand created to allow the Saturn IB-Apollo to use the Saturn V's Launch Umbilical Tower on LC 39. The three Skylab crews and the Apollo CSM for the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project were launched from LC 39 with the milkstool. In reality it was a gray color, but a red variant is also available as an alternative. Attach the milkstool to a bottom center node of a rocket, then attach the launcher base to the bottom node of the milkstool. The center ring at top has switchable hold-down arm support and node arrangements. There is a built-in decoupler for separating the milkstool from a rocket for liftoff.
zh: 这台被戏称为“挤奶凳”的发射架，旨在让土星 1B-阿波罗能够在 39 号发射工位上使用土星 5 号的发射脐带塔。三次天空实验室乘组任务和阿波罗-联盟测试计划中的阿波罗 CSM 均是通过“挤奶凳”从 39 号工位发射升空。现实中它呈灰色，但也提供红色变体可选。将挤奶凳安装到火箭的底部中心节点，然后将发射底座安装到挤奶凳的底部节点。顶部的中心环具有可切换的固定臂支撑及节点布局。内置分离器，用于在起飞时将挤奶凳与火箭分离。

src: A specialty square node-attached launch clamp designed for the Vanguard and Scout rockets from Bluedog Design Bureau. The hold-down structure in the center has configurations for the BDB Vanguard shrouded engine (2 types), bare engine/0.9375m tank and 1.25m tank; the structure can also be turned off so other hold-downs can be used instead. Optional nodes for the separate Redstone Umbilical Pole can be turned on. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Vanguard Service Tower for the full LC-18A recreation.
zh: 专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的先锋号和侦察兵火箭设计的方形节点安装型发射支架。中央的压紧结构可配置为 BDB 先锋号带罩发动机（2 种）、裸露发动机/0.9375m 储箱以及 1.25m 储箱；该结构也可关闭以使用其他压紧装置。可开启独立红石脐带塔架的可选连接节点。发射台带有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。与先锋号勤务塔搭配使用可实现完整的 LC-18A 复原。

src: This is the free-standing base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes a built-in decoupler and an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. No launch clamps are necessary. Includes a manually-activated generator for electric charge. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional center-mount hold-down and Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes.
zh: 这是土星移动发射台的独立底座。底座通过排气孔开口顶部的 5 号尺寸节点，连接到火箭下级或芯级中央的空闲节点。塔架基座段连接到发射台底座另一端的 5 号尺寸节点。包含内置分离器以及供乘员从地面到达顶层甲板的电梯。为获得最佳效果，请将前支腿放置在 VAB 地面大圆圈的白色区域内。无需发射支架。包含一个手动启动的电能发电机。底座的排气孔可针对三种尺寸的火箭进行配置：土星 V 号（6.4/5.625m）、SLS（5m）和土星 IB 号（4.25/3.75m），具有适用于单芯级或三芯级火箭的多种方形和矩形形状。提供多种可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的中心安装压紧装置和土星 V 号尾部勤务桅杆连接节点。

src: Small size launch base for the Space Shuttle, made for smaller flat launch pads, and inspired by the launch mount for the shuttle at Vandenberg's SLC-6 pad. The base attaches to the shuttle's External Tank via the large node in the center, and requires a free attach node below the center of the shuttle's External Tank in order to be attached. Service towers are attached to the nodes around the outside of the mount. SRB hold-downs are integrated into the base and are adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The shuttle tail service masts attach on the sides of the square main engine exhaust hole, either with the two nodes or by surface attach. The whole base can be rotated via the switcher to keep the support legs in the right place.
zh: 航天飞机小型发射底座，专为较小的平坦发射台设计，灵感源自范登堡 SLC-6 工位的航天飞机发射支架。该底座通过中心的大节点连接到航天飞机的外储箱，需要外储箱底部中心有一个闲置的连接节点才能安装。勤务塔连接在支架外围的节点上。SRB 压紧装置已集成到基座中，可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。航天飞机机尾勤务桅杆安装在方形主发动机排气孔的两侧，可通过两个节点连接或表面贴装。整个底座可通过切换器旋转，以确保支撑腿处于正确位置。

src: The core (lower) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It ataches to a large node off to the side of the SLC6 Shuttle Launch Mount. Has multiple height variants, and two color options. A node on the side is for attaching the SLC-6 Shuttle Intertank Structure. Has one crew elevator, which has to be brought down first, then can be raised. Adjust the maximum stopping height with the deploy limit slider. A hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: SLC6 航天飞机发射塔的核心（下部）段。它连接到 SLC6 航天飞机发射支架侧面的大节点上。拥有多种高度变体和两种颜色选项。侧面节点用于连接 SLC-6 航天飞机级间段结构。配有一部乘员电梯，必须先降下然后才能上升。使用开启限制滑块调节最高停止高度。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。

src: The crew (middle) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It ataches to the top of the core section. Has two crew access height variants plus optional extra core levels on top. Includes an adjustable integrated floor to align with the SLC6 crew arm and the orbiter. The crew arm attaces to the node on the front. A node on the side is for attaching the SLC-6 Shuttle Intertank Structure.
zh: SLC6 航天飞机发射塔的乘员（中部）段。连接在核心段顶部。拥有两种乘员登机高度变体，顶部还可选装额外的核心层。包含一个可调节的一体式地板，以便与 SLC6 乘员登机臂及轨道器对齐。乘员登机臂连接在正面节点上。侧面的节点用于连接 SLC-6 航天飞机级间段结构。

src: The Intertank Structure for the SLC-6 shuttle tower. It attaches to one of the nodes on the side of the tower opposite the crew arm. The main structure can be adjusted sideways with the deploy limit slider. The one thing that was mounted on this structure was the Hydrogen Vent Arm, which attaches to the node at the end of the main structure.
zh: 用于 SLC-6 航天飞机发射塔的级间段结构。它连接到塔架侧面（乘员臂对面）的其中一个节点上。主体结构可通过开启限制滑块横向调节。该结构上安装的部件为液氢排气臂，连接在主体结构末端的节点上。

src: The top (upper) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It attaches to the top of the crew section. Has 3 height variants, though the default height matches the IRL tower. The mast base has 6 height variants, with 4x matching the IRL one. The LOX Vent Arm attaches to the node in the top front, while the mast attaches to the node on top of the square-sided mast base.
zh: SLC6 航天飞机发射塔的顶部（上部）段。连接在乘员段顶部。拥有 3 种高度变体，其中默认高度与现实中的塔架一致。桅杆底座拥有 6 种高度变体，其中 4x 与现实一致。液氧排气臂连接在顶部正面的节点上，而桅杆则连接在四方桅杆底座顶部的节点上。

src: The Large Fuel Arm for the Soyuz Launch Base and other bases, styled after the actual Soyuz arm which serviced the third stage and spacecraft. Three color options are available. It attaches to one of the auxiliary nodes on the Soyuz base or a tower node on other bases. Six height options are available, and the umbilical can be adjusted horizontally and vertically with the deploy limit sliders. Arm retraction can be either done manually or by staging.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座及其他底座的大型燃料臂，仿照现实中为联盟号三级和飞船提供勤务的加注臂设计。提供三种颜色选项。它可连接至联盟号底座上的辅助节点之一，或其它底座上的塔架节点。提供六种高度选项，脐带管可通过开启限制滑块进行水平和垂直调节。支臂回缩可通过手动或分级进行。

src: Small Fuel Arm for the Soyuz Launch Base and other bases, styled after the actual Soyuz arm which serviced the core stage. Three color options are available. It attaches to one of the auxiliary nodes on the Soyuz base ring or a tower node on other bases. Six height options are available, and the umbilical can be adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit slider. Arm retraction can be either done manually or by staging.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座及其他底座的小型燃料臂，仿照现实中为联盟号芯级提供勤务的加注臂设计。提供三种颜色选项。它可连接至联盟号底座环上的辅助节点之一，或其它底座上的塔架节点。提供六种高度选项，脐带管可通过开启限制滑块进行水平调节。支臂回缩可通过手动或分级进行。

src: Animated retracting clamp arm for the Soyuz Launch Base or other launch base/plate, styled after the actual Soyuz support arms . It surface attaches to the clamp arm pads or the deck of the base, not the auxiliary nodes. There are three color options available. The arm end pad can be adjusted in size with the deploy limit slider. Retraction of the arm can be done manually or by staging.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座或其他发射底座/平台的带动画回缩托臂，仿照现实中的联盟号支撑臂设计。它表面贴装在托臂垫或底座甲板上，而不是辅助节点。提供三种颜色选项。支臂末端承托垫的大小可通过开启限制滑块调节。支臂的回缩可通过手动或分级进行。

src: A separate version of the Soyuz Gantry crew elevator only. Elevator tower has 7 height options and two color options. The crew elevator pad's height, the walkway platform's height and platform extension's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. Optional transfer airlock can be turned on to allow crew boarding of a spacecraft inside a fairing via the crew transfer function. Hatches on the elevator car and at the bottom of the tower allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 联盟号发射塔乘员电梯的独立版本。电梯塔拥有 7 种高度选项和两种颜色选项。乘员电梯垫的高度、走道平台的高度以及平台延伸长度均可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。可启用可选的转移气闸，通过乘员转移功能让乘员进入整流罩内的航天器。电梯轿厢和塔架底部的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。

src: Gantry arm assembly for the Soyuz Launch Base. Three color options are available. It attaches to the auxiliary node in the center of the Soyuz base. There are multiple height options for the arms, and the full arms can be turned off so only the crew elevator is visible. The gantry platform stack has three height variants, and the whole stack can be moved down up to 2.4m with the deploy limit slider. The crew elevator pad's height, the walkway platform's height and platform extension's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. Optional transfer airlocks can be turned on to allow crew boarding of a spacecraft inside a fairing via the crew transfer function. Hatches on the elevator car and at the bottom of the tower allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座的勤务塔架组件。提供三种颜色选项。它连接至联盟号底座中心的辅助节点。双臂拥有多种高度选项，并且可以完全关闭双臂，使其仅显示乘员电梯。塔架平台堆叠有三种高度变体，整个组件可通过开启限制滑块向下移动最多 2.4 米。乘员电梯垫的高度、走道平台的高度以及平台延伸长度均可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。可开启可选的转移气闸，通过乘员转移功能让乘员进入整流罩内的航天器。电梯轿厢和塔架底部的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。

src: Soyuz Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp pad styled after the actual Soyuz launch pad facility at Baikonur. Three color options are available. It attaches via the upper larger node in the central hole to a center node at the bottom of a rocket. The clamp arms, service gantry, large fuel arm, and small fuel arm are separately attached. The clamp arm pads can be switched among several options. 8 auxiliary nodes for the fuel arms or other tower are on the deck. Has two manual fuel and electric charge generators.
zh: 联盟号发射台，一款节点连接式发射架基座，仿照拜科努尔实际的联盟号发射台设施设计。提供三种配色方案。通过中心孔内上方较大的节点连接至火箭底部的中心节点。夹臂、勤务塔、大燃料臂和小燃料臂均为独立安装。夹臂垫板可在多个选项间切换。甲板上配有 8 个用于安装燃料臂或其他脐带塔的辅助节点。配有两个手动控制的燃料和电能发生器。

src: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this ablative heat shield can be stretched to a range of sizes. Hardens to a rigid, heat resistant structure before launch!
zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（偶然在办公室小冰箱深处发现其生长出来的产物）制成，这种烧蚀防热盾可以拉伸至各种尺寸。发射前会硬化为刚性耐热结构！

src: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this fuel tank can be stretched to accommodate fuel loads of a range of sizes and shapes. Hardens to a rigid structure before launch!
zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（偶然在办公室小冰箱深处发现其生长出来的产物）制成，这种储罐可以拉伸以容纳不同尺寸与形状的推进剂负载。发射前会硬化为刚性结构！

src: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this solid rocket can be stretched to accommodate fuel loads of a range of sizes and shapes. Hardens to a rigid structure before launch!
zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（偶然在办公室小冰箱深处发现其生长出来的产物）制成，这种固体火箭可以拉伸以容纳不同尺寸与形状的装药负载。发射前会硬化为刚性结构！

src: With further refinements to procedural tech, we were able to fill a viscoelastic nanopolymer shell with electroactive particles. This gives you a battery able to be adapted to many shapes.
zh: 随着程序化技术的进一步完善，我们得以在粘弹性纳米聚合物外壳中注入电活性粒子。这使你可以获得能够适应多种形状的电池。

src: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this decoupler can be stretched to accommodate a range of sizes.
zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物制成（纯属意外发现……长在办公室小冰箱的背面），这款分离器可以延展以适应多种尺寸。

src: Three of these tail service masts were located on the launcher base, connected to the lower part of the S-IC stage of the Saturn V, and were retracted at liftoff. These have to be placed separately, and attach to nodes right outside the flame hole, two on one side, and one on the other side. Rotate them 5 degrees to have them properly aligned with the S-IC.
zh: 发射台基座上布置有三座此类尾部勤务桅杆，连接至土星5号的S-IC级下部，并在起飞时缩回。它们需要单独放置，并安装在排焰口外侧的节点上（一侧两个，另一侧一个）。将其旋转5度以与S-IC对齐。

src: A separate version of the original Saturn tower lightning mast that was mounted on the hammerhead crane, for use with other towers. Red and gray versions can be selected, and the mounting plate can be turned off.
zh: 原版土星发射塔避雷针的独立版本，原本安装在锤头起重机上，现可用于其他发射塔。可选择红色和灰色版本，安装底板也可关闭。

src: A standalone launch clamp version of the Saturn "Milkstool", with two height variants: the regular tall version and an alternate short one, both with two color options. The center ring at top has switchable hold-down arm support pads, which can be adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit slider. The railings on the ring can also be turned off.
zh: 土星“挤奶凳”的独立发射架版本，有两种高度变体：常规高版与备选矮版，均提供两种配色方案。顶部中心环具有可切换的压紧臂支承垫，可通过开启限制滑块进行水平调节。环上的栏杆也可以关闭。

zh_samples: 模块化土星发射塔的斜角基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的
模块化土星发射塔的方形基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的
脐带塔兼具发射架和燃油泵的功能。这可以在发射台上等待发射窗口时保持燃料充满。要启动燃料加注，请右键点击该塔。

src: Angled base section of the modular Saturn launch tower, with two color options: classic red and new gray. The base has two independent crew elevators, each with four switchable maximum height options; elevators can also be turned off. Adjust the deploy limit of the elevators to make them stop at a lower height than the maximum. Elevators start at the highest point and have to be brought down first. Hatches on the elevator cars allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 模块化土星发射塔的斜角基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种移动方式。

zh_samples: 模块化土星发射塔的斜角基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的
