src:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Required

While batteries alone are good enough for simple satellites, they are insufficient for the greater energy demands of more complex systems. The first step towards that is to generate power to augment the supplied batteries. Launch a satellite into the specified orbit and demonstrate that it can generate more solar power than it consumes after a 2-week period in orbit.
zh:
项目：早期卫星（轻型）
类型：必选

虽然仅靠电池足以支持简易卫星，但对于能耗更高的复杂系统而言则远远不够。迈向这一目标的第一步是发电以补充自带电池。发射一颗卫星进入指定轨道，并证明其在轨运行两周后，产生的太阳能电力大于其消耗的电力。

src:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Optional

A sun-synchronous orbit is a geocentric orbit that combines altitude and inclination in such a way that the satellite passes over any given point of the planet's surface at the same local solar time. Such an orbit can place a satellite in constant sunlight and is useful for imaging, spy, and weather satellites.&br;&br;Place a satellite into a sun-synchronous orbit. Note that sun-synchronous orbits are often slightly retrograde, as is this orbit. You'll need to fly northwest from the launch pad and it will take more delta-v than a normal polar orbit.&br;&br;You can use an online orbit calculator to determine what kind of orbit will meet the eccentricity requirement, such as the one available from https://orbital-math.com/.
zh:
项目：早期卫星（轻型）
类型：可选

太阳同步轨道是一种将高度与倾角巧妙结合的地心轨道，使卫星能在相同的平太阳时飞越地表任意给定点。这种轨道可让卫星持续处于日照中，非常适合成像、侦察和气象卫星。&br;&br;将一颗卫星送入太阳同步轨道。请注意，太阳同步轨道通常略微逆行，本次轨道亦是如此。你需要从发射场向西北方向飞行，且消耗的Δv会比常规极轨道更多。&br;&br;你可以使用在线轨道计算器来确定何种轨道能满足偏心率要求，例如https://orbital-math.com/提供的计算工具。

src:

Type: CAPSTONE

Humans staying in space for longer durations allows for different types of experiments from what we can do with unmanned probes. Utilize your stations to complete these experiments. NOTE: You may have already collected some or all of this science. If you have, you won't need to collect it again.
zh:
项目：载人入轨
类型：收官

人类在太空驻留更长时间，能开展不同于无人探测器的多种实验。利用你的空间站完成这些实验。注意：你可能已经收集了部分或全部此项科学。若已收集，则无需重复进行。

src:
Program: Earth Space Station
Type: CAPSTONE

Design, build, and launch a second generation space station into Earth orbit to research the effects of long duration space habitation over 2 years. This contract is based off of the Skylab and Second Generation Salyut space stations.
zh:
项目：地球空间站
类型：收官

设计、建造并将一座第二代空间站发射至地球轨道，以研究历时2年以上的长期太空驻留效应。本合同基于天空实验室和第二代礼炮系列空间站设计。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: CAPSTONE

Human beings are capable of conducting a unique class of science experiments, one robotic spacecraft simply can't match. We'd like you to fly orbital missions in order to learn about human beings in space, what they can do, and how they perceive things around them. All these experiments were conducted historically during the Mercury and Vostok programs. As part of this science campaign, we also need you to fly at least one flight that lasts a day or more in orbit. NOTE: You may have already collected some or all of this science. If you have, you won't need to collect it again, but you do need to fly at least one whole-day (or more) duration crewed flight.

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh:
项目：载人入轨
类型：收官

人类有能力开展一类无人航天器无法比拟的独特科学实验。我们希望你执行轨道任务，以了解太空中的人类状况、行为能力以及对周围环境的感知。在历史上，所有这些实验均在水星计划和东方计划期间完成。作为该科学计划的一部分，你还需要执行至少一次在轨驻留一天或更长时间的飞行。注意：你可能已经收集了部分或全部此项科学。若已收集，无需重复进行，但你仍必须完成至少一次全天（或更长）的载人飞行。

注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员对其发射所乘载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要进行熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对预定发射部件的任务训练。每次飞行前都必须进行任务训练，且该训练在执行任务后或长期未使用时会过期失效。若要开始训练航天员，请通过工具栏中的 RP-1 图标打开 RP-1 窗口，并前往“训练”标签页。

zh_samples:

类型：必要

可以说，航天计划所能达成的最重要里程碑之一就是将人类送入环绕地球的轨道。这项任务需要可靠的发射系统，以及数以千计小时的研发与工程攻关才能
中央机械制造科研所（TsNIIMash）

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Arguably one of the most important milestones a space program can achieve is putting a human into orbit around the Earth. The task requires a reliable launch system and many hours of research and engineering to pull off. Before committing to the goal, ensure you have the time to research, design, and build a craft capable of putting a human into a 150 km orbit for at least one full orbit. Single-person orbital spacecraft are fairly rare in history but serve an important role in proving future technologies and sending crew to space before rivals, with Mercury (1962, Atlas LV-3B) and Vostok (1961, Vostok-K) being the only examples.&br;&br;NOTE: Completing this contract will cause the 'Suborbital Flight (Crewed)' contracts to become unavailable. If it is accepted then it will automatically fail.

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh:
计划：载人入轨
类型：必要

可以说，航天计划所能达成的最重要里程碑之一就是将人类送入环绕地球的轨道。这项任务需要可靠的发射系统，以及数以千计小时的研发与工程攻关才能实现。在承诺此目标前，请确保有足够时间来研发、设计并建造一艘能够将航天员送入 150 km 轨道并完成至少一整圈飞行的航天器。单人轨道航天器在历史上相当罕见，但在验证未来技术以及抢在对手之前将乘员送入太空方面发挥了重要作用，水星号（1962年，宇宙神 LV-3B）和东方号（1961年，东方号-K）是仅有的范例。&br;&br;注意：完成此合同将导致“亚轨道飞行（载人）”合同不再可用。如果已接受该合同，则会自动失败。

注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员发射时所乘坐载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要完成熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对预定发射部件的任务训练。任务训练必须在每次飞行前进行，使用后或闲置时间过长均会失效。要开始训练航天员，请前往工具栏中通过 RP-1 图标打开的 RP-1 窗口中的“训练”标签页。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit or Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Reentry is brutally hot and dangerous, but it can be survivable with the right technology and equipment. We want you to design, build, and launch a craft that can survive a reentry and make a soft landing or splashdown on Earth. Note that orbital-speed suborbital flights are acceptable as well. Historically this research started with weapon reentry vehicles for the newly developing ICBM forces but the research, and rockets, were quite applicable elsewhere; reconnaissance satellite recovery vessels, crewed capsules, and interplanetary landers have also withstood this crucible.
zh:
计划：载人入轨或早期地球观测卫星
类型：必要

再入过程酷热且极度危险，但借助合适的技术与设备完全可以幸存。我们需要你设计、建造并发射一艘能够经受再入考验并在地球上软着陆或溅落的航天器。请注意，达到轨道速度的亚轨道飞行同样有效。历史上这项研究始于新兴洲际弹道导弹部队的武器再入载具，但相关研究与火箭也广泛适用于其他领域；侦察卫星回收舱、载人飞船以及行星际着陆器都曾经历过这种严苛考验。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Single-person orbital spacecraft are fairly rare in history but serve an important role in proving future technologies, with Mercury (1962, 1.4 tons, Atlas LV-3B) and Vostok (1961, 4.7 tons, Vostok-K) being the only examples. Design, build, and launch one that remains for @/NoOfOrbits orbits and return the crew safely back to Earth.

NOTE: You can not complete this contract and the Orbital Flight with Maneuvers and 2+ Crew contract at the same time. Attempting to complete both in same flight will automatically fail this one.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh:
计划：载人入轨
类型：可选

单人轨道航天器在历史上相当罕见，但在验证未来技术方面发挥了重要作用，水星号（1962年，1.4吨，宇宙神 LV-3B）和东方号（1961年，4.7吨，东方号-K）是仅有的范例。设计、建造并发射一艘航天器，在轨停留 @/NoOfOrbits 圈，并将乘员安全送回地球。

注意：你不能同时完成此合同与“2人以上机动轨道飞行”合同。若尝试在同一次飞行中同时完成两项，将导致本合同自动失败。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / 无限制

注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员发射时所乘坐载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要完成熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对预定发射部件的任务训练。任务训练必须在每次飞行前进行，使用后或闲置时间过长均会失效。要开始训练航天员，请前往工具栏中通过 RP-1 图标打开的 RP-1 窗口中的“训练”标签页。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Before putting a crew in a capsule to send into space, it is a good idea to test the capsule on an uncrewed flight. Send a Crew Capsule, WITH NO CREW IN IT, into orbit and return safely to Earth.
zh:
计划：载人入轨
类型：必要

在将乘员送入太空舱之前，先通过无人飞行测试该返回舱是一个明智的做法。发射一个载人返回舱（舱内不载人）进入轨道，并安全返回地球。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Before putting a crew in a capsule to send into space, it is a good idea to test the capsule with an advanced biological creature in it. Send a Crew Capsule WITH AN ANIMAL (one of the generated tourists) into orbit and return safely home. These animals are represented by tourists.

Can be completed @maxCompletions times.
zh:
计划：载人入轨
类型：可选

在将乘员送入太空舱之前，先搭载高等生物测试该返回舱是一个明智的做法。发射一个载有动物（由生成的游客代表）的载人返回舱进入轨道，并安全返回家园。这些动物由游客代替。

可完成 @maxCompletions 次。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Reentry is brutally hot and dangerous but it can be survivable with the right technology and equipment. We want you to design, build, and launch a craft that can survive a reentry and make a soft landing or splashdown on Earth after achieving a typical orbit (roughly 200 km). This is a step up in the testing to ensure that our equipment works under expected orbital mission parameters. Note that this contract will be unavailable after completing the first crewed orbit.
zh:
计划：载人入轨
类型：可选

再入过程酷热且极度危险，但借助合适的技术与设备完全可以幸存。我们需要你设计、建造并发射一艘航天器，在达到典型轨道（约 200 km）后能够经受再入考验并在地球上软着陆或溅落。这是测试的进一步深入，以确保我们的设备在预期的轨道任务参数下正常工作。注意，在完成首次载人入轨后，此合同将不再可用。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Crewed suborbital flights are used as a safer prelude to an orbital mission, for research, or to set non-orbital altitude records. Send any number of crew above @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude meters to satisfy the requirements of this mission. Historical missions used the Mercury capsule (1961, Mercury-Redstone), the X-15 (1963, B-52), and SpaceShipOne (2004, White Knight).NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Orbital Flight (Crewed') or 'X-Planes High' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh:
项目：载人轨道
类型：可选

载人亚轨道飞行可用作轨道任务前更安全的前奏、用于研究，或用于创造非轨道高度纪录。将任意数量的乘员送至 @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude 米以上以满足该任务的要求。历史上执行此类任务的有水星号乘员舱（1961年，水星-红石）、X-15（1963年，B-52）以及 SpaceShipOne（2004年，白色骑士）。注意：你不能同时接受此合同与“首次轨道飞行（载人）”或“高空 X 飞机”。如果在激活此合同时接受了另一个合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

注意：宇航员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两类：熟练度训练和任务训练。宇航员在发射载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要接受熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对你计划发射他们所用部件的任务训练。任务训练必须在每次飞行前进行，使用后或闲置过久都会过期。要开始训练宇航员，请转到工具栏中 RP-1 图标打开的 RP-1 窗口下的“训练”标签页。

src:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Before putting a crew in a capsule to send into space, it is a good idea to test the capsule on an uncrewed flight. Send a Crew Capsule, WITH NO CREW IN IT, above @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude meters to satisfy the requirements of this mission. &br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh:
项目：载人轨道
类型：可选

在将乘员送入乘员舱发射升空之前，最好先进行一次无人飞行测试。发射一个不载有任何乘员的载人乘员舱至 @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude 米以上以满足该任务的要求。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

src:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: CAPSTONE

Perform the first docking between two spacecraft. Historically, this was first done on March 16, 1966 with Gemini 8. Neil Armstrong and David Scott docked to an Agena target vehicle, before a stuck thruster on the Gemini spacecraft caused a near-disaster and the mission was aborted.
zh:
项目：高级载人轨道
类型：里程碑

完成两艘航天器之间的首次交会对接。历史上，该任务于1966年3月16日由双子座8号首次完成。尼尔·阿姆斯特朗与大卫·斯科特成功与阿金纳目标飞行器对接，随后双子座航天器上卡死的一台姿控推力器险些酿成灾难，任务被迫中止。

src:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Performing the first EVA provides valuable insight into future spacesuit, rather than flight suit, design. It also highlights future technologies that need development for EVA. Launch a spacecraft into orbit with least one crewmember aboard, perform a spacewalk while recording observations, and immediately transmit them home. Then, return the crew to Earth after at least one full orbit with a perigee above 150 km. Historically, the first spacewalk was performed from a Soviet Voskhod 2 (1965, 5.7 tons, modified Molniya) followed a few months later by a spacewalk from a U.S. Gemini capsule (1965, 3.8 tons, Gemini Titan II).
zh:
项目：高级载人轨道
类型：必需

进行首次 EVA 可为未来航天服（而非飞行服）的设计提供宝贵经验，并明确未来 EVA 所需研发的关键技术。发射一艘搭载至少一名乘员的航天器进入轨道，在进行太空行走的同时记录观测数据并立即传回地面。随后，在近地点高于 150 km 的轨道上运行至少一整圈后将乘员安全带回地球。历史上，首次太空行走由苏联上升2号（1965年，5.7吨，改装型闪电号运载火箭）完成，数月后美国双子座乘员舱（1965年，3.8吨，双子座-大力神II）也实现了这一壮举。

src:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Putting two people into space in the same capsule opens the door to a range of new activities and opportunities. Such a spacecraft must remain in orbit with its crew @/DurationText days and return them safely to Earth. Only two spacecraft were ever specifically created for this task, the Soviet Voskhod 2, a refit of the 3-seat Voskhod 1 (1965, 5.7 tons, modified Molniya) and the U.S. Gemini (1965, 3.2 - 3.8 tons, Gemini-Titan II).

NOTE: Once you've completed this contract, Orbital Flight (One Crew) contracts will become unavailable. If you have both this and the Orbital Flight (One Crew) contract accepted, completing this will cause that contract to fail.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh:
项目：高级载人轨道
类型：可选

将两人同时送入同一乘员舱进入太空，开启了一系列全新的任务与机遇。此类航天器必须搭载乘员在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天并将他们安全带回地球。历史上仅有两型航天器专门为此任务研制：苏联上升2号（由3座上升1号改装，1965年，5.7吨，改装型闪电号运载火箭）与美国双子座（1965年，3.2 - 3.8吨，双子座-大力神II）。

注意：完成此合同后，“轨道飞行（单人）”合同将不再可用。如果你同时接受了此合同与“轨道飞行（单人）”合同，完成此合同将导致该合同失败。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / 无限制

src:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

The goal and realization of putting three (or more) crew on orbit at the same time begins the era of the space taxi and ready access to LEO. Depending on the politics and economy of the originating nation, these craft will either be noted predecessors to later craft or become so ubiquitous and reliable in the role that they are still flying 50 years after their first. These craft should be able to support at least three crew and prove that they can stay in orbit for @/DurationText days. The Soviet Voskhod 1 (1964, 5.3 tons, modified Molniya) and Soyuz (1967, 6.5 tons, Soyuz), and the U.S. Apollo CSM (1968, 14.7 - 21 tons for LEO, Saturn 1B) are examples of these craft.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh:
项目：高级载人轨道
类型：可选

同时将三名（或更多）乘员送入轨道的设想与实现，标志着“太空班车”以及便捷进出近地轨道时代的到来。取决于发起国的政治与经济环境，这些航天器要么成为后续型号的著名先驱，要么在其岗位上高度普及并极其可靠，甚至在首飞50年后仍在使用。此类航天器应能支持至少三名乘员，并证明其能在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天。苏联上升1号（1964年，5.3吨，改装型闪电号运载火箭）、联盟号（1967年，6.5吨，联盟号运载火箭）以及美国阿波罗服务舱/指令舱（1968年，近地轨道构型14.7 - 21吨，土星1B）均为此类航天器的典范。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / 无限制

src:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

The first successful rendezvous between two spacecraft was when Gemini 6 and 7 met in 1965. Wally Schirra maneuvered Gemini 6 to within 30 cm of Gemini 7, close enough and precise enough to prove that docking two craft together in space was possible. Using your own knowledge of orbital mechanics, bring two craft to within 100 meters of each other while in orbit around Earth. At least one of the spacecraft must be a new launch.
zh:
项目：高级载人轨道
类型：必需

航天器之间的首次成功交会发生于1965年双子座6号与7号的相会。沃利·希拉操纵双子座6号接近至距离双子座7号仅 30 cm 处，其极高的精度证明了在太空中实现两艘航天器交会对接的可行性。运用你的轨道力学知识，在环绕地球轨道上将两艘航天器相互靠近至 100 米以内。其中至少一艘航天器必须是新发射的。

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Launch a satellite into an elliptical orbit with a new cosmic ray detector called a Cherenkov counter. This device is a different type of cosmic ray detector specifically calibrated for high-energy particles like neutrinos.

Make sure your craft contains a Cherenkov Counter and return 75% of the available science from High Earth Orbit. Science does not have to be collected in only 1 flight.

Historical example: Explorer 11 (37kg, Juno II)
zh:
项目：早期地球观测卫星
类型：必需

发射一颗搭载新型宇宙射线探测器（切伦科夫计数器）的卫星进入椭圆轨道。该设备是一种专为中微子等高能粒子校准的特殊宇宙射线探测器。

确保你的航天器装有切伦科夫计数器，并从高地球轨道传回 75% 的可用科学点数。科学数据无需在单次飞行中全部收集。

历史范例：探索者11号（37 kg，朱诺II）

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Taking photographic images from space, with a powerful enough lens, can provide highly detailed information about many things. When used for intelligence purposes, an eye in the sky is an invaluable tool for gathering information about geopolitical rivals. These types of satellites also have numerous peaceful purposes, including crop monitoring, observing deforestation, and providing indicators for areas requiring humanitarian aid. Make sure your craft contains an Basic Film Camera, and a system to return the film for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Real life examples: Discoverer/Keyhole-1 (780kg, Thor-Agena)
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：必选

从太空进行摄影，配合足够强大的镜头，可以获取海量高细节信息。用于情报目的时，天眼是收集地缘政治对手情报的无价工具。此类卫星还具备广泛的和平用途，包括作物监测、森林砍伐观测，以及为需要人道主义援助的地区提供预警指示。确保你的航天器携带基础胶卷相机，以及用于回收胶卷进行冲洗的系统。由于飞行器自带的胶卷存储容量限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。

现实案例：探索者/锁眼-1（780kg，雷神-阿金纳）

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

With orbital imagery now a proven capability, send up a follow-on early-generation imagery satellite for a longer duration in orbit. This will allow the collection of far more data with repeat passes over the same points on the surface. Make sure your craft contains an Improved Film Camera, and a system to return the film canister for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: CORONA/Keyhole-4 (1,500kg, Thor-Agena)
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：可选

随着轨道成像技术得到验证，发射一颗后续的早期成像卫星以延长在轨时间。这将允许通过对地表同一点的多次重访收集更多数据。确保你的航天器携带改进型胶卷相机，以及用于回收胶卷舱进行冲洗的系统。由于飞行器自带的胶卷存储容量限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史案例：日冕/锁眼-4（1,500kg，雷神-阿金纳）

zh_samples: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的
在月球上完成科学任务目标

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

The satellite launched in the Early Satellites program returned valuable data about the space near Earth. Send a satellite to High Earth Orbit to detect cosmic rays so that we may better ascertain the shape and strength of the cosmic ray environment around Earth. Early scientific satellites also contained still-frame and video cameras to take photos of Earth from entirely new perspectives.&br;&br;Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray Science experiment (Geiger-Muller Counter or Scintillation Counter) and an Early TV camera. Between this and any other launches you must transmit 75% of Cosmic Ray Science and 75% of Visual Imaging from High Earth Orbit. Science does not have to be collected in only 1 flight.&br;&br;Historical example: Explorer 6 (64kg, Thor-Able)
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：必选

早期卫星计划中发射的卫星传回了关于近地空间的宝贵数据。向地球高轨发射一颗卫星以探测宇宙射线，从而更好地查明地球周围宇宙射线环境的形态与强度。早期科学卫星还搭载了静止图像和视频摄像机，从全新的视角拍摄地球。&br;&br;确保你的航天器携带宇宙射线科学实验（盖革-米勒计数器或闪烁计数器）以及早期电视摄像机。在本次发射及其他发射中，你必须传回地球高轨75%的宇宙射线科学数据与75%的可见光成像数据。科学数据不必在单次飞行中全部收集。&br;&br;历史案例：探险者6号（64kg，雷神-埃布尔）

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

Launch a new satellite to measure the gravimetric field of earth and its effect on orbiting satellites.

Make sure your craft contains an Orbital Perturbation experiment. Launch it into an inclined orbit and return 2 months worth of science.

Historical example: ANNA 1B (161kg, Thor-Ablestar)
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：可选

发射一颗新卫星以测量地球的重力场及其对轨道卫星的影响。

确保你的航天器携带轨道摄动实验设备。将其发射至倾斜轨道并传回相当于2个月的科学数据。

历史案例：ANNA 1B（161kg，雷神-埃布尔之星）

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Weather forecasting today would be impossible without the numerous weather satellites constantly observing our atmosphere from orbit. Launch the very first dedicated weather satellite to measure temperatures in the atmosphere and correlate those with real-time video.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometer 1 experiment and an Early TV camera.

Historical example: TIROS-1 (120kg, Thor-Able)
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：必选

如今的天气预报离不开众多在轨道上持续观测大气的气象卫星。发射首颗专用气象卫星以测量大气温度，并将其与实时视频建立关联。

确保你的航天器携带红外辐射计1号实验设备和早期电视摄像机。

历史案例：泰罗斯1号（120kg，雷神-埃布尔）

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

After the success of your first weather satellite, your government wants additional satellites available for more timely weather observations with better coverage of Earth. Launch an additional weather satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometry 1 experiment and an Early TV camera. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical examples: TIROS-2 through TIROS-8.
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：可选

在首颗气象卫星成功发射后，政府希望部署更多卫星以获得更及时的气象观测和更好的地球覆盖范围。发射一颗附加气象卫星以满足其需求。

确保你的航天器携带红外辐射测量1号实验设备和早期电视摄像机。科学需求可通过多次发射达成。

历史案例：泰罗斯2号至泰罗斯8号。

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

After the success of your first weather satellite, your government wants additional satellites available for more timely weather observations with better coverage of Earth. Launch an additional weather satellite to fulfill their request.

<Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometry 1 experiment and an Early TV camera. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical example: TIROS-9.
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：可选

在首颗气象卫星成功发射后，政府希望部署更多卫星以获得更及时的气象观测和更好的地球覆盖范围。发射一颗附加气象卫星以满足其需求。

<确保你的航天器携带红外辐射测量1号实验设备和早期电视摄像机。科学需求可通过多次发射达成。

历史案例：泰罗斯9号。

src:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Anyone that has ever used a compass is familiar with the magnetic fields that encapsulate Earth. Launch a satellite to better charaterize the strength and direction of the magnetic field, and determine how far into space its influence is felt.

Make sure your craft contains a Magnetic Scan experiment. Launch it into an elliptical orbit and return 75% worth of science from both Low and High Earth Orbit.

Historical example: IMP-A (138kg, Thor-Delta)
zh:
计划：早期对地观测卫星
类型：必选

任何使用过指南针的人都对包裹地球的磁场并不陌生。发射一颗卫星以更好地表征磁场的强度和方向，并测定其影响能延伸至多远的太空深处。

确保你的航天器携带磁测扫描实验设备。将其发射至椭圆轨道，并从地球低轨与高轨各传回75%的科学数据。

历史案例：IMP-A（138kg，雷神-德尔塔）

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants satellites capable of monitoring the weather in a hempishere. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment, a Helium Magnetometer, a Mass Spectrometer and a Basic TV Camera.

Historical example: ATS-1.
zh:
计划：先进对地观测卫星
类型：必选

政府需要能够监测半球气象的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足其需求。

确保你的航天器携带宇宙射线实验设备、氦磁强计、质谱仪以及基础电视摄像机。

历史案例：ATS-1。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation
Type: Required

Your government wants high resolution imagery of Earth.

Launch an analog film camera and retrieve its film.

Make sure your craft contains an High Resolution Film Camera and a system to return the film canister for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Historical example: KH-9 (Hexagon).
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测
类型：必选

你的政府需要地球的高分辨率图像。

发射一台模拟胶卷相机并回收其胶卷。

请确保你的载具搭载了高分辨率胶卷相机，以及用于带回胶卷舱进行处理的回收系统。受载具胶卷储存限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。

历史参考：KH-9（Hexagon）。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation
Type: Optional

With orbital imagery now a proven capability, send up a follow-on early-generation imagery satellite for a longer duration in orbit. This will allow the collection of far more data with repeat passes over the same points on the surface. Make sure your craft contains an High Resolution Film Camera and a system to return the film canister for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: HEXAGON/Keyhole-7
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测
类型：可选

轨道成像能力已获验证，现需发射一颗后续的早期成像卫星并在轨运行更长时间。这将通过对地面同一区域的多次重访，收集更多数据。请确保你的载具搭载了高分辨率胶卷相机，以及用于带回胶卷舱进行处理的回收系统。受载具胶卷储存限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史参考：HEXAGON/Keyhole-7

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants satellites capable of detecting rocket launches by other nations. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment, an Infrared Radiometer and a Micrometeorite Detector.

Historical example: Midas 1.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：必选

你的政府需要能够探测其他国家火箭发射的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足他们的需求。

请确保你的载具搭载了宇宙射线实验装置、红外辐射计和微流星体探测器。

历史参考：Midas 1。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

The initial tests were successful, but a single satellite cannot monitor the entire globe. We need to build a constellation.

Launch another operational rocket launch detection satellite to expand our early warning coverage.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment, an Infrared Radiometer and a Micrometeorite Detector. Place it in a polar orbit between 2,500 and 4,000 km.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: MIDAS 3-9.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：可选

早期试验已获成功，但单颗卫星无法监视全球。我们需要构建一个星座。

发射另一颗业务化火箭发射探测卫星，以扩大我们的预警覆盖范围。

请确保你的载具搭载了宇宙射线实验装置、红外辐射计和微流星体探测器。将其送入 2,500 至 4,000 km 之间的极地轨道。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史参考：MIDAS 3-9。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants a satellite capable of more advanced meteorological research. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometer and a Basic TV Camera. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical example: Nimbus 1.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：必选

你的政府需要一颗能够开展更先进气象研究的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足他们的需求。

请确保你的载具搭载了红外辐射计和基础电视摄像机。科学需求可通过多次发射累计达成。

历史参考：Nimbus 1。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

The prototype proved the concept, but reliable weather forecasting requires a stable platform. We need consistent, daily imagery from a circular polar orbit.

Launch an operational weather satellite to stabilize our weather network.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometer and a Basic TV Camera. Place it in a circular polar orbit.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: Nimbus 2-6.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：可选

原型星验证了设计概念，但可靠的气象预报需要一个稳定的平台。我们需要从圆形极地轨道获取持续的每日图像。

发射一颗业务化气象卫星以稳定我们的气象监测网。

请确保你的载具搭载了红外辐射计和基础电视摄像机。将其送入圆形极地轨道。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史参考：Nimbus 2-6。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants a satellite capable of more advanced geophysical research. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains a Helium Magnetometer and a Mass Spectrometer. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical example: OGO 1.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：必选

你的政府需要一颗能够开展更先进地球物理研究的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足他们的需求。

请确保你的载具搭载了氦磁力计和质谱仪。科学需求可通过多次发射累计达成。

历史参考：OGO 1。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

The first Observatory has provided incredible data on the magnetosphere, but the space environment is dynamic and constantly changing. We need long-term monitoring.

Launch another OGO satellite into a highly elliptical orbit to continue the survey.

Make sure your craft contains a Magnetometer, RPWS, Mass Spectrometer, and Cosmic Ray detector. Place it in a highly eccentric orbit.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: OGO 3/5.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：可选

第一座观测台提供了大量令人惊叹的磁层数据，但太空环境处于动态且不断变化中。我们需要长期监测。

发射另一颗 OGO 卫星进入大椭圆轨道以继续探测。

请确保你的载具搭载了磁力计、RPWS、质谱仪和宇宙射线探测器。将其送入大偏心率轨道。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史参考：OGO 3/5。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants satellites capable of monitoring the Earth for nuclear tests. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment and an Infrared Radiometer.

Historical example: Vela 1A.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：必选

你的政府需要能够监测全球核试验的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足他们的需求。

请确保你的载具搭载了宇宙射线实验装置和红外辐射计。

历史参考：Vela 1A。

src:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

The initial nuclear detection satellites have proven effective, but global coverage requires a constellation. We need to ensure no nuclear test goes undetected, anywhere, anytime.

Launch another nuclear detection satellite to expand the network.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment and an Infrared Radiometer. Place it in a High Earth Orbit (>100,000 km).

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: Vela 5/6.
zh:
计划：进阶对地观测卫星
类型：可选

首批核探测卫星已证明其有效性，但全球覆盖需要组建星座。我们必须确保任何时间、任何地点的核试验都无所遁形。

发射另一颗核探测卫星以扩建监测网。

请确保你的载具搭载了宇宙射线实验装置和红外辐射计。将其送入高地球轨道（>100,000 km）。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史参考：Vela 5/6。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Required

Weather satellites look at the atmosphere, but we need to look at the ground. By analyzing different wavelengths of light, we can monitor crop health, water resources, and urban growth.

Launch the first dedicated Earth Resources satellite.

Make sure your craft contains an Improved TV Camera and reaches a Sun-Synchronous Orbit.

Historical example: ERTS-1 (Landsat 1).
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：必选

气象卫星观测大气，但我们需要观测地面。通过分析不同波长的光，我们可以监测农作物长势、水资源以及城市扩张。

发射首颗专用地球资源卫星。

确保你的航天器配备了改进型电视摄像机，并进入太阳同步轨道。

历史原型：ERTS-1（陆地卫星 1 号 / Landsat 1）。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Required

To navigate precisely in space and target ICBMs accurately, we need a perfect mathematical model of the Earth's shape and gravity field (the Geoid).

Launch a dedicated geodetic satellite to map gravitational anomalies.

Make sure your craft contains an Orbital Pertubation Experiment and is placed in a high-inclination eccentric orbit.

Historical example: GEOS-1 / GEOS-2.
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：必选

为了在太空中精确定位导航并准确瞄准洲际弹道导弹（ICBM），我们需要一个完美的地球形状和重力场（大地水准面）数学模型。

发射一颗专用大地测量卫星来绘制重力异常点图。

确保你的航天器配备了轨道摄动实验设备，并进入高倾角大椭圆轨道。

历史原型：GEOS-1 / GEOS-2。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Optional

The initial geodetic satellite has provided a baseline, but to achieve the precision required for ICBM targeting and orbital navigation, we need a denser dataset.

Launch an operational GEOS satellite to refine our map of the Earth's gravitational field.

Make sure your craft contains a Gravity Scan experiment (Gravioli Detector) and is placed in a high-inclination eccentric orbit.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: GEOS 2/3.
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：可选

初步的大地测量卫星提供了基准，但为了达到 ICBM 瞄准和轨道导航所需的精度，我们需要更密集的数据集。

发射一颗业务化 GEOS 卫星以完善我们的地球重力场分布图。

确保你的航天器配备了重力扫描实验（引力子探测器），并进入高倾角大椭圆轨道。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史原型：GEOS 2/3。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Required

Polar satellites only see a location twice a day. To predict severe storms and hurricanes effectively, we need continuous monitoring of the entire hemisphere.

Launch a satellite into a Geostationary Orbit to provide real-time weather tracking.

Make sure your craft contains a Two-Channel Infrared Radiometer and an Improved TV Camera.

Historical example: SMS-1 / GOES-1.
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：必选

极轨卫星每天只能观测同一地点两次。为了有效预测强风暴和飓风，我们需要对整个半球进行连续监测。

发射一颗卫星进入地球静止轨道以提供实时天气追踪。

确保你的航天器配备了双通道红外辐射计和改进型电视摄像机。

历史原型：SMS-1 / GOES-1。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Optional

The first synchronous weather satellite was a triumph. Now we must maintain a permanent watch over the hemisphere to track hurricane development and severe storms.

Launch an operational GOES satellite into geostationary orbit.

Make sure your craft contains a Two-Channel Infrared Radiometer and an Improved TV Camera. Place it in a Geostationary Orbit.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: GOES 2-7.
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：可选

首颗同步轨道气象卫星取得了巨大成功。现在我们必须对半球保持长期监视，以追踪飓风发展和强风暴。

发射一颗业务化 GOES 卫星进入地球静止轨道。

确保你的航天器配备了双通道红外辐射计和改进型电视摄像机，并将其送入地球静止轨道。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史原型：GOES 2-7。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Required

Your government wants high resolution imagery of Earth, but is no longer willing to pay for the recovery of film capsules. Since we now have access to high fidelity digital cameras, launch one of those instead!

Launch an analog film camera and retrieve its film.

Make sure your craft contains an Ultra Resolution Digital Imaging Camera.

Historical example: KH-11 (Kennen).
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：必选

你的政府希望获得高分辨率的地球图像，但不再愿意为胶卷回收舱的回收买单。既然我们现在已经掌握了高保真数字相机技术，那就发射一台吧！

发射一台胶片相机并回收其胶卷。

确保你的航天器配备了超高分辨率数码成像相机。

历史原型：KH-11（锁眼-11 / Kennen）。

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Optional

With digital orbital imagery now a proven capability, send up a follow-on early-generation imagery satellite for a longer duration in orbit. This will allow the collection of far more data with repeat passes over the same points on the surface. Make sure your craft contains an Ultra Resolution Digital Imaging Camera.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: Kennen/Keyhole-11
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：可选

随着天基数码成像技术得到验证，发射一颗后续的早期数码成像卫星以实现更长的在轨时间。通过对地表同一点位的重复飞越，这将有助于收集更多的数据。确保你的航天器配备了超高分辨率数码成像相机。

已完成合同数量：@index / @maxCompletions

历史原型：Kennen/锁眼-11（Keyhole-11）

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Required

Previous magnetic satellites flew high to study the magnetosphere. We want to fly low to map the magnetic anomalies in the Earth's crust itself.

Make sure your craft contains a Helium Magnetometer and is placed in a high-inclination LEO orbit.

Historical example: Explorer-61A / Magsat
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：必选

以往的磁测卫星都在高轨道飞行以研究磁层。我们希望在低轨道飞行，绘制地壳本身的磁异常点图。

确保你的航天器配备了氦磁力仪，并进入高倾角 LEO 轨道。

历史原型：探索者 61A / 磁场卫星（Magsat）

src:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Optional

We have conquered weather and land mapping, but we are blind to the chemistry of our atmosphere. Scientists are concerned about ozone depletion and ocean health.

Launch a multi-instrument platform to monitor atmospheric gases and ocean pigments.

Make sure your craft contains a Gas Chromatograph-Mass Spectrometer and an Improved TV Camera and is placed in a high-inclination eccentric orbit.

Historical example: Nimbus-7.
zh:
项目：业务化对地观测
类型：可选

我们已经征服了气象和陆地测绘，但我们对大气的化学组成依然一无所知。科学家们正对臭氧消耗和海洋健康状况感到担忧。

发射一个多载荷平台来监测大气气体和海洋色素。

确保你的航天器配备了气相色谱-质谱联用仪和改进型电视摄像机，并进入高倾角大椭圆轨道。

历史原型：雨云 7 号（Nimbus-7）。

Type: Required

Mission control is tired of losing vessels and probes over the horizon, since they are rarely heard from again. src:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: Required

Our communications around the globe are limited to line of sight because of the curvature of Earth. If we can launch a communications satellite into orbit, we can use it to transmit information to the opposite side of the world.
zh:
项目：专用卫星
类型：必要

由于地球曲率，全球通信受限于视距传输。如果我们能将一颗通信卫星送入轨道，就能利用它将信息传送到地球的另一侧。

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务
你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: Required

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. Place a satellite into a Molniya orbit.&br;&br;There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.
zh:
项目：专用卫星
类型：必要

闪电轨道（Molniya orbit）是一种大椭圆轨道，倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角为 -90 度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。将一颗卫星送入闪电轨道。&br;&br;地图视图和测控站中会显示一条轨道。你无需完全吻合该轨道，它的作用是向你指示近地点和远地点的大致位置，更重要的是展示轨道的正确形态。

src:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: Required

Through measuring the Doppler shift of radio signals transmitted from a satellite in a known orbit, it is possible for a receiver on the ground to establish their location, which would have many applications both civilian and military. To test the principle and develop receiver equipment, it is necessary to have a test navigational satellite in orbit. Be sure to include solar panels to generate power. Historically, the first experiments in satellite navigation were made with Transit 1B (119 kg, Thor-Ablestar).
zh:
项目：专用卫星
类型：必要

通过测量已知轨道卫星发射无线电信号的多普勒频移，地面接收机就能够确定自身位置，这在民用和军用领域都有广泛应用。为了测试该原理并研制接收机设备，必须在轨道上拥有一颗导航测试卫星。请务必安装太阳能电池板以发电。历史上，最早的卫星导航实验由子午仪 1B（Transit 1B，119 kg，雷神-爱布尔星运载火箭）完成。

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务

src:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: CAPSTONE

A Tundra orbit is a highly elliptical geosynchronous orbit (note: not geostationary orbit) with a high inclination (usually near 63.4) and an orbital period of one sidereal day. A satellite placed in this orbit spends most of its time over a chosen area of the Earth, a phenomenon known as apogee dwell. The ground track of a satellite in a tundra orbit is a closed figure eight. The orbit in this contract is actually using data from the Sirius satellites, the only known satellites using a Tundra orbit.&br;&br;Place a satellite into a Tundra orbit.&br;&br;There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.
zh:
项目：专用卫星
类型：重大里程碑

苔原轨道（Tundra orbit）是一种大椭圆地球同步轨道（注意：并非地球静止轨道），具有高倾角（通常接近 63.4 度），轨道周期为一个恒星日。置于该轨道的卫星大部分时间都停留于地球选定区域的上空，这种现象称为远地点驻留。苔原轨道卫星的星下点轨迹呈闭合的“8”字形。此合同中的轨道实际上采用了天狼星（Sirius）卫星的数据，这是已知唯一使用苔原轨道的卫星系统。&br;&br;将一颗卫星送入苔原轨道。&br;&br;地图视图和测控站中会显示一条轨道。你无需完全吻合该轨道，它的作用是向你指示近地点和远地点的大致位置，更重要的是展示轨道的正确形态。

Type: Required

The Atmospheric Analysis Satellite that we launched was a good first step to understanding how the upper atmosphere affects the weather. However, our meteorologists want to see images of the clouds to better assess the situation.&br;&br;Launch our first official weather satellite into orbit.
zh:
项目：专用卫星
类型：必要

我们发射的大气分析卫星是了解高层大气如何影响天气的重要一步。然而，气象学家希望获取云层图像以更好地评估气象状况。&br;&br;发射我们的第一颗正式气象卫星入轨。

zh_samples: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们

Type: Optional

Launch a crewed spacecraft into lunar orbit for a routine mission of the specified duration and return safely to Earth.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / 2
zh:
项目：载人月球探测
类型：可选

发射一艘载人飞船进入环月轨道执行指定时长的常规任务，随后安全返回地球。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 2

src:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members with the ability to land one crew member on the Moon. This will be a targeted landing near a randomly generated waypoint. We will also require you to take a crewed rover to explore an additional two waypoints. Once you have explored the waypoints, return safely to Earth.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh:
项目：载人月球探测
类型：可选

设计并发射一艘至少搭载两名乘员的飞船，并具备将一名乘员送上月球着陆的能力。此为定点着陆，降落于随机生成的航路点附近。同时要求携带一辆载人漫游车探索另外两个航路点。探索完毕后，安全返回地球。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / @maxCompletions

src:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: CAPSTONE

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members and the capability to land at least one crew member at a specific location on the Moon. Explore the area for at least @/LandDur and then return safely to Earth.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh:
项目：载人月球探测
类型：里程碑

设计并发射一艘至少搭载两名乘员的飞船，并具备将至少一名乘员送至月球指定地点着陆的能力。在目标区域探索至少 @/LandDur，随后安全返回地球。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / @maxCompletions

src:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members to orbit close to the Moon for at least 20 hours and return safely to Earth. You must also broadcast live TV during the mission, the experiment for which is unlocked in the Improved Communications technology node. Historically, Apollo 8 was the first to do this, flying to the Moon over Christmas, 1968.
zh:
项目：载人月球探测
类型：必选

设计并发射一艘至少搭载两名乘员的飞船，在近月轨道运行至少 20 小时并安全返回地球。任务期间还必须进行电视直播，该实验可在“改进型通信”科技节点中解锁。历史上，阿波罗 8 号于 1968 年圣诞节期间飞往月球，率先完成了这一壮举。

src:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

We are ready to finally put Humans on the surface of the Moon! Good luck to you in your design and execution of this complex mission!&br;&br;You must bring two Humans to the Moon and put at least one Human on the Moon and return them safely to the Earth.&br;&br;NOTE: The contract asks you to plant a flag on the Moon. Be sure that you have updated your Astronaut Complex to level five to unlock that ability.
zh:
项目：载人月球探测
类型：必选

我们终于准备好将人类送上月球表面了！祝你在设计与执行这项复杂任务时一切顺利！&br;&br;你必须搭载两名乘员前往月球，并让至少一名乘员踏上月球表面，最后将他们安全带回地球。&br;&br;注意：该合同要求在月球表面插旗。请确保航天员中心已升级至 5 级以解锁该能力。

src:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

We are ready to finally put Humans on the surface of the Moon! Good luck to you in your design and execution of this complex mission!&br;&br;You must put at least two Humans on the Moon and return them safely to the Earth. You may not perform any dockings or this contract will fail. &br;&br;NOTE: The contract asks you to plant a flag on the Moon. Be sure that you have updated your Astronaut Complex to level five to unlock that ability.
zh:
项目：载人月球探测
类型：必选

我们终于准备好将人类送上月球表面了！祝你在设计与执行这项复杂任务时一切顺利！&br;&br;你必须让至少两名乘员踏上月球表面，并安全返回地球。全程不得执行任何对接操作，否则合同失败。&br;&br;注意：该合同要求在月球表面插旗。请确保航天员中心已升级至 5 级以解锁该能力。

src:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Lunar Landing (Uncrewed)' contract will become available.
zh:
项目：无人月表探测
类型：必选

设计并成功发射一艘航天器，使其在月球软着陆并将科学数据传回地球。

完成该合同后，将解锁“月球着陆（无人）”合同。

src:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: CAPSTONE

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the far side of the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

Lunar libration already allows us to see 59% of the Moon's surface, so we want you to land within 80° of the far side.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Far Side Lunar Landing (Uncrewed)' contract will become available.
zh:
项目：无人月表探测
类型：里程碑

设计并成功发射一艘能够在月球背面实现软着陆、并将科学数据传回地球的航天器。

月球天平动已经让我们能观测到 59% 的月球表面，因此我们希望你在月球背面中心区域 80° 范围内着陆。

完成此合同后，将解锁“月球背面着陆（无人）”合同。

src:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the far side of the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

Lunar libration already allows us to see 59% of the Moon's surface, so we want you to land within 80° of the far side.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh:
项目：无人月表探测
类型：可选

设计并成功发射一艘能够在月球背面实现软着陆、并将科学数据传回地球的航天器。

月球天平动已经让我们能观测到 59% 的月球表面，因此我们希望你在月球背面中心区域 80° 范围内着陆。

这是一个包含 @maxCompletions 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

src:

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh:
项目：无人月球表面探测
类型：可选

设计并成功发射一艘能够在月球软着陆并将科学数据传回地球的航天器。

zh_samples: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的
在月球上完成科学任务目标

src:

Type: Optional

You have successfully landed on the Moon, but our scientists need to know more information about the elements that make up the surface. Send a craft to land on the Moon and then return to Earth with scientific data from the Moon's surface.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.

项目：无人月表探测
类型：可选

你已经成功在月球着陆，但我们的科学家需要了解更多有关月表组成成分的信息。发射一艘航天器在月球着陆，并携带月表的科学数据返回地球。

这是一个包含 @maxCompletions 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

Type: Required

Design and successfully launch a probe into lunar orbit (with a maximum apiselene of @/maxApText.Print() km) and successfully transmit or return Visible Imaging 2 Science.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Lunar Orbiter & Mapper (Uncrewed)' contracts will become available.
zh:
项目：无人月表探测
类型：必需

设计并成功发射一颗探测器进入环月轨道（远月点最高不超过 @/maxApText.Print() km），并成功传回或带回可见光成像 2 科学数据。

完成此合同后，将解锁“月球轨道器与测绘器（无人）”合同。

src:

Type: Optional

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.

这是一个包含 @maxCompletions 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

src:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

A good way to explore more of the Moon is to send a rover to visit different places. Our scientists have picked three locations to inspect with a rover.

Design and successfully send a rover to the Moon and visit the marked waypoints.
It is recommended to use the Waypoint Manager mod for better navigation.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh:
项目：无人月表探测
类型：可选

深入探索月球的良策是派遣巡视器造访不同地点。我们的科学家已选定三处地点供巡视器考察。

设计并成功发射一辆巡视器前往月球，造访标记的导航点。
建议使用 Waypoint Manager 模组以获得更佳的导航体验。

这是一个包含 @maxCompletions 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

src:

Create a probe and send it to flyby Deimos within 45 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.

Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into a scientifically useful orbit of Mars.&br;The flexible parameters of this contract allow you to choose either a high inclination orbit for maximum surface coverage, or an orbit coplanar with the moons for repeated flybys.
zh:
项目：早期内行星探测器或火星表面探测
类型：可选

设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，进入具有科学价值的环火星轨道。&br;该合同的弹性参数允许你选择高倾角轨道以实现最大地表覆盖率，或选择与卫星共面的轨道以进行多次飞掠。

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe to land on Phobos, gather science, and bring something back to Earth for study. This is a sample return missions so you cannot just transmit the data back, it needs to be physically returned.
zh:

NASA 对接系统（NDS）是用于美国载人航天器的航天器对接与停泊机构，例如猎户座多功能载人飞船和商业载人航天器。
高分辨率胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄行星照片。这台相机提供极高分辨率的照片，且底片需要回收至地球。历史上，这些相机曾以KH-9“六边形”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，但对于RP-1而言，它们代表了商业公司的第一批高分辨率卫星相机。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Communications around the globe are limited to line of sight because of the curvature of Earth. If we can launch a communications satellite into orbit, we can use it to transmit information to the opposite side of the world. Launching a satellite into an eccentric low earth orbit is a good place to start. It should be relatively easy with existing launch vehicles, and the high apogee will provide good lines of sight for a few minutes every orbit. However, providing global communications coverage with such a low orbit would require very many satellites.

Historical example: Telstar 1 (78kg, Thor-Delta).
zh:
项目：早期商业应用
类型：可选

由于地球曲率的影响，全球范围内的通信受限于视距传输。如果能将一颗通信卫星送入轨道，我们就能利用它将信息传送到地球的另一侧。将卫星发射到大椭圆低地球轨道是一个很好的起点。利用现有的运载火箭相对容易实现，而且较高的远地点在每个轨道周期都能提供数分钟良好的视距通信。然而，要用如此低的轨道实现全球通信覆盖，需要非常多的卫星。

历史范例：同温层1号（Telstar 1，78 kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务
你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Having a communication satellite that remains stationary relative to a satellite earth station means that the antenna wouldn't need to track movements to stay connected, and a constant line of sight can be maintained 24 hours a day. This would greatly simplify communication relay and mass transmission systems.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a geostationary orbit.
Historical example: Syncom 3 (39 kg, Thor-Delta) launched in August of 1964.
zh:
项目：早期商业应用
类型：可选

拥有相对于卫星地球站保持相对静止的通信卫星，意味着地面天线无需追踪移动即可保持连线，且能全天 24 小时保持不间断视距。这将极大地简化通信中继与大规模传输系统。

有关如何进入地球静止轨道的更多信息，请参阅 RP-1 wiki。
历史范例：辛康3号（Syncom 3，39 kg，雷神-德尔塔），于 1964 年 8 月发射。
