src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

With an orbital period of an earth day, a satellite will remain above a constant longitude, appearing to drift north and south through the day. This orbit will be able to provide a constant line of sight for satellite earth stations at low latitudes, but at high latitudes it may still drift too far north or south to be used for portions of the day. However, forgoing an inclination change burn makes this orbit easier to get to than a proper geostationary orbit.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a geostationary orbit.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (36kg, Thor-Delta).
zh:
项目：早期商业应用
类型：可选

若轨道周期为一个地球日，卫星将保持在固定的经度上方，并在一天中呈现南北漂移。该轨道能够为低纬度的卫星地面站提供持续的视距，但在高纬度地区，卫星在一天中的部分时间仍可能漂移过远而无法使用。不过，放弃轨道倾角变轨使得该轨道比真正的地球静止轨道更容易入轨。

有关如何进入地球静止轨道的更多信息，请参阅 RP-1 wiki。
历史范例：辛康2号（Syncom 2，36 kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 (270) degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. This orbit will cause the satellite to appear to remain nearly stationary in the sky for a short period at apogee. Combined with the high inclination, this orbit will allow a satellite to maintain a line of sight with satellite earth stations at a high latitude for about 6 hours a day.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a Molniya orbit.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya)
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：可选

闪电轨道是一种大椭圆轨道，倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角为 -90（270）度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。处于此轨道的卫星在远地点附近的一段短周期内，在天空中看起来几乎处于静止状态。结合高倾角特性，该轨道能让卫星每天维持与高纬度地面站视线连通约 6 小时。

有关如何进入闪电轨道的详细信息，请参阅 RP-1 wiki。

历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600kg，闪电号）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

A Tundra orbit is a highly elliptical geosynchronous orbit (note: not geostationary orbit) similar to a Molniya orbit, with a high inclination (usually near 63.4) and an orbital period of one sidereal day. A satellite placed in this orbit spends most of its time over a chosen area of the Earth, a phenomenon known as apogee dwell, allowing it to maintain a line of sight with satellite earth stations at a high latitude for about 8 hours a day. The ground track of a satellite in a tundra orbit is a closed figure eight.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a Tundra orbit.

Historical example: Sirius FM-1 (3,800kg, Proton-K)
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：可选

苔原轨道是一种类似于闪电轨道的大椭圆地球同步轨道（注意：非地球静止轨道），具有高倾角（通常在 63.4 度左右）和 1 个恒星日的轨道周期。置于该轨道的卫星大部分时间停留在地球的指定区域上空（称为远地点驻留现象），使其每天能维持与高纬度地面站视线连通约 8 小时。处于苔原轨道的卫星地面星下点轨迹呈闭合的“8”字形。

有关如何进入苔原轨道的详细信息，请参阅 RP-1 wiki。

历史参考：天狼星 FM-1（3,800kg，质子-K）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

As part of a Franco-Soviet agreement on colour television, we are considering using the space segement of the Soviet television network to relay television between Paris and Moscow.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：必选

作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑利用苏联电视网络空间段在巴黎和莫斯科之间中继电视信号。

历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，闪电号）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

For the Soviet Union, which occupies about one-sixth of the earth’s surface, an efficient system of space communications is a vital necessity. The country covers nearly 11,000 km from east to west and over 7,200 km from north to south, and is crossed by 11 time zones; in addition, there are tremendously varied climatic conditions and vast areas of rugged terrain.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：必选

对占据地球陆地面积约六分之一的苏联来说，建立高效的空间通信系统是至关重要的刚需。苏联东西横跨近 11,000 km，南北纵贯超过 7,200 km，跨越 11 个时区；此外，各地气候条件差异极大，且分布着广袤崎岖的地形。

历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600kg，闪电号）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The development of artificial satellites opens the possibility of applying microwave radio relay technology to transoceanic links, using a “microwave repeater in the sky”. The objective for this experiment is to answer the critical questions, leaving until a later round of design the optimization of trade-offs and the development and construction of a commercial operating system.

Historical example: Telstar 1 (78kg, Thor-Delta).
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：必选

人造卫星的发展使利用“空中微波转发器”将微波无线电中继技术应用于跨洋通信链路成为可能。本试验的目标是验证关键技术问题，系统的权衡优化以及商业运营系统的研制与建设则留待后续阶段进行。

历史参考：电星 1 号（78kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The development of artificial satellites opens the possibility of applying microwave radio relay technology to transoceanic links, using a “microwave repeater in the sky”. The objective for this experiment is to answer the critical questions, leaving until a later round of design the optimization of trade-offs and the development and construction of a commercial operating system.

Historical example: Relay 1 (79kg, Thor-Delta).
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：必选

人造卫星的发展使利用“空中微波转发器”将微波无线电中继技术应用于跨洋通信链路成为可能。本试验的目标是验证关键技术问题，系统的权衡优化以及商业运营系统的研制与建设则留待后续阶段进行。

历史参考：中继 1 号（79kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Satellite communications offers the ability to communicate with nearly any point on Earth, including the oceans. A ship equipped with a satellite terminal could be provided a reliable radio link to shore in nearly any condition, bypassing many of the difficulties involved in communicating with a vessel at sea. However, this will require a satellite terminal small enough to fit on a ship.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (39kg, Thor-Delta).
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：可选

卫星通信具备与地球上几乎任何地点（包括大洋）进行通信的能力。配备卫星终端的船只几乎可以在任何条件下与陆地保持可靠的无线电连接，避开海上船舶通信面临的诸多困难。然而，这需要研制出小到足以安装在船上的卫星终端。
历史参考：辛康 2 号（39kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

For a transatlantic satellite telecom system to be viable, it must provide a sustained link, not just a few minutes until the satellite passes below the horizon. Provide a transatlantic connection that supports a few voice channels for at least 12 hours a day. The lower required data rate should allow a very small satellite to be used, opening up the possibility for higher orbits.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (39kg, Thor-Delta).
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：可选

跨大西洋卫星电信系统要具备实用性，就必须提供持久的链路，而不能仅在卫星降至地平线以下的几分钟内有效。请建立一条每天至少支持 12 小时数路话音信道的跨大西洋连接。较低的数据速率需求可以使用极小型的卫星，从而为进入更高轨道创造条件。
历史参考：辛康 2 号（39kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

For a Transpacific satellite telecom system to be viable, it must provide a sustained link, not just a few minutes until the satellite passes below the horizon. Provide a Transpacific connection that supports a few voice channels for at least 12 hours a day. The lower required data rate should allow a very small satellite to be used, opening up the possibility for higher orbits.
Historical example: Syncom 3 (34kg, Thor-Delta)
zh:
方案：早期专注效益应用
类型：可选

跨太平洋卫星电信系统要具备实用性，就必须提供持久的链路，而不能仅在卫星降至地平线以下的几分钟内有效。请建立一条每天至少支持 12 小时数路话音信道的跨太平洋连接。较低的数据速率需求可以使用极小型的卫星，从而为进入更高轨道创造条件。
历史参考：辛康 3 号（34kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Cuba is a close ally to the Soviet Union, but it's position in the Caribbean leaves it surrounded by unfriendly forces. Satellite communications offers a way to safely link Cuba to the Soviet Union.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
方案：第一代专注效益应用
类型：可选

古巴是苏联的亲密盟友，但其地处加勒比海的地理位置使其处于敌对势力的包围之中。卫星通信提供了一种将古巴与苏联安全连接的方式。

历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，闪电号）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Australia is one of the furthest-flung members of the British Commonwealth, positioned in the southern hemisphere, nearly at the antipode of the British Isles. Even in the jet age, it takes a Boeing 707 a grueling 34 hours to make the trip from London to Sydney. We would like to end the isolation of "the land down under", and broadcast live television between Britain and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：可选

澳大利亚是英联邦中最遥远的成员国之一，位于南半球，几乎处于不列颠群岛的对跖点上。即使在喷气机时代，波音 707 从伦敦飞往悉尼也需要耗费漫长而疲惫的 34 小时。我们希望结束这片“南方大陆”的隔绝状态，在英国和澳大利亚之间进行电视直播。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The ability to relay television, voice and facsimile transmissions across the Atlantic ocean has proven useful. However, we would like to be able to maintain continuous communications, instead of being constrained by the timing of satellite passes.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：必需

事实证明，跨越大西洋中继电视、语音和传真传输的能力十分实用。然而，我们希望能维持持续不间断的通信，而不再受限于卫星过境的时间窗口。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The ability to relay television, voice and facsimile transmissions across the Pacific ocean has proven useful. However, we would like to be able to maintain continuous communications, instead of being constrained by the timing of satellite passes.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：必需

跨越太平洋中继电视、语音和传真传输的能力已被证明极具价值。然而，我们希望能维持不间断的通信，不再受限于卫星过境的时间窗口。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The success of the link between Moscow and Vladivostok has shown the viability of a system of space communications. We must now turn this experiment into an operational network for the entire Union.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：必需

莫斯科与符拉迪沃斯托克之间链路的成功，证明了天基通信系统的可行性。我们现在必须将这项试验转化为覆盖全联盟的实用业务网络。

历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

As part of a Franco-Soviet agreement on colour television, we are considering using the space segement of the Soviet television network to relay television between Paris and Moscow.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：必需

作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑利用苏联电视网络的天基段在巴黎与莫斯科之间中继电视信号。

历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to be able to broadcast live television between North America and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：可选

我们希望能实现北美洲与澳大利亚之间的电视直播。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Satellite communications offers the ability to communicate with nearly any point on Earth, including the oceans. A ship equipped with a satellite terminal could be provided a reliable radio link to shore in nearly any condition, bypassing many of the difficulties involved in communicating with a vessel at sea. However, this will require a satellite terminal small enough to fit on a ship.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：可选

卫星通信使我们能够与地球上的几乎任何地点进行联络，包括广袤的大洋。配备卫星终端的船只几乎可以在任何海况下与陆地建立可靠的无线电链路，绕过海上船只通信所面临的诸多难题。然而，这需要体积足够小、能够安装在船只上的卫星终端。

历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Mongolia is a close ally to the Soviet Union, but much like the eastern territories of the Soviet Union, it is sparsely populated and dominated by rugged terrain. Satellite telecommunication offers a way to easily provide TV to these remote areas.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：可选

蒙古是苏联的亲密盟友，但与苏联东部领土类似，其地广人稀且以崎岖地形为主。卫星电信为向这些偏远地区普及电视转播提供了一条便捷之路。

历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to create "Ground stations at sea", ships equipped with unified S-band antennas to relay data from manned and unmanned scientific spacecraft. However, a ship at sea cannot have a landline connection to mission control, and existing HF radio systems are unreliable and low quality. Instead, these ships have had a satellite communications terminal installed, allowing them to relay data back to mission control via communications satellites.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：可选

我们希望建立“海上地面站”，即配备统一 S 波段天线的船只，以中继载人和无人热心科研航天器的数据。然而，海上的船只无法通过陆线连接至任务控制中心，而现有的高频无线电系统可靠性差且质量低下。因此，这些船只安装了卫星通信终端，使其能够通过通信卫星将数据回传给任务控制中心。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。
我们的世界

src:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: CAPSTONE

Your satellite communications network has allowed the world to be connected like never before, routing live TV broadcasts across continents and over oceans. To celebrate this achievement we would like to make a special TV broadcast involving live footage from dozens of countries across the world. You will need to provide a connection for about 3 months for shakedown testing before the broadcast.
Author's note: Our World was televised June 1967, although the Soviet Union pulled out 4 days before the broadcast in protest of the Six-Day War.

Historical example: Intelsat I (39kg, Delta-D), Intelsat IIF-2 and F-3 (86kg, Delta-E1), and ATS-1 (352 kg, Atlas-Agena D).
zh:
项目：第一代专注效益应用
类型：收官任务

你的卫星通信网络使整个世界前所未有地紧密相连，将电视直播信号送过大洲与重洋。为了庆祝这一成就，我们计划举办一场包含全球数十个国家现场画面的特别电视直播。在正式播出前，你需要提供约 3 个月的稳定连接以进行试运转测试。
作者注：《我们的世界》于 1967 年 6 月播出，尽管苏联为了抗议六日战争在播出的 4 天前退出了该项目。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 I（39kg，Delta-D）、国际通信卫星 IIF-2 和 F-3（86kg，Delta-E1）以及 ATS-1（352 kg，Atlas-Agena D）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, South America, and Europe.

Historical example: Intelsat III series satellites (151kg, Delta-M).
zh:
项目：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必需

第一代电信卫星网络已大获成功。然而，对卫星通信的需求正在日益增长，更多国家希望获得专用的卫星链路。请建立同时覆盖北美洲、南美洲与欧洲的通信链路。

历史参考：国际通信卫星 III 系列卫星（151kg，Delta-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Satellites have proven to be a reliable way to communicate with our comrades in the Western Hemisphere. We would like to increase the capacity of the link between Moscow and Cuba.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
项目：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必要

卫星已被证明是与西半球同志进行通信的可靠途径。我们希望提高莫斯科与古巴之间链路的容量。

历史参考：闪电2系列卫星（1,700kg，闪电-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between Europe, Pakistan, Africa, Thailand and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat III series satellites (151kg, Delta-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必选

第一代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求持续增长，更多国家需要专用卫星链路。在欧洲、巴基斯坦、非洲、泰国与澳大利亚之间建立同步链路。

历史参考：通信卫星三号（Intelsat III）系列卫星（151kg，Delta-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

We have successfully deployed satellite communications across the Soviet Union. However, we would also like the ability to directly broadcast to other Soviet-aligned states. The Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications has been formed to bring satellite communications technology to Soviet allies in Europe.

Historical example: Molniya 3 series satellites (1,740kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必选

我们已成功在苏联境内完成卫星通信部署。然而，我们还希望能够直接向其他苏联阵营国家进行广播。国际宇宙通信组织（Intersputnik）已成立，旨在将卫星通信技术推广至欧洲的苏联盟友。

历史参考：闪电3型（Molniya 3）系列卫星（1,740kg，Molniya-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Fast and reliable communication between the United States and the Soviet Union is critical to prevent diplomatic incidents and misunderstandings. We would like to use satellite communications to ensure a fast and uninterruptible teletype link between Moscow and Washington D.C.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：可选

美苏之间快速可靠的通信对于防止外交事件和误解至关重要。我们希望利用卫星通信确保莫斯科与华盛顿特区之间快速且不间断的电传通信链路。

历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, we would like to improve bandwidth to utilize color television and improve quality. Further, we want be able to use satellite communications to relay information back to Moscow. Select stations across the Union have had transmission equipment installed. Improve the existing TV network while adding two-way voice capabilities.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必选

第一代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，我们希望提高带宽以支持彩色电视并改善质量。此外，我们希望利用卫星通信将信息传回莫斯科。苏联各地的指定地面站已安装发射设备。改善现有电视网络并增加双向语音功能。

历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, Japan, the Republic of China, Hong Kong and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat III series satellites (151kg, Delta-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必选

第一代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求持续增长，更多国家需要专用卫星链路。在北美、日本、中华民国、香港与澳大利亚之间建立同步链路。

历史参考：通信卫星三号（Intelsat III）系列卫星（151kg，Delta-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

As part of a Franco-Soviet agreement on colour television, we are considering using the space segement of the Soviet television network to relay television between Paris and Moscow.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：可选

作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑使用苏联电视网络的空间段在中继巴黎与莫斯科之间的电视信号。

历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to create "Ground stations at sea", ships equipped with high-gain antennas to relay data from manned and unmanned scientific spacecraft. However, a ship at sea cannot have a landline connection to mission control, and existing HF radio systems are unreliable and low quality. Instead, these ships have had a satellite communications terminal installed, allowing them to relay data back to mission control via communications satellites.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：可选

我们希望建立“海上地面站”，即装备高增益天线的船只，用于中继载人和无人热心科研航天器的数据。然而，海上的船只无法通过陆地线路连接任务控制中心，且现有的高频无线电系统可靠性低、质量差。为此，这些船只已安装卫星通信终端，使其能够通过通信卫星将数据传回任务控制中心。

历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to be able to relay live TV footage from manned spacecraft to mission control via tracking ships. Provide improved connections to our tracking ships.
zh:
方案：第二代专注效益应用
类型：可选

我们希望能够通过测量船将载人航天器的实时电视画面中继至任务控制中心。改善与我们测量船的通信连接。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, South America, and Europe.

Historical example: Intelsat IV series satellites (730kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh:
方案：第三代专注效益应用
类型：必选

第二代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求持续增长，更多国家需要专用卫星链路。在北美、南美与欧洲之间建立同步链路。

历史参考：通信卫星四号（Intelsat IV）系列卫星（730kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

The Canadian government has called for the establishment of a commercial, domestic satellite system to provide telecommunications services throughout the nearly 10 million square kilometers (4 million square miles) of Canada extending across six time zones. As the first stage of this system, satellite links should be established across the populated areas in the southern portion of Canada. This nearly 5,000 kilometer (3,000 mile) strip of land along the US-Canada border contains the majority of the Canadian population, and a satellite telecommunications should allow TV and voice circuits to be quickly routed from one side of the country to the other.

Historical example: Anik A series satellites (544kg, Delta 1914).
zh:
方案：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

加拿大政府呼吁建立一个专注效益的国内卫星系统，为横跨六个时区、近1000万平方公里（400万平方英里）的加拿大全境提供电信服务。作为该系统的第一阶段，应在加拿大南部人口稠密地区建立卫星链路。沿美加边界近5,000公里（3,000英里）的狭长地带聚集了加拿大的大部分人口，卫星电信应能够让电视与语音线路在全国东西两端之间快速接通。

历史参考：加拿大阿尼克A（Anik A）系列卫星（544kg，Delta 1914）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

The Canadian government has called for the establishment of a commercial, domestic satellite system to provide telecommunications services throughout the nearly 10 million square kilometers (4 million square miles) of Canada extending across six time zones. Hundreds of small towns, hamlets and clusters of isolated communities in northern areas have very limited communications. Satellite service offers a way for TV and radio programs to be distrubuted to remote communities in the Canadian north.

Historical example: Anik A series satellites (544kg, Delta 1914).
zh:
方案：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

加拿大政府呼吁建立一个专注效益的国内卫星系统，为横跨六个时区、近1000万平方公里（400万平方英里）的加拿大全境提供电信服务。北部数百个小镇、村落和孤立的定居点通信手段极其有限。卫星服务为向加拿大北部的偏远社区分发电视和广播节目提供了途径。

历史参考：加拿大阿尼克A（Anik A）系列卫星（544kg，Delta 1914）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Several corporations have expressed interest in establishing a domestic satellite communications network for voice, fax and data transmissions. A series of satellite earth stations distributed across the country will allow for fast and secure transmission of data.

Historical example: Western Union Westar series satellites (574kg, Delta 2914), RCA Satcom series satellites (868kg, Delta 3914), AT&T Comstar series satellites (1,516 kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

数家企业表示有兴趣建立国内卫星通信网络，用于语音、传真和数据传输。分布在全国各地的一系列卫星地面站将实现快速安全的数据传输。

历史参考：西联通信 Westar 系列卫星（574kg，Delta 2914）、RCA Satcom 系列卫星（868kg，Delta 3914）、AT&T Comstar 系列卫星（1,516kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Although satellite communications have brought state TV to millions across the vast territories of the Soviet Union, large swathes of territory remain without coverage. Even with recent advances in telecommunications technology, the satellite earth stations required to track, recieve and demodulate signals from out existing satellite network are too expensive and complex to install in every village, hamlet and logging camp across the vast territories of Siberia. Instead, we would like to transmit TV signals directly from orbit, where they can be recieved with standard TV and radio equipment, bringing accessible television to the entire Union.

Historical example: Ekran series satellites (1,970kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

尽管卫星通信已将国家电视信号带给全苏联广袤土地上的千百万人，但仍有大片区域未被覆盖。即使近年来电信技术有所突破，要在西伯利亚辽阔疆域上的每个村庄、聚落和伐木营地都安装用于跟踪、接收和解调现有卫星网络信号的卫星地面站，成本过高且过于复杂。因此，我们希望直接从轨道广播电视信号，只需标准的电视和无线电设备即可接收，让电视信号覆盖整个苏联。

历史参考：Ekran（荧屏）系列卫星（1,970kg，Proton-K Blok-DM）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Many TV studios have expressed interest in using leased domestic satellite communications to distribute TV programs. This will allow TV programs to be produced at a single central studio and be instantly transmitted to dozens of local studios across the country. In order to reduce costs, however, local TV studios will be equipped with very basic 4.5-meter satellite earth stations.

Historical example: Western Union Westar series satellites (574kg, Delta 2914), RCA Satcom series satellites (868kg, Delta 3914), AT&T Comstar series satellites (1,516 kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

许多电视台表示有兴趣租赁国内卫星通信信道来分发电视节目。这将允许电视节目在中央演播室制作完成后，即时分发至全国各地的数十家地方演播室。然而，为了降低成本，地方演播室将仅配备基础的 4.5 米卫星地面站。

历史参考：西联通信 Westar 系列卫星（574kg，Delta 2914）、RCA Satcom 系列卫星（868kg，Delta 3914）、AT&T Comstar 系列卫星（1,516kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务
你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

The C-band frequencies are heavily utilized for both satellite and terrestrial communications. There are growing concerns that there will not be enough bandwidth to accommodate future growth in telecommunications demand. Additionally, C-band satellite earth stations require large and expensive antennas to recieve signals from satellites in orbit. However, recent advances in technology have allowed for the creation of lightweight and efficient millimeter-wave transcievers, operating in what is now known as Ku-band.
Ku-band offers much wider frequency allocations than C-band, and allows for the use of much smaller antennas. This has allowed for the creation of a portable satellite earth station that is able to fit on a single truck. We would like to test the capabilities of this portable station to recieve and transmit TV from remote communities in the Canada.

Historical example: CTS "Hermes" (680kg, Delta 2914).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

C 频段频率已被卫星和地面通信大量占用。人们日益担忧现有带宽无法满足未来的电信增长需求。此外，C 频段卫星地面站需要庞大且昂贵的天线来接收轨卫星信号。不过，最新技术进展已实现了轻型高效毫米波收发机，运行在如今被称为 Ku 频段的频域。
Ku 频段相比 C 频段拥有更宽阔的可用频带，并允许使用尺寸小得多的天线。这使得单辆卡车即可容纳的便携式卫星地面站成为可能。我们希望测试这种便携式站点在加拿大偏远社区收发电视信号的能力。

历史参考：CTS "Hermes"（680kg，Delta 2914）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between Europe, Pakistan, Africa, Thailand and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat IV series satellites (730kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：必需

第二代电信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求正在激增，更多国家希望获得专属卫星链路。请在欧洲、巴基斯坦、非洲、泰国和澳大利亚之间建立同步通信链路。

历史参考：Intelsat IV 系列卫星（730kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

We have successfully deployed satellite communications across the Union. However, we would also like the ability to directly broadcast to other Soviet-aligned states. The Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications would like to bring satellite communications technology to Soviet allies in Central and Southeast Asia.

Historical example: Raduga/Gran series satellites (2,000kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：必需

我们已成功在全苏联部署卫星通信。然而，我们还希望能够直接向其他亲苏阵营国家广播。国际卫星通信组织（Intersputnik）希望将卫星通信技术拓展至中亚和东南亚的苏联盟友。

历史参考：Raduga/Gran（彩虹/格兰）系列卫星（2,000kg，Proton-K Blok-DM）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Satellites have proven to be a reliable way to communicate with our comrades in the Western Hemisphere. We would like to increase the capacity of the link between Moscow and Cuba. Additionally, Nicuragua has joined the Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications and needs satellite service as well.

Historical example: Molniya 3 series satellites (1,740kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：必需

事实证明，卫星是与我们在西半球的同志通信的可靠方式。我们希望扩大莫斯科与古巴之间通信链路的容量。此外，尼加拉瓜已加入国际卫星通信组织，同样需要卫星通信服务。

历史参考：Molniya 3 系列卫星（1,740kg，Molniya-M）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Maritime mobile communications on the high seas in the HF radio band suffer from the inherent limitations of signal propagation. Continuous, real-time, highly reliable communication to ships on the high seas is not available today, with an average message taking 12 hours to reach a ship at sea. With the power of satellite communications, we would like to provide reliable telephone and teletype service to the high seas.

Historical example: Marisat series satellites (362kg, Delta 2914).
zh:
项目：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

远海上的高频（HF）无线电移动通信受制于信号传播特性的固有缺陷。目前仍无法为远海船舶提供持续、实时、高可靠性的通信，一封电报平均需要 12 小时才能送达海上船只。借助卫星通信的力量，我们希望能为远海区域提供可靠的电话和电传打字机服务。

历史参考：Marisat 系列卫星（362kg，Delta 2914）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, with just a single central television feed, it is difficult to provide timely TV programming across 11 time zones. Further, our existing satellite earth stations are expensive to construct and maintain, and in order to continue spreading TV coverage to remote communities we would like to reduce costs. Provide five dedicated regional connections, and support connections to smaller satellite earth stations.

Historical example: Gorizont series satellites (2,300kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh:
计划：第三代专注效益应用
类型：必选

第二代通信卫星网络已证明非常成功。然而，仅靠单一的中央电视信号源，很难跨越11个时区及时提供电视节目。此外，我们现有的卫星地面站建造成本与维护费用高昂，为了继续将电视信号覆盖扩大到偏远社区，我们需要降低成本。请提供5个专用区域连接，并支持连接到较小的卫星地面站。

历史参考：地平线（Gorizont）系列卫星（2,300 kg，质子-K/D组级）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, Taiwan, Japan, Taiwan, and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat IV series satellites (730kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh:
计划：第三代专注效益应用
类型：必选

第二代通信卫星网络已证明非常成功。然而，对卫星通信的需求正在增长，更多国家希望获得专用卫星链路。请建立北美、台湾、日本与澳大利亚之间的同步链路。

历史参考：国际通信卫星IV系列（Intelsat IV）（730 kg，宇宙神-半人马座D）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

As part of a Franco-Soviet agreement on colour television, we are considering using the space segement of the Soviet television network to relay television between Paris and Moscow.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
计划：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑利用苏联电视网络空间段在巴黎和莫斯科之间转播电视节目。

历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700 kg，闪电-M）。

zh_samples: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的
在月球上完成科学任务目标

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to create "Ground stations at sea", ships equipped with high-gain antennas to relay data from manned and unmanned scientific spacecraft. However, a ship at sea cannot have a landline connection to mission control, and existing HF radio systems are unreliable and low quality. Instead, these ships have had a satellite communications terminal installed, allowing them to relay data back to mission control via communications satellites.

Historical example: Raduga/Gran series satellites (2,000kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh:
计划：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

我们希望建立“海上地面站”，即配备高增益天线的测控船，用于中继载人和无人科学航天器的数据。然而，海上的船只无法通过陆线与任务控制中心连接，而现有的高频无线电系统可靠性差且质量低下。因此，这些船只安装了卫星通信终端，使其能够通过通信卫星将数据回传给任务控制中心。

历史参考：虹（Raduga）/面（Gran）系列卫星（2,000 kg，质子-K/D组级）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Hawaii, Alaska and Puerto Rico are isolated from the continental United States by hundreds of miles of ocean or rugged terrain, rendering communications between them and the continental United States expensive and difficult using terrestrial methods. Several corporations have expressed interest in using the domestic US satellite network to establish reliable, high data-rate communications with their remote offices located in these areas. However, some modifications may be required to ensure a stable connection can be established with ground stations far from the continental US.

Historical example: Western Union Westar series satellites (574kg, Delta 2914), RCA Satcom series satellites (868kg, Delta 3914), AT&T Comstar series satellites (1,516 kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh:
计划：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

夏威夷、阿拉斯加和波多黎各与美国本土相隔数百英里的海洋或崎岖地形，利用地面手段在它们与本土之间建立通信既昂贵又困难。几家公司表示有兴趣利用美国国内卫星网络与位于这些地区的偏远办事处建立可靠的高速率数据通信。不过，可能需要进行一些改造，以确保能与远离美国本土的地面站建立稳定连接。

历史参考：西联西星（Westar）系列卫星（574 kg，德尔塔2914）、RCA Satcom系列卫星（868 kg，德尔塔3914）、AT&T Comstar系列卫星（1,516 kg，宇宙神-半人马座D）。

src:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Soviet vessels at on the high seas currently must undergo long periods of isolation from communications with fleet headquarters. Shore-based HF band is limited and unreliable, and in many areas Soviet shipping must rely on international communication networks, which the Soviet government considers an unacceptable security risk. With the power of satellite communications, we would like to provide reliable telephone and teletype service to the high seas.

Historical example: Gorizont series satellites (2,300kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh:
计划：第三代专注效益应用
类型：可选

目前公海上的苏联船只往往与舰队司令部长期处于通信失联状态。岸基高频频段通信受限且不可靠，在许多区域，苏联船运不得不依赖国际通信网络，苏联政府认为这是不可接受的安全隐患。借助卫星通信的力量，我们希望为公海提供可靠的电话和电传服务。

历史参考：地平线（Gorizont）系列卫星（2,300 kg，质子-K/D组级）。

src:
Program: Small Bodies Flyby
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Ceres within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh:
计划：小天体飞掠
类型：必选

建造一颗探测器并将其送往谷神星，在20,000 km以内完成飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

src:
Program: Small Bodies Flyby
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Mercury within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh:
计划：小天体飞掠
类型：必选

建造一颗探测器并将其送往水星，在20,000 km以内完成飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

src:
Program: Small Bodies Flyby
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Vesta within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh:
计划：小天体飞掠
类型：必选

建造一颗探测器并将其送往灶神星，在20,000 km以内完成飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

Type: Optional

Design, build, and launch a rocket with @/missionPayload.Print() units of Sounding Rocket Payload to a downrange distance of @/missionDistance.Print() km. @RP0:soundingTankAdvice Your rocket must be suborbital (over 140 km) for the contract to be completed. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice Perfecting this is part of Launch Vehicle development to utilize a gravity turn and tune your ascent profile and angle of attack. Elapsed/Expected Days: @elapsedDays / @RP0:expectedDays_DistanceSounding
zh:

src:
Program: Early Rocket Development
Type: Required

The challenge of orbit is not merely to go high, which has been shown by breaching the Karman line, but to achieve great horizontal speed. Design, build, and launch a rocket that will travel 3000 km or more over ground. Such a rocket is typically two stages (guided lower stage coupled with an unguided upper stage), has 6 km/s or more of delta-v, and is using upgraded engines, tanks, and/or avionics. Do this, and you will be halfway to orbit! Your rocket must be suborbital (over 140 km) for the contract to be completed. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice Perfecting this is part of launch vehicle development to tune your ascent profile and develop high-altitude staging methods. The current distance that your rocket has traveled can be seen in the contract parameters in the Contracts App display for this contract. It will update in real time. &br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice
zh:
计划：早期火箭开发
类型：必需

入轨的挑战不仅在于飞得高（冲破卡门线已证明了这一点），更在于获得极高的水平速度。设计、建造并发射一枚火箭，在地面上飞行 3000 km 或更远。此类火箭通常采用两级构型（受控下级配合无控上级），拥有 6 km/s 或更多的 Δv，并采用升级后的发动机、储箱和/或航电系统。完成此目标，你就已经完成入轨的一半了！火箭必须处于亚轨道（高度超过 140 km）方可完成合同。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice完善该过程是运载火箭开发的一部分，有助于优化你的上升轨迹并开发高空分级技术。当前火箭已飞行的距离可在合同应用程序界面中的该合同参数内查看。它将实时更新。&br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice

Just design and build a vessel, roll it out to the pad (or the runway if it's an airplane), throttle up with "Z" and stage to take off! (And note all the records to break in the 'Active Contracts' tab. They update, so keep checking.) If you haven't already, look at the tutorial on the GitHub wiki for advice on this and other missions.
zh:

src:
Program: Early Rocket Development or Suborbital Research
Type: Required

The Karman line is the line at which the speed necessary to maintain altitude via lift is the same as the speed required for orbit. It's the traditional dividing line between the atmosphere and space (despite there being nonzero pressure well above it; Earth's atmosphere extends quite far indeed). We want you to send something above it!
zh:
计划：早期火箭开发或亚轨道研究
类型：必需

卡门线是指依靠空气动力升力维持飞行高度所需的速度与轨道速度相等的边界高度。它历来被视为大气层与太空的分界线（尽管在此高度之上仍存在非零的大气压力；地球大气层确实延伸得很远）。我们希望你将物体发射到该线之上！

Type: CAPSTONE

By training and launching a larger mammal in a capsule with recording instruments, we can test how astronauts might perform tasks under similar conditions. For instance, whether they'll be able to focus under the heavy G-loads, vibrations, and noise encountered during the launch into and recovery from orbit.
Carry an advanced biological capsule and @payload units of monitoring instrumentation on a suborbital trajectory, then recover the experiment.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Advanced Biological Suborbital Experiment' contract will become available.

携带一个高级生物实验舱和 @payload 单位的监测仪器进入亚轨道轨迹，随后回收该实验。

完成此合同后，将解锁“高级生物亚轨道实验”合同。

Program: Early Rocket Development
Type: Required

As early as 1947 the U.S. was launching fruit flies into space on suborbital trajectories and recovering them, but it wasn't until 1951 that a monkey named Yorick and eleven mice were successfully recovered from an Aerobee flight. The Soviets preferred dogs and returned many from suborbital flights, the first two being Dezik and Tsygan in 1951 on top of an R-1. Although it is not a requirement to launch a biological capsule for this mission, it is a perfect opportunity to do so. Send a rocket out of the atmosphere (140 km) and return at least some of the craft back to Earth, intact, for study.
zh:
项目：早期火箭研制
类型：必要

早在1947年，美国就已通过亚轨道弹道将果蝇送入太空并成功回收，但直到1951年，名为Yorick的猴子和11只小鼠才在一架Aerobee火箭的飞行中被成功回收。苏联人更倾向于使用犬类，并从亚轨道飞行中多次回收它们，最早的两只是1951年搭乘 R-1 的德齐克（Dezik）和吉甘（Tsygan）。虽然本次任务不强制要求发射生物舱，但这无疑是一次绝佳的机会。发射一枚火箭穿出大气层（140 km），并使航天器的至少一部分完好无损地返回地球以供研究。

src:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Capstone

A use for space shuttles is orbital servicing, docking to an existing satellite and performing repairs, like the Space Shuttle did to fix the Hubble Space Telescope. Docking is also necessary to bring crew to space stations. Perform the first docking between a spaceplane and another spacecraft.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Docking' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.
zh:
项目：载人空天飞机研制
类型：顶点

航天飞机的一项重要用途是在轨维护——与现有卫星对接并执行维修任务，就像航天飞机维护哈勃空间望远镜那样。对接也是运送乘员前往空间站的必要手段。执行一次空天飞机与另一艘航天器之间的首次对接。&br;&br;注意：你不能同时接取此合同与“首次对接”合同。若在激活此合同时接取另一合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-CanaveralHD 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。

src:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Required

Putting a human into orbit around the Earth is a major milestone in spaceplane development. Such a spaceplane needs to be capable of both extended operation in space, like traditional spacecraft, but also atmospheric flight at speeds up to 7 km/s. The task requires a reliable launch system and many hours of research and engineering to pull off. Single-person orbital spaceplanes were not historically built, but a number of concepts were studied and X-20 Dyna-Soar (1966 planned, Titan III) even began construction, paving the way for later more capable vehicles.&br;&br;NOTE: Unlike capsule missions, this contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.&br;&br;HINT: Launching slightly northwards (if in the Northern Hemisphere) instead of due East will put the launch site back under your track after a small number of orbits, reducing crossrange requirements.&br;&br;NOTE: Completing this contract will cause the 'Suborbital Spaceplane (Crewed)' contracts to become unavailable. If it is accepted then it will automatically fail.
zh:
项目：载人空天飞机研制
类型：必要

将人类送入环绕地球的轨道是空天飞机研制过程中的重大里程碑。此类空天飞机不仅需要像传统航天器一样具备长时间在太空运行的能力，还必须能够在大气层内以高达 7 km/s 的速度飞行。这项任务需要可靠的发射系统，以及数以千计小时的研究与工程设计才能实现。历史上并未建造过单人轨道空天飞机，但曾研究过多种概念设计，X-20 Dyna-Soar（原计划1966年，大力神III）甚至已动工建造，为后续性能更强大的飞行器奠定了基础。&br;&br;注意：与返回舱任务不同，此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-CanaveralHD 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。&br;&br;提示：向稍偏北方向发射（若位于北半球）而非正东方向，可以使发射场在少数几圈轨道后重新位于你的地面轨迹下方，从而降低横向航程需求。&br;&br;注意：完成此合同将导致“亚轨道空天飞机（载人）”系列合同不可用。若已接取该合同，它将自动失败。

Type: Optional

Design, build, and launch a spaceplane that remains for @/NoOfOrbits orbits and return the crew safely back to Earth.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and the Orbital Flight (One Crew) or Orbital Spaceplane with Maneuvers and 2+ Crew contract. zh:
项目：载人空天飞机研制
类型：可选

历史上并未建造过单人轨道空天飞机，但曾研究过多种概念设计，X-20 Dyna-Soar（原计划1966年，大力神III）甚至已动工建造，为后续性能更强大的飞行器奠定了基础。设计、建造并试射一架空天飞机，在轨飞行 @/NoOfOrbits 圈并将乘员安全带回地球。&br;&br;注意：你不能同时接取此合同与“轨道飞行（单人）”或“带机动与2人以上乘员的轨道空天飞机”合同。若在激活此合同时接取另一合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-CanaveralHD 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。务必合理规划轨道以确保在正确地点再入。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 无限制

Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Optional

The goal and realization of putting three (or more) crew on orbit at the same time begins the era of the space shuttle and ready access to LEO. These craft should be able to support at least three crew and prove that they can stay in orbit for @/DurationText days before returning to a runway landing. The U.S. Space Shuttle (1981, STS) performed this mission, while the Soviet Буран (1988, Energia) was designed to do the same but made only one, unmanned, orbital flight before cancellation.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'Orbital Flight with at Least Three Crew' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh:
方案：载人空天飞机研发
类型：可选

同时将三名（或更多）乘员送入轨道的设想与实现，开启了航天飞机以及便捷往返近地轨道（LEO）的时代。航天器应能支持至少三名乘员，并证明其能在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天，然后返回跑道着陆。美国航天飞机（1981年，STS）执行过此类任务，而苏联暴风雪号（Буран，1988年，能源号）虽设计具有同样能力，但在取消前仅执行过一次无人轨道飞行。&br;&br;注意：不可同时接取此合同与“至少三名乘员的轨道飞行”。若在此合同有效时接取另一合同，本合同将自动判定失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道水平着陆。若在卡纳维拉尔角游玩，RSS-CanaveralHD 模组提供的航天飞机跑道也是有效着陆目标。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 无限制

Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Required

One mission planned for reconnaissance spaceplanes such as Dyna-Soar II was to rendezvous with and investigate satellites on orbit. Using your own knowledge of orbital mechanics, bring two craft to within 100 meters of each other while in orbit around Earth. At least one of the spacecraft must be a newly launched spaceplane which subsequently lands on the runway.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Rendezvous' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.
zh:
方案：载人空天飞机研发
类型：必要

恐龙 II（Dyna-Soar II）等侦察空天飞机规划的一项任务，是与在轨卫星交会并进行调查。运用你的轨道力学知识，让两个航天器在环绕地球轨道上交会至相距 100 米以内。其中至少一艘航天器必须是新发射的空天飞机，且随后在跑道上着陆。&br;&br;注意：不可同时接取此合同与“首次交会”。若在此合同有效时接取另一合同，本合同将自动判定失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道水平着陆。若在卡纳维拉尔角游玩，RSS-CanaveralHD 模组提供的航天飞机跑道也是有效着陆目标。

Type: Optional

Crewed suborbital flights are used as a safer prelude to an orbital mission, for research, or to set non-orbital altitude records. Send any number of crew above @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude meters and land on the runway to satisfy the requirements of this mission. Historical missions used the X-15 (1963, B-52), and SpaceShipOne (2004, White Knight).NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Orbital Spaceplane Flight', 'X-Planes (Suborbital)', or 'Suborbital Flight (Crewed)' at the same time. src:
Program: X-Plane Research
Type: Required

Design, build, and fly a crewed aircraft or rocket to attain Mach 1 and hold above it for 30 seconds. Vital to the development of new wing shapes and high-speed aerodynamics (the area rule, swept wings, mach tuck, and so on), breaching the sound barrier is a worthy scientific endeavor. Firsts include the U.S. Bell X-1 (1947), the Soviet Lavochkin La-176 (1948), and the British de Havilland DH.108 (1948).

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh:
项目：X-Plane研究
类型：必要

设计、制造并试飞一架载人飞机或火箭，达到 1 马赫并保持该速度以上 30 秒。突破音障对于新型机翼形状和高速空气动力学（面积律、后掠翼、马赫俯头等）的发展至关重要，是一项热心科研的卓越壮举。先驱机型包括美国贝尔 X-1（1947 年）、苏联拉沃奇金 La-176（1948 年）和英国德哈维兰 DH.108（1948 年）。

注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员在发射载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要进行熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次，永久有效。接下来是针对发射时所处部件的任务训练。每次飞行前都必须进行任务训练，使用后或闲置时间过长均会失效。要开始训练航天员，请通过工具栏上的 RP-1 图标打开 RP-1 窗口，转到“训练”标签页。

照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src: Craft must have Electric Charge after one day

To investigate determination of spacecraft attitude in yaw and pitch from measurement of ion flow variations. The recording of ion sensor outputs during pitch and yaw maneuvers will be compared with data obtained from the inertial guidance system and the horizon scanner. Results of the comparison and the astronaut evaluation will form the basis for further development of simple, lightweight orbital attitude determination systems.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 48 hours.
zh: 通过测量离子流变化来研究航天器偏航与俯仰姿态的测定。将俯仰和偏航机动期间离子传感器的输出记录与惯导系统和地平扫描仪获取的数据进行比对。比对结果与宇航员的评估将为进一步开发简易、轻型的轨道姿态测定系统奠定基础。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 48 小时。

src: To test the usefulness and performance of a low-light-level television system as a supplement to unaided vision in observing surface features primarily when such features are in darkness and spacecraft pilots are not dark-adapted.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 测试微光电视系统的实用性与性能，作为肉眼视力的补充，主要用于在地面目标处于黑暗中且航天器驾驶员尚未适应暗光时观察地表特征。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

src: Crew photographs of land and ocean areas for geologic, geographic, and oceanographic study for evaluation of various film typesThis experiment can be completed 3 times. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 乘员拍摄陆地和海洋区域的照片，用于地质、地理和海洋学研究，并评估各类胶片的性能。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

src: Crew photographs of global and local weather systems for use by scientists in improving techniques of interpretation of orbital altitude weather photographs.This experiment can be completed 3 times. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 乘员拍摄全球和局部天气系统，供科学家改进轨道高度气象照片的判读技术。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

src: It will be necessary for our future spacecraft to be able to change their orbits in order to rendezvous and dock. This experiment will test the Orbital Maneuvering system to better understand what is required and possible.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 未来的航天器必须能够改变轨道以进行交会对接。本实验将测试轨道机动系统，以更好地了解相关需求和可行性。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 2 小时。

src: The visual ability of the astronauts in the detection and recognition of objects on the Earth's or Moon's surface will be tested. This experiment can be completed three times. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 测试宇航员在探测和识别地球或月球表面目标时的视觉能力。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 2 小时。

src: To study the feasibility and operational value of star occulting measurements in the development of a simple, accurate, and self-contained navigational capability by measuring the time stars dip behind an established horizon.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 24 hours.
zh: 通过测量恒星沉入既定地平线以下的时间，研究恒星掩星测量值在开发简易、精确且自主的导航能力方面的可行性与实用价值。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 24 小时。

src: To determine man's ability to perform work tasks in pressurized suit under zero gravity.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 24 hours.
zh: 测定人在零重力环境下身着增压服执行工作任务的能力。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 24 小时。

src: This experiment is designed to explore the possibility of the existence of a gravitational field effect on cells exposed to microgravity situations. These irregularities would be easier to explore in simple cell systems. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 3 hours.
zh: 本实验旨在探索微重力环境下细胞是否存在重力场效应。这类异常现象在简单的细胞系统中更容易探索。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 3 小时。

src: The objective is to examine the biological effects of radiation. The experiment will test the possibility that weightlessness interacts with radiation to produce unpredicted effects greater than the sum of their individual effects. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 48 hours.
zh: 目的是检查辐射的生物学效应。实验将检验失重与辐射相互作用产生超出各自效应总和的不可预测影响的可能性。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 48 小时。

src: The objectives of this experiment are to assess the crew's state of alertness, levels of consciousness, and depth of sleep during flight.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 72 hours.
zh: 本实验的目的是评估乘员在飞行期间的警觉状态、意识水平和睡眠深度。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 72 小时。

src: Our scientists have come up with a fancy way of packaging food for consumption in space. We need the crew to evaluate how the trip to space has affected this packaging and the quality of the food. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 1 hour.
zh: 我们的科学家研发出了一种用于太空食用的高级食品包装。我们需要乘员评估太空飞行对该包装以及食品质量造成的影响。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 1 小时。

src: The astronauts will use a bungee cord to assess their capacity to do physical work under space flight conditions. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 1 hour.
zh: 宇航员将使用弹力绳评估他们在太空飞行条件下进行体力劳动的能力。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 1 小时。

src: Study the capability of crew to provide a reliable method of navigation without input from the ground utilizing a space stedimeter and a sextant.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 利用太空视距仪和六分仪，研究乘员在脱离地面支持的情况下提供可靠导航方法的能力。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

src: To obtain photographs of zodiacal light, airglow layer, and other dim light phenomena, including day sky brightness from orbital altitude.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 从轨道高度拍摄黄道光、气辉层以及包括白昼天空亮度在内的其他微光现象的照片。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

src: To obtain information on communication systems operating through the ionosphere.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 获取穿越电离层运行的通信系统的相关信息。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

src: To analyze the health of humans in space over a prolonged period of time. NOTE: This experiment takes half a year and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days
zh: 长期分析人体在太空中的健康状况。注意：此实验耗时半年，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷

src: To track the movement of civilian ships and naval vessels with Visible, Infrared, and Radio light NOTE: This experiment takes 30 Days.
zh: 利用可见光、红外线和无线电波追踪民用船只和海军舰艇的动向 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

src: To utilize an orthicon to analyze UV radiation near orbital vessels NOTE: This experiment takes 6 Days.
zh: 利用超正规管分析轨道航天器附近的紫外辐射 注意：此实验耗时 6 天。

src: To analyze the airglow formed by radiation interacting with the upper atmosphere NOTE: This experiment takes 6 hours.
zh: 分析辐射与高层大气相互作用形成的气辉 注意：此实验耗时 6 小时。

src: To test secure communication using a narrow radio beam NOTE: This experiment takes 1 Day.
zh: 测试利用窄波束无线电的安全通信 注意：此实验耗时 1 天。

src: To test secure communication using a narrow laser beam NOTE: This experiment takes 1 Day.
zh: 测试利用窄波束激光的安全通信 注意：此实验耗时 1 天。

src: To test an evaporator for vacuum distillation/vapor filtration water reclamation system for use on manned space flights. NOTE: This experiment takes 7 Days.
zh: 测试载人航天飞行所用的真空蒸馏/蒸汽过滤水回收系统蒸发器。注意：此实验耗时 7 天。

src: To monitor X-ray flux emitted by the Sun NOTE: This experiment takes 30 Days.
zh: 监测太阳发射的 X 射线通量 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

src: To further analyze the health of humans in space over an extended period of time. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 years and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days.
zh: 在更长的时间内进一步分析人体在太空中的健康状况。注意：此实验耗时 2 年，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷。

src: To utilize an emulsion consisting of silver-halide crystals in gelatin to identify atomic nuclei in cosmic rays NOTE: This experiment takes 21 days.
zh: 利用明胶中卤化银晶体构成的乳胶来识别宇宙射线中的原子核 注意：此实验耗时 21 天。

src: To analyze ultraviolet line spectra of stars in the Milky Way and other galaxies NOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 分析银河系及其他星系中恒星的紫外线谱线 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

src: To photograph ultraviolet and x-ray line spectra of stars in the Milky Way and other galaxies NOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 拍摄银河系及其他星系中恒星的紫外线和 X 射线谱线 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

src: To analyze airglow in the upper atmosphere in the UV spectrumNOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 在紫外光谱中分析高层大气的气辉 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Now that satellite navigation technology has been proven, we need to launch more capable satellites to expand navigation coverage further around Earth. Our customers want their own satellite capabilities tailored to their specific needs. Launch new navigation satellites with the required specifications into the specified orbits.

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

Once more than half of the expected days have been elapsed, the reward of this contract will slowly increase over time, but will be reset to 0 after each completion.
Current reward is at @rewardFactorPercent % of its nominal value. Elapsed/Expected Days: @elapsedDays / @RP0:expectedDays_EarlyComSat
Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh:
项目：早期专注效益应用
类型：可选

既然卫星导航技术已得到验证，我们需要发射性能更强的卫星，以进一步扩大环绕地球的导航覆盖范围。客户希望获得根据其特定需求量身定制的专用卫星功能。将符合要求规格的新导航卫星发射入指定轨道。

注意：完成合同后卫星将被销毁。这代表将载荷控制权移交给客户。

一旦超过预期天数的一半，该合同的奖励将随时间缓慢增加，但在每次完成后将重置为0。
当前奖励为标称值的 @rewardFactorPercent %。已过/预期天数：@elapsedDays / @RP0:expectedDays_EarlyComSat
已完成合同数：@index / 无限制

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务
你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部

src:
Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Having a communication satellite that remains stationary relative to a ground station means that the antenna wouldn't need to track movements to stay connected. This would greatly simplify communication relay and mass transmission systems.
Historical example: Syncom 3 (39 kg, Thor-Delta) launched in August of 1964.
zh:
项目：先进专注效益应用
类型：必需

让通信卫星相对于地面站保持静止，意味着天线无需跟踪其移动即可保持连接。这将极大简化通信中继和大容量传输系统。
历史参考：Syncom 3（39 kg，雷神-德尔塔），于1964年8月发射。

src:
Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

With an orbital period of an earth day, a satellite will remain above a constant longitude, appearing to drift north and south through the day. This will allow for constant connection to a ground station.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (39kg, Thor-Delta) launched in July of 1963.
zh:
项目：先进专注效益应用
类型：可选

当轨道周期为一个地球日时，卫星将保持在恒定经度上空，在一天中呈现南北漂移的轨迹。这可以实现与地面站的持续连接。

src:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The previous launch of the first navigation satellite proved the theories that Doppler shift timing can be used to precisely locate a point or location on the surface of the Earth using satellites. Put that concept into operational use with the first rudimentary satellite navigation network.

Build a navigation network with four NavSats that provide more frequent revisit rates than the single previous satellite. Make sure the satellites are spread around the Earth to provide reasonable coverage.&br;&br;NOTE: You may choose only the 3-satellite or 4-satellite contract.

NOTE: The satellites will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Communications around the globe are limited to line of sight because of the curvature of Earth. If we can launch a communications satellite into orbit, we can use it to transmit information to the opposite side of the world.

Historical example: Telstar 1 (78kg, Thor-Delta)

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 (270) degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. This keeps the satellite mostly to the northern hemisphere of the Earth. Place a satellite into a Molniya orbit.

There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya)

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

By measuring the Doppler shift of radio signals from a satellite in a known orbit, it is possible for a receiver on the ground to establish their location, which would have many applications both civilian and military. To test the principle and develop receiver equipment, it is necessary to have a test navigational satellite in orbit.
Historical example: Transit 1B (119 kg, Thor-Ablestar).

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

src: The Science Sample Return Capsule is based on the Corona/Discoverer satellites from the United States in the early 1960's. These capsules were used to send film back to Earth to be processed for analysis. In-game, you can use this to return your valuable samples and science data from low Earth orbit. Note that the heat shield on this part is a <b>heatsink<b>, meaning it can only survive steep re-entries (perigee around -500 km) with high peak heat flux but low total heating. Historically, the Corona return capsules used a Star-12 SRM for deorbiting, which is comparable to a Baby Sergeant. [Diameter 0.6 m]
zh: 科学样本返回舱基于 20 世纪 60 年代初美国的“日冕/发现者”卫星设计。这些返回舱曾用于将胶卷送回地球进行冲洗和分析。在游戏中，你可以用它从近地轨道运回宝贵的样本和科学数据。请注意，该部件上的防热盾属于<b>散热阱<b>，这意味着它只能承受峰值热通量高但总受热量低的陡峭再入轨道（近地点约 -500 km）。在历史上，“日冕”返回舱使用 Star-12 固体火箭发动机进行离轨制动，其性能相当于“小警官”（Baby Sergeant）。[直径 0.6 m]

src:
The experimental era is over. We have proven that satellites can see the Earth; now we must put them to work. This program shifts from simple prototypes to the establishment of dedicated operational networks. The goal is no longer to just survive in orbit, but to provide a constant stream of actionable data for national security and public safety.
Author's Note: This program requires Surface Science (1969-1971).
zh:
试验时代已经结束。我们已经证明了卫星能够俯瞰地球；现在我们必须让它们发挥实效。该计划从简单的原型研制转向建立专门的业务化网络。目标不再仅仅是在轨生存，而是为国家安全与公共安全提供持续、可用的数据流。
作者注：该计划需要“地表科学（1969-1971）”。

src:
We are expanding our vision beyond the visible spectrum and simple photography. The advanced platforms we will launch now require complex orbital insertions and long-duration stability to revolutionise our understanding of the planet's changing environment.
Author's Note: This program requires Deep Space Science (1972-1980).
zh:
我们的视野正拓展至可见光波段和简单摄影之外。我们即将发射的先进平台需要复杂的入轨机动与长期的稳定性，以彻底革新我们对地球环境变化的认识。
作者注：该计划需要“深空科学（1972-1980）”。

zh_samples: CST-100“星际客机”商业乘员运输系统（COTS）的指令舱。设计最多可重复使用10次。
NASA 对接系统（NDS）是用于美国载人航天器的航天器对接与停泊机构，例如猎户座多功能载人飞船和商业载人航天器。
高分辨率胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄行星照片。这台相机提供极高分辨率的照片，且底片需要回收至地球。历史上，这些相机曾以KH-9“六边形”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，但对于RP-1而言，它们代表了商业公司的第一批高分辨率卫星相机。

src:
Although the earliest satellites were launched through government programs, commercial uses had been envisioned for a long time. Through this program, you will launch the earliest iterations of commercial-use satellites. With wildly varying needs, each satellite is dedicated to a specific requirement, typically with far more focused requirements than the earlier, broader scientific satellites.
Author's Note: These contracts will require a satellite relay to be maintained for ONE YEAR.
zh:
尽管最早的卫星是通过政府项目发射的，但人们早就设想过商业用途。通过该计划，你将发射最早一批商业用途卫星。由于需求千差万别，每颗卫星都专门针对特定需求设计，通常比早期用途广泛的科学卫星要求更为明确。
作者注：这些合同需要保持卫星中继运行一年。

src:
Geosynchronous, Geostationary, Molniya, and Tundra orbits have the potential to improve satellite coverage and simplify ground antenna tracking. This program tasks you with testing these orbits, launching satellites into them for commercial customers, and creating a satellite network for communication.
Author's Note: These contracts will require a satellite relay to be maintained FOREVER.
zh:
地球同步轨道、地球静止轨道、莫尼亚轨道与金德拉轨道具有改善卫星覆盖范围并简化地面天线跟踪的潜力。该计划要求你测试这些轨道，为专注效益的客户向这些轨道发射卫星，并建立通信卫星网络。
作者注：这些合同需要永久保持卫星中继运行。

zh_samples: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的
在月球上完成科学任务目标

src:
Jupiter presents many opportunities for exploration, but also many challenges: it requires almost the same amount of energy for a spacecraft to reach Jupiter from Earth's orbit as it does to lift it into orbit in the first place. Gravity assists can be used to save delta-v at the cost of flight duration. Once there, a rich and diverse system awaits any explorer. Along with the largest planet in the Solar System, the Jovian system is also home to the largest moon, Ganymede, a planetary-mass moon. This program will send uncrewed scientific probes to Jupiter and its moons.

Historically, Jupiter is the most-visited outer planet, with 9 missions having completed flybys or entered orbits, most notably by the Voyager missions in 1979 on their flybys towards the outer Solar System, and by the Juno orbiter whose mission continues today. Most recently, NASA's Europa Clipper mission departed in 2024 enroute to the Galilean moons.
zh:
木星带来了许多探测机遇，但也伴随着重重挑战：航天器从地球轨道飞往木星所需的能量，几乎与最初将其送入轨道所需的能量相当。可以利用引力助推来节省Δv，代价是延长飞行时间。一旦抵达，一个丰富多样的系统正等待着探索者。除了太阳系中最大的行星之外，木星系还是太阳系最大卫星——具有行星级质量的木卫三的家园。该计划将向木星及其卫星派遣无人科学探测器。

历史上，木星是到访次数最多的外行星，共有 9 次任务完成了飞掠或入轨，其中最著名的是 1979 年旅行者号在飞往外太阳系途中的飞掠，以及至今仍在执行任务的朱诺号轨道器。最近，NASA 的欧罗巴快船任务已于 2024 年启程前往伽利略卫星群。

src:
Known for its photogenic rings, Saturn has long been a subject of observation and exploration. Visible from Earth with little more than a set of binoculars, Saturn's rings have intrigued observers for centuries. Further, with the highest number of moons in the entire Solar System, and more discovered with each additional mission, the Saturn system is a destination with extensive exploration opportunities. Titan, the largest moon of Saturn, may have an atmosphere conducive to life, while Enceladus is thought to contain liquid water below its icy exterior. Explore the Saturn system with uncrewed probes, analyzing the atmospheres of Saturn and Titan, and take a closer look at the larger moons of the system.

Historical missions to Saturn include flybys from Pioneer 11 and both Voyagers, while the Cassini orbiter mission operated from 2004 to 2017.
zh:
土星以其优美上镜的光环而闻名，长期以来一直是观测和探索的对象。只需一副双筒望远镜即可从地球上观测到，土星的环形结构几个世纪以来一直吸引着观测者。此外，土星拥有全太阳系最多的卫星，且每次任务都会发现更多，因此土星系是一个拥有广阔探索机遇的目的地。土卫六是土星最大的卫星，可能拥有孕育生命的大气层，而土卫二被认为在其冰层之下存在液态水。利用无人探测器探索土星系统，分析土星和土卫六的大气，并近距离观察该系统的各大卫星。

历史上前往土星的任务包括先驱精神 11 号和两艘旅行者号的飞掠，而卡西尼号轨道器任务则在 2004 年至 2017 年间运行。

src: This experiment is designed to test how well humans can track objects in space. A multicolor, mylar balloon, about the size of a beach ball, will be extended on a tether for the crew member to track.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 该实验旨在测试人类在太空中跟踪目标的能力。一个沙滩球大小的彩色聚酯薄膜气球将通过系绳释放，供乘员进行追踪。该实验可完成两次。注意：该实验需要 2 小时。

src: Maneuvering in space will be very important if we want to continue our exploration. We need the crew member to see how the spacecraft reacts and maneuvers with yaw, pitch and roll controls. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: Experiment takes 1 hour of Crew Observations to complete
zh: 如果我们想继续探索，太空机动将至关重要。我们需要乘员观察航天器在偏航、俯仰和滚转控制下的反应与机动表现。该实验可完成两次。注意：实验需要 1 小时的乘员观测方可完成

src: By using a hand-held camera, our crew can take images of locations on Earth that our scientists are intersted in. These images can be of much higher quality than our current satellite technology can accomplish. This experiment can be completed four times. NOTE: Experiment takes 1 hour of Crew Observations to complete
zh: 通过使用手持相机，乘员可以拍摄科学家感兴趣的地球区域图像。这些图像的清晰度可以远高于当前卫星技术所能达到的水平。该实验可完成四次。注意：实验需要 1 小时的乘员观测方可完成

src: Broadcast live black & white analog television while landed on the moon. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 4 hours and can only be completed landed on the moon.

src: To fabricate a lamellar eutetic composite in the absence of thermal convectionNOTE: This experiment takes 6 hours.
zh: 在无热对流环境下制备层状共晶复合材料。注意：该实验耗时 6 小时。

src: To determine the effects of zero-G on the growth of Gallium Arsenide CrystalsNOTE: This experiment takes 115 hours.
zh: 测定零重力对砷化镓晶体生长的影响。注意：该实验耗时 115 小时。

src: To analyze the health of humans in Lunar space over an extended period of time. NOTE: Requires a Scientist. This experiment takes 720 Days and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days.
zh: 长期分析地月空间中人体的健康状况。注意：需要一名科学家。该实验耗时 720 天，每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷。

src: Advanced health monitoring and lab work, activity experimentation and in-situ analysis of working and living on lunar regolith. NOTE: This experiment takes 720 days and consumes 12000L of Research Payload.
zh: 在月壤环境中工作与生活的高级健康监测、实验室工作、活动实验及原位分析。注意：该实验耗时 720 天，消耗 12000L 研究载荷。

src: The extreme darkness, lack of atmosphere and stability provided by solid ground is ideal for high precision astronomy. NOTE: This experiment takes 14 days and must run during the lunar night.
zh: 极端黑暗、无大气干扰以及坚实地面提供的稳定性是高精度天文学观测的理想条件。注意：该实验耗时 14 天，且必须在月夜期间进行。

src: A basic, heavily miniaturized tape drive, capable of storing a few hours of data from early science experiments. <color=green>Base Capacity: 6.3 kB</color>
zh: 一种基础的高度小型化磁带机，能够存储早期科学实验数小时的数据。<color=green>基础容量：6.3 kB</color>

src: Although essentially the same as the early tape recorder, increased size allows for more tape to be loaded, improving capacity. <color=green>Base Capacity: 25 kB</color>
zh: 尽管本质上与早期磁带录音机相同，但扩大的尺寸允许装入更多磁带，从而提升了容量。<color=green>基础容量：25 kB</color>

src: A full-size tape drive for more advanced satellites, this is capable of storing much more data, such as slow-scan TV images. <color=green>Base Capacity: 125 kB</color>
zh: 适用于更先进卫星的全尺寸磁带机，能够存储更多数据，例如慢扫描电视图像。<color=green>基础容量：125 kB</color>

src: Transistorized electronics allow for better read/write sensitivity, enabling more data to be stored on the same length of tape. <color=green>Base Capacity: 700 kB</color>
zh: 晶体管化电子学带来了更好的读写灵敏度，使同等长度的磁带能够存储更多数据。<color=green>基础容量：700 kB</color>

src: Using a digital computer to digitize and compress data increases the effective capacity that can be stored on a data tape by an order of magnitude. <color=green>Base Capacity: 3 MB</color>
zh: 使用数字计算机对数据进行数字化和压缩，使数据带的有效存储容量提升了一个数量级。<color=green>基础容量：3 MB</color>

src: A division of Wenkel Corporation, RealChutes was the result of an Industry-Government-Academia Joint Research project undertaken in conjunction with the Kerbal Space Administration (KSA) and the University of Kerbin to develop improved spacecraft recovery systems.
zh: 作为 Wenkel Corporation 的一个部门，RealChutes 是与坎巴拉航天局（KSA）和坎原大学联合开展的“产官学联合研究”项目的成果，旨在开发更先进的航天器回收系统。

zh_samples: 气泵
严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。
一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

src: Originally founded by Wenkel Kerman in KY 450 to commercialize his vapor-compression refrigeration units for domestic use, the company now develops and manufactures air conditioning and thermal control systems for the aerospace industry. More recently, it has entered the spacecraft recovery systems market through innovative new products by its subsidiary, RealChute Aerodynamic Deacceleration Recovery Systems.
zh: 该公司最初由 Wenkel Kerman 于 KY 450 年创立，旨在将其民用蒸汽压缩制冷机组商业化，如今致力于为航空航天工业开发和制造空调与热控系统。近来，它通过其子公司 RealChute 气动减速回收系统的创新产品进军了航天器回收系统市场。

src: After Bob almost splattered against the walls of a descending capsule whose instantly-deploying, one-size fits all parachute ripped off, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he returned with a BACC, a lighter, and an empty bottle of Scotch. Terrified, KSC engineers invented the Real Chute, which is highly configurable gradually deploys.
zh: 在一次返回中，由于瞬间展开的“均码”降落伞直接扯脱，Bob 险些在指令舱内被压成肉泥，随后他便强烈要求整改。KSC 以成本为由无视了他的诉求，直到他拎着一台 BACC 助推器、一个打火机和一瓶喝光的苏格兰威士忌再次登门。KSC 工程师们被吓破了胆，连夜发明了 Real Chute——高度可配置且支持渐进展开。

src: After Bill nearly met fiery doom because his Real Chute could not stop his capsule's screaming descent, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he strapped some spare boosters from Jebediah's Junkyard onto his car and flew into the boardroom one afternoon, terrorizing the already traumatized directors with savage screams and his wafer-thin heatshield. KSC engineers hastily added a drogue chute to their otherwise successful Real Chute design.
zh: 在经历了一次 Real Chute 无法阻止指令舱呼啸坠落、险些烈火焚身的大难不死后，Bill 强烈要求做出改变。KSC 同样以成本为由置之不理，直到某天下午，他用 Jebediah's Junkyard 淘来的废弃助推器绑在车上直接冲进了董事会，伴随着野兽般的咆哮和薄如蝉翼的隔热罩，吓傻了本就惊魂未定的董事们。KSC 工程师只得在他们原本大获成功的 Real Chute 设计上匆忙加装了减速伞。

src: When Vernher designed a parachute that could be placed under things, administrators with brimming eyes called the nursing home. When Verhner spelled "Institutionalize THIS!" with smoking craters on KSC's lawn, they immediately effected his vision.
zh: 当 Wernher 设计出一款可以安装在部件下方的降落伞时，眼眶湿润的行政人员差点直接拨通了养老院的电话。而当 Wernher 用冒烟的撞击坑在 KSC 的草坪上拼出“送我住院试试！”时，他们立即贯彻落实了他的构想。

src: A small French solid rocket motor that was developed as a fourth stage for the Europa II launch vehicle, and later used as the third stage on the B and BP.4 configurations of the Diamant launch vehicle.
zh: 法国研制的小型固体火箭发动机，最初作为欧罗巴 II 运载火箭的第四级研发，后来用于钻石号运载火箭 B 和 BP.4 构型的第三级。

src: The CASTOR 30B is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This production motor incorporates a few modifications from the CASTOR 30, primarily a change in propellant and a longer nozzle. It is 169.9 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration.
zh: CASTOR 30B 是一款低成本、坚固且先进的上面级发动机。此量产型发动机在 CASTOR 30 的基础上进行了一些改进，主要是更换了推进剂并加长了喷管。其长度为 169.9 英寸，标称设计为上面级，可根据运载火箭构型用作二级或三级。

src: The CASTOR 30XL is more than a stretched version of the CASTOR 30. The motor is 235.8 inches long and designed to function as a second or third stage depending on vehicle configuration. The nozzle is 8 feet long and submerged, with a high expansion ratio (55.9:1), a dual density exit cone for high altitude operation, and an electro-mechanical TVA system.
zh: CASTOR 30XL 不仅仅是 CASTOR 30 的加长版本。该发动机长 235.8 英寸，根据运载火箭构型可用作二级或三级。喷管长 8 英尺且为潜入式设计，具有高膨胀比（55.9:1）、用于高空运行的双密度出口锥头以及机电推力矢量控制（TVA）系统。

src: The Castor 120 is a medium solid booster used on the Minotaur and Athena launch vehicles. Its design was based on the TU-903, which serves as the first stage of the Peacekeeper ICBM. The standard thrust curve can be modified to produce a regressive burn that reduces maximum acceleration or a saddle-shaped profile that limits aerodynamic forces. Burn time 79 seconds.
zh: Castor 120 是一款中型固体助推器，用于米诺陶和雅典娜运载火箭。其设计基于 TU-903（用作和平卫士洲际弹道导弹的第一级）。标准推力曲线可以修改为递减燃烧以降低最大加速度，或修改为马鞍形剖面以限制气动力。燃烧时间 79 秒。

src: The Co-Optimized Booster for Reusable Applications was an early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion hydrolox engine. Developed as the main engine for a Space Shuttle replacement through the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, but cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: COBRA（可重复使用共优化助推器）是 2000 年代初期研制的大气层内分级燃烧循环氢氧发动机。作为“太空运载倡议”（SLI）计划中航天飞机替代方案的主发动机而开发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

src: The Co-optimized Booster for Reusable Applications was proposed by Pratt & Whitney-Aerojet Propulsion Associates to cover a wide range of thrust. This hydrolox reusable rocket engine was designed in 2003 to produce 4500 kN thrust. Proposed as a long-life, moderate-to high-thrust, reusable booster engine with a safe and low-cost single burner and a fuel-rich staged combustion cycle.
zh: COBRA（可重复使用共优化助推器）由普惠-喷气飞机构型联合推进系统提出，旨在覆盖广泛的推力范围。这款氢氧可重复使用火箭发动机于 2003 年设计，可产生 4500 kN 推力。其定位为长寿命、中高推力的可重复使用助推器发动机，采用安全且低成本的单燃烧室与富燃分级燃烧循环。

src: The Aerojet Dual Fuel Mixed-Mode High Pressure Engine for SSTO Vehicles. It burned RP-1 and LOX in sea level mode, and then at high altitude would deploy a nozzle extension and switch to burning LH2 and LOX for higher performance.
zh: Aerojet 为单级入轨（SSTO）运载器设计的双燃料混合模态高压发动机。在海平面模式下燃烧 RP-1 与液氧（LOX），而在高空则开启喷管延伸段并切换为燃烧液氢（LH2）与液氧以获得更高性能。

src: The Dual Stage 4 Grid (DS4G) ion thruster was developed primarily by the European Space Agency for a variety of future deep space missions. This version is their most robust design, designed for deep space missions. Requires 50kW of electrical power. NOTE: This engine is based on technical design and test articles.
zh: 双级四栅极（DS4G）离子推力器主要由欧洲空间局开发，用于各种未来的深空任务。该型号是其设计中最坚固的一款，专为深空任务打造。需要 50kW 的电能。注意：该发动机基于工程设计方案和测试件。

src: An open cycle kerolox booster engine developed from LR79/89. It was a backup proposal for the first stage engine on the Titan 1 ICBM, and proposed first stage engine on the Saturn 1, but ultimately never flown (4 E-1s were replaced by 8 H-1s).
zh: 基于 LR79/89 改进的开式循环液氧煤油助推器发动机。曾作为泰坦 1 洲际弹道导弹一级发动机的备选方案，并提议用作土星 1 的一级发动机，但最终从未飞行（4 台 E-1s 被 8 台 H-1s 取代）。

src: The EPEX (Electrical Propulsion Experiment) was a pulsed magnetoplasmadynamic thruster, tested on the Japanese Space Flyer Unit satellite in 1995. Although the Soviet Union experimented with MPD thrusters extensively, the Space Flyer Unit was the first spacecraft to use an MPD thruster as its main propulsion system.
zh: EPEX（电推进实验）是一种脉冲磁等离子体动力（MPD）推力器，于 1995 年在日本太空巡游单元（Space Flyer Unit）卫星上进行了测试。尽管苏联对 MPD 推力器进行了广泛试验，但太空巡游单元是第一个使用 MPD 推力器作为主推进系统的航天器。

src: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application. Represents the throttlable F-1A engine as found in 'Eyes Turned Skyward'.
zh: 巨大的 Rocketdyne F-1 发动机。有史以来制造的体型最大、推力最强的火箭发动机之一。请根据应用需求确保开启滚转控制能力或禁用万向节。代表了《目光投向天际》架空历史中的可节流 F-1A 发动机。

src: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. FARAD (Faraday Accelerator with Radio-Frequency Assisted Discharge) ionizes gas before it is exposed to the magnetic field, greatly reducing the required pulse energy, allowing for a much smaller thruster.
zh: 脉冲感应推力器利用强大的磁脉冲来电离并加速气体。它可以达到令人惊叹的比冲，并且只需提高脉冲频率即可放大推力。然而，它的耗电量十分可观。FARAD（射频辅助放电法拉第加速器）在气体暴露于磁场之前就将其电离，大幅降低了所需的脉冲能量，从而造就了尺寸更小的推力器。

src: The F-1B engine was designed to power the proposed Pyrios advanced boosters for the Space Launch System. A highly modified version of the original F-1, the F-1B uses modern manufacturing techniques including 3-D printing and features a simpler gas generator exhaust arrangement in order to reduce manufacturing costs and increase thrust at a slight cost of efficiency.
zh: F-1B 发动机专为太空发射系统（SLS）提议的 Pyrios 先进助推器提供动力。作为原始 F-1 的高度改进型，F-1B 采用了包括 3D 打印在内的现代制造工艺，并配备了更简单的燃气发生器排气布局，以降低制造成本并提高推力，仅付出了极小的效率代价。

src: This was developed for the NOMAD high energy upper stage, intended to replace Agena. The hydrazine/fluorine propellant mix showed impressive performance in testing, but concerns over the toxicity of fluorine lead to the project being cancelled after extensive work had already been done.
zh: 专为 NOMAD 高能上面级研发，旨在取代阿金纳（Agena）。肼/氟推进剂组合在测试中展现出了惊人的性能，但由于对氟毒性的担忧，该项目在完成大量工作后仍被取消。

src: A two chamber version of Gamma, used for the second stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. As the only Gamma not required to operate at sea level, the nozzles were extended to allow better expansion.
zh: Gamma 的双燃烧室版本，用于黑箭卫星运载火箭的第二级。作为唯一不需要在海平面运行的 Gamma 发动机，其喷管经过加长以获得更好的膨胀效果。

src: This was an 8 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control.
zh: 这是 Gamma 的 8 燃烧室发展型，用于黑箭卫星运载火箭的第一级。Gamma 的推力室成对径向安装，每对安装在一个单轴切向万向节上。同步偏转提供滚转控制，而差动偏转提供俯仰控制。

src: This was an 4 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Knight sounding rocket. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control.
zh: 这是 Gamma 的 4 燃烧室发展型，用于黑骑士探空火箭的第一级。Gamma 的推力室成对径向安装，每对安装在一个单轴切向万向节上。同步偏转提供滚转控制，而差动偏转提供俯仰控制。

src: The Graphite-Epoxy Motor (GEM) replaced the steel case used on earlier Castor-series boosters with a lighter composite case. The 40-inch (1-meter) diameter GEM 40 was used on the Delta II 7000-series in sets of three, four, or nine. When nine boosters were used, six were ignited at liftoff and the remaining three were ignited after burnout and jettison of the first six. Burn time: 58 seconds.
zh: 石墨-环氧树脂发动机（GEM）用更轻的复合材料壳体取代了早期卡斯托系列助推器使用的钢制壳体。直径 40 英寸（1 米）的 GEM 40 以 3、4 或 9 台一组的形式用于德尔塔 II 7000 系列。当使用 9 台助推器时，6 台在起飞时点火，其余 3 台在前 6 台燃尽脱落后点火。燃烧时间：58 秒。

src: The 46-inch (1.2-m) diameter GEM 46 was used on the Delta III and Delta II Heavy in sets of nine, with six ignited at liftoff and three ignited after burnout of the first six. On the Delta III, three ground-lit boosters were equipped with TVC while all the remaining boosters used fixed nozzles. The Delta II Heavy used no boosters with TVC. Burn time 75 seconds.
zh: 直径 46 英寸（1.2 米）的 GEM 46 以 9 台一组的形式用于德尔塔 III 和德尔塔 II 重型火箭，其中 6 台在起飞时点火，3 台在前 6 台燃尽后点火。在德尔塔 III 上，3 台地面点火助推器配备了推力矢量控制（TVC），而其余助推器均采用固定喷管。德尔塔 II 重型火箭则未使用配备 TVC 的助推器。燃烧时间 75 秒。

src: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. This is the -4 variant, which powered the T-2C Buckeye. Available 1958. Thrust 13.1 kN. OPR 6.1, SFC 0.980 lb/lbf-hr static.
zh: J85最初作为一款小型一次性喷气发动机研发，用于为诱饵和无人机提供动力，但后来升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它为许多小型飞机提供了动力，包括F-5、CF-5、G.91Y、T-2、T-38以及A-37。这是-4型号，曾为T-2C“橡树”提供动力。1958年可用。推力13.1 kN。总增压比6.1，静止比油耗0.980 lb/lbf-hr。

src: An early 50s turbojet that was the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat. This a early model with afterburner, the -7F, which powered the prototype Su-7. Available 1955. 88.8kN wet, 66.7kN dry. OPR 9.5, SFC 0.97/2.25 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.85.
