zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，曾是Su-7、Su-9、Su-11、Tu-128以及Be-10水上飞机的动力装置。这是一款带加力燃烧室的早期型号-7F，曾为原型机Su-7提供动力。1955年可用。加力88.8kN，无加力66.7kN。总增压比9.5，静止比油耗0.97/2.25 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.85马赫。

src: A late 1950s redesign of the Atar 101 to increase thrust (creating the Atar 08) and add an afterburner (creating the Atar 09). These upgrades powered the next generation of French jet aircraft, including the Etendard IV, Super Etendard, Mirage III/IV, and Mirage F1. The Atar 09B is an early model used in the Mirage IIIA. Available 1959. 58.8kN wet, 40.9kN dry. SFC 1.01/2.03 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.0.
zh: 于1950年代末期对Atar 101进行的重新设计，旨在提高推力（研制出Atar 08）并增加加力燃烧室（研制出Atar 09）。这些改进型为法国下一代喷气式飞机提供了动力，包括超军旗、军旗IV、幻影III/IV和幻影F1。Atar 09B是用于幻影IIIA的早期型号。1959年可用。加力58.8kN，无加力40.9kN。静止比油耗1.01/2.03 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.0马赫。

src: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. The RA.4, an early 1950s model, powered early Hawker Hunters. Available 1951. Thrust 33.4kN. OPR 7.0, SFC 0.883 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: Avon是罗尔斯·罗伊斯于1950年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括海雌狐、堪培拉、闪电、猎鹰、急流和勇士。RA.4是1950年代初期的型号，曾为早期的小贩猎鹰提供动力。1951年可用。推力33.4kN。总增压比7.0，静止比油耗0.883 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.5马赫。

src: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. The RA.24R, an early 1960s model, powered the English Electric Lightning F.1. Available 1960. 63.9kN wet, 50.0kN dry. OPR 7.8, SFC 0.88/1.9 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: Avon是罗尔斯·罗伊斯于1950年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括海雌狐、堪培拉、闪电、猎鹰、急流和勇士。RA.24R是1960年代初期的型号，曾为英国电气闪电F.1提供动力。1960年可用。加力63.9kN，无加力50.0kN。总增压比7.8，静止比油耗0.88/1.9 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.5马赫。

src: The J48 was also known as the Rolls-Royce Tay. Essentially an enlarged Nene, it was abandoned by Rolls-Royce in favor of the Avon. However, Pratt & Whitney was able to acquire the design, and produced it as the J48. It was used in the F9F-5 Panther, F9F-6/8 Cougar, F-94C Starfire, and YF-93. This is the -5, with afterburner, as used in the F-94C. Available 1950. 38.9 kN wet, 28.2 kN dry. 4.4 OPR, SFC 1.16 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: J48也被称为罗尔斯·罗伊斯泰伊。它本质上是放大的尼恩发动机，罗尔斯·罗伊斯后来放弃该项目转而研发Avon。然而，普拉特·惠特尼获得了该设计，并将其作为J48生产。它曾用于F9F-5黑豹、F9F-6/8美洲狮、F-94C星火和YF-93。这是带加力燃烧室的-5型号，用于F-94C。1950年可用。加力38.9 kN，无加力28.2 kN。总增压比4.4，静止比油耗1.16 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1马赫。

src: An early 50s turbojet. The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2. This represents an early model, the -8, which powered the F4D Skyray/F5D Skylancer. Available 1951. 64.5kN wet, 45.3kN dry. OPR 11.9, SFC 0.90/2.1 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。J57是一款主力机型，设计于1950年代初，曾为B-52、大多数百系列战斗机甚至U-2提供动力。这代表了其早期型号-8，曾为F4D天光/F5D空中骑兵提供动力。1951年可用。加力64.5kN，无加力45.3kN。总增压比11.9，静止比油耗0.90/2.1 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.5马赫。

src: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. This is the afterburning -5 variant, which powered the F-5A/B Freedom Fighter. Available 1959. Thrust 17.1 kN wet, 11.9 kN dry. OPR 6.5, SFC 1.03/2.2 lb/lbf-hr static.
zh: J85最初作为一款小型一次性喷气发动机研发，用于为诱饵和无人机提供动力，但后来升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它为许多小型飞机提供了动力，包括F-5、CF-5、G.91Y、T-2、T-38以及A-37。这是带加力燃烧室的-5型号，曾为F-5A/B自由斗士提供动力。1959年可用。推力：加力17.1 kN，无加力11.9 kN。总增压比6.5，静止比油耗1.03/2.2 lb/lbf-hr。

src: A late 50s turbojet. Based on the Pratt & Whitney J57, the Model 304-2 was a liquid-hydrogen fueled turbojet, designed for project SUNTAN, a high performance replacement for the U-2 spyplane. The project required the development of large-scale Liquid Hydrogen production and handling techniques, at the cost of hundreds of millions of dollars, but the results were impressive. Pratt & Whitney were able to convert various jet engines to hydrogen power, where they showed incredible stability and efficiency. This information, along with many of the engineers involved in the project, were later transferred to working on the Pratt & Whitney RL-10, where the information gained proved invaluable. The Model 304 and project SUNTAN, however, were ultimately cancelled, as the conventionally fueled A-12/SR-71 was showing much greater promise. This represents the Model 304-2, the most advanced design developed before the cancellation of the project. Available 1959. 60.1 kN wet, 32.1 kN dry. OPR 5.1, SFC 0.38/0.9 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.0.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。304-2型基于普拉特·惠特尼J57改进，是一款液氢燃料涡轮喷气发动机，专为SUNTAN计划设计，该计划旨在寻找高性能飞机替代U-2侦察机。该项目耗资数亿美元研发了大规模液氢生产和处理技术，成果令人瞩目。普拉特·惠特尼成功将多种喷气发动机改装为氢燃料动力，展现出了极高的稳定性与效率。这些技术资料以及参与该项目的许多工程师随后被转去研发普拉特·惠特尼RL-10，所获得的经验被证明极具价值。然而，304型和SUNTAN项目最终被取消，因为使用常规燃料的A-12/SR-71展现出了更光明的前景。这代表了该项目取消前研发的最先进设计——304-2型。1959年可用。加力60.1 kN，无加力32.1 kN。总增压比5.1，静止比油耗0.38/0.9 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制3.0马赫。

src: A late 1960s turbojet. The ultimate version of the Olympus turbojet, designed for sustained Mach 2 operation to power Concorde. Although thirsty at sea level, when mated to a well-optimized intake this engine can supercruise at Mach 2, achieving relatively good efficiency. This represents the Olympus 593 Mk.610, as used in all production Concordes. Available 1969. 169.2kN wet, 139.4kN dry. OPR 15.5, SFC 0.87/1.39 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.0.
zh: 一款1960年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。作为奥林匹斯涡轮喷气发动机的终极版本，专为协和飞机以2马赫持续巡航而设计。尽管在海平面油耗极高，但在配合经过良好优化的进气道时，该发动机能够以2马赫超音速巡航并获得相对不错的效率。这代表了用于所有量产型协和飞机的奥林匹斯593 Mk.610。1969年可用。加力169.2kN，无加力139.4kN。总增压比15.5，静止比油耗0.87/1.39 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制3.0马赫。

src: A late 50s turbojet. Developed in parallel with the less sophisticated RD-9, the R-11 became the powerplant for the MiG-21, Yak-28 and Su-15. This an early model, the F2-300, which powered the MiG-21PF. Available 1960. 60.8kN wet, 38.3kN dry. OPR 8.8, SFC 0.95/2.37 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。与技术较为简单的RD-9并行研发，R-11成为了MiG-21、Yak-28和Su-15的动力装置。这是一款早期型号F2-300，曾为MiG-21PF提供动力。1960年可用。加力60.8kN，无加力38.3kN。总增压比8.8，静止比油耗0.95/2.37 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.5马赫。

src: A late 50s turbojet. Originally developed for the Tu-121 cruise missile, the R-15 was modified instead for use on the MiG-25, which became the fastest serially produced fighter, capable of reaching Mach 3.2, although at the risk of severe engine damage. This is a later model, the BD-300, used on the MiG-25RB. Available 1969. 109.8kN wet, 86.3kN dry. OPR 4.75, SFC 1.25/2.75 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.5.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。R-15最初为Tu-121巡航导弹研制，后改装用于MiG-25，使其成为飞行速度最快的量产战斗机，能够达到3.2马赫（尽管有发动机严重受损的风险）。这是后期的BD-300型号，用于MiG-25RB。1969年可用。加力109.8kN，无加力86.3kN。总增压比4.75，静止比油耗1.25/2.75 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制3.5马赫。

src: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time. This is the production model, used on the MiG-21Bis and Su-15Bis. 97.1kN wet, 40.3kN dry. OPR 9.5, SFC 0.96/3.34 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: 一款60年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。为了替代R-11和R-13而研制，R-25增加了一个极其强劲的“额外功率”加力燃烧室，使其能够在短时间内将推力提升近一倍。这是量产型号，用于MiG-21Bis和Su-15Bis。加力97.1kN，无加力40.3kN。总增压比9.5，静止比油耗0.96/3.34 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.5马赫。

src: An early 50s turbojet. Developed as a scaled down Mikulin AM-3, the RD-9 was designed for fighter aircraft, and powered the Yak-25, 26, 27, 28, and MiG-19. This represents an early model, the -9B, which powered early MiG-19s. 31.9kN wet, 25.1kN dry. Available 1951. OPR 7.14, SFC 0.96/1.6 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。RD-9作为米库林AM-3的按比例缩小版本进行研发，专为战斗机设计，曾为Yak-25、26、27、28以及MiG-19提供动力。这代表了其早期型号-9B，曾为早期MiG-19s提供动力。加力31.9kN，无加力25.1kN。1951年可用。总增压比7.14，静止比油耗0.96/1.6 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.5马赫。

src: A basic pressure-fed booster engine developed by General Electric to power American-built Wasserfall missiles for the Hermes program (CTV-G-5). Although the design was deemed unsuitable for military use, several Hermes A-1 missiles were still flown to gain experience in the construction and operation of large rockets.
zh: 通用电气开发的一种基础挤压循环助推器发动机，用于为“爱马仕”计划（CTV-G-5）中美国制造的“瀑布”导弹提供动力。尽管该设计被认为不适合军用，但仍试射了数枚“爱马仕”A-1导弹，以获取大型火箭建造与操作方面的经验。

src: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin. This represents a later model, the ASSa.7, which powered the Gloster Javelin FAW Mk.7. Available 1955. Thrust 48.9kN. OPR 7.0, SFC 0.885 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.0.
zh: 一款20世纪50年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。源自英国研制的第一款轴流式喷气发动机MetroVick F.2，Sapphire曾为霍克“猎鹰”、汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”和格罗斯特“标枪”提供动力。此型号代表后期的ASSa.7，曾用于格罗斯特“标枪”FAW Mk.7。1955年可用。推力48.9 kN。总增压比7.0，地面静止SFC 0.885 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.0。

src: A Soviet hypergolic gas generator upper stage engine. Created for the upper stage of the UR-100, the 15D13 was one of the first rockets ever developed by OKB-117. In order to save time, it's development was combined with the 5D22 upper stage engine for the A-350Zh anti-ballistic missile. It was also proposed as the braking engine for the LK-700S lander as the 11D423.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂气动发生器循环上面级发动机。15D13专为UR-100的上面级研制，是OKB-117最早开发的火箭发动机之一。为了节省时间，其研发与用于A-350Zh反弹道导弹的5D22上面级发动机合并进行。它还曾以11D423的代号被提议用作LK-700S着陆器的制动发动机。

src: This is a 50 kW-class thruster. Development started in 2000 to enable space solar power systems and other high power spacecraft. A laboratory model of this high power thruster was fabricated and tested with xenon in 2002 at power levels up to 72 kW with 650V.
zh: 这是一款50 kW级的推进器。研发始于2000年，旨在支持空间太阳能电站系统和其他大功率航天器。2002年制造了该大功率推进器的实验室模型，并在高达72 kW、650V的功率水平下进行了氙气测试。

src: A basic pump-fed booster engine developed as an improved version of the Hermes A-1 for the Hermes A-3 ballistic missile. Difficulties with development led the program being split into two parts, with the smaller A-3A testing the engine and guidance systems for the larger A-3B. Although it was evaluated for use by the US Army as the SSM-A-16, it was rejected due to poor performance and reliability.
zh: 一款基础泵压式助推器发动机，作为Hermes A-1的改进型为Hermes A-3弹道导弹研制。由于研发困难，该项目被拆分为两部分，由较小的A-3A为较大的A-3B测试发动机和制导系统。尽管曾被美国陆军评估为SSM-A-16使用，但因性能和可靠性较差而被否决。

src: A Thiel alcolox booster engine used on the A-4 Series B/V-2 missile. The Model 39b was an interim design, but went into production. Used 18 x 1.5 tonne thrust chambers that fed a common mixing chamber, as combustion instability issues of a single large injector were unable to be resolved. Work began 1936, testing in 1939, and mass production from 1943-1945.
zh: 一款用于A-4系列B/V-2导弹的Thiel酒精/液氧助推器发动机。Model 39b是一个过渡设计，但最终投入了量产。由于单个大型喷注器的燃烧不稳定性问题无法解决，该发动机采用了18个1.5吨级的推力室共同喷入一个混合室。研发工作始于1936年，1939年进行测试，1943年至1945年间大规模生产。

src: A hypergolic upper stage engine. The baseline Aestus engine is pressure fed and is used on the Ariane 5 G, GS and ES series, while the Aestus II (also known as RS-72) variant is pump-fed with better overall performance.
zh: 一款自燃推进剂上面级发动机。基准型Aestus发动机为挤压循环，用于阿丽亚娜5 G、GS和ES系列；而Aestus II（亦称RS-72）变型则采用泵压循环，具备更优越的综合性能。

src: Originally developed for a standoff weapon for the B-58 Hustler, the XLR81 is a gas-generator engine with storable propellants. Later space variants improved performance and capability. Engine restart was added on the Agena B's XLR81-BA-7 (Model 8081). The XLR81-BA-11 (Model 8096) used on Agena D used propellant sumps to handle ullage. The XLR81-BA-13 (Model 8247) powered the Gemini Agena Target Vehicle (a modified Agena D) and was rated for up to 14 restarts.
zh: XLR81最初是为B-58“盗贼”防区外武器研制的，是一款采用可贮存推进剂的气动发生器循环发动机。后期的航天型号提升了性能和能力。阿金纳B使用的XLR81-BA-7（Model 8081）增加了发动机重启功能。阿金纳D使用的XLR81-BA-11（Model 8096）利用推进剂收集沉淀槽来解决沉底问题。XLR81-BA-13（Model 8247）为双子座阿金纳目标飞行器（改装版阿金纳D）提供动力，额定重启次数多达14次。

zh_samples: CST-100“星际客机”商业乘员运输系统（COTS）的指令舱。设计最多可重复使用10次。
NASA 对接系统（NDS）是用于美国载人航天器的航天器对接与停泊机构，例如猎户座多功能载人飞船和商业载人航天器。
高分辨率胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄行星照片。这台相机提供极高分辨率的照片，且底片需要回收至地球。历史上，这些相机曾以KH-9“六边形”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，但对于RP-1而言，它们代表了商业公司的第一批高分辨率卫星相机。

src: A secondary propulsion system developed for the Gemini program on the Agena Target Vehicle. It allowed for fine control and orbital maneuvers without igniting the main engine. It was later offered to commercial customers as an upgrade for Agena. The system is a completely contained unit including propellant tanks, one 16-lb thrust chamber, and one 200-lb thrust chamber.
zh: 为双子座计划中阿金纳目标飞行器研制的二次推进系统。它无需启动主发动机即可进行微调控制和轨道机动。该系统后来作为阿金纳的升级方案向商业客户推销。该系统为一个完全自成一体的单元，包含推进剂贮箱、一个16磅推力室和一个200磅推力室。

src: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents advanced AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Transtage and the Delta F and Delta K upper stages.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，AJ10是所有发动机家族中寿命最长的一系，从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，乃至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。此型号代表带有喷管延伸段且具备重启能力的先进型AJ10s。曾用于Transtage以及德尔塔F和德尔塔K上面级。

src: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This is the original Vanguard second stage / Able / Delta configuration, without restart capability.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，AJ10是所有发动机家族中寿命最长的一系，从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，乃至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。这是最初的“先锋号”第二级/Able/德尔塔构型，不具备重启能力。

src: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents mid-period AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Thor-Ablestar and Delta E through Delta N.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，AJ10是所有发动机家族中寿命最长的一系，从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，乃至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。此型号代表带有喷管延伸段且具备重启能力的中期型AJ10s。曾用于雷神-Ablestar以及德尔塔E至德尔塔N。

src: A pump-fed upgrade for the AJ10 developed in the 1980s as a high performance upper stage and tug. It was based heavily on the Shuttle OMS, with the same nozzle and combustion chamber, but had turbomachinery installed in place of a pressure-fed system. The program was cancelled after the Challenger disaster, but Transtar 1 flew as the Titan Launch Dispenser on Titan IV.
zh: 于20世纪80年代为AJ10研制的泵压式升级型，旨在用作高性能上面级和轨道拖船。它大量借鉴了航天飞机OMS的技术，拥有相同的喷管和燃烧室，但安装了涡轮泵机械以取代挤压循环系统。该计划在挑战者号失事后取消，但Transtar 1曾作为大力神发射分配器在“大力神IV”上飞行。

src: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles.
zh: AJ-260是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是该发动机的全长版本。总质量1,648吨，可提供超过2分钟的35,391 kN推力。该版本被设计为土星IB的替代方案，以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。

src: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. This is the radially attached version to be used as a strap-on booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: AJ-260是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是该发动机的全长版本。总质量1,648吨，可提供超过2分钟的35,391 kN推力。该版本被设计为土星IB的替代方案，以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。这是用于捆绑式助推器的径向安装版本。[直径：6.6 m]

src: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications.
zh: AJ-260是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是缩短长度的版本，是一个尺寸达21.6 x 6.6米、满载重量超过842吨的庞然大物。它能够提供超过15 MN的推力并持续120秒。该项目最终被取消，但取消前曾进行过三次试车，发动机的性能完全符合技术规范。

src: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this final version was used on later Scout B launch vehicles. It was used to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Maximum thrust 25.6 kN, burn time 31 seconds.
zh: 小型固体变轨发动机。由 Altair 发动机发展而来，该最终版本用于后期的侦察兵 B 运载火箭。常用于远地点圆化轨道或完成最后的有效载荷变轨。最大推力 25.6 kN，工作时间 31 秒。

src: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. This is the radially attached version to be used as a strap-on booster.
zh: AJ-260是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是短款构型，是一个尺寸达 21.6 x 6.6 米、满载重量超过 842 吨的庞然大物。它能够提供超过 15 MN 的推力，工作时间长达 120 秒。该计划最终被取消，但在三次试车中发动机均完全达到了指标要求。此版本为径向安装型，用作捆绑助推器。

src: A small solid kick motor developed for use as the 5th stage on the Scout launch vehicles. It was only ever launched once, on the Scout E-1 used for Explorer 52. Maximum thrust 27.5kN, burn time 9 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，开发用作侦察兵（Scout）运载火箭的第 5 级。它仅发射过一次，搭载于用于探索者 52 号的 Scout E-1 上。最大推力 27.5 kN，工作时间 9 秒。

src: A small solid kick motor developed as alternative Vanguard third stage. It was reused on many later LVs with the Able/Delta upper stage (or simply "Thor Burner") to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Burn time 39 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，作为先锋号第三级的替代方案而开发。它随后被广泛用于搭载 Able/Delta 上级（或简称“雷神-伯纳”）的多种后续运载火箭，用于在远地点进行圆轨道化或对有效载荷进行最终加速。工作时间 39 秒。

src: The Advanced Material Bipropellant Rocket engine is a high performance, higher thrust, radiation cooled, storable bipropellant space engine of the same physical envelope as the High Performance Apogee Thruster.
zh: 先进材料双组元火箭（AMBR）发动机是一款高性能、高推力、辐射冷却的可贮存双组元航天发动机，具有与高性能远地点推进器相同的外部轮廓尺寸。

zh_samples: BE-4 是一台富氧分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。尽管最初是为蓝色起源的运载火箭研发，但在2014年，联合发射联盟（ULA）宣布他们的新型火神运载火箭（宇宙神5型与德尔塔4型运载火箭的共同继承者）将由一对 BE-4 发动机提供动力。
早期富氧分级燃烧发动机（1961）
1963 富氧分级燃烧发动机

src: The AR-1 is a 2,200-kilonewton-class kerolox engine using oxidizer-rich staged combustion. Two of those were proposed to replace the Russian made RD-180 on the Atlas V rocket. Development of this engine was halted because Aerojet Rocketdyne was unwilling to pay for its completion.
zh: AR-1是一款 2200 kN 级的富氧分级燃烧煤油液氧发动机。曾提议使用两台该型发动机来替代宇宙神 V 型火箭上的俄制RD-180。由于 Aerojet Rocketdyne 不愿出资完成研发，该发动机的研制工作最终中止。

zh_samples: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: A small liquid fueled booster rocket, intended to increase the performance of the FJ-4/F-86. Tested extensively, but the weight of the system offset any performance gains. Later upgraded to be pump-fed, allowing it to use fuel directly from the fuel tanks of the aircraft, and used to power the NF-104A astronaut training aircraft.
zh: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。

src: A small solid kick motor used on the Jupiter-C sounding rocket (and later the Juno I and II launch vehicles) as upper stages in clusters of 11, 3 and, finally, one attached to the payload. The standard version uses the T17-E2 grain mixture while the higher performance one uses the JPL-532A.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，用于朱庇特-C 探空火箭（以及后来的朱诺 I 号和 II 号运载火箭），以 11 台、3 台以及最后单台连接至有效载荷的聚束形式作为上面级使用。标准版本使用 T17-E2 推进剂药柱，而高性能版本则使用JPL-532A。

src: The BE-3 (Blue Engine 3) is a hydrolox rocket engine developed by Blue Origin, using a combustion tap-off cycle. The BE-3U is a significantly upgraded BE-3 for vacuum use, with a large nozzle and very high thrust to weight ratio.
zh: BE-3（蓝色发动机 3 号）是由蓝色起源（Blue Origin）开发的一款氢氧火箭发动机，采用燃烧室抽气循环。BE-3U是BE-3的大幅真空升级型，拥有大喷管和极高的推重比。

zh_samples: BE-4 是一台富氧分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。尽管最初是为蓝色起源的运载火箭研发，但在2014年，联合发射联盟（ULA）宣布他们的新型火神运载火箭（宇宙神5型与德尔塔4型运载火箭的共同继承者）将由一对 BE-4 发动机提供动力。
早期富氧分级燃烧发动机（1961）
1963 富氧分级燃烧发动机

src: The BE-4 is an oxidizer-rich staged combustion methalox engine. Though initially developed for use on a Blue Origin launch vehicle, United Launch Alliance announced in 2014 that their new Vulcan launch vehicle will be powered by a pair of BE-4 engines.
zh: BE-4是一款富氧分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。虽然最初是为蓝色起源自家的运载火箭开发，但联合发射联盟（ULA）于 2014 年宣布，其全新的火神（Vulcan）运载火箭将由一对BE-4发动机提供动力。

src: Low thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency.
zh: 低推力泵压膨胀循环核火箭发动机。双模态 NTR 从原版 NERVA 设计演变而来，不再将珍贵的推进剂质量浪费在反应堆冷却上，而是使用布雷顿循环发电机组将废热能转化为有用的电能。它还支持液氧喷射（TRITON——三模态运行），以牺牲整体效率为代价换取更大的推力。

src: Moderate thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency. This is from a later study, and is larger than the original BNTR design. It also uses low-enriched uranium to reduce costs, and a much more powerful Brayton generator to power electrical propulsion systems.
zh: 中推力泵压膨胀循环核火箭发动机。双模态 NTR 从原版 NERVA 设计演变而来，不再将珍贵的推进剂质量浪费在反应堆冷却上，而是使用布雷顿循环发电机组将废热能转化为有用的电能。它还支持液氧喷射（TRITON——三模态运行），以牺牲整体效率为代价换取更大的推力。这来自后期的研究方案，尺寸大于原始的 BNTR 设计。它还使用低浓缩铀以降低成本，并配备更强劲的布雷顿发电机为电力推进系统供电。

zh_samples: 作为卡斯托尔 1 发动机的衍生型，卡斯托尔 2 具有更高的比冲和推进剂加注量、更低的干重比以及更长的燃烧时间。它从德尔塔 E 开始用作捆绑助推器，并在除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭中得到应用。燃烧时间 39 秒。直径：[0.79 m]。
作为卡斯托 1（Castor 1）发动机的衍生型号，卡斯托 2 具有更高的比冲和装药量、更低的结构质量比以及更长的工作时间。从德尔塔 E 起，以及除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭上，它都被用作捆绑助推器。工作时间 39 秒。
搅拌摩擦焊等改进的制造技术可进一步降低储箱干重。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具摩擦产生的热量使两块金属软化并在机械力作用下混合。它适用于需要极高焊接强度的结构，并在航天工业中有着广泛应用。SpaceX首次在“猎鹰1e”及随后的“猎鹰9”系列火箭上对

src: A derivative of the Castor 1 motor, the Castor 2 featured higher specific impulse and propellant load, a lower dry mass fraction, and a longer burn time. It was used as strap-on booster starting with Delta E and in all but the early Scouts. Burn time 39s.
zh: 作为卡斯托 1（Castor 1）发动机的衍生型号，卡斯托 2 具有更高的比冲和装药量、更低的结构质量比以及更长的工作时间。从德尔塔 E 起，以及除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭上，它都被用作捆绑助推器。工作时间 39 秒。

src: The Castor 4 was developed as the second stage of the Athena H missile and first flew in 1971. It was later adapted to replace Delta's Castor 2 boosters, increasing GTO capacity from 723 kg to nearly 900 kg. The Delta 3000-series launched in 1975 with a staggered booster staging sequence. Previous Deltas burned their motors in a 6-3 sequence and then jettisoned all SRMs at once. The heavier and longer-burning Castor 4 required that the motors be jettisoned as soon as they ran out to reduce dead weight. A less efficient 5-4 sequence was used until Delta was strengthened in the early 80s to handle the acceleration of a 6-3 sequence.
zh: 卡斯托 4 最初作为雅典娜 H 导弹的第二级研制，于 1971 年首飞。后来经过改装以替代德尔塔火箭上的卡斯托 2 助推器，将地球同步转移轨道（GTO）运载能力从 723 kg 提高到近 900 kg。德尔塔 3000 系列于 1975 年首飞，采用了交错的助推器分离时序。先前的德尔塔火箭采用 6-3 顺序点火，然后一次性抛弃所有固体火箭助推器。更重且工作时间更长的卡斯托 4 要求助推器燃尽后立即抛弃以减少死重。在 80 年代初德尔塔火箭进行结构加强以承受 6-3 顺序的加速度之前，一直采用效率较低的 5-4 顺序。

src: The Castor 4A was introduced on the first generation of Delta II launchers, the 6000-series, and offered improved thrust and specific impulse by replacing PBAA with higher energy HTPB. This, combined with a stretched first stage (the Extra-Extended Long Tank Thor), and a return to the more efficient 6-3 SRM ignition sequence, improved Delta's performance by 11% over the 3000-series. The Castor 4A was flown on the Delta II from 1989 until 1993, when it was replaced by the GEM 40. The boosters were also used on the Atlas IIAS from 1993 until 2004. Burn time 53 seconds.
zh: 卡斯托 4A 首次应用于第一代德尔塔 II 系列运载火箭（6000 系列），通过使用能量更高的 HTPB 代替 PBAA，提高了推力和比冲。配合加长的第一级（加长型长箱体雷神）以及恢复采用更高效率的 6-3 固体助推器点火时序，使德尔塔的性能比 3000 系列提高了 11%。卡斯托 4A 在德尔塔 II 上服役至 1993 年，随后被 GEM 40 取代。该助推器还于 1993 年至 2004 年间用于宇宙神 IIAS 火箭。工作时间 53 秒。

src: The CASTOR 30 is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This commercially-developed motor is 144 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration.
zh: CASTOR 30 是一款低成本、高可靠性、先进的上面级发动机。这款商业开发的发动机长 144 英寸，名义上设计为上面级，可根据火箭构型充当第二级或第三级。

src: A composite solid rocket motor designed as a drop-in replacement for the 5 Segment RSRM used on the Space Launch System (SLS). Its lower inert mass along with the higher surface thrust will enable the SLS to lift more than 130 metric tonnes into low Earth orbit.

The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs, and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. The NuPIT (Nuclear-Electric Pulsed Inductive Thruster) is based on the PIT Mk VII, redesigned for extremely long life for Ice Giant and even Interstellar missions.
zh: 脉冲感应推进器利用强磁脉冲使气体电离并加速。它能实现极具吸引力的比冲，且只需提高脉冲频率即可扩展功率。然而，它的电力消耗相当巨大。NuPIT（核电脉冲感应推进器）基于 PIT Mk VII 设计，专为冰巨星乃至星际任务进行了极长寿命的重新设计。

src: A very early Soviet rocket engine, designed by Glushko in 1936 for use on the KR-212 cruise missile, and modified for the rocket aircraft RP-318. It was the first reliable, regeneratively cooled rocket.
zh: 一款极早期的苏联火箭发动机，由格卢什科于1936年为KR-212巡航导弹设计，后改装用于RP-318火箭飞机。它是第一台可靠的再生冷却火箭发动机。

src: Developed jointly by the AFRL and PEPL, the P5 is a dual-stage Hall thruster. This means it can more effectively lens the charged ions, giving you increased thrust above single-stage operation at the expense of efficiency.
zh: 由 AFRL 与 PEPL 联合研制的 P5 是一款双级霍尔推进器。这意味着它能更有效地聚焦带电离子，以牺牲部分效率为代价，提供高于单级运行状态的推力。

src: The "PEWEE" series is a smaller 572MW reactor with the highest power density of all the rover tests. It also recorded the Highest ISP ratings of the test at 901s. Its core is capable of starting up to 12 times. An integral Tungsten Boron Composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be nine to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. Most modern NASA study reactors such as the BNTR are derived in turn from this test reactor. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2750 Ideal ISP=998 Reactor Power=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 Chamber Pressure=4344kPa Ignitions =12 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 2.23tons
zh: “PEWEE”系列是一款功率为 572MW 的小型反应堆，在所有 Rover 测试堆中具有最高的功率密度。它还在测试中创下了 901s 的最高比冲记录。其堆芯最多可启动 12 次。包含整体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二级回路通过小型热机导出停堆废气，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机距离最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距离发动机应在 9 至 12 米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上缩短该距离。现代 NASA 研究的多数反应堆（如 BNTR）均源自此测试反应堆。该型号采用固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=100 燃烧室温度=2750 理想比冲=998 反应堆功率=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 燃烧室压力=4344kPa 点火次数=12 含整体投影屏蔽重量: 2.23吨

src: The "Phoebus 1" series is a 1500MW reactor. Most tests early resulted in failure from pumping or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and lighter materials. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2445 Ideal ISP=881 Reactor Power=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 Chamber Pressure=3772kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 9.14tons
zh: “Phoebus 1”系列是一款 1500MW 的反应堆。早期的大多数测试都因泵故障或测试设备损坏而失败，但也借此积累了大量经验，并促进了先进涂层、化学气相沉积和更轻材料的发展。其堆芯最多可启动 4 次。包含整体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二级回路通过小型热机导出停堆废气，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机距离最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距离发动机应在 8 至 12 米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上缩短该距离。该火箭代表了更强大、更高效火箭系列的开端。该型号采用膨胀比为 50:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=50 燃烧室温度=2445 理想比冲=881 反应堆功率=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 燃烧室压力=3772kPa 点火次数=4 含整体投影屏蔽重量: 9.14吨

src: The "Phoebus 2" series is a 5000MW reactor. Most tests resulted in success proving new coatings worked well and existing at the time as the most powerful reactor core on the planet. Its core is capable of starting up eight times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents a more powerful and capable series of rocket with a TWR of nearly 6. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2245 Ideal ISP=889 Reactor Power=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 Chamber Pressure=3825kPa Ignitions =8 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 16.97tons
zh: “Phoebus 2”系列是一款 5000MW 的反应堆。大多数测试均取得成功，不仅验证了新涂层性能优良，还成为当时地球上功率最强大的反应堆堆芯。其堆芯最多可启动 8 次。包含整体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二级回路通过小型热机导出停堆废气，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机距离最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距离发动机应在 10 至 15 米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上缩短该距离。该火箭代表了 TWR 接近 6 的更强大、更高效的火箭系列。该型号采用膨胀比为 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=100 燃烧室温度=2245 理想比冲=889 反应堆功率=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 燃烧室压力=3825kPa 点火次数=8 含整体投影屏蔽重量: 16.97吨

src: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs, and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. The Mk V PIT was tested by TRW in 1993 with a variety of voltages, pulse sizes, and propellants.
zh: 脉冲感应推进器利用强磁脉冲使气体电离并加速。它能实现极具吸引力的比冲，且只需提高脉冲频率即可扩展功率。然而，它的电力消耗相当巨大。TRW 于 1993 年对 Mk V PIT 进行了测试，评估了各种电压、脉冲大小和推进剂。

src: A "Bubbler" liquid core nuclear thermal rocket. Hydrogen gas is bubbled through the liquid core of the reactor, resulting in extremely efficient heat transfer and high performance. Unfortunately, unexpected behavior in the hydrogen gas bubbles resulted in large amounts of fuel being lost from the reactor, and temperature and propellant flow had to be reduced, decreasing performance. A later redesign with a different fuel alloy allowed some performance to be restored.
zh: 一款“鼓泡式”液芯核热火箭。氢气通过气泡形式穿过反应堆的液态堆芯，带来极高的换热效率和出色的性能。不幸的是，氢气泡的异常行为导致反应堆损失了大量燃料，不得不降低温度和推进剂流量，从而降低了性能。后来采用不同燃料合金进行的改型设计挽回了部分性能。

src: A 490 N bipropellant thruster found in the propulsion system of the ESA ATV and the Orion MPCV Service Module. It performs orbit-raising maneuvers for many communication satellite platforms, including the Astrium Eurostar 3000, Boeing Space Systems 702HP, MELCO DS-2000, and the Loral LS-1300. The R-4D has also played a role in NASA missions, such as Cassini's orbital insertion around Saturn.
zh: 一款 490 N 双组元推进剂推进器，用于欧空局 ATV 和猎户座 MPCV 服务舱的推进系统。它负责为多种通信卫星平台执行轨道提升机动，包括 Astrium Eurostar 3000、Boeing Space Systems 702HP、MELCO DS-2000 以及 Loral LS-1300。R-4D 还在 NASA 任务中发挥了重要作用，例如卡西尼号的土星轨道捕获。

src: An American open cycle gas core nuclear rocket. NYRATH (Nuclear electrodYnamic Retention Advanced THermal) uses electrostatic confinment, instead of magnetic confinment, to contain the gaseous fissile core. By exploiting the difference between the ionization energies of uranium and hydrogen, an electrostatic nozzle can prevent fissile material from passing through while allowing hydrogen to leave unhindered. This allows for complete mixing of fissile material and propellant in the core, enabling extremely high energy transfer, and therefore extremely high performance.

A kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s), is lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes the boosters are dropped and Atlas continues to orbit under the power of the LR105 (with the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for better performance. As a sustainer, the LR105 has sea level and vacuum efficiencies somewhere between a booster and an upper stage engine.
zh: 用于宇宙神运载火箭的煤油/液氧燃气发生器主级发动机。它与宇宙神的助推器发动机（LR89s）一样在地面点火，但在2分多钟后助推器分离，宇宙神在LR105的动力下继续入轨（使用游标发动机进行滚转控制与最终微调）。LR105的最终构型（类似LR89）使用了RS-27组件以获得更高性能。作为主级发动机，LR105的海平面与真空效率介于助推器和上面级发动机之间。

src: A staged combustion sustainer engine developed for the USAF ISINGLASS spaceplane. After the ISINGLASS project was cancelled, it was adapted by P&W for their SSME proposal. It utilized staged combustion, mixture control, and extendable nozzles to allow for versatility and high performance.
zh: 为美国空军 ISINGLASS 空天飞机开发的分级燃烧主级发动机。在 ISINGLASS 项目取消后，它被普惠公司改造并用于竞标 SSME 方案。该发动机采用分级燃烧、混合比控制以及可延伸喷管，具备极高的多用途性与高性能。

src: Developed from the RS-25 SSME, the Liquid Rocket Booster Engine (LRBE) was a design concept for a liquid fueled Space Shuttle booster. Methane was chosen as a fuel, which increased density and thrust while still allowing fuel-rich staged combustion.
zh: 液体火箭助推器发动机（LRBE）基于RS-25 SSME 开发，是液体燃料航天飞机助推器的设计概念。它选用甲烷作为燃料，在提高密度和推力的同时，仍能实现富燃分级燃烧。

src: A "radiator" liquid core nuclear thermal rocket developed by Lewis Research Center. Rather than bubbling hydrogen through the reactor core, it is used to regeneratively cool the reactor walls, then flow through the middle of the reactor to be heated by radiation. Although this is less efficient than a "bubbler" reactor, the reduced interaction with the reactor core allows for much higher mass flow rates without excessive fuel loss, resulting in a higher TWR. The simpler core design also means it can be reloaded with fuel on-orbit (requires Near Future Electrical).
zh: 由刘易斯研究中心（Lewis Research Center）开发的“辐射式”液核核热火箭。该设计不再让氢气以气泡形式穿过反应堆堆芯，而是先用于对反应堆壁面进行再生冷却，随后流经反应堆中心利用热辐射加热。虽然其效率低于“鼓泡式”反应堆，但与反应堆堆芯的相互作用减少，使得在没有过多燃料损失的情况下获得更高的质量流量，从而实现更高的 TWR。更简单的堆芯设计也意味着它可以在轨加注燃料（需要 Near Future Electrical）。

src: The massive M-1 engine was the largest and most powerful hydrolox engine ever designed and individual components have been tested. It was generally designed as an upper stage engine, but first stage designs with expanding nozzles were also worked on.
zh: 巨大的M-1发动机是有史以来设计且经过单独组件测试的尺寸最大、推力最强的氢氧发动机。它通常被设计为上面级发动机，但研究人员也针对带有可膨胀喷管的第一级构型开展过研制。

src: Italian expander cycle methalox upper stage engine. Originally developed as a derivative of the RD-0146 in collaboration with KBKhA, sanctions levied against Russia in 2014 forced Avio to continue the development alone. The engine is intended to be used as the third stage of the new Vega-E launch vehicle, with it's first flight planned for 2026.
zh: 意大利膨胀循环甲烷/液氧上面级发动机。最初作为RD-0146的衍生型号与KBKhA合作研发，2014年对俄制裁迫使 Avio 单独继续研制。该发动机计划作为新型织女星-E（Vega-E）运载火箭的第三级使用，首次飞行计划于2026年进行。

src: The Mars Landing Engine (MLE) is a derivative of the highly successful MR-80 engine used for the two Viking missions to Mars in 1976. Eight of these engines were used on the sky-crane which landed the Curiosity Rover on the martian surface.
zh: 火星着陆发动机（MLE）衍生自大获成功的MR-80发动机，后者曾用于1976年两次海盗号火星任务。好奇号火星车降落在火星表面时使用的天空起重机就安装了八台此类发动机。

src: The power plant of the Redstone missile. Originally designed for ethanol/LOX it was later adapted to use Hydyne/LOX for 6% more performance in Jupiter-C / Juno I. When adapted for crewed use under Mercury, the A-7 was used with the original ethalox mixture, accepting slightly lower performance for the lack of toxicity. TVC was provided by carbon thrust vanes and additional attitude control was provided by actuating fins in the guidance section.
zh: 红石导弹的动力装置。最初设计使用乙醇/液氧，后来在朱庇特-C / 丘诺一号上改用 Hydyne/液氧，性能提升了6%。当为水星计划进行载人改装时，A-7重新采用了原版乙醇/液氧混合物，为消除毒性而牺牲了少量性能。TVC 由碳质燃气舵提供，制导段上的可动空气舵则提供额外的姿态控制。

src: The "Nerva NRX" series is a 1200MW reactor. A partial flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E replacing the "Hot End Seal" with peripheral systems. Its core is capable of starting up thirty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2550 Ideal ISP=943 Reactor Power=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 Chamber Pressure=4151kPa Ignitions =30 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 11.33tons
zh: “NERVA NRX”系列是一个 1200MW 的反应堆。作为部分飞行试验原型，最初基于 KIWI B4E，并用外围系统取代了“热端密封”。其堆芯可启动三十次。内置钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。副回路使停机气体流经小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电输出。该发动机应安装在距离最近油箱三至六米处。燃料应对所有乘员进行屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距发动机八至十米。诸如水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短此距离。该火箭代表了一系列更强力、更先进火箭的开端。该版本配备膨胀比为 50:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管 Ae=50 燃烧室温度=2550 理想比冲=943 反应堆热功率=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 燃烧室压力=4151kPa 点火次数=30 包含整体屏蔽层的总重：11.33吨。

src: The "Nerva XE" series is a 1550 MW reactor. A full flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E. Its core is capable of starting up sixty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2500 Ideal ISP=945 Reactor Power=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 Chamber Pressure=3806kPa Ignitions =60 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 10.38tons
zh: “NERVA XE”系列是一个 1550MW 的反应堆。作为完整飞行试验原型，最初基于 KIWI B4E。其堆芯可启动六十次。内置钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。副回路使停机气体流经小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电输出。该发动机应安装在距离最近油箱三至六米处。燃料应对所有乘员进行屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距发动机八至十米。诸如水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短此距离。该火箭代表了一系列更强力、更先进火箭的开端。该版本配备膨胀比为 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管 Ae=100 燃烧室温度=2500 理想比冲=945 反应堆热功率=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 燃烧室压力=3806kPa 点火次数=60 包含整体屏蔽层的总重：10.38吨。

src: The NASA Evolutionary Xenon Thruster (NEXT) project at NASA GRC produced quite a little marvel. Certified for flight use, and currently planned for several outer-Solar-System missions, the efficiency of the ion thruster greatly increased the payload weight, at the expense of burn time. Uses about 6.9kW of electricity.
zh: NASA 格伦研究中心的 NASA 演进型氙推进器（NEXT）项目创造了一项真正的奇迹。它已通过飞行认证，目前计划用于数项外太阳系任务；离子推力器的高效率极大地增加了有效载荷质量，代价是更长的点火时间。功耗约为 6.9kW。

src: A staged combustion engine developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1. The NK-15 powered the N1, and the NK-33 was developed to power the upgraded N1F. Though the N1F was scrapped, the engines survived and were sold to Aerojet in the 1990s. Refurbished as AJ26-62 engines, they powered Antares. Modifications made by Aerojet included increasing thrust and adding gimbals.
zh: 作为 N1 运载火箭研制 150 吨级推力助推器发动机计划的一部分而开发的分级燃烧发动机。NK-15曾用于为 N1 提供动力，而研制NK-33则是为了驱动升级版的 N1F。尽管 N1F 被废弃，但这批发动机幸存了下来，并在 20 世纪 90 年代被出售给 Aerojet。经过翻新后命名为AJ26-62发动机，曾为安塔瑞斯火箭提供动力。Aerojet 实施的改进包括提高推力并增加了万向节。

src: The 60-inch (1.5-meter) diameter GEM 60 is used on the Delta IV in sets of two or four. When two boosters are used, both are equipped with thrust vector control (TVC). When four are used, two boosters use TVC while the other two use fixed nozzles to reduce weight. Burn time 90 seconds.
zh: 直径60英寸（1.5米）的GEM 60在德尔塔IV号上以两台或四台为一组使用。当使用两台助推器时，两者均配备推力矢量控制（TVC）。当使用四台时，两台助推器使用TVC，而另外两台采用固定喷管以减轻重量。燃烧时间90秒。

src: In 2015, ULA announced that Orbital ATK would develop the GEM 63 as a drop-in replacement for the AJ-60A, and replace Aerojet-Rocketdyne for Atlas V SRMs. The GEM 63 is larger than the GEM 60 used on the Delta IV and cannot thrust vector. As with the AJ-60A, launches using the 4 m fairing will be able to use up to three boosters while up to five can be used with the 5 m fairing.
zh: 2015年，ULA宣布轨道ATK将开发GEM 63作为AJ-60A的直接替代品，并在宇宙神V号固体火箭助推器上取代喷气发动机-洛克达因公司。GEM 63比德尔塔IV号上使用的GEM 60更大，且无法进行推力矢量控制。与AJ-60A一样，使用4米整流罩的发射最多可使用三台助推器，而使用5米整流罩时最多可使用五台。

src: In addition to the GEM 63 for Atlas V, Orbital ATK will develop a larger variant, the GEM 63XL, for Vulcan. The boosters will be approximately 1.5 m longer than the GEM 63 and Vulcan will be able to use up to four boosters with a four-meter fairing or six boosters with a five-meter fairing.
zh: 除用于宇宙神V号的GEM 63外，轨道ATK还将为火神运载火箭开发更大的衍生型号GEM 63XL。该助推器比GEM 63长约1.5米，火神运载火箭在使用四米整流罩时最多可使用四台助推器，在使用五米整流罩时最多可使用六台助推器。

src: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles, as well as late-model Delta rockets (as the RS-27). The RS-27A has a higher expansion ratio optimized for performance at altitude since liftoff thrust on the Delta II is augmented by solid boosters.
zh: H-1是原始LR79发动机的升级版，曾为土星I号和IB号运载火箭以及后期的德尔塔火箭（作为RS-27）提供动力。RS-27A具有更高的膨胀比，针对高空性能进行了优化，因为德尔塔II号的起飞推力由固体助推器增强。

src: The High Power Electric Propulsion (HiPEP) unit was designed and tested at NASA Glenn Research Center and can produce more thrust than its smaller cousin. Requires about 39.3kW of electricity. Mass/power ratio: 3.05 kg/kW.
zh: 大功率电推进（HiPEP）装置由NASA格伦研究中心设计并测试，可产生比其同类更小的型号更大的推力。需要约39.3kW的电能。质量/功率比：3.05 kg/kW。

src: Advanced NTR, based on the SNTP/Timberwind design. Higher temperature alloys and a sintered fuel element allow for extremely-high-temperature operation, with specific impulse exceeding 1000 seconds. The use of low-enriched uranium fuel reduces TWR as compared to Timberwind/SNTP designs, but allows for greatly increased core lifetime.
zh: 基于SNTP/Timberwind设计的高级热核火箭（NTR）。耐高温合金和烧结燃料元件使其能够在极高温度下运行，比冲超过1000秒。与Timberwind/SNTP设计相比，使用低浓缩铀燃料降低了TWR，但极大地延长了堆芯寿命。

src: A 2000s medium TWR vacuum engine, the J-2X was intended to be used on the upper stages of Ares I and Ares V. Development continued after the cancellation of Ares, and early designs of SLS incorporated the engine, but the project was mothballed after the RL10-powered Exploration Upper Stage was selected.
zh: 一款2000年代的中TWR真空发动机，J-2X原定用于战神I号和战神V号的上面级。战神计划取消后该发动机继续研发，SLS的早期设计也采用了该发动机，但在选用RL10驱动的探索上面级后，该项目被搁置。

src: Early exploration into pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engines. This was designed by JPL to be the third stage on the Juno IV launch vehicle. After cancellation of the Juno IV, it was then selected to power the Vega upper stage for the Atlas-Vega launcher, but the Vega program was canceled in 1959. The "6K" upper stage engine was tested often, but never flew.
zh: 对挤压循环自燃推进剂上面级发动机的早期探索。由JPL设计，原定作为朱诺IV号运载火箭的第三级。在朱诺IV号取消后，它被选为宇宙神-织女星运载火箭的织女星上面级提供动力，但织女星计划于1959年被取消。“6K”上面级发动机经过多次测试，但从未实际飞行。

src: Developed by JPL as a high-performance second stage engine, this was intended for the Juno IV launch vehicle and would provide 45,000 pounds of thrust in vacuum. It was tested, but ultimately decided against in favor of the X-405.
zh: 由JPL开发的高性能二级发动机，原定用于朱诺IV号运载火箭，可在真空中提供45000磅的推力。经过测试，但最终被否决以支持X-405。

src: The "KIWI A" series is an older 132MW reactor with the lowest power density of all the rover tests. Most tests resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of liquid hydrogen pumping is a major accomplishment. Its core is capable of starting up twice. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted two to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be six to nine meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. All subsequent US nuclear thermal rocket designs build off this concept. This version features a very small fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 24:1 area expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae/A*=24 Chamber Temp=2300 Ideal ISP=874 Reactor Power=132MW(th) TWR=0.24 Chamber Pressure=1415kPa Ignitions =2 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 12.08tons
zh: “KIWI A”系列是一台较早的132MW反应堆，在所有漫游者测试中功率密度最低。大多数测试都以燃料元件破碎或测试设备故障告终，但从中吸取了大量经验，液氢泵送技术的发展也是一项重大成就。其堆芯能够启动两次。包含一体式钨屏蔽层，整体采用再生冷却。辅助回路将停机气体导入小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机应安装在距离最近的燃料箱2到6米处。燃料箱应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距离发动机6到9米。水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短该距离。后续所有美国热核火箭设计均基于此概念。该版本配备一个极小的固定式再生冷却喷管，面积膨胀比为24:1。喷管 Ae/A*=24 燃烧室温度=2300 理想比冲=874 反应堆功率=132MW(th) TWR=0.24 燃烧室压力=1415kPa 点火次数=2 含一体式阴影屏蔽总重：12.08吨

src: The "KIWI B" series is an older 1100MW reactor with more than 10 times the power density of the A series. Most tests early resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and heat pipes. The final test B4E ran smoothly and even restarted from a cold condition. The first Kiwi B test was run on gaseous hydrogen since hydrogen pumping and storage was in its infancy. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the basic and conservative solid core rocket design. The NERVA designs build off this concept. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 66:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=66 Chamber Temp=2473 Ideal ISP=864 Reactor Power=1166MW(th) TWR=2.04 Chamber Pressure=3606kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 14.89tons
zh: “KIWI B”系列是一台较早的1100MW反应堆，功率密度是A系列的10倍以上。大多数早期测试都以燃料元件破碎或测试设备故障告终，但从中吸取了大量经验，促进了先进涂层、化学气相沉积和热管技术的发展。最终的B4E测试运行平稳，甚至实现了冷态重启。首次Kiwi B测试使用气态氢进行，因为当时氢泵送和储存技术尚处于起步阶段。其堆芯能够启动四次。包含一体式钨屏蔽层，整体采用再生冷却。辅助回路将停机气体导入小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机应安装在距离最近的燃料箱3到6米处。燃料箱应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距离发动机8到12米。水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短该距离。这枚火箭代表了基础而保守的固态堆芯火箭设计。NERVA设计即基于此概念。该版本配备一个固定式再生冷却喷管，膨胀比为66:1。喷管 Ae=66 燃烧室温度=2473 理想比冲=864 反应堆功率=1166MW(th) TWR=2.04 燃烧室压力=3606kPa 点火次数=4 含一体式阴影屏蔽总重：14.89吨

src: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use on the TKS FGB (Functional Cargo Block). Extremely reliable and with restart capability, it has been used on many FGB derivatives, such as later Almaz stations, Skif, Kvant-1 FSM, Kvant-2, Krystal, Spektr, Priroda, Zarya, and Nauka. The pump of the KRD-442 can also be used to internally transfer fuel or refuel from Progress resupply craft.
zh: 苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，设计用于TKS FGB（功能货舱）。极度可靠且具备重启能力，已用于许多FGB衍生型号，例如后期的礼炮号空间站、极地号、量子1号FSM、量子2号、晶体号、光谱号、自然号、曙光号和科学号。KRD-442的泵还可用于内部燃料输送或从进步号补给船加注推进剂。

src: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Luna E-6 spacecraft bus. It was used for the first Soviet lunar landers and lunar orbiters. When used on a lunar lander, it was switched to verniers only for terminal descent.
zh: 苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，设计用于月球E-6航天器平台的推进系统。用于苏联首批月球着陆器和月球轨道器。在月球着陆器上使用时，在最终下降阶段会切换为仅使用游标发动机。

src: The KTDU-35 is a gas generator hypergolic engine capable of multiple ignitions, used on the first generation Soyuz and Progress spacecrafts (the 7K series). It consists of the single nozzle S5.60 main engine and the dual nozzle S5.35 backup engine. If the main engine fails, the backup one will assume its position.
zh: KTDU-35 是一款具备多次点火能力的气体发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机，用于第一代联盟号和进步号航天器（7K系列）。它由单喷管 S5.60 主发动机和双喷管 S5.35 备用发动机组成。若主发动机发生故障，备用发动机将接替工作。

src: The landing engine for Luna 15-24. The main gas generator engine was used for orbital manuevering and descent, and then switched over to a secondary pressure-fed engine for terminal descent. Use an action group to toggle between the main and secondary engines quickly to make landing easier.
zh: 月球15至24号的着陆发动机。主发生器发动机用于轨道机动和动力下降，随后切换至挤压循环辅助发动机进行末段着陆。使用动作组快速开关切换主发动机与副发动机，可使着陆更为轻松。

src: A staged combustion hydrolox engine intended for the N-1M, considered for Proton and Angara, and eventually licensed to India for its GSLV. Later versions were developed by India for domestic use as the CE-7.5. The main engine bell is fixed in place and two verniers provide combined pitch-yaw-roll control. This engine runs with a somewhat higher than average O/F ratio, resulting in a denser than average hydrolox stage.
zh: 一款专为 N-1M 设计的分级燃烧循环氢氧发动机，曾作为质子号和安加拉号的备选，最终授权印度用于其 GSLV 火箭。印度后来将其国产改进型号命名为 CE-7.5。主发动机喷管固定，由两个游标发动机提供综合俯仰-偏航-滚转控制。该发动机的氧燃比较常规略高，因此氢氧级推进剂密度更高。

src: The LE-5 is a gas generator hydrolox engine, the first natively-developed Japanese hydrolox engine, designed for use on the second stage of the H-1 launch vehicle. It was then completely redesigned into the world's first expander bleed cycle engine for use on the H-II. It has gone through several evolutions since, being used on the H-IIA, H-IIB, and planned for the H-3.
zh: LE-5 是一款气体发生器循环氢氧发动机，也是日本首款自主研发的氢氧发动机，专为 H-1 运载火箭第二级设计。随后它被彻底重新设计为世界上首款开式膨胀循环发动机，用于 H-II 火箭。此后经历多次改进，曾用于 H-IIA、H-IIB，并计划用于 H-3。

src: A fuel-rich staged combustion engine used on the core stage of H-II series launchers. The original LE-7 was replaced by the LE-7A, which sacrificed some performance in favor of reduced cost and better reliability.
zh: 一款富燃分级燃烧循环发动机，用于 H-II 系列运载火箭的芯级。最初的 LE-7 被 LE-7A 取代，后者牺牲了部分性能以换取更低的成本和更高的可靠性。

src: An expander-bleed cycle booster engine, developed for the Japanese H-3 launch vehicle. The use of an expander-bleed cycle makes the engine much cheaper than it's staged combustion predecessor, the LE-7.
zh: 一款为日本 H-3 运载火箭研制的开式膨胀循环助推器发动机。采用开式膨胀循环使其造价比采用分级燃烧循环的前身 LE-7 低廉得多。

src: LEROS is a family of chemical rocket engines manufactured by Moog-ISP. LEROS engines have been used as primary apogee engines for telecommunications satellites such as the Lockheed Martin A2100 as well as deep space missions such as Juno.
zh: LEROS 是由 Moog-ISP 生产的化学火箭发动机系列。LEROS 发动机已用作通信卫星（如洛克希德·马丁的 A2100）以及深空探测任务（如朱诺号）的主远地点发动机。

src: The LEROS 4 High Thrust Apogee Engine is an ESA-funded 1100 N engine undergoing development by Moog. It will support the agency's future interplanetary missions by reducing the mass of spacecraft propellant required for orbit insertion maneuvers, allowing more scientific payload to be carried.
zh: LEROS 4 高推力远地点发动机是由欧空局资助、Moog 正在研发的 1100 N 发动机。它将通过减少航天器入轨机动所需的推进剂质量，从而能够携带更多热心科研载荷，为欧空局未来的行星际任务提供支持。

src: An American closed cycle gas core nuclear rocket. Fissile material is contained in fused quartz "lightbulbs", cooled by continuously circulating neon. Propellant passed over these "lightbulbs" is heated to incredible temperatures by the intense light and radiation produced by the nuclear reaction. This design prevents any fissile material from escaping the engine, but reduces performance due to heat transfer losses.
zh: 一款美国闭式气芯核火箭。易裂变材料封装在熔融石英“灯泡”内，由持续循环的氖气冷却。推进剂流经这些“灯泡”时，被核反应产生的强烈光辐射加热至极高温度。该设计防止了任何易裂变材料逸出发动机，但由于传热损失而降低了性能。

src: A deeply-throttleable pressure-fed engine used for the descent module of the Apollo lunar lander. The version on J-class missions had slightly higher isp, which helped give payload capacity for the rover and other equipment. A later variant (TR-201) was used on Delta P series as an upper stage engine; this was a low-cost model with more restarts and slightly higher thrust but with lower efficiency and no throttling.
zh: 一款用于阿波罗登月舱下降级的深度节流挤压循环发动机。J级任务使用的版本比冲略高，有助于为月球车和其他设备提供有效载荷能力。后来的改型（TR-201）作为上面级发动机用于德尔塔 P 系列；这是一款低成本型号，具有更多的重启次数和略高的推力，但效率较低且无法节流。

src: The low-pressure NTR is a proposal for a higher performance NTR, relying on hydrogen dissociation. By decreasing the chamber pressure of an NTR to near atmospheric pressure, it is possible to trigger dissociation of diatomic hydrogen into monatomic hydrogen, greatly increasing specific impulse. This low pressure also allows for extremely lightweight construction, allowing for an acceptable TWR despite the low mass flow. The LPNTR is also extremely simple, requiring no pumps, and self-regulating using hydrogen as a moderator, although it also lacks a gimbal.
zh: 低压核热火箭（LPNTR）是一种旨在通过氢解离来提高性能的核热火箭方案。通过将核反应室压力降低至接近大气压，可以触发双原子氢解离为单原子氢，从而大幅提高比冲。这种低压环境还允许采用极轻量化的结构，在较低质量流量的情况下仍可获得尚可的 TWR。LPNTR 还极其简单，无需泵组，且利用氢自身作为慢化剂实现自调节，不过它也缺乏万向节。

src: A long-lasting US kerolox gas-generator booster engine. The same components and broadly the same performance as the LR89, the LR79 (also known as S-3D in Jupiter / Juno II) powered the Jupiter, Thor, and Thor-Delta (Delta) rockets.
zh: 一款服役寿命极长的美国煤油/液氧气体发生器助推器发动机。LR79（在朱庇特/朱诺二号中亦称 S-3D）拥有与 LR89 相同的组件和大致相当的性能，曾为朱庇特、雷神及雷神-德尔塔（德尔塔）火箭提供动力。

src: Used in the first stage of the Titan rocket family, the LR87 is composed of two engines with separate turbomachinery integrated into one unit. The version used on Titan I burned kerosene and liquid oxygen, while Titan II through Titan IV burned storable propellants. A modified version burning liquid hydrogen was developed for the upper stages of Saturn V and Saturn IB, but the J-2 was selected instead.
zh: LR87 用于大力神火箭家族的第一级，由两台拥有独立涡轮泵的发动机集成在一个单元内。大力神 I 使用的版本燃烧煤油和液氧，而大力神 II 到大力神 IV 则燃烧可贮存推进剂。曾有一款燃烧液氢的改进版本为土星五号和土星 IB 的上面级研制，但最终入选的是 J-2。

src: Aerojet developed the LR87 engine (used for the Titan series) into a liquid hydrogen/oxygen engine for prospective USAF contracts in the 1958-1960 period, at the same time Aerojet was converting the LR87 to burn Aerozine and NTO. Aerojet also proposed this engine for Saturn upper stage duties, but NASA selected the J-2 over the LR87-LH2 and it was canceled in 1961.
zh: 在 1958-1960 年间，喷气飞机公司（Aerojet）将用于大力神系列的 LR87 发动机改进为液氢/液氧发动机以竞标美国空军合同，与此同时 Aerojet 正在将 LR87 改装为燃烧混胺和四氧化二氮。Aerojet 还提议将此发动机用于土星上面级，但 NASA 最终选择了 J-2 而放弃了 LR87-LH2，该项目遂于 1961 年取消。

src: Beginning its life as the etholox-powered XLR43-NA-3, this was the first US engine to use tubular-wall construction for its combustion chamber. It served as the basis for early orbital US engines, with its lineage stretching to the 21st century. The LR43 was converted to run on kerosene for Atlas and was later renamed LR89, and the LR79 derivative powered Thor. Later LR89s used RS-27 components for higher efficiency, whereas the RS-27 itself was used on Delta by that point. LR89 configs are comparable to similar-era -79 configs, since they were the same engine underneath.
zh: 该系列最初为乙醇/液氧动力的 XLR43-NA-3，是美国首款采用管状冷却燃烧室壁结构的发动机。它作为美国早期轨道级发动机的基础，其血统一直延续到 21 世纪。LR43 被改装为适用于宇宙神火箭的煤油发动机，后来改名为 LR89，其衍生型号 LR79 则为雷神火箭提供动力。后期的 LR89s 采用了 RS-27 的部件以提高效率，而此时 RS-27 本身已被用于德尔塔火箭。LR89 的构型与同时期的 -79 构型相当，因为两者的本质是同一款发动机。

src: A pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able, Thor-Agena, Thor-Delta, and Delta.
zh: 一款泵压或挤压循环的煤油/液氧游标发动机。用于宇宙神 MA-x 系统（2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101）以及雷神-艾布尔、雷神-阿金纳、雷神-德尔塔和德尔塔火箭 MB-x 系统（LR79 或 RS-27 + 2xLR101）的姿态控制和最终速度修正。

src: A post-war Russian version of the German Taifun anti-aircraft barrage rocket booster. Developed and tested in 1947-1951 but abandoned in favor of the R-110. A cluster of 8 of these rockets formed the first stage of the MR-1 sounding rocket. Length without payload - 1.36 meters.
zh: 德国“台风”（Taifun）防空弹幕火箭助推器的战后苏联仿制型号。于1947至1951年间研制并测试，但后来因转投R-110而被放弃。由8枚该型火箭捆绑而成的发动机组构成了MR-1探空火箭的第一级。不含有效载荷时的长度为1.36米。

src: A 225 N hydrazine thruster, used on all Ranger and early Mariner spacecraft for midcourse corrections. Since reliable hydrazine catalysts had not yet been developed, the engines were only capable of two starts.
zh: 一款225 N肼推进器，用于所有“徘徊者”以及早期“水手”航天器的中途修正。由于当时尚未开发出可靠的肼催化剂，该发动机仅能点火两次。

src: The Raptor is a methalox full-flow staged combustion engine designed for both Starship & the Super Heavy Launch Vehicle. The Super Heavy first stage uses 33 sea-level optimized engines, and Starship uses 3 sea-level engines and 3 vacuum engines.
zh: 猛禽（Raptor）是一款专为星舰及“超级重型”运载火箭设计的全流量分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。“超级重型”第一级使用33台海平面优化发动机，星舰则使用3台海平面发动机和3台真空发动机。

src: A four-chamber nitric acid and kerosene engine developed by Glushko during WW2. It was used in various rocket powered aircraft proposals, and tested extensively in the Pe-2RD, a Pe-2 bomber with an RD-1 installed in the fuselage, but abandoned after WW2, as jet engines proved to be more reliable for high performance aircraft.
zh: 一款由格鲁什科在二战期间研制的四燃烧室硝酸/煤油发动机。它曾用于多种火箭动力飞机的方案设计，并在Pe-2RD（一架在机身内安装了Pe-2的RD-1轰炸机）上进行了广泛测试；但由于喷气式发动机在高性能飞机上展现出了更高的可靠性，该方案在二战后被放弃。

src: A 1970s low TWR staged combustion hydrolox upper stage engine intended for use on the N1/N1M. A later version designated RD-57M had an extendable nozzle and was intended for the Vulkan and Energia-M rockets. The engine was marketed by Aerojet in the 1990s under the designation D-57 for use on an SSTO demonstrator.
zh: 一款20世纪70年代研制的低TWR分级燃烧氢氧上面级发动机，原计划用于N1/N1M。后期代号为RD-57M的改型配备了可伸展喷管，原定用于“火神”（Vulkan）和“能源-M”（Energia-M）火箭。该发动机在20世纪90年代由Aerojet以代号D-57推向市场，拟用于单级入轨（SSTO）验证机。

src: The world's first closed-cycle engine. The S1.5400 was used as the final stage for the R-7's Molniya configuration to launch communication satellites and interplanetary probes. Unlike prior upper stages, it was restartable (apogee kicks are needed for Molniya orbits). It was given the industry designation 11D33. The 11D33M brought upgrades and was the basis for the RD-58 with higher performance still (designated 11D58). The RD-58 was used on many Russian launchers, including N1 and Buran and is still in use on Proton and Zenit.
zh: 世界上第一款闭式循环发动机。S1.5400曾作为R-7“闪电”构型的末级，用于发射通信卫星和行星际探测器。与以往的上面级不同，它具备二次启动能力（闪电轨道需要远地点加速）。其工业代号为11D33。升级版的11D33M成为性能更高的RD-58（代号11D58）的基础。RD-58曾用于包括N1和暴风雪号在内的众多俄罗斯运载火箭，至今仍在使用于“质子”号和“天顶”号上。

src: RD-100 series engines were the first large scale ethalox Russian engines ever developed and fired. The original RD-100 engine was a 1:1 copy of the German Model 39 engine (used on the A-4 ballistic missile), with later variants (RD-101 and RD-103/M) featuring ever increasing performance to satisfy the needs of the larger R-2 and R-5 IRBMs.
zh: RD-100系列发动机是俄罗斯有史以来研发并点火的第一批大型乙醇液氧发动机。最初的RD-100发动机是德国39型发动机（用于A-4弹道导弹）的1:1仿制品，后期的衍生型号（RD-101与RD-103/M）性能不断提升，以满足更大的R-2和R-5中程弹道导弹（IRBM）的需求。

src: A kerolox gas generator vacuum engine which served in R-7 upper stages (Luna, Vostok). The RD-0105 was designed for Luna launches; it was the first upper stage for the R-7 series and was reused for uncrewed Vostok tests. An enhanced version, the RD-0109, was used for crewed Vostok launches.
zh: 一款煤油液氧气动发生器循环真空发动机，曾用于R-7的上面级（“月球”号、“东方”号）。RD-0105专为“月球”号任务设计，是R-7系列的首个上面级，后又复用于无人“东方”号测试。其性能增强版本RD-0109则用于载人“东方”号发射。

src: The booster engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the core engine series (RD-108) with a higher chamber pressure, thrust, and smaller vernier layout. The R-7 family core was supplemented for (roughly) two minutes by four strap-on boosters powered by these engines.
zh: 用于R-7“老七”（Semyorka）及其衍生型号（包括“伴侣”号、“月球”号、“上升”号、“东方”号、“联盟”号和“闪电”号运载火箭）的助推器发动机。与芯级发动机系列（RD-108）相比，它的室压和推力更高，游标布局更紧凑。由这些发动机提供动力的四个捆绑助推器会为R-7家族芯级提供约两分钟的推力补充。

src: The core engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the booster engine series (RD-107) with a lower chamber pressure, thrust, and a wider vernier layout. It powers the R-7 family core through a very long (roughly) five minute burn that starts on the pad alongside the boosters.
zh: 用于R-7“老七”（Semyorka）及其衍生型号（包括“伴侣”号、“月球”号、“上升”号、“东方”号、“联盟”号和“闪电”号运载火箭）的芯级发动机。与助推器发动机系列（RD-107）相比，它的室压和推力更低，游标布局更宽。它为R-7家族芯级提供长达约五分钟的动力推进，并在发射台上与助推器同时点火。

src: A Soviet high-performance semi-cryogenic upper stage engine. Originally developed as an upper stage for the R-7, it was never used due to Korolev's refusal to use toxic propellants. It was later adapted for the Kosmos-2 Launch Vehicle, which needed a high performance upper stage due to the low performance of its R-12 first stage.
zh: 一款苏联研制的高性能半低温上面级发动机。最初作为R-7的上面级研制，但因科罗廖夫拒绝使用剧毒推进剂而未被采用。后来它被适配到“宇宙-2”运载火箭上，以弥补其R-12第一级性能不足的问题。

src: The first stage engine for the R-9 ICBM. Derived from the RD-107/108 engines of the R-7, the RD-111 was intended to provide a much quicker reaction time than the R-7. Although still using cryogenic liquid oxygen, it could be fuelled and launched in under 20 minutes. This, combined with its high performance, meant it was the last cryogenic ICBM to leave service.
zh: 用于R-9洲际弹道导弹的第一级发动机。衍生自R-7的RD-107/108发动机，RD-111旨在提供比R-7快得多的反应时间。尽管仍使用低温液氧，但它能在20分钟内完成加注并点火发射。这一特点配合其高性能，使其成为服役时间最长的低温洲际弹道导弹。

src: A 1990s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120T is a fuel-rich staged combustion tripropellant engine developed from the RD-0120 for use on SSTOs and other high performance vehicles. Tested in collaboration with Aerojet, but never flew.
zh: 一款20世纪90年代研制的中TWR大气与真空通用发动机。RD-0120T是一款富燃分级燃烧三组元推进剂发动机，由RD-0120衍生而来，用于SSTO及其他高性能运载工具。曾与Aerojet合作进行过测试，但从未实际飞行。

src: The first expander cycle engine developed in Russia. It was developed in collaboration with Pratt & Whitney as a high performance upper stage for Proton. It was heavily inspired by the RL10, and some of its design elements were integrated into the RL10.
zh: 俄罗斯研制的第一款膨胀循环发动机。它是与普惠公司（Pratt & Whitney）合作开发的，拟作为“质子”号的高性能上面级。其设计深受RL10的启发，部分设计元素后来也被反哺整合到了RL10中。

src: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，KBKhA在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯MRKS-1可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为RD-0162的可重复使用发动机。

src: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0164 is higher thrust variant of that engine.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，KBKhA在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯MRKS-1可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为RD-0162的可重复使用发动机。RD-0164是该发动机的大推力改型。

src: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0169 is an upper stage derivative of that engine.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，KBKhA在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯MRKS-1可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为RD-0162的可重复使用发动机。RD-0169是该发动机的上面级衍生型号。

src: An atmospheric booster engine used from the 1980s to present, the RD-170 is the most powerful liquid rocket engine ever flown. Originally developed for the Energia launcher's boosters, the engine consists of four combustion chambers fed by a single turbopump. A modified version, the RD-171, is used on the first stage of the Zenit launch vehicle.
zh: 一款从20世纪80年代沿用至今的大气助推器发动机，RD-170是有史以来实际飞行过的推力最大的液体火箭发动机。该发动机最初为“能源”号运载火箭的助推器研制，由单台涡轮泵向四个燃烧室供油。其改进型号RD-171被用于“天顶”号运载火箭的第一级。

src: A further continuation of the RD-170/171 series, featuring a single combustion chamber and nozzle. The RD-191 powers the Angara family of launchers, while the RD-151 was used on the Naro-1 launch vehicle and the RD-181 will be used on the Antares 200-series.
zh: RD-170/171系列的进一步延续型号，采用单燃烧室和单喷管设计。RD-191为安加拉系列运载火箭提供动力，RD-151曾用于Naro-1运载火箭，而RD-181将用于安塔瑞斯200系列。

src: The first multi-chamber engine developed by Glushko. After Glushko's attempts to scale up existing engines for what would become the R-7 resulted in unresolvable combustion instability (RD-105/106), Glushko instead combined multiple chambers of his ED-140 engine into one to increase thrust. The result, the RD-200, proved successful and, although it never flew, its design formed the basis of the RD-107/108 and RD-214.
zh: 格鲁什科开发的第一款多燃烧室发动机。格鲁什科曾尝试放大现有发动机以用于后来的R-7，但导致了无法解决的燃烧不稳定问题（RD-105/106），因此他改为将多个ED-140发动机燃烧室组合在一起来提升推力。成果即是RD-200，该设计被证明是成功的，尽管从未升空飞行，但其设计构成了RD-107/108和RD-214的基础。

src: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. Used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-200 rocket, with 3 RD-0203s and 1 RD-0204 forming a RD-0202 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。用作UR-200火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台RD-0203s和1台RD-0204组成RD-0202发动机模块。具备双轴万向节机构以用于姿态控制。

src: An early Soviet four combustion chamber rocket. Developed from the RD-100 for the R-12 IRBM in the mid 1950s, it provided a significant increase in power over earlier Soviet engines. It was later used for the Kosmos-2 launch vehicle.
zh: 苏联早期研发的四燃烧室火箭发动机。由RD-100发展而来，于1950年代中期用于R-12中程弹道导弹，相比苏联早期的发动机提供了显著的动力提升。后来用于宇宙-2号运载火箭。

src: A staged combustion, hypergolic vacuum rocket engine. Used as the power plant on the second stage of the UR-200, and third stage of UR-500/Proton launch vehicle family. Features four integrated vernier engines for three-axis attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机。用作UR-200第二级以及UR-500/质子号运载火箭家族第三级的动力装置。配备四台集成式游标发动机以提供三轴姿态控制。

src: A staged combustion engine found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher. It is fixed, and requires its accompanying vernier module for 3-axis control. It uses UDMH & NTO for propellant.
zh: 用于UR-200第二级和UR-500/质子号系列运载火箭第三级的分级燃烧发动机。该发动机为固定安装，需要搭配专用游标模块来实现三轴控制。使用偏二甲肼与四氧化二氮推进剂。

src: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. It was designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fueling before launch. It was used in clusters of up to three in many Soviet ICBMs, and later in the Kosmos and Tsiklon launch vehicles.
zh: 苏联的双燃烧室燃气发生器循环发动机。设计于1950年代后期，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时R-7采用的低温推进剂无法长时间贮存，发射前需要耗费漫长时间加注。它以最多三台并联的方式应用于多种苏联洲际弹道导弹，后来又用于宇宙号和旋风号运载火箭。

src: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. It was used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-100 rocket, with 3 RD-0216s and 1 RD-0217 forming a 15D2 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control. It was later modified into an upper stage engine for the UR-100N, and proposed as an upper stage engine for the UR-700/LK-700 complex.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。曾用作UR-100火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台RD-0216s和1台RD-0217组成15D2发动机模块。配备双轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。后来被改装为用于UR-100N的上面级发动机，并曾提议作为UR-700/LK-700综合体的上面级发动机。

src: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. Designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fuelling before launch. It was used on the R-16 and R-36 ICBMs, and Tsiklon-2 and Tsiklon-3 LVs.
zh: 苏联的双燃烧室燃气发生器循环发动机。设计于1950年代末，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时R-7采用的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要冗长的加注过程。曾用于R-16和R-36洲际弹道导弹，以及旋风-2号和旋风-3号运载火箭。

src: An early Soviet hypergolic staged combustion vacuum engine. Designed for the second stage of the enormous R-20 project, versions were designed using Nitric Acid or Liquid Oxygen as an oxidizer, with UDMH as fuel. Although it was never used, it formed the basis of the much more successful RD-253 used on Proton.
zh: 苏联早期的自燃推进剂分级燃烧真空发动机。为庞大的R-20工程第二级而设计，研发了使用硝酸或液氧作为氧化剂、以偏二甲肼为燃料的多个版本。尽管从未实际使用，但它为质子号上极为成功的RD-253奠定了基础。

src: A staged combustion upper stage engine module developed for the R-36M second stage. It consists of an RD-0229 main engine and RD-0230 vernier engine. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0255.
zh: 为R-36M第二级研制的分级燃烧上面级发动机模块。它由一台RD-0229主发动机和一台RD-0230游标发动机组成。R-36M2采用了该发动机的升级型号，即RD-0255。

src: A staged combustion upper stage engine developed for the R-36M second stage. This engine cannot gimbal, and should be paired with a set of RD-0230 verniers. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0256.
zh: 为R-36M第二级研制的分级燃烧上面级发动机。该发动机无法使用万向节摆动，需与一组RD-0230游标发动机搭配使用。R-36M2采用了该发动机的升级型号，即RD-0256。

src: A staged combustion booster engine developed for the UR-100N. The RD-0234 was identical, other than the addition of pressurization equipment. Three RD-0233s and one RD-0234 powered the first stage of the UR-100N, UR-100NU, Strela and Rokot.
zh: 为UR-100N研制的分级燃烧助推器发动机。除增加了增压设备外，RD-0234与其实际相同。三台RD-0233s和一台RD-0234共同为UR-100N、UR-100NU、箭号和呼啸号的第一级提供动力。

src: Staged combustion booster engine module. Developed as the first stage engine of the R-29RM Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile, the RD-0243 consists of an RD-0244 main engine and RD-0245 vernier engine. In order to save space, the engine is submerged within the fuel tank of the R-29RM, with the rear bulkhead of the missile welded to the engine nozzle. Also used on the Shtil' launch vehicle, a unique smallsat launcher capable of being deployed from Delta IV submarines.
zh: 分级燃烧助推器发动机模块。作为R-29RM潜射弹道导弹的第一级发动机研制，RD-0243由一台RD-0244主发动机和一台RD-0245游标发动机组成。为节省空间，发动机浸没安装在R-29RM的燃料贮箱内，导弹尾部舱壁直接与发动机喷管焊接。该发动机还用于静海号运载火箭——一种能够从德尔塔IV级潜艇发射的独特微小型卫星运载器。

src: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15 was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-253, using NTO, was chosen to power the UR-500/Proton, becoming the workhorse of the Soviet space program.
zh: 苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1运载火箭建造150吨级推力助推器发动机计划的一部分而研发，制造了分别使用硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼燃烧的版本。尽管最终N1选用了NK-15作为动力，但采用四氧化二氮的RD-253被选为UR-500/质子号的动力装置，并成为了苏联航天工程的绝对主力。

src: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust vacuum engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15V was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-254, using NTO, was chosen to power the upper stages of the UR-700. The RD-254 was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew.
zh: 苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1运载火箭建造150吨级推力真空发动机计划的一部分而研发，制造了分别使用硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼燃烧的版本。尽管最终N1选用了NK-15V作为动力，但采用四氧化二氮的RD-254被选为UR-700的上面级动力装置。RD-254随着UR-700项目的下马而取消，从未升空飞行。

src: The largest single-chamber engine ever built in the USSR, and the first full-flow staged combustion engine, the RD-270 was fueled by NTO and UDMH combined under some of the highest pressures ever encountered in an ignition chamber. Extensively tested to power the first and second stages of the UR-700, it was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew, despite efforts to convert it to kerosene for the N1.
zh: 苏联建造过的最大单燃烧室发动机，也是第一款全流量分级燃烧发动机。RD-270以四氧化二氮和偏二甲肼为燃料，在极高的燃烧室压力下混合燃烧。该发动机为了给UR-700的第一级和第二级提供动力而进行了广泛的测试，但尽管曾尝试将其改用煤油以供N1使用，它最终还是随着UR-700工程的下马而取消，从未升空飞行。

src: Modification of the RD-270 to use highly toxic pentaborane as fuel. Although the M variant boasts higher thrust and isp, the fuel mixture is much, much more toxic than even UDMH. Pentaborane has a flash point of 30 degrees Celsius, a tendency to form shock-sensitive explosive compounds, and is classified as "immediately dangerous to life or health" with concentrations at or above one part per million.
zh: RD-270的改型，使用剧毒的五硼烷作为燃料。尽管M改型拥有更高的推力和比冲，但其推进剂混合物的毒性甚至远超偏二甲肼。五硼烷的闪点仅为30摄氏度，极易形成对震动敏感的爆炸性化合物，在浓度达到或超过百万分之一（1 ppm）时即被归类为“对生命或健康有即刻危险”。

src: An exotic fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed as a high-energy upper stage for Proton by Glushko, the RD-301 burned liquid fluorine and ammonia, which gave very high performance and density. It was tested extensively, but never flew due to toxicity concerns.
zh: 一款罕见的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。由格鲁什科为质子号设计的高能上面级发动机，RD-301 使用液氟和液氨作为推进剂，拥有极高的性能与推进剂密度。该发动机进行了大量地面测试，但由于剧毒问题从未实际飞行。

src: RD-0410 was a Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine developed from 1965 through the 1994 using liquid hydrogen propellant. The engine was ground-tested at the Semipalatinsk Test Site, and its use was incorporated in the Kurchatov Mars 1994 manned mission proposal. Its moderator and fuel are quite different from the US designs and Metal Carbide (MC) versions of the fuel are rumoured to have reach as high as 3500K without melting in the early 1990's. Use of Heptane to reduce hydrogen corrosion of the carbides was critical to function (~1%). First run tests occurred in 1985. Some Russian sources list it as dual mode using not only Hydrogen but also liquid Methane without additives. During the SNTP program the US tried to acquire MC fuels from Russian sources but planned purchases fell through. This engine is very heavily built compared to US designs and incorporates a four lobed spiral fuel rod to eliminate risk of fuel being ejected if the rods shattered. This design uses a short regeneratively cooled nozzle and is intended as an upper stage. Design stats Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=972 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=1.73 Chamber Pressure=4000kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons. In Methane mode the nozzle is slightly expanded by 12cm length and slightly enlarged. Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=467 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=3.56 Chamber Pressure=4800kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons
zh: RD-0410 是苏联在 1965 年至 1994 年间开发的核热火箭发动机，使用液氢推进剂。该发动机在塞米巴拉金斯克试验场进行了地面测试，并被列入 1994 年库尔恰托夫火星载人任务方案。其慢化剂和燃料与美国设计大相径庭，据传其碳化物金属（MC）燃料版本在 20 世纪 90 年代初能在高达 3500K 下不发生熔化。添加庚烷（约 1%）以减少氢对碳化物的腐蚀对正常运行至关重要。首次点火测试于 1985 年进行。部分俄罗斯资料显示它具备双模式，不仅能使用液氢，还能使用无添加剂的液态甲烷。在 SNTP 计划期间，美国曾试图从俄罗斯获取 MC 燃料，但采购计划流产。与美国设计相比，该发动机结构非常坚固，并采用四瓣螺旋燃料棒，以消除燃料棒破碎时被喷出的风险。该设计采用短型再生冷却喷管，定位于上面级。设计参数：喷管面积比=46，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=972，反应堆功率=173MW(th)，TWR=1.73，室压=4000kPa，点火次数=10，含一体化屏蔽罩重量：2 吨。在甲烷模式下，喷管长度增加 12cm 并略微扩大。喷管面积比=46，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=467，反应堆功率=173MW(th)，TWR=3.56，室压=4800kPa，点火次数=10，含一体化屏蔽罩重量：2 吨。

src: A Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine. Developed in parallel with the RD-0410, the RD-0411 was a much larger engine, intended for upper stage use on the UR-700 or N-I. Using the same advanced Metal Carbide (MC) fuels and spiral fuel rods as the RD-0410, it achieves good performance for it's size. Unlike the RD-0410, no test articles were ever built, as the failure of the N1 and cancellation of the UR-700 meant there would be no launch vehicle large enough to use it. It never progressed past the study stage, and much of it's performance is speculative.
zh: 一款苏联核热火箭发动机。与 RD-0410 平行开发，RD-0411 尺寸要大得多，原计划用作 UR-700 或 N-I 火箭的上面级。它采用了与 RD-0410 相同的先进碳化物金属（MC）燃料和螺旋燃料棒，在其尺寸规格下实现了优异的性能。与 RD-0410 不同，由于 N1 的失败和 UR-700 的取消意味着不再有足够大的运载火箭来搭载它，因而从未制造过任何测试样机。该项目从未推进到研究阶段之后，其大部分性能数据均为推测值。

src: A staged combustion kerosene and peroxide lander engine, developed for Soviet heavy manned moon landers. Derived from the earlier RD-502 project, the use of hydrogen peroxide with kerosene allowed for a very dense, storable, and non-toxic stage. Although tested extensively, and proposed for various lunar lander designs including the LK-700, it never flew.
zh: 一款分级燃烧煤油/过氧化氢着陆器发动机，专为苏联重型载人登月着陆器开发。衍生自早期的 RD-502 项目，使用过氧化氢与煤油使得级段具有极高的密度、可贮存性与无毒特性。尽管进行了广泛的测试，并被提议用于包括 LK-700 在内的多种月球着陆器设计，但它从未实际飞行过。

src: A Soviet magnetic confinment open cycle gas core nuclear rocket. After a few experiments with solid-core nuclear thermal rockets, Glushko ordered development transferred to other design bureaus due to low performance, and instead focused on gas core nuclear rockets. The RD-600 was a very complex design, containing a conventional solid core reactor for power generation and startup, and powerful electromagnets to contain the gaseous fissile material in the core powered by a 2 MW magnetoplasmadynamic generator on the nozzle. Designed for manned Mars missions, outer planet probes, and worryingly the sustainer stage of superheavy launch vehicles, development was ultimately abandoned due to high costs, difficulty achieving stable containment of a gaseous core, and the lack of launch vehicles of the required scale for such a large engine.
zh: 一款苏联磁约束开式循环气核核火箭。在对固核核热火箭进行了几次试验后，格鲁什科因其性能过低而下令将开发工作移交至其他设计局，转而专注于气核核火箭。RD-600 的设计极其复杂，包含一个用于发电和启动的常规固核反应堆，以及安装在喷管上的 2 MW 磁流体动力发电机供电的强力电磁铁，用以约束堆芯中的气态裂变物质。其设计目标是执行载人火星任务、外行星探测器任务，乃至令人担忧地用作超重型运载火箭的持续级。最终由于成本高昂、难以实现对气态堆芯的稳定约束，以及缺乏相匹配规模的超重型运载火箭，开发工作被彻底放弃。

zh_samples: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: A staged combustion tripropellant liquid fuel engine using kerosene, liquid hydrogen, and liquid oxygen. Originally developed for the MAKS space plane. In the booster phase of the ascent it uses a mixture of kerosene with liquid hydrogen and it switches to pure hydrogen for the sustainer phase.
zh: 一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

zh_samples: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: A staged combustion tripropellant liquid fuel engine using kerosene, liquid hydrogen, and liquid oxygen. This is the single chamber version of the RD-701, originally developed for the MAKS space plane. In the booster phase of the ascent it uses a mixture of kerosene with liquid hydrogen and it switches to pure hydrogen for the sustainer phase.
zh: 一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: A single-chamber derivative of the RD-8 engine used on the Zenit second stage. A Yuzhnoye Design Office concept, featuring dual-axis gimbal control and restart capability for use as a standalone upper stage engine.
zh: Zenit 火箭第二级上使用的 RD-8 发动机的单燃烧室衍生型号。由南方设计局提出的概念，具备双轴万向节控制和多次重启能力，可用作独立的上面级发动机。

src: A pressure-fed upper stage engine developed for the third stage of R-36MUTTKh. This represents 1/4th of an RD-864.
