The RD-864 was able to restart many times and had extremely high gimbal authority and limited throttle, to allow it to dodge American missile defenses while deploying multiple warheads. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-869.
zh: 一款为 R-36MUTTKh 第三级开发的挤压循环上面级发动机。该部件代表 RD-864 的四分之一。RD-864 能够多次重新点火，并拥有极大的万向节控制范围和有限的节流阀调节能力，使其在释放多个分导核弹头的同时躲避美国的反导防御。R-36M2 使用了该发动机的升级版本，即 RD-869。

src: A restartable expander-cycle hydrolox engine used in multiple upper stages, including Centaur, the Saturn I S-IV, and the Delta Cryogenic Second Stage. It has low thrust, but very high ISP and low mass.
zh: 一款可多次点火的膨胀循环液氢液氧发动机，广泛应用于半人马座、土星 1 号 S-IV 级以及德尔塔低温第二级等多种上面级。它的推力较小，但比冲极高且结构质量低。

src: A next generation cryogenic upper stage engine designed to replace the RL10, providing higher performance while maintaining the same installation envelope. Also available in a lower 180kN thrust Vinci-180 model.
zh: 下一代低温上面级发动机，旨在取代 RL10，在保持相同安装包络的同时提供更高的性能。此外还提供推力较低的 180kN 版本 Vinci-180。

src: A reusable expander-cycle vacuum engine. Also known as the Advanced Expander Cycle engine, it was developed as an engine for a high-performance Space Shuttle upper stage. Although the engine was tested, it was canceled after the Challenger disaster.
zh: 一款可重复使用的膨胀循环真空发动机。亦被称为先进膨胀循环发动机，是作为高性能航天飞机上面级的发动机而开发的。尽管该发动机进行了地面测试，但在挑战者号失事后项目被取消。

src: A 1990s atmospheric engine using technology developed for the Space Shuttle SSME, the RS-68 is a single-use engine. It features a simplified design with fewer parts and an easier construction and uses exhaust from the gas generator for roll control. The RS-68 powers the Delta IV launch vehicle family and is the most powerful LH2/LOX engine ever flown.
zh: 一款 1990 年代的大气发动机，采用了为航天飞机 SSME 发动机开发的技术，RS-68 为一次性使用发动机。它简化了设计，零部件更少且制造更简单，利用燃气发生器的排气来实现滚转控制。RS-68 为德尔塔 IV 运载火箭家族提供动力，是人类发射过的推力最大的液氢/液氧发动机。

src: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine. Developed as the booster engine for the liquid fly-back booster, a reusable space shuttle booster system. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款 2000 年代早期的大气分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机。作为液体滑翔返航助推器（一种可重复使用的航天飞机助推器系统）的助推发动机开发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

src: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion hydrolox engine. Developed as the main engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初的大气分级燃烧氢氧发动机。作为“航天发射倡议”计划的一部分，研发用于取代航天飞机的主发动机。性能极高，但在原型阶段被取消。

src: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine. Developed as the booster engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初的大气分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机。作为“航天发射倡议”计划的一部分，研发用于取代航天飞机的助推器发动机。性能极高，但在原型阶段被取消。

src: A high thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine. Initially designed and built as a part of the NASA Bantam System Technology program, aiming for a low cost, high power propulsion system, it was later modified by Lockheed Martin for use as a launch abort engine. A derivative of the RS-88 is used by the Boeing CST-100 "Starliner" spacecraft for launch aborts under the name "Launch Abort Engine - LAE".
zh: 一款大推力挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。最初作为NASA矮脚鸡系统技术（Bantam System Technology）计划的一部分设计和制造，旨在提供低成本、高功率的推进系统，后来由洛克希德·马丁公司改进用作发射逃逸发动机。RS-88的衍生型号被波音CST-100“星际客机”飞船用作发射逃逸系统，命名为“发射逃逸发动机（LAE）”。

src: A four segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor, one of the most powerful rocket motors ever built and flown. Two of them were used by the Space Shuttle for liftoff and the initial part of the flight, providing more than 75% of the overall stack thrust. Manufactured by Thiokol and later by ATK.
zh: 四段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRM），是有史以来制造并飞行的最强大火箭发动机之一。航天飞机使用两台用于起飞和初始爬升段，提供了整个箭体总推力的75%以上。由Thiokol制造，后由ATK制造。

zh_samples: 平滑锥体
空心锥体
五段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRMV）最初作为航天飞机的升级型号进行研究，随后进入战神一号的全面开发阶段。战神计划取消后，该研发转移至SLS。整流锥高6.50662m。

src: The 5-segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor (RSRMV) was first studied as an upgrade for the Space Shuttle, and entered full-scale development for Ares I. Development continued for SLS after the cancellation of Ares. Nose Cone 6.50662m tall.
zh: 五段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRMV）最初作为航天飞机的升级型号进行研究，随后进入战神一号的全面开发阶段。战神计划取消后，该研发转移至SLS。整流锥高6.50662m。

src: The Rutherford engine is the world's first electrically pumped engine. It adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance lithium polymer batteries to drive its pumps. The engine is named after the New Zealand-born physicist Ernest Rutherford.
zh: 卢瑟福（Rutherford）发动机是世界上第一款采用电泵供给的火箭发动机。它采用了全新的动力循环，利用无刷直流电机和高性能锂聚合物电池驱动推进剂泵。该发动机以新西兰出生的物理学家欧内斯特·卢瑟福的名字命名。

src: A pump-fed gas generator hydrolox engine, developed as an upper stage for the Black Knight and Blue Streak. The use of furnace brazing, rather than hand brazing as used in many earlier designs, significantly reduced manufacturing costs. The design was tested, but cancelled in the late 60s due to funding concerns.
zh: 一款泵压式燃气发生器循环氢氧发动机，作为“黑夜”和“蓝光”火箭的上面级研发。采用了炉内钎焊工艺而非以往多种设计中使用的手工钎焊，大幅降低了制造成本。该设计进行了测试，但在60年代末因资金问题被取消。

src: Better known by its western designation, Scud, the S2.253 engine was developed for use in the R-11 Zemlya ballistic missile and sounding rocket. It was originally based on the German Wasserfall engine and later versions were exported extensively to many countries, eventually forming the basis of the Iranian and North Korean space programs.
zh: S2.253发动机更为西方所熟知的名称是“飞毛腿”，专为R-11“大地”弹道导弹和探空火箭研发。它最初基于德国瀑布（Wasserfall）防空火箭的发动机设计，后续型号广泛出口至多个国家，最终构成了伊朗和朝鲜航天计划的基础。

src: A small gas generator vacuum engine, developed as the de-orbit motor for the Vostok spacecraft. It was very reliable, and was also used on the Voskhod and early Zenit spacecraft, before being replaced by a solid rocket motor.
zh: 一款小型燃气发生器循环真空发动机，作为东方号飞船的离轨发动机研发。其工作非常可靠，也被用于上升号和早期的天顶号飞船，后被固体火箭发动机取代。

src: A throttleable rocket engine designed to turn the MiG-21 into a super-high-performance rocket interceptor. It proved successful in tests, but the destruction of the only prototype due to an engine explosion and the increasing performance of jet-powered aircraft led to the project being abandoned.
zh: 一款可节流的火箭发动机，旨在将MiG-21改装为超高性能的火箭截击机。测试证明其性能优异，但由于发动机爆炸导致唯一的原型机损毁，加之喷气动力飞机的性能不断提升，该项目最终被放弃。

src: The "SNTP-PFE" series is a 1000MW reactor. The reactor is a particle bed using metallic carbide coated uranium granules embedded in a graphite rod that hydrogen is passed through. This allows for power densities of up to 40MW/liter. Its core is capable of starting up five times. An integral Tungsten Boron Lithium Hydride composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket has impressive stats for its size (Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=991 Reactor Power=1054MW(th) TWR=13.94 Chamber Pressure=6800kPa Ignitions =5 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:1.504tons ) The nozzle is a fixed ablatively cooled filament wound carbon-carbon design.
zh: “SNTP-PFE”系列是一台1000MW反应堆。该反应堆采用颗粒床设计，将涂覆碳化物的铀颗粒嵌入石墨棒中，氢气流经其中吸收热量，功率密度高达40MW/L。其堆芯具备五次启动能力。配有一体化钨-硼-氢化锂复合辐射屏蔽层，整体总成采用再生冷却。辅助回路可引导关机气体流经一台小型热机，以最大限度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料储罐3至6米处。燃料可用作乘员屏蔽层，发动机运转时乘员位置应距其10至15米。水箱或高密度燃料等附加屏蔽措施可在一定程度上缩短该距离。该火箭在同尺寸下拥有惊人的性能参数（喷管膨胀比Ae=100，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=991，反应堆功率=1054MW(th)，TWR=13.94，燃烧室压力=6800kPa，点火次数=5次，含一体化阴影屏蔽层自重：1.504吨）。喷管为固定式烧蚀冷却缠绕碳-碳复合材料结构。

src: Derived from the Sprite, the Spectre was a rocket motor designed for the SR.53 interceptor, and to replace the Sprite for higher-performance JATO applications. It was tested extensively, both on the SR.53 prototypes and on the Vickers Valiant and Hadley-Page Victor, but improved jet engine performance and cancellation of the SR.53 and the SR.177 follow-on project resulted in the cancellation of the Spectre.
zh: “鬼怪”（Spectre）由“子弹”（Sprite）衍生而来，是专为SR.53截击机设计的火箭发动机，也用作替代“子弹”的高性能起飞助推器（JATO）。它在SR.53原型机以及维克斯“勇士”和汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”轰炸机上进行了广泛测试，但喷气发动机性能的提升以及SR.53和后续SR.177项目的取消导致“鬼怪”最终下马。

src: A small monopropellant rocket motor, intended for JATO use to improve the takeoff performance of various aircraft. Developed directly from german JATO boosters captured during WW2, the Sprite incorporated improvements such as silver gauze catalyst beds, but was still a low-performance motor. The Super Sprite added a kerosene "afterburner" that injected small amounts of kerosene into the combustion chamber to increase performance.
zh: 一款小型单组元推进剂火箭发动机，用作喷气辅助起飞助推器（JATO）以提升各类飞机的起飞性能。“子弹”直接脱胎于二战中缴获的德国JATO助推器，引入了银丝网催化剂床等改进，但性能依然偏低。超级子弹（Super Sprite）增加了一个煤油“加力燃烧室”，向燃烧室中喷入少量煤油以提高性能。

src: The Titan IVB Solid Rocket Motor Upgrade (also known as the Upgraded Solid Rocket Motor or USRM), was developed with the goal of 25% more capacity than the Titan IVA with the UA1207 SRM. It achieved this through a more energetic propellant and a 3-segment composite case that carried more fuel and weighed less than the UA1207's 7-segment steel case. Burn time 150 seconds.
zh: 大力神IVB固体火箭发动机升级版（也称改进型固体火箭发动机，即USRM），研制目标是比采用UA1207 SRM的大力神IVA提升25%的运载能力。通过采用能量更高的推进剂和三段式复合材料壳体实现了这一目标，相比UA1207的七段式钢制壳体装药更多且重量更轻。工作时间150秒。

src: Developed from the RS-25 SSME, the Space Shuttle Booster Engine (SSBE) was a concept for a kerolox fueled Space Shuttle booster. The engine used three fuel-rich preburners, burning a mixture of LH2 and RP-1 to minimize coking. The LH2 was also used to cool the combustion chamber, allowing unmodified SSME components to be used.
zh: 航天飞机助推器发动机（SSBE）由RS-25 SSME衍生而来，是一种使用液氧煤油推进剂的航天飞机助推器构想。该发动机使用三个富燃预燃室，燃烧液氢和RP-1的混合物以最大限度减少结焦。液氢还用于冷却燃烧室，从而可以直接沿用未经修改的SSME部件。

src: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. Though complex and expensive, these engines provide very high performance and are extremely reliable. Three of these engines powered each Shuttle Orbiter and four power the core stage of the SLS.
zh: RS-25，又称航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一款液氢/液氧富燃分级燃烧发动机。尽管结构复杂且造价高昂，这些发动机提供了极高的性能和极佳的可靠性。每架航天飞机轨道器配备三台，SLS核心级配备四台。

src: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. This version uses an extendable nozzle, allowing the SSME to switch from a 50:1 sea level nozzle to a 150:1 vacuum nozzle mid-flight. Intended for SSTO use, where the extending nozzle would allow for the required performance at sea level and vacuum.
zh: RS-25也被称为航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一款富氢分级燃烧液氢/液氧发动机。该版本采用了可伸缩喷管，允许SSME在飞行中从50:1的海平面喷管切换为150:1的真空喷管。专为单级入轨（SSTO）设计，伸缩喷管能够同时满足海平面和真空环境下的性能需求。

src: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. This version has an enormous 650:1 vacuum nozzle and has undergone extensive weight-reduction measures for use on a martian space tug.
zh: RS-25也被称为航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一款富氢分级燃烧液氢/液氧发动机。该版本拥有巨大的650:1真空喷管，并经过了深度的减重处理，专用于火星太空拖船。

src: The STAR 3 motor was developed and qualified in 2003 as the Transverse Impulse Rocket System (TIRS) for the Mars Exploration Rover (MER) program for JPL in Pasadena, CA. Three TIRS motors were carried on each of the MER landers. One of the TIRS motors was fired in January 2004 to provide the impulse necessary to reduce lateral velocity of the MER Spirit lander prior to landing on the Martian surface. The motor also has applicability for spin/despin and separation systems.
zh: STAR 3发动机于2003年研制并通过认证，作为加州帕萨迪纳JPL火星探测漫游者（MER）项目的横向冲量火箭系统（TIRS）。每个MER着陆器均搭载了三台TIRS发动机。2004年1月，其中一台TIRS发动机点火，为MER勇气号着陆器在火星表面着陆前提供了降低横向速度所需的冲量。该发动机还适用于自旋/解旋及分离系统。

zh_samples: 模块化土星发射塔的斜角基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的
模块化土星发射塔的方形基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的
脐带塔兼具发射架和燃油泵的功能。这可以在发射台上等待发射窗口时保持燃料充满。要启动燃料加注，请右键点击该塔。

src: This STAR motor was developed and tested in January 2000 under a NASA Goddard Space Flight Center program for a low-cost, high mass fraction orbit adjust motor for use in deploying constellations of very small satellites (nanosatellites). The first static test of the STAR 4G prototype motor was conducted 8 months after program start. The motor is designed to operate at high chamber pressure and incorporates a noneroding throat insert to maximize specific impulse.
zh: 该STAR发动机于2000年1月在NASA戈达德太空飞行中心的一项计划下研制并测试，旨在作为低成本、高质量比的轨道调整发动机，用于部署超小型卫星（纳米卫星）星座。STAR 4G原型发动机在项目Start后8个月进行了首次静止点火测试。该发动机设计在较高的室压下工作，并采用抗侵蚀喉衬以最大化比冲。

src: The STAR 5C rocket motor was initially designed and produced (1960-1963) under a contract with Martin Marietta. The STAR 5C is used to separate the second stage from the trans-stage on the Titan II missile and Titan launch vehicle. The current version was qualified for use in 1976, replacing the earlier main propellant grain with TP-H-3062.
zh: STAR 5C火箭发动机最初根据与马丁·玛丽埃塔的合同进行设计与生产（1960-1963年）。STAR 5C用于在大力神II型导弹和大力神运载火箭上将二级与过渡级分离。当前版本于1976年通过认证投入使用，将早期的主推进剂药柱替换为TP-H-3062。

src: The STAR 5D rocket motor was designed and qualified to serve as the Rocket-Assisted Deceleration (RAD) motor on the Mars Pathfinder mission. Three of these motors were fired to slow the Pathfinder spacecraft to near-zero velocity before bouncing on the surface of Mars.
zh: STAR 5D火箭发动机经过设计与认证，在火星探路者任务中用作火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机。其中三台发动机点火，使探路者航天器在火星表面弹跳前减速至接近零速度。

src: The STAR 6B rocket motor was developed for spin-up and axial propulsion of re-entry vehicles. The design incorporates an aluminum case and a carbon-phenolic nozzle assembly. The STAR 6B was qualified in 1984 and first flew in 1985.
zh: STAR 6B火箭发动机专为再入飞行器的起旋和轴向推进而研制。其设计采用了铝制外壳和碳-酚醛喷管组件。STAR 6B于1984年通过认证，并于1985年首飞。

src: The STAR 8 was developed and qualified as the Rocket Assisted Deceleration (RAD) motor for the Mars Exploration Rover (MER) program. The motor is based on the STAR 5D motor technology developed for JPL’s Mars Pathfinder program. The STAR 8 first flew in January 2004 when three motors were used to decelerate each of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers for landing at Gusev Crater and Meridiani Planum on Mars.
zh: STAR 8作为火星探测漫游者（MER）项目的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机研制并通过认证。该发动机基于为JPL火星探路者项目研制的STAR 5D发动机技术。STAR 8于2004年1月首飞，当时三台发动机分别用于勇气号和机遇号漫游者在火星古谢夫环形山和子午线高原着陆时的减速。

src: The STAR 9 rocket motor was developed in 1993 on independent research and development funds to demonstrate a number of low-cost motor technologies. These included an integral aft polar boss/exit cone, two-dimensional carbon-carbon throat, and case-on-propellant manufacturing technique.
zh: STAR 9火箭发动机于1993年利用独立研究与开发资金研制，旨在验证多项低成本发动机技术。其中包括一体成型的后极孔封头/出口锥头、二维碳-碳喉衬以及药柱直接浇注外壳工艺。

src: This orbit insertion motor incorporated the lightweight case developed for the STAR 13 with the propellant and nozzle design of the earlier TE-M-516 apogee motor. The motor case was stretched 2.2 inches to provide for increased propellant loading. This motor was used to adjust the inclination of a satellite from a Delta launch.
zh: 这款轨道入轨发动机结合了为STAR 13研制的轻质外壳以及早期TE-M-516远地点发动机的推进剂和喷管设计。发动机外壳加长了2.2英寸，以增加推进剂加注量。该发动机曾用于调整德尔塔运载火箭发射的卫星倾角。

zh_samples: 气泵
严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。
一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

src: Apogee kick motor. Modifications: 175 mm straight section added to the Star 17. The 17A has been used for circularized orbits for the Skynet 1, NATO 1, and IMP-H & J satellites. This motor provides the high case safety factor required for this program. The TE-M-521-7 model used for several Air Force missions provides a typical safety factor with a 1.3 pound weight savings.
zh: 远地点变轨发动机。改进：在STAR 17的基础上增加了175 mm直段。17A已被用于天网1号、北约1号以及IMP-H与J卫星的轨道圆化。该发动机为该项目提供了所需的高外壳安全系数。用于多次空军任务的TE-M-521-7型号则提供标准安全系数并减轻了1.3磅重量。

src: The lightweight external nozzle is a composite of graphite, plastic, and steel. The consumable pyrogen igniter is actuated by two 6-second-delay electrical initiators or two SBASI zero-time-delay initiators.
zh: 轻型外喷管由石墨、塑料和钢的复合材料制成。耗损型点火药点火器由两个6秒延时电引爆器或两个SBASI零延时引爆器触发。

src: The STAR 24C is an improved variant of the STAR 24 solid rocket motor, designed for the International Ultraviolet Explorer mission. Features an increased propellant loading and higher chamber pressure compared to the baseline STAR 24 motor.
zh: STAR 24C是STAR 24固体火箭发动机的改进型号，专为国际紫外线探测器任务设计。与基准型号STAR 24相比，它增加了推进剂加注量并提高了室压。

src: An apogee motor developed for the Canadian Communications Research Centre's Communications Technology Satellite. An offloaded version was qualified and flown successfully. With various propellant loadings and explosive transfer assemblies, it was used for the Broadcast Satellite Experiment, the Geostationary Meteorological Satellite, the Navigation Technology Satellite No. 2, the Global Positioning System Satellites, the P78-1 Satellite, and the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite.
zh: 为加拿大通信研究中心的通信技术卫星研制的远地点发动机。其减载版本已通过认证并成功飞行。通过不同的推进剂加注量和爆炸传输组件，它曾用于广播卫星实验、地球静止气象卫星、2号导航技术卫星、全球定位系统卫星、P78-1卫星和地球静止环境观测卫星。

src: Antares III is the third-generation third stage for Vought Corporation's Scout launch vehicle. The design incorporates an 89-percent-solids HTPB propellant in a Kevlar filament-wound case insulated with silica-filled EPDM rubber.
zh: 心宿二III（Antares III）是沃特公司侦察兵（Scout）运载火箭的第三代第三级。其设计采用了含固量89%的HTPB推进剂，外壳为凯夫拉纤维缠绕结构，并采用填充二氧化硅的EPDM橡胶绝热。

src: The STAR 37E is an improved version of the venerable STAR 37 solid rocket motor, featuring increased propellant loading, higher efficiency, and more vacuum thrust. It was first used on the Delta 1000 launch vehicle family as a third stage kick motor.
zh: STAR 37E是经典的STAR 37固体火箭发动机的改进版本，具有更大的推进剂加注量、更高的效率和更强的真空推力。它最初在德尔塔1000系列运载火箭上用作第三级变轨发动机。

src: The STAR 37FM is an improved version of the venerable STAR 37 solid rocket motor, featuring increased propellant loading, higher efficiency, and more vacuum thrust. It was first used on the FTLSATCOM satellites as an apogee motor.
zh: STAR 37FM是经典的STAR 37固体火箭发动机的改进版本，具有更大的推进剂加注量、更高的效率和更强的真空推力。它最初在FTLSATCOM卫星上用作远地点发动机。

src: Also known as the Payload Assistance Module (PAM) B, this kick motor was used for Delta and STS launches to add extra impulse to the payload. This is the short-nozzle version. Maximum thrust 76.11kN, burn time 85 seconds.
zh: 该变轨发动机亦被称为有效载荷辅助模块（PAM）B，用于德尔塔火箭和航天飞机的发射，为有效载荷提供额外的冲量。此版本为短喷管型号。最大推力76.11 kN，工作时间85秒。

src: The STAR 63, as part of the PAM DII upper stage, has been flown from the Space Shuttle. The motor utilizes a head-end web and a carbon-phenolic nozzle. The case material is a Kevlar-epoxy composite, through future motors would be made using a graphite-epoxy composite. Testing of STAR 63 series motors began in 1978 with completion of the PAM DII motor qualification in 1985. The first STAR 63D flight was from the Shuttle in November 1985 to place a defense communication satellite in orbit.
zh: STAR 63 作为 PAM DII 上面级的一部分，曾随航天飞机发射升空。该发动机采用前端轮辐构型装药和碳-酚醛喷管。外壳材料为凯夫拉-环氧树脂复合材料，不过后来的型号改用了石墨-环氧树脂复合材料。STAR 63 系列发动机的测试始于 1978 年，并于 1985 年完成 PAM DII 发动机认证。STAR 63D 的首次飞行是在 1985 年 11 月通过航天飞机将一颗国防通信卫星送入轨道。

zh_samples: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: Stentor was developed as a two chamber booster-sustainer for the Blue Steel missile, with one chamber providing boost thrust and another smaller chamber providing sustainer thrust. This part represents the larger booster chamber. The smaller chamber was developed into the Gamma series of rocket engines, while the larger chamber was proposed for several projects, but ultimately never developed further.
zh: Stentor 是为“蓝钢”导弹研发的双燃烧室助推-主推发动机，其中一个燃烧室提供助推推力，另一个较小的燃烧室提供主推推力。此部件代表较大的助推燃烧室。较小的燃烧室后来发展为 Gamma 系列火箭发动机，而较大的燃烧室曾被提议用于数个项目，但最终未做进一步发展。

src: The Space Transportation Main Engine was a hydrolox engine, ultimately cancelled in 1992. Rocketdyne was teamed with Aerojet and Pratt & Whitney on the STME, which would have powered the next generation of large launch vehicles.
zh: 空间运输主发动机（STME）是一款液氢液氧发动机，最终于 1992 年取消。Rocketdyne 与 Aerojet 以及 Pratt & Whitney 联合研发 STME，原计划用于驱动下一代大型运载火箭。

src: The Vernier System as used on the Surveyor Probes. It uses storable hypergolic propellants, has infinite restarts, is not subject to ullage, and is throttleable down to 30%. Historically 3 of them were used on the Surveyor probes which landed on the Moon.
zh: 勘测者号探测器上使用的游标系统。它使用可贮存可自燃推进剂，具备无限次重启能力，不受沉底限制，节流阀可低至 30%。历史上曾有 3 台此发动机用于在月球着陆的勘测者号探测器。

src: The Viking lander Terminal Descent Engine (TDE). The lander had three such engines, which were used during the final 45 seconds or so of the descent to the surface of Mars. Multiple small exhaust nozzles are used to diffuse the exhaust plume to eliminate a recirculation zone that could contaminate spacecraft instrumentation and avoid potential extensive erosion of the landing site.
zh: 海盗号着陆器末端下降发动机（TDE）。着陆器装有三台此类发动机，在降落火星表面的最后 45 秒左右使用。采用多个小型排气喷嘴来发散排气羽流，以消除可能污染航天器仪器的回流区，并避免对着陆点造成严重的冲刷侵蚀。

src: A small solid fueled booster originally used to power anti-shipping rockets during WW2. It was used as the kick stage on the WAC Corporal, the USA's first sounding rocket, and reused in a modified form for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 一种小型固体燃料助推器，最初在二战期间用于为反舰火箭提供动力。它曾作为美国首枚探空火箭“女兵小队”（WAC Corporal）的起旋/助推级，并经改进后复用于“秀丽水母”（Aerobee）系列探空火箭。

src: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine developed as the booster engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. High performance with reusability and throttling capabilities, but cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款 2000 年代初的大气层内分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机，作为航天发射计划（SLI）的一部分，旨在为航天飞机的替代型号提供助推动力。具备高比冲、可复用和节流调节能力，但在原型机阶段被取消。

src: The UA1207 was used on the Titan IVA, which was developed to launch payloads that had been designed to fly on the Shuttle from Vandenberg. It was a 7-segment modification of the 5-segment UA1205 used on the Titan 3. Burn time 130 seconds.
zh: UA1207 用于大力神 IVA，该火箭旨在发射原定从范登堡随航天飞机升空的载荷。它是大力神 3 上使用的 5 段式 UA1205 的 7 段式改进版。燃烧时间 130 秒。

src: Developed as a "Super-Veronique", the Vexin is a large pressure-fed booster engine used on the Vesta and "Precious Stones" series of sounding rockets, as well as the Diamante and Europe launch vehicles. One of the largest pressure-fed engines ever flown, this engine is simple but low performance.
zh: 作为“超级韦罗妮克”研制的维辛（Vexin）是一款大型挤压循环助推发动机，曾用于维斯塔和“宝石”系列探空火箭，以及钻石号和欧罗巴号运载火箭。作为曾飞行的最大挤压循环发动机之一，该发动机结构简单但性能较低。

src: Based on the Ad Astra lab test article built to test the configuration to be flown on the ISS, the VASIMR engine is far more powerful than any other ion engine to this point. It will require about 200kW of power.
zh: 基于 Ad Astra 实验室测试件构建，该测试件用于验证拟在 ISS 上飞行的构型。VASIMR 发动机远比迄今为止的任何离子发动机都要强大。它需要约 200kW 的功率。

zh_samples: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: A high thrust hypergolic vacuum engine. Derived from the European Viking engines that were used on the early Ariane launch vehicles for booster or sustainer roles. ISRO adapted them as a vacuum engine for the second stage of the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) and the Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) families.
zh: 一款大推力自燃推进剂真空发动机。衍生自早期阿丽亚娜运载火箭上用于助推级或主推级的欧洲维京（Viking）发动机。ISRO 对其进行了改进，作为极轨卫星运载火箭（PSLV）和地球同步卫星运载火箭（GSLV）家族第二级的真空发动机。

src: A hypergolic booster engine developed for the European Ariane launch vehicle. Used as both a first stage engine and second stage engine when equipped with an extended nozzle. A version was also created for the Ariane 4 strap-on liquid boosters. Unremarkable performance, but good reliability.
zh: 一款为欧洲阿丽亚娜运载火箭研发的可自燃助推器发动机。用作第一级发动机，换装加长喷管后也可用作第二级发动机。还开发了用于阿丽亚娜 4 捆绑式液体助推器的版本。性能平平，但可靠性良好。

src: Operational Viking variants with bell nozzles, used on the first stage of Ariane 1-4, and on the Ariane 4 strap-on liquid boosters. The Viking is a hypergolic booster engine developed for Ariane and used as both a first and second stage engine (when equipped with an extended nozzle). Unremarkable performance, but good reliability.
zh: 配有钟形喷管的维京（Viking）实用改型，用于阿丽亚娜 1-4 的第一级以及阿丽亚娜 4 捆绑式液体助推器。维京发动机是为阿丽亚娜研发的可自燃助推发动机，可用作第一级和第二级发动机（配备加长喷管时）。性能平平，但可靠性良好。

src: Developed to power the Wasserfall anti-aircraft missile, the Wasserfall Booster was essentially a 1/4 scale A-4. Designed to be cheap and able to launch on short notice, it used a simple pressure-fed feed system and was powered by explosives-grade nitric acid and liqufied coal. Although the rocket worked well, difficulty in developing a guidance system that could accurately engage aircraft proved impossible with the technology available. Post-war, it was tested by both American and Soviet engineers. Soviet engineers developed improved versions for the R-101, but were also unable to develop a practical guidance system for anti-aircraft use, and instead converted it into a ballistic missile, creating the R-11 (Scud).
zh: 瀑布防空导弹的动力系统，瀑布助推器本质上是 1/4 缩比的 A-4。旨在廉价且能迅速发射，它采用简单的挤压式增压系统，并由炸药级硝酸与液化煤浆驱动。虽然火箭运行良好，但在当时的技术水平下，研发能精确拦截飞机的制导系统被证明是不可能的。战后，美国和苏联工程师都对其进行了测试。苏联工程师为 R-101 开发了改进版本，但同样无法研制出实用的防空制导系统，转而将其改装为弹道导弹，造就了 R-11（飞毛腿）。

src: This 3-channel thruster was designed for operation up to 250 kW of discharge power at specific impulses ranging from 1800–3500 seconds on xenon propellant and up to 5000 seconds on krypton, all with state of the art total efficiencies in excess of 60%.
zh: 这款 3 通道推力器设计放电功率高达 250 kW，使用氙推进剂时比冲为 1800–3500 秒，使用氪推进剂时最高可达 5000 秒，且最高总效率均超过 60%。

zh_samples: CST-100“星际客机”商业乘员运输系统（COTS）的指令舱。设计最多可重复使用10次。
NASA 对接系统（NDS）是用于美国载人航天器的航天器对接与停泊机构，例如猎户座多功能载人飞船和商业载人航天器。
高分辨率胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄行星照片。这台相机提供极高分辨率的照片，且底片需要回收至地球。历史上，这些相机曾以KH-9“六边形”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，但对于RP-1而言，它们代表了商业公司的第一批高分辨率卫星相机。

src: Xenon Ion Propulsion System, 25 cm. A small gridded ion thruster developed by L-3 technologies to act as a stationkeeping thruster for commercial satellites. Currently used on the Boeing 601 and 702 satellite busses. Mass/power ratio: 3.56 kg/kW.
zh: 氙离子推进系统（Ion Propulsion System），25 cm。由 L-3 技术研发的小型栅极离子推力器，用于商用卫星的位置保持。目前用于波音 601 和 702 卫星平台。质功比：3.56 kg/kW。

src: The Reaction Motors XLR10 was an early rocket developed to power the Viking sounding rocket. Intended to replace the V-2, the Viking sounding rocket was successful, but ultimately cancelled due to high costs. It was revived to create the first stage of the Vanguard launch vehicle, with the XLR10 modified to create the XLR50 (X-405).
zh: Reaction Motors 的 XLR10 是一款早期的火箭，专为维京探空火箭提供动力而开发。原定用于取代 V-2，维京探空火箭虽然取得成功，但最终因成本高昂而取消。后来被重新启用以制造先锋号运载火箭的第一级，其中 XLR10 经过改进衍生出了 XLR50（X-405）。

src: The Reaction Motors XLR11 (internal designation 6000C-4) was a small rocket motor designed to power experimental high-speed aircraft, including the X-1, early X-15s, X-24B, and D-558-2. Its four combustion chambers were ignited independently, which is represented as the ability to throttle in discrete steps.
zh: Reaction Motors XLR11（内部代号 6000C-4）是一款小型火箭发动机，旨在为实验性高速飞机提供动力，包括 X-1、早期 X-15s、X-24B 以及 D-558-2。它的四个燃烧室可独立点火，在游戏中表现为分挡位调节节流阀。接

src: The Allison/General Electric J35 is an axial flow turbojet, and one of the first turbojets natively designed in the United States. Although not as well known as its later derivative, the J47, it still powered many late 40s aircraft such as the FJ-1, F-84, F-89, XP-86, XB-45, XB-47, X-5, and D-558.
zh: 艾里逊/通用电气 J35 是一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机，也是美国本土最早自主设计的涡喷发动机之一。尽管其知名度不如后来的衍生型号 J47，但它仍为 40 年代末的许多飞机提供了动力，例如 FJ-1、F-84、F-89、XP-86、XB-45、XB-47、X-5 和 D-558。

src: The XLR25 was designed for the X-2, to test higher speeds and altitudes than the X-1. It was the first continuously throttleable engine designed in the US. Although the engine was successful, the X-2 proved extremely unstable at high speeds and only a few flights were undertaken.
zh: XLR25专为X-2设计，旨在测试比X-1更高的速度与高度。它是美国设计的第一款可连续调节节流阀的发动机。尽管该发动机取得了成功，但X-2在高速下表现得极不稳定，仅进行了少量试飞。

src: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator booster engine. Derived from the Isayev S2.1100 Burya booster engine, four YF-1 engines form the YF-2 booster used on the first stage of the DF-3, DF-4, and Long March 1 rockets.
zh: 一款中国自研的自燃推进剂燃气发生器助推器发动机。源自伊萨耶夫S2.1100“风暴”助推器发动机，四台YF-1发动机构成了用于DF-3、DF-4和长征一号运载火箭第一级的YF-2助推器。

src: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator booster engine. Four YF-20 engines form the YF-21 booster used on the first stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets, as well as the strap-on boosters for the Long March 2/3.
zh: 一款中国自研的自燃推进剂燃气发生器助推器发动机。四台YF-20发动机构成了用于DF-5、FB-1和长征二号/三号/四号运载火箭第一级，以及长征二号/三号捆绑助推器的YF-21助推器。

src: A Chinese hydrolox gas generator vacuum engine, created to replace the YF-73. Used on the third stage of the Long March 3A/B/C. It was converted to expander cycle to create the YF-75D, which is used on the second stage of Long March 5.
zh: 一款中国自研的氢氧燃气发生器真空发动机，旨在替代YF-73。用于长征三号甲/乙/丙的第三级。后改进为膨胀循环模式衍生出YF-75D，用于长征五号的第二级。

src: A Chinese kerolox staged combustion booster engine. Based on the RD-120, it is the first staged combustion engine developed in China, and is used on the boosters of the Long March 5, as well as the boosters and first stage of the Long March 6, 7, and 8.
zh: 一款中国自研的液氧煤油分级燃烧助推器发动机。基于RD-120开发，是中国研制的第一款分级燃烧发动机，用于长征五号的助推器，以及长征六号、七号和八号的助推器与第一级。

zh_samples: 气泵
严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。
一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

src: An early 1960s nuclear turbo-ramjet, designed for supersonic bombers. One of the ultimate direct-cycle designs produced by the Aircraft Nuclear Propulsion (ANP) program, the A-136 used a hybrid cycle to improve supersonic performance. By tapping off a small amount of air to cool the turbine, turbine inlet temperatures could be managed, while the remaining air passed straight through the reactor and was heated to full temperature. This gave the engine good performance up to Mach 3. It also included a kerosene burner to improve takeoff thrust.
zh: 一款20世纪60年代初的核涡轮冲压发动机，专为超音速轰炸机设计。作为飞机核动力推进（ANP）计划产出的终极直接循环设计之一，A-136采用混合循环以提升超音速性能。通过引出一小部分空气冷却涡轮以控制涡轮前温度，其余空气则直接穿过反应堆并被加热至最高温度。这使得该发动机在高达3马赫时仍具有良好性能。它还包含一个煤油燃烧室以提高起飞推力。

src: The AL-31 is a early 1980s low-bypass turbofan, designed to power the Su-27. Despite difficult development, resulting in early Su-27s being equipped with the AL-21 engine, it ultimately proved successful, powering the Su-27, Su-30, Su-34, Su-35, Su-57, J-10 and J-11. Later models were also equipped with thrust vectoring capability. Modernized AL-31s were designated AL-41F-1, not to be confused with the AL-41, an unrelated design from the late 1980s.
zh: AL-31是一款20世纪80年代初的小涵道比涡扇发动机，设计用于为Su-27提供动力。尽管研制过程困难重重，导致早期的Su-27s不得不装备AL-21发动机，但它最终获得了成功，为Su-27、Su-30、Su-34, Su-35、Su-57、J-10和J-11提供动力。后期型号还具备推力矢量能力。现代化改型AL-31s被命名为AL-41F-1，切勿与20世纪80年代末毫无关联的设计AL-41混淆。

src: The Atar 08/09 was a late-1950s redesign of the Atar 101, increasing thrust (creating the Atar 08) and adding an afterburner (creating the Atar 09). The Atar 09 powered the next generation of French jet aircraft, including the Cheetah C/D/E/R, Mirage III/IV, and Mirage F1.
zh: 阿塔（Atar）08/09是20世纪50年代末对阿塔101的重新设计版本，提高了推力（诞生了阿塔08）并增加了加力燃烧室（诞生了阿塔09）。阿塔09为下一代法国喷气式飞机提供了动力，包括猎豹C/D/E/R、幻影III/IV和幻影F1。

src: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant.
zh: 埃文（Avon）是罗尔斯·罗伊斯第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机，于1950年推出。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括海雌狐、堪培拉、闪电、猎人、雨燕和勇士。

src: The CF6 high-bypass turbofan was developed from the TF39, the first ever production high-bypass turbofan. It powered many large aircraft, including the A300, A310, A330, B747, B767, DC-10, KC-10, MD-11, E-4, C-2, and C-5M.
zh: CF6大涵道比涡扇发动机由史上第一款量产型大涵道比涡扇发动机TF39发展而来。它为许多大型飞机提供了动力，包括A300、A310、A330、B747、B767、DC-10、KC-10、MD-11、E-4、C-2和C-5M。

src: The TF34 is a 1970s high-bypass turbofan. It powered the S-3, S-72, and A-10, while its civilian derivative, the CF34, powered many large private jets and regional airliners such as the Challenger 600 Series, Challenger 850, CRJ100/200/440/700/900, and the Embraer 170/175/190/195.
zh: TF34是一款20世纪70年代的大涵道比涡扇发动机。它为S-3、S-72和A-10提供动力，而其民用衍生型号CF34则为许多大型私人飞机和支线客机提供动力，例如挑战者600系列、挑战者850、CRJ100/200/440/700/900以及巴航工业170/175/190/195。

src: The CFM56 is a 1970s high-bypass turbofan, developed from the F101. Created in a collaboration between GE and Snecma, the CFM56 is the most successful high-bypass turbofan ever made, with over 30,000 built. It powered the Airbus A320 and A340 series, B737 Classic and Next Gen series, DC-8-70, and was used to re-engine many 707-based aircraft such as the E-3, E-6, and KC/RC-135.
zh: CFM56是一款20世纪70年代的大涵道比涡扇发动机，由F101发展而来。由通用电气（GE）和斯奈克玛（Snecma）合作研发，CFM56是史上最成功的大涵道比涡扇发动机，产量超过30,000台。它为空中客车A320和A340系列、B737经典型和新一代系列、DC-8-70提供动力，并用于为许多基于707的飞机更换发动机，如E-3、E-6以及KC/RC-135。

src: The D-30 is one of the first turbofan engines developed in the Soviet Union, and the most successful. While originally developed to power the Tu-134 airliner, it found its way into many Soviet aircraft, including the Tu-154, Il-62, Il-76, M-55, and with afterburner, MiG-31 and Su-47.
zh: D-30是苏联研制的最早也是最成功的涡扇发动机之一。虽然最初是为Tu-134客机研制的，但它随后被广泛应用于许多苏联飞机，包括Tu-154、Il-62、Il-76、M-55，以及带加力燃烧室的MiG-31和Su-47。

src: The Derwent was a development of the W.2 / Welland engine with "straight through flow" rather than "reverse flow," leading to an increase in thrust and efficiency. It was a short-lived line of engines, ending with World War II; indeed, the Derwent V was in fact a scaled-down Nene. Powered the Meteor F.3/F.4/NF.12/NF.14, Nord 1601, Sagittario II, and Yak-23/25/30 and La-15 as the license-built RD-500.
zh: 德温特（Derwent）是W.2 / 韦兰（Welland）发动机的发展型，采用“直流式”而非“反流式”燃烧室，从而提高了推力和效率。这是一个寿命短暂的发动机系列，随着二战结束而终结；事实上，德温特V实际上是缩小版的尼恩（Nene）。曾为流星F.3/F.4/NF.12/NF.14、诺德1601、人马座II，以及作为授权生产型号RD-500的Yak-23/25/30和La-15提供动力。

src: The F100 is a 1970s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F-15 and F-16. Its advanced design and high power allowed the F-15 and F-16 to achieve a thrust to weight ratio greater than one. It was used in all F-15 and most F-16 variants.
zh: F100是一款20世纪70年代专为F-15和F-16设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。其先进的设计和强大的动力使F-15和F-16的推重比突破了1。它被应用于所有F-15和绝大多数F-16改型。

src: The F119 is a 1990s low-bypass turbofan designed for the Advance Tactical Fighter program. Designed for supercruise capability, it has unusually high dry thrust for its size, and it has a 2D thrust-vectoring nozzle for increased maneuverability. It was used in the F-22, YF-23, X-32 and X-35.
zh: F119是一款20世纪90年代专为先进战术战斗机（ATF）计划设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。旨在实现超音速巡航能力，就其尺寸而言具有极高的无加力推力，并配有二维推力矢量喷管以增强机动性。它被用于F-22、YF-23、X-32和X-35。

src: The F135 is a 2000s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F-35. Two variants exist, with a conventional nozzle for the F-35A/C, and one with a forward PTO shaft and gimbaled nozzle for the VTOL-capable F-35B.
zh: F135是一款21世纪初专为F-35设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。存在两种改型：一种是用于F-35A/C的常规喷管型号，另一种是带有前进动力输出（PTO）轴和万向节喷管的型号，专为具备VTOL能力的F-35B设计。

src: The F404 is a 1970s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F/A-18. It was designed for reliability rather than performance, in order to replace the notoriously unreliable F-4s and F-14s used by the US Navy and Marines at the time. It was used in the F/A-18A/B/C/D, F-20A, F-117A, T-7A, T-50, JAS-39, and Tejas.
zh: F404是一款20世纪70年代专为F/A-18设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。它的设计侧重于可靠性而非极限性能，以替换当时美国海军和海军陆战队使用的臭名昭著、故障频发的F-4s和F-14s。它被用于F/A-18A/B/C/D、F-20A、F-117A、T-7A、T-50、JAS-39以及光辉战斗机。

src: The GE4 was a 1970s turbojet developed to power the Boeing 2707 supersonic transport at speeds up to Mach 2.7. The most powerful turbojet ever made, the GE4 was tested extensively, but ultimately cancelled with the rest of the 2707 project.
zh: GE4是一款20世纪70年代研制的涡轮喷气发动机，旨在为波音2707超音速客机提供动力，使其速度高达2.7马赫。作为史上推力最强劲的涡轮喷气发动机，GE4进行了大量测试，但最终随2707项目的终止而下马。

src: The J48 was also known as the Rolls-Royce Tay. Essentially an enlarged Nene, it was abandoned by Rolls-Royce in favor of the Avon. However, Pratt & Whitney was able to acquire the design, and produced it as the J48. It was used in the F9F-5 Panther, F9F-6/8 Cougar, F-94C Starfire, and YF-93.
zh: J48也被称为劳斯莱斯泰伊（Rolls-Royce Tay）。它本质上是尼恩（Nene）的放大版，后来被劳斯莱斯放弃以优先发展埃文（Avon）。然而，普惠公司获得了该设计并将其生产为J48。它曾用于F9F-5“黑豹”、F9F-6/8“美洲狮”、F-94C“星火”以及YF-93。

src: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37.
zh: J85最初被开发为一种小型一次性喷气发动机，用于为诱饵和无人机提供动力，但后来升级为载人飞机所用。它为许多小型飞机提供了动力，包括F-5、CF-5、G.91Y、T-2、T-38和A-37。

src: Derived from the J52, the JT8D was an early low-bypass turbofan, used on many second-generation jetliners like the Boeing 727, 737, and DC-9. It received a substantial redesign in the 1970s, creating the JT8D-200 series, which powered the Super 27, MD-80 series, and was used to upgrade many 707-based aircraft like the E-8C.
zh: 衍生自J52的JT8D是一种早期的低涵道比涡扇发动机，曾用于波音727、737和DC-9等许多第二代喷气客机。它在20世纪70年代进行了大幅重新设计，衍生出JT8D-200系列，为超级27、MD-80系列提供动力，并用于升级诸如E-8C等多款基于707改进的飞机。

src: A late 50s turbojet based on the Pratt & Whitney J57, the Model 304-2 was a liquid-hydrogen-fueled turbojet, designed for project SUNTAN, a high-performance replacement for the U-2 spyplane. The project required the development of large-scale liquid hydrogen production and handling techniques, at the cost of hundreds of millions of dollars. Various jet engines were converted to hydrogen power, where they showed incredible stability and efficiency. This information, along with many of the engineers involved, were later transferred to working on the RL-10 where the information gained proved invaluable. The Model 304 and project SUNTAN, however, were ultimately cancelled, as the conventionally-fueled A-12/SR-71 was showing much greater promise.
zh: Model 304-2是一款基于普惠J57的50年代末涡轮喷气发动机，以液氢为燃料，专为“日晒”（SUNTAN）项目设计，旨在作为U-2侦察机的高性能替代方案。该项目耗资数亿美元，开发了大规模液氢生产和处理技术。多种喷气发动机被改装为氢动力，表现出惊人的稳定性和效率。这些技术资料以及许多参与项目的工程师后来转入RL-10的研发工作中，所积累的经验证明具有不可估量的价值。然而，Model 304和SUNTAN项目最终被取消，因为采用常规燃料的A-12/SR-71展现出了更光明的前景。

src: The NK-8 was a 1960s low-bypass turbofan, created to power the Il-62 and Tu-154. It was later modified for improved performance to power the Il-86, and modified to run on alternate fuels for the Tu-155 project. It powered the A-90, Il-62, Il-62M, Tu-154, Tu-154A/B and Tu-155.
zh: NK-8是一款20世纪60年代的低涵道比涡扇发动机，最初设计用于为Il-62和Tu-154提供动力。后来为了提升性能而进行改进以适配Il-86，并为Tu-155项目改造为可使用替代燃料的版本。它为A-90、Il-62、Il-62M、Tu-154、Tu-154A/B和Tu-155提供了动力。

src: The NK-144 was a 1960s low-bypass turbofan developed from the NK-8 to power the Tu-144 supersonic transport. The NK-144 was unable to meet performance requirements and was replaced by the RD-36, but found new life as the NK-22, which powered the Tu-22M0/M1/M2.
zh: NK-144是一款20世纪60年代的低涵道比涡扇发动机，基于NK-8改进而来，旨在为Tu-144超音速客机提供动力。NK-144无法达到性能要求，最终被RD-36取代，但随后重获新生改名为NK-22，为Tu-22M0/M1/M2提供了动力。

src: The Nord 1500 ramjet was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to an Atar 101E. Used on the Griffon II experimental aircraft, the Atar 101 would accelerate the aircraft up to the speed of sound, at which point the ramjet could act as a thrust augmentor and accelerate aircraft up to speeds over Mach 2. Although the Griffon II performed well, it was cancelled in favor of more conventional aircraft.
zh: 诺德（Nord）1500冲压发动机是一款组合循环冲压发动机，与阿塔（Atar）101E配套使用。它用于“格里芬II”（Griffon II）实验机，Atar 101可将飞机加速至音速，此时冲压发动机充当推力助推器，进一步将飞机加速至2马赫以上。尽管Griffon II表现出色，但最终仍被取消以优先发展更常规的机型。

src: A late 1960s turbojet. The ultimate version of the Olympus turbojet, designed for sustained Mach 2 operation to power Concorde. Although thirsty at sea level, when mated to a well-optimized intake this engine can supercruise at Mach 2, achieving relatively good efficiency.
zh: 一款20世纪60年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。这是奥林匹斯（Olympus）涡喷发动机的终极型号，专为协和客机在2马赫下持续巡航而设计。尽管它在海平面油耗极高，但与经过良好优化的进气道配合时，该发动机能以2马赫超音速巡航，并实现相对出色的效率。

zh_samples: 气泵
严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。
一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

src: An early 1960s small turboprop. Developed for midsize general aviation aircraft, the PT6A was first used on the Beechcraft King Air. It's low cost, low weight, and high reliability led to it becoming one of the most popular turboprop engines ever, with over 60,000 built. It is offered in many large general aviation and small commercial aircraft, and is popular as an upgrade to older piston-engined aircraft.
zh: 一款20世纪60年代初期的小型涡轮螺旋桨发动机。PT6A专为中型通用航空飞机开发，最早用于比奇“空中国王”（King Air）。其低成本、轻重量和高可靠性使其成为有史以来最受欢迎的涡桨发动机之一，产量超过60000台。它广泛应用于大型通用航空和小型商业飞机，也是旧款活塞发动机飞机热门的升级换发选择。

src: A late 50s turbojet, the R-11 was developed in parallel with the less sophisticated RD-9. It became the powerplant for the MiG-21, Yak-28 and Su-15. It was reverse-engineered in China and built as the WP-7, where it powered the JJ-7, J/F-7, and J-8.
zh: 一款50年代末的涡轮喷气发动机，R-11与结构相对简易的RD-9并行研发。它成为了MiG-21、Yak-28和Su-15的动力装置。该发动机在中国被逆向工程研制并命名为WP-7，用于为JJ-7、J/F-7以及J-8提供动力。

src: A late 60s turbojet, the R-13 was developed from the earlier R-11 to improve the performance of the MiG-21. It became the powerplant for late model MiG-21s and Su-15s. It was reverse-engineered in China and built as the WP-13, where it powered the J-7III onwards and J-8II.
zh: 一款60年代末的涡轮喷气发动机，R-13在早期的R-11基础上开发而成，旨在提高MiG-21的性能。它成为了后期型MiG-21s和Su-15s的动力装置。该发动机在中国被逆向工程研制并命名为WP-13，用于为J-7III及后续型号和J-8II提供动力。

src: A late 50s turbojet originally developed for the Tu-121 cruise missile, the R-15 was modified instead for use on the MiG-25, which became the fastest serially produced fighter, capable of reaching Mach 3.2, although at the risk of severe engine damage.
zh: 一款50年代末的涡轮喷气发动机，最初专为Tu-121巡航导弹研制。R-15随后被改装用于MiG-25，使其成为飞行速度最快的量产战斗机，能够达到3.2马赫，但代价是面临严重的发动机损坏风险。

src: A 1980s afterburning turbofan, designed for the Yak-41. It was equipped with an engine gimbal system that allowed the nozzle to rotate 95 degrees, to support vertical flight, and was the first engine of this type equipped with an afterburner, allowing the Yak-41 to achieve supersonic flight. It powered the Yak-141/41, and was proposed to power the Su-47 with the thrust vectoring system removed.
zh: 一款20世纪80年代的带加力涡扇发动机，专为Yak-41设计。它配备了发动机万向节系统，喷管可旋转95度以支持垂直飞行，并且是第一款配备加力燃烧室的此类发动机，使Yak-41能够实现超音速飞行。它为Yak-141/41提供动力，并曾被提议在移除推力矢量系统后用于Su-47。

zh_samples: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升FJ-4/F-86的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动NF-104A宇航员训练机。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。
一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 RD-701 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

src: The RB.162 was a lightweight turbojet, designed to be used as a liftjet for VTOL aircraft. It utilized fiberglass and plastic extensively in it's construction to reduce weight as much as possible, resulting in a low lifetime but very high thrust-to-weight ratio. It was used as a liftjet on the Do-31, Mirage IIIV, and VAK 191B, and as a booster engine on the Trident 3B to improve takeoff performance.
zh: RB.162是一款轻型涡轮喷气发动机，设计用作垂直起降（VTOL）飞机的升力发动机。其结构大量采用玻璃纤维和塑料以最大程度减轻重量，这导致了较短的使用寿命，但换来了极高的推重比。它曾作为升力发动机用于Do-31、幻影IIIV和VAK 191B，并作为三叉戟3B上的助推发动机以改善起飞性能。

src: An early 50s turbojet. Developed as a scaled down Mikulin AM-3, the RD-9 was designed for fighter aircraft and powered the Yak-25, 26, 27, 28, and MiG-19. It was license-built in China as the WP-6, where it powered the JJ-6, J/F-6, Q/A-5, and J-12.
zh: 一款50年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。作为米库林AM-3的缩小版，RD-9专为战斗机设计，为Yak-25、26、27、28以及MiG-19提供动力。它在中国获得许可生产为WP-6，为JJ-6、J/F-6、Q/A-5和J-12提供动力。

src: The RD-36 was a 1970s turbojet, developed to power the Tu-144. The RD-36 replaced the underperforming NK-144 engines, allowing the Tu-144 to achieve its intended range. Ultimately, the Tu-144 was taken out of service shortly after being upgraded due to costs. The RD-36 powered the Tu-144D and M-17.
zh: RD-36是一款20世纪70年代的涡轮喷气发动机，专为Tu-144提供动力而研制。RD-36取代了性能欠佳的NK-144发动机，使Tu-144能够达到预期的航程。最终，出于成本原因，Tu-144在完成升级后不久便退役。RD-36曾用于Tu-144D和M-17。

src: The RD-41 was a lightweight turbojet, designed as an improved version of the RD-36 liftjet for the Yak-141/41M. It was provided with a gimballing engine mount, allowing for 12.5 degrees of deflection to improve stability while hovering. Used as the liftjet on the Yak-141/41M.
zh: RD-41是一款轻型涡轮喷气发动机，是为Yak-141/41M设计的RD-36升力发动机的改进版本。它配备了可偏转12.5度的万向节发动机架，以提高悬停时的稳定性。曾用作Yak-141/41M的升力发动机。
