一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

src: The RJ43 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the CIM-10 Bomarc surface to air missile at speeds up to Mach 3. It was also used on the X-7 and XQ-5/AQM-60 target drone, and was modified to power the D-21 up to speeds over Mach 3.3.
zh: RJ43是一款超音速冲压喷气发动机，设计用于为CIM-10“波马克”地对空导弹提供动力，最高速度可达3马赫。它还曾用于X-7和XQ-5/AQM-60靶机，并经过改装为D-21提供动力，使其速度超过3.3马赫。

src: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These early balloon tanks were first used by Atlas and the Centaur C upper stage.
zh: 气球贮箱没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持形状。如果失去增压，气球贮箱就会坍缩。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，具有非常优秀的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价相当昂贵。这些早期的气球贮箱最初用于宇宙神以及半人马座 C 上面级。

src: The unparalleled low density and high strength of carbon composites have long been the siren call of tank design. Ever since the X-33 and Venture Star program of the 1990s was aborted only a few years years before the leaking problems that had killed Venture Star were solved, space companies have been trying to justify the very high cost of composite materials. Although costs continue to drop, the intensive manufacturing process is still very expensive, requiring the wrapping and weaving of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber with resins that are then baked off in massive autoclaves. Currently, the only rocket to use composite materials is the smallsat Electron orbital launcher developed by Rocket Lab.
zh: 碳复合材料无可比拟的低密度与高强度，长期以来一直是储罐设计的诱人目标。自20世纪90年代的X-33与“冒险之星”计划被叫停（而在取消仅数年后，导致其夭折的泄漏难题便被攻克）以来，航天企业一直在设法证明高昂复合材料成本的合理性。尽管成本在持续下降，但其密集制造工艺仍然代价不菲——需要将数百层碳纤维与树脂缠绕编织，随后在巨大的高压釜中固化。目前，唯一使用复合材料的火箭是Rocket Lab研制的小卫星轨道运载火箭“电子号”。

src: Advanced carbon composite tankage, more resistant to cryogenic temperatures, and built using cutting edge construction techniques to maximize strength. Although small technology demonstrators have been made, no launch vehicle has utilized this style of advanced composite tankage.
zh: 先进碳复合材料储罐，具备更优异的耐低温性能，采用尖端制造工艺以实现强度最大化。尽管已有小型技术验证件制成，但尚无运载火箭实际采用此类先进复合材料储罐。

src: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These advanced balloon tanks were first used by the Centaur G upper stage.
zh: 气球储罐没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持构型。若增压失效，气球储罐就会瘪瘪垮塌。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有出色的质量分数，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价高昂。此类先进气球储罐最早应用于半人马座G上面级。

src: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These modern balloon tanks were first used by Centaur III.
zh: 气球储罐没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持构型。若增压失效，气球储罐就会瘪瘪垮塌。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有出色的质量分数，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价高昂。此类现代气球储罐最早应用于半人马座III。

src: You can now use Aluminum Fuselage tanks. Aluminum tank and fuselage construction was first used on the American Viking sounding rocket and then, perplexingly, on the massive Soviet N-1 lunar rocket. These are 40% (standard) or 20% (HP) lighter than steel tanks while costing 5% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝制机身储罐。铝制储罐与机身构型最早应用于美国“维京”探空火箭，随后令人费解地用于庞大的苏联N-1登月火箭。这类储罐比钢制储罐轻40%（标准型）或20%（高压型），模具成本高5%，投产后制造成本高10%。

src: You can now use Aluminum Stringer tanks. Longitudinal stringers transfer the aerodynamic loads from the skin to the frame, similar to aircraft design. This combines tank and frame, but the skin of the tank is only responsible for containing the propellant and is not structural. The first rocket of this type of construction was the R-5 and skin-stringer-frame construction has remained a staple of Russian design philosophy, including the R-7 and Proton families. These are 35% (standard) or 20% (HP) lighter than Al fuselage tanks while costing 25% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝制桁条储罐。纵向桁条将气动载荷从蒙皮传递至框架，类似于飞机设计。这种结构将储罐与框架融为一体，但储罐蒙皮仅用于容纳推进剂，不承受结构载荷。首枚采用此类结构的火箭是R-5，蒙皮-桁条-框架结构随后一直是俄系设计理念的支柱，包括R-7与“质子”家族。这类储罐比铝制机身储罐轻35%（标准型）或20%（高压型），模具成本高25%，投产后制造成本高10%。

src: You can now use Aluminum-Copper Alloy Stringer tanks. Also known as "Duraluminum", this family of alloys is very strong and as workable as regular aluminum. The most famous use of this construction was in the titanic and powerful S-IC, the first stage of the Saturn V lunar rocket, but it was also used in the early versions of the Shuttle External Tank. These are 25% lighter than Al stringer tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝铜合金桁条储罐。该合金系列也被称为“硬铝”，强度极高且具备与常规铝相当的可加工性。该结构最著名的应用是土星五号登月火箭体量庞大且推力强劲的S-IC第一级，早期版本的航天飞机外贮箱也有采用。这类储罐比铝制桁条储罐轻25%，模具成本高20%，投产后制造成本高10%。

src: You can now use Aluminum-Lithium Alloy Stringer tanks. Since lithium is the least dense metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while still being very strong. However, they are more expensive and can be hard to work with. This technology was used for the final version of the Shuttle External Tank, the Super Lightweight Tank. These are 25% (standard) or 45% (HP) lighter than refined Al stringer tanks while costing 25% more to tool and once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝锂合金桁条储罐。由于锂是密度最低的金属，铝锂合金在保持极高强度的同时密度显著降低。然而，该材料造价更高且加工难度较大。这项技术曾用于航天飞机外贮箱的最终版本——超轻型外贮箱（SLWT）。这类储罐比精炼铝桁条储罐轻25%（标准型）或45%（高压型），模具成本与投产后制造成本均高25%。

src: You can now use stir-welded Aluminum-Lithium Alloy Stringer tanks. Friction stir welding uses heat from the friction of rotating tool to soften and intermix two pieces of metal for very strong welds. A completely stir-welded tank was first used on the Falcon 1e and then on Falcon 9. This allows for fewer structural components and lighter welds, thus, cheaper and lighter tanks, especially at high pressures. These are 6% (standard) or 15% (HP) lighter than Al-Li stringer tanks while costing 20% less to tool and 15% less once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用搅拌摩擦焊铝锂合金桁条储罐。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具的摩擦热软化并熔合两块金属，形成极高强度的焊缝。全搅拌摩擦焊储罐最早应用于猎鹰1e，随后用于猎鹰9号。该工艺减少了结构部件并降低了焊缝重量，从而让储罐更便宜、更轻盈（尤其在高压工况下）。这类储罐比铝锂合金桁条储罐轻6%（标准型）或15%（高压型），模具成本低20%，投产后制造成本低15%。

src: You can now use stir-welded Steel Alloy Stringer tanks. This is the all-new 1950's technology that will be used by SpaceX's Starship vehicle & Superheavy booster. These are 24% (standard) or 70% (HP) heavier than refined Al-Li stringer tanks while costing 20% less to tool and once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用搅拌摩擦焊合金钢桁条储罐。这项“源自20世纪50年代的全新技术”将被SpaceX的星舰飞船与超重型助推器所采用。这类储罐比精炼铝锂合金桁条储罐重24%（标准型）或70%（高压型），模具成本与投产后制造成本均低20%。

src: You can now use Aluminum gridded tanks. Isogrids and orthogrids are advanced hollowed-out structures milled out of a single block of material that have very high rigidity yet exceptional material and mass savings. The delicate & complex lattices on the panel require very high precision machining and thus such a construction is much more expensive to produce than more standard tanks. Nevertheless, gridded tanks have been utilized by nearly every NASA orbital vehicle since the very first to use gridded aluminum construction: the Thor/Delta and Titan rockets as well as the Agena upper stage.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝制网格筋储罐。等网格筋与正交网格筋是由整块材料铣削而成的先进镂空结构，在具备极高刚度的同时实现了非凡的材料与质量节省。面板上精细复杂的晶格需要极高精度的机械加工，因此该结构的制造成本远高于常规储罐。尽管如此，自首批采用铝制网格筋结构的雷神/德尔塔、泰坦火箭以及阿金纳上面级以来，NASA几乎所有入轨航天器均采用了网格筋储罐。

src: You can now use Aluminum-Copper Alloy gridded tanks. Stronger than unalloyed aluminum and workable to boot, advanced new Al-Cu alloys were used in orthogrid and isogrid tanks for all upper stages of the Saturn program. These are 25% (standard) or 10% (HP) lighter than Al gridded tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝铜合金网格筋储罐。先进的新型铝铜合金强度高于纯铝，且易于加工，曾用于土星计划所有上面级的正交网格筋与等网格筋储罐。这类储罐比铝制网格筋储罐轻25%（标准型）或10%（高压型），模具成本高50%，投产后制造成本高10%。

src: Upgraded RD-0120 for Vulkan and later Energia versions. Used a nozzle insert to increase sea level performance, which would then be ejected at altitude. Proposed to power Angara after the cancellation of Energia.
zh: 为“火神”（Vulkan）及后续“能源”（Energia）改型设计的升级版RD-0120。采用喷管内嵌衬套以提高海平面性能，升空后将其抛弃。在“能源”号取消后曾被提议用于为“安加拉”（Angara）火箭提供动力。

src: Demonstrator for a throttlable engine, based on the RL10A-3-3. It was intended to be used for the Lunar Applications of a Spent S-IVB Stage (LASS) program to use modified S-IVB stages as heavy lunar landers.
zh: 基于RL10A-3-3的可节流发动机技术验证机。原计划用于“S-IVB废弃级月球应用”（LASS）项目，将改装后的S-IVB级作为重型月球着陆器使用。

src: RL10A-3-3A modified to operate with an O/F ratio of 6.0 for Shuttle-Centaur. This reduces performance, but increases the average propellant density, allowing for greater fuel load in the Shuttle cargo bay.
zh: 为“航天飞机-半人马座”改型的RL10A-3-3A，氧化剂/燃料混合比调整为6.0。这降低了比冲性能，但提高了推进剂平均密度，从而允许在航天飞机有效载荷舱内加注更多燃料。

src: This config represents the RL-10A-4-1 and RL-10A-4-2 variants. Reworked turbopumps and improved performance for usage in a single & dual engine configuration on Atlas II & Atlas III & single engine configuration on Atlas V.
zh: 该构型代表RL-10A-4-1与RL-10A-4-2变体。改进了涡轮泵并提升了性能，适用于“擎天神 II”和“擎天神 III”的单发及双机构型，以及“擎天神 V”的单机构型。

src: Upgrade used for the R-17MU, A.K.A Scud-D. It saw very little use in the Soviet Union due to mediocore performance, so the remaining missiles were sold to North Korea, providing the basis for North Korean missile development.
zh: 用于R-17MU（即飞毛腿-D）的升级版本。由于性能平平，在苏联几乎没有服役，剩余导弹被出售给朝鲜，为朝鲜的导弹研制奠定了基础。

src: Isayev improved Wasserfall engine used in Soviet R-101B/V/E anti-aircraft missile prototype. Development abandoned in favor of Isayev S09.19A, but was later repurposed for the R-11 (Scud) ballistic missile as the S2.253.
zh: 伊萨耶夫为苏联R-101B/V/E防空导弹原型机改进的“瀑布”（Wasserfall）发动机。该项目后来被放弃，转而采用伊萨耶夫S09.19A，但随后作为S2.253重新用于R-11（飞毛腿）弹道导弹。

src: A two-person pod. Features an offset Center of Mass to allow lifting reentry and an integrated bi-propellant Attitude Control System (ACS) for controlled reentries. Heat shield rated for LEO reentries.
zh: 双人乘员舱。具备偏置质心以实现升力式再入，并集成了双组元姿态控制系统（ACS）以实现受控再入。防热盾额定承受LEO再入热流。

src: Small solid fueled booster originally used to power anti-shipping missiles during WW2. Used as the kick stage on the WAC Corporal, the USA's first sounding rocket, and reused in modified form for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 小型固体燃料助推器，最初在二战期间用于反舰导弹。后作为美国第一型探空火箭“下士WAC”的起飞助推级，并在改进后重新用于“艾比”（Aerobee）系列探空火箭。

src: Simple steel tank and fuselage designs were used only on very early rockets such as the German V-2 and its American and Soviet clones. Tank and fuselage tankage is no more advanced than that used in the construction of early airplanes.
zh: 简易钢制储箱与机身设计仅用于极早期的火箭，例如德国的V-2及其美苏仿制品。这种储箱与机身结构的先进程度不高于早期飞机的制造水平。

src: Aluminum alloy skin-stringer-frame construction is nothing new to the aerospace industry and is the preferred construction of large aircraft today. Longitudinal stringers are responsible for transferring the aerodynamic loads acting on the skin onto the frame. This method of construction does not have mechanically separate tanks and frame, but the skin of the tank is only responsible for containing the propellant and is not load-bearing. The first rocket of skin-stringer-frame construction was the Soviet R-5 and has remained a staple of Russian design philosophy since, best exemplified in the very successful R-7 family.
zh: 铝合金蒙皮-桁条-隔框结构在航空航天工业中早已屡见不鲜，是当今大型飞机的首选结构。纵向桁条负责将作用在蒙皮上的气动载荷传递到隔框上。这种结构没有机械独立的储箱与框体，但储箱蒙皮仅用于盛装推进剂而不承受载荷。第一型采用蒙皮-桁条-隔框结构的火箭是苏联的R-5，此后一直成为俄罗斯设计理念的核心，最典型的代表就是极为成功的R-7家族。

src: Improved welding and manufacturing techniques developed in the 1960s allowed the use of more advanced aluminum alloys, containing higher fractions of Magnesium, Manganese, and Copper than their predecessors. The increased alloying makes these alloys slightly difficult to work with, but the increased strength allows for the creation of lighter structures. The most famous use of this construction was in the titanic and powerful S-IC, the first stage of the Saturn V lunar rocket, but it was also used in the early versions of the Shuttle External Tank.
zh: 20世纪60年代发展的先进焊接与制造技术使得采用更先进的铝合金成为可能，与早期合金相比，这些合金含有更高比例的镁、锰和铜。合金化程度的提高使得这些合金加工难度略有增加，但更高的强度使其能够制造更轻质的结构。这种结构最著名的应用是土星五号登月火箭庞大而强劲的S-IC第一级，同时也用于早期的航天飞机外贮箱。

src: Since lithium is the least dense elemental metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while being stronger than most other Al alloys. However, they are much more expensive and their metallurgical properties can present great difficulties to work with. Al-Li alloys are commonly used in modern aerospace applications, and all Al-Li skin-stringer construction was used for the final version of the Shuttle External Tank, the Super Lightweight Tank.
zh: 由于锂是密度最低的金属元素，铝锂合金比大多数其他铝合金密度显著更低，同时强度更高。然而，其成本高得多，冶金特性也会带来极大的加工难度。铝锂合金广泛用于现代航空航天领域，航天飞机外贮箱的最终版本——超轻型贮箱（SLWT），就完全采用了铝锂合金蒙皮-桁条结构。

zh_samples: 作为卡斯托尔 1 发动机的衍生型，卡斯托尔 2 具有更高的比冲和推进剂加注量、更低的干重比以及更长的燃烧时间。它从德尔塔 E 开始用作捆绑助推器，并在除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭中得到应用。燃烧时间 39 秒。直径：[0.79 m]。
作为卡斯托 1（Castor 1）发动机的衍生型号，卡斯托 2 具有更高的比冲和装药量、更低的结构质量比以及更长的工作时间。从德尔塔 E 起，以及除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭上，它都被用作捆绑助推器。工作时间 39 秒。
搅拌摩擦焊等改进的制造技术可进一步降低储箱干重。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具摩擦产生的热量使两块金属软化并在机械力作用下混合。它适用于需要极高焊接强度的结构，并在航天工业中有着广泛应用。SpaceX首次在“猎鹰1e”及随后的“猎鹰9”系列火箭上对

src: Improved construction techniques, such as friction stir welding, allow for additional decreases of tank dry mass. Friction stir welding uses heat generated by the friction of rotating tool to soften and mechanically intermixes two pieces of metal. It is used for structures which need very high weld strength, and has broad application in the aerospace industry. Completely stir-welding a semi-stringer-constructed tank was first used by SpaceX on their Falcon 1e and then Falcon 9 series of rockets. This unique construction allows for the use of fewer structural components and lighter welds, resulting in both mass and cost reductions.
zh: 搅拌摩擦焊等改进的制造技术可进一步降低储箱干重。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具摩擦产生的热量使两块金属软化并在机械力作用下混合。它适用于需要极高焊接强度的结构，并在航天工业中有着广泛应用。SpaceX首次在“猎鹰1e”及随后的“猎鹰9”系列火箭上对半桁条结构储箱进行了全搅拌摩擦焊接。这种独特的结构减少了结构组件并减轻了焊缝质量，从而同时降低了质量和成本。

src: Isogrids and orthogrids are advanced hollowed-out structures milled out of a single block of material that have very high rigidity yet exceptional material and mass savings. The delicate & complex lattices on the panel require very high precision machining and thus such a construction is much more expensive to produce than more standard tanks. Nevertheless, gridded tanks have been utilized by nearly every NASA orbital vehicle since the very first to use gridded aluminum construction: Thor/Delta as well as the S-IV and S-IVB upper stage.
zh: 等网格和正交网格结构是由整块材料铣削加工而成的先进掏空结构，具有极高的刚度，同时能大幅节省材料并减轻质量。壁板上精致复杂的网格需要极高精度的加工，因此该结构的制造成本远高于标准储箱。尽管如此，自首次采用网格铝结构的雷神/德尔塔以及S-IV和S-IVB上面级以来，NASA几乎所有的轨道飞行器都采用了网格储箱。

src: Improved welding and manufacturing techniques developed in the 1960s allowed the use of more advanced aluminum alloys, containing higher fractions of Magnesium, Manganese, and Copper than their predecessors. The increased alloying makes these alloys slightly difficult to work with, but the increased strength allows for the creation of lighter structures. The S-II stage of the Saturn V used this construction to become the highest performance hydrolox stage of its time.
zh: 20世纪60年代发展的先进焊接与制造技术使得采用更先进的铝合金成为可能，与早期合金相比，这些合金含有更高比例的镁、锰和铜。合金化程度的提高使得这些合金加工难度略有增加，但更高的强度使其能够制造更轻质的结构。土星五号的S-II级就采用了这种结构，成为当时性能最高的液氢液氧级。

src: Since lithium is the least dense elemental metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while being stronger than most other Al alloys. However, their tendency to work-harden means that machining such alloys is much more difficult than standard alloys. Nevertheless, lightweight Al-Li gridded tanks have been the foundation of the modern era of orbital American rocketry, used in the Atlas V Common Core Booster, the Delta IV Common Booster Core (and DCSS upper stages), the Space Launch System core stage, and the ULA Vulcan rocket.
zh: 由于锂是密度最低的金属元素，铝锂合金比大多数其他铝合金密度显著更低，同时强度更高。然而，其加工硬化倾向意味着机械加工此类合金比标准合金困难得多。尽管如此，轻质铝锂合金网格储箱仍是现代美国轨道运载火箭的基础，应用于“擎天神 V”的通用核心助推器、“德尔塔 IV”的通用助推核心（及DCSS上面级）、太空发射系统（SLS）的核心级以及ULA的“火神”火箭。

src: The RJ55 was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to a J67. At low speeds, the RJ55 functioned as an afterburner for the J67 turbojet, but at mach 2.24 the turbojet would be shut down and the RJ55 would power the aircraft up to Mach 3. Designed for the XF-103, but difficuties with the J67 turbojet meant the prototype never flew under it's own power.
zh: RJ55 是一种组合循环冲压发动机，与 J67 配合使用。在低速时，RJ55 作为 J67 涡喷发动机的加力燃烧室工作；但在 2.24 马赫时涡喷发动机会关闭，由 RJ55 驱动飞机加速至 3 马赫。专为 XF-103 设计，但 J67 涡喷发动机的技术困难导致原型机从未依靠自身动力飞行过。

src: The RJ59 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the Convair Super Hustler. Although the Super Hustler was cancelled, the RJ59 was fitted to the X-7 for testing, where it was able to achieve speeds over Mach 4.
zh: RJ59 是一种超音速冲压发动机，设计用于为康维尔“超级骗子”（Super Hustler）提供动力。尽管超级骗子项目被取消，但 RJ59 被安装在 X-7 上进行测试，并在测试中达到了超过 4 马赫的速度。

src: The WS-10 is a modern low-bypass afterburning turbofan, and the first successful Chinese turbofan design. Developed from the earlier experimental WS-6 turbofan, the WS-10 was designed to replace the Russian AL-31 engines used in some Chinese aircraft. The WS-10 powers the J-8II, J-10B/C, J-11B, J-15, J-16, and J-20/A.
zh: WS-10 是一款现代低涵道比加力涡扇发动机，也是中国首款成功研制的涡扇发动机。由早期的试验性 WS-6 涡扇发动机发展而来，WS-10 旨在替代部分中国飞机上使用的俄罗斯 AL-31 发动机。WS-10 为 J-8II、J-10B/C、J-11B, J-15、J-16 和 J-20/A 提供动力。

src: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II. This is the 101D, an early model used in the Dassault Mystère IIC. Available 1954. Thrust 29.42kN. OPR 4.5, SFC 1.09 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 阿塔（Atar）101 是二战后法国研制的最早的喷气发动机之一。它被用于许多早期的法国喷气式飞机，包括秃鹰 I/II、苍鹰 I 和神秘 II。这是 101D 型，是达索神秘 IIC 上使用的早期型号。1954 年可用。推力 29.42 kN。总压比 4.5，静态比油耗 1.09 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1.5 马赫。

src: The Derwent V, rather than being a development of the Derwent line (a straight-through-flow development of the W.2), was instead a scaled-down Nene. It powered the Meteor F.4, and also the La-15, Yak-23 and Yak-25 as the RD-500, a Soviet-built copy. Thrust 15.6kN. Available in mid-late 1945. OPR 4.0, SFC 1.03 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 德温特 V（Derwent V）并非德温特系列（W.2 的平直通流改型）的衍生产品，而是内恩（Nene）发动机的缩小型。它为流星 F.4 提供动力，其苏联仿制型号 RD-500 则为 La-15、Yak-23 和 Yak-25 提供动力。推力 15.6 kN。1945 年中后期可用。总压比 4.0，静态比油耗 1.03 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

src: The Allison/General Electric J35 is an axial flow turbojet, and one of the first turbojets natively designed in the United States. Although not as well known as it's later derivative, the J47, it still powered many late 40s aircraft such as the FJ-1, F-84, F-89, XP-86, XB-45, XB-47, X-5, and D-558. This is the -11, as used on the Douglas D-558-1. Available 1946. Thrust 16.68kN. 4.0 OPR, SFC of 1.12lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 艾里逊/通用电气 J35 是一款轴流式涡喷发动机，也是美国本土设计的最早的涡喷发动机之一。尽管不如其后来的衍生型号 J47 知名，但它仍为 40 年代后期的许多飞机提供动力，例如 FJ-1、F-84、F-89、XP-86、XB-45、XB-47、X-5 和 D-558。这是 -11 型，用于道格拉斯 D-558-1。1946 年可用。推力 16.68 kN。总压比 4.0，静态比油耗 1.12 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

src: The General Electric J47 is an axial flow turbojet, developed from the J35 in parallel with centrifugal flow jets based on British designs. The J47 was very successful, used on many early 50s aircraft, including the F-86, FJ-2, XF-87, XF-91, B-36, B-45, B-47, XB-51, KB-50, KB-97, and even the M-497 jet-powered railcar. This is the -27, a later model used in the F-86F. Available 1952. Thrust 26.47 kN. 5.5 OPR, SFC of 0.902lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 通用电气 J47 是一款轴流式涡喷发动机，由 J35 改进而来，与基于英国设计的离心式喷气发动机并行发展。J47 非常成功，广泛用于 50 年代初期的许多飞机，包括 F-86、FJ-2、XF-87、XF-91、B-36、B-45、B-47、XB-51、KB-50、KB-97，甚至还有 M-497 喷气动力轨道车。这是 -27 型，是用于 F-86F 的后期型号。1952 年可用。推力 26.47 kN。总压比 5.5，静态比油耗 0.902 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

src: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene. The British government sold several Nene and Derwent engines to the Soviet Union in 1946, which were then reverse engineered, and used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, and Il-28. The VK-1 was an improved version, used in the MiG-15bis. Available 1949. Thrust 26.47 kN. 4.4 OPR, SFC 1.049 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 内恩（Nene）发动机的苏联仿制衍生型号。英国政府于 1946 年向苏联出售了数台内恩和德温特发动机，随后苏联对其进行逆向工程，并用于许多早期的苏联喷气式飞机，包括 MiG-15、MiG-17 和 Il-28。VK-1 是其改进型号，用于 MiG-15bis。1949 年可用。推力 26.47 kN。总压比 4.4，静态比油耗 1.049 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

src: Monolithic "mixing-head" injector engine. Improved thrust, decreased weight, and storable fuel mixture consisting of explosives grade acid and coal tar distillate. The combustion instability issues of this design were never resolved, although a subscale version was used as the basis for the "Wasserfall" anti-aircraft missile.
zh: 整体式“混合头”喷注器发动机。提升了推力，减轻了重量，并使用由炸药级硝酸和煤焦油馏分组成的可贮存燃料混合物。该设计的燃烧不稳定问题从未得到解决，但其缩比版本被用作“瀑布”（Wasserfall）防空导弹的动力基础。

src: Proposed engine for X-15 program, with a recirculation valve to allow operation at ~60% throttle. Limited throttle capability and starts, but much lighter, cheaper, and more reliable than other options.
zh: 为 X-15 计划提议的发动机，带有再循环阀，允许在约 60% 节流阀开度下运行。节流阀调节能力和启动次数有限，但比其他方案更轻、更便宜且更可靠。

src: Maximum possible thrust for H-1 design, proposed for a post-Apollo uprated Saturn IB. Although engines were tested at increased thrust levels, the end of Apollo and selection of Titan III over Saturn IB meant this was never developed further.
zh: H-1 设计的最大可能推力型号，提议用于后阿波罗时代的土星 IB 改型。尽管发动机在更高推力水平下进行了测试，但阿波罗计划的结束以及选用大力神 III 而非土星 IB，导致该型号未能进一步开发。

src: Enhanced H-1 design, featuring an enlarged, tap-off cycle turbopump and simplified components to increase thrust and reduce cost. Intended to power the Saturn-II and later versions of the Saturn-I, but development was cancelled due to satisfactory performance of the H-1 at increased thrust levels.
zh: 增强型 H-1 设计，采用扩大的分流循环涡轮泵和简化部件，以增加推力并降低成本。原本打算为土星 II 和土星 I 的后续版本提供动力，但由于 H-1 在更高推力水平下的性能令人满意，该研发被取消。

src: Further refinement of the HG-3 engine, taking into account developements with the RL-10 and RS-25. Run time and reliability are extended compared to original models, although turbopump throughput is decreased to reduce strain on engine components.
zh: HG-3 发动机的进一步改进型号，吸收了 RL-10 和 RS-25 的研制经验。与原始型号相比延长了工作时间和可靠性，但降低了涡轮泵流量以减少发动机部件的应力。

src: Sea-level variant of HG-3B upgrade. Increased specific impulse compared to other sea-level variants prior to B version development results in slightly higher thrust for the same level of turbopump throughput as the HG-3B vacuum engine.
zh: HG-3B 升级型号的海平面改型。与 B 版本开发前的其他海平面改型相比，提高了比冲，在与 HG-3B 真空发动机相同的涡轮泵流量下获得了略高的推力。

src: Modified version of HG-3B, running the turbopumps harder to generate the same level of mass flow as in previous models. This results in improved thrust compared to the normal B model, at the cost of slightly less reliability in comparison.
zh: HG-3B 的改进版本，通过加大涡轮泵转速来产生与早期型号相同的质量流量。与普通 B 型相比提高了推力，但相对代价是可靠性略有下降。

src: The J-2S (J-2 Simplified) was a improvement on the J-2 Engine. It was completely tested and logged more than 30,000 seconds of static fire before the program was terminated. Five minutes minimum between restarts.
zh: J-2S（J-2 简化版）是 J-2 发动机的改进型。在项目终止前已完成全部测试，并记录了超过 30,000 秒的静止试车时间。两次重启之间至少需要间隔五分钟。

src: GE4/J6H turbojet, designed after tests revealed the afterburners of the GE4 would make the 2707 too loud to use most airports. The revised engine has slightly superior performance, but is much heavier. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.56.
zh: GE4/J6H 涡喷发动机，在测试显示 GE4 的加力燃烧室会使 2707 噪音过大而无法在大多数机场使用后设计。改进后的发动机性能略有提升，但重量大幅增加。15 km 处的温度马赫极限：3.56。

src: Simplified design for the H-IIA. Lower cost and better reliability, at the cost of lower performance. Intended to have a nozzle extension, but it had to be removed due to unexpected combustion instability issues.
zh: 用于 H-IIA 的简化设计。以牺牲部分性能为代价，换取更低的成本和更高的可靠性。原本计划配备喷管延伸段，但由于意料之外的燃烧不稳定问题而不得不将其移除。

src: AJ23-139, First stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Modified to light in midair, since the UA120x boosters used by Titan III could lift Titan without assistance. Ignited just before booster burnout.
zh: AJ23-139，大力神 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 和 IIIE 的第一级发动机。经改装可在空中点火，因为大力神 III 使用的 UA120x 助推器无需协助即可推起大力神火箭。在助推器燃尽前点火。

src: Uprated XLR43 for later Navaho applications. First US engine to use tubular wall, aka spaghetti, thrust chamber which greatly reduced weight. Also first to use a gas generator, removing the need for HTP to power the turbopump.
zh: 用于后期“纳瓦霍”（Navaho）计划的增推型 XLR43。美国第一款采用管状内壁（即意大利面式）推力室的发动机，大幅减轻了重量。也是第一款使用燃气发生器的发动机，消除了对驱动涡轮泵的高浓度过氧化氢（HTP）的需求。

src: You can now use Aluminum-Lithium Alloy gridded tanks. Since lithium is the least dense metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while still being very strong. However, their tendency to work-harden makes them more difficult to machine. These tanks are common in modern American rocketry, used in the Atlas V Common Core Booster, the Delta IV, the SLS core stage, and Vulcan. These are 5% (standard) or 18% (HP) lighter than refined Al gridded tanks while costing 10% more to tool and 15% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝锂合金网格储罐。由于锂是密度最低的金属，铝锂合金在保持极高强度的同时显著降低了密度。然而，其加工硬化倾向使得机械加工更加困难。这类储罐在现代美国火箭中很常见，应用于擎天神5号公共核心助推器、德尔塔4号、SLS核心级以及火神火箭。它们比精炼铝网格储罐轻 5%（标准）或 18%（高压），但模具成本高出 10%，制造单价高出 15%。

src: You can now use Carbon Composite tanks. The low density and high strength of carbon composites have long been the siren call of tank design, ever since the aborted Venture Star program of the 1990s. Costs continue to drop, but the manufacturing process is still very expensive, requiring the wrapping and weaving of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber and baking in massive autoclaves. Currently, the only rocket to use composite tanks is Electron, developed by Rocket Lab. These are 18% lighter than Al-Li gridded tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 17% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用碳复合材料储罐。自20世纪90年代中止的冒险之星项目以来，碳复合材料的低密度和高强度一直是储罐设计中极具诱惑的目标。成本虽在持续下降，但制造工艺仍然十分昂贵，需要缠绕编织数百层碳纤维并在巨型高压釜中固化。目前唯一采用复合材料储罐的火箭是火箭实验室研发的电子号。它们比铝锂合金网格储罐轻 18%，但模具成本高出 20%，制造单价高出 17%。

src: You can now use Advanced Carbon Composite tanks. Ceramic-metal alloys and insulating complex composite structures are still speculative, but if they ever come to fruition, they'd probably be something like this. These are 40% lighter than composite tanks while costing 33% more to tool and 18% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用先进碳复合材料储罐。金属陶瓷合金和隔热复杂复合材料结构仍处于前沿探索阶段，但如果它们最终成真，大概会是这个样子。它们比复合材料储罐轻 40%，但模具成本高出 33%，制造单价高出 18%。

src: You can now use Steel & Aluminum balloon tanks. Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These early balloon tanks were first used by Atlas and the Centaur C upper stage.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢铝气囊储罐。气囊储罐没有内部构架，而是依靠内部增压来维持形状。如果失去内部压力，气囊储罐就会瘪塌。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有出色的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其相当昂贵。这些早期气囊储罐最早应用于擎天神和半人马座C上面级。

src: You can now use Steel & Aluminum-Copper Alloy balloon tanks. These advanced balloon tanks were first used by the Centaur G upper stage. These are 25% lighter than basic balloon tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 12% less once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝铜合金气囊储罐。这些先进的气囊储罐最早应用于半人马座G上面级。它们比基础气囊储罐轻 25%，模具成本高出 20%，但制造单价低 12%。

src: You can now use Steel & Aluminum-Lithium Alloy balloon tanks. These modern balloon tanks were first used by Centaur III. These are 5% lighter than refined balloon tanks while costing 7% more to tool and 25% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝锂合金气囊储罐。这些现代气囊储罐最早应用于半人马座III。它们比精炼气囊储罐轻 5%，但模具成本高出 7%，制造单价高出 25%。

zh_samples: 你现在可以使用复合材料机翼油箱。大型复合材料结构的应用最早由波音787、777X和空中客车A350开创。它们比常规机翼油箱轻 35%，但成本高出 10%。
机翼油箱
复合材料机翼油箱

src: You can now use composite wet wings. Large-scale use of composite structures was first pioneered in the Boeing 787, 777X, and Airbus A350. These are 35% lighter than wet wing tanks while costing 10% more.
zh: 你现在可以使用复合材料机翼油箱。大型复合材料结构的应用最早由波音787、777X和空中客车A350开创。它们比常规机翼油箱轻 35%，但成本高出 10%。

src: The full-sized version of the centrifuge from the Nautilus-X proposal. With a habitable volume close to that of the entire ISS put together, it's large enough to provide comfortable habitation to six astronauts. Although the diameter remains too small to allow for full Earth-like gravity under tolerable rotation rates, Martian gravity levels are easily achievable.
zh: Nautilus-X 方案中的全尺寸离心机。其居住容积接近整个国际空间站的总和，足够为六名航天员提供舒适的生活空间。尽管其直径仍然较小，在人体可耐受的转速下无法提供完整的类地重力，但达到火星重力水平绰绰有余。

src: A expander bleed cycle engine developed in the 2000s. It was a Mitsubishi and Boeing joint project for Delta IV cryogenic upper stages.
zh: 2000年代研制的膨胀排放循环发动机。为三菱与波音联合研发的项目，用于德尔塔IV的低温上面级。

src: A staged combustion upper stage vernier engine developed for the R-36M second stage. This represents 1/4th of an RD-0230. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0257.
zh: 为R-36M二级研制的分级燃烧上面级游标发动机。相当于一台RD-0230的1/4。R-36M2使用了该发动机的升级版本，即RD-0257。

src: A British kerolox booster engine for the Blue Streak missile and the first stage of the Europa launch vehicle. It was derived from the Rocketdyne S-3, with minor modifications.
zh: 英国用于“蓝光”导弹及“欧罗巴”运载火箭第一级的液氧煤油助推器发动机。由洛克达因S-3衍生而来，仅作了少量改动。

src: The whole family of Merlin 1 rocket engines, made by SpaceX.
zh: Merlin 1全系列火箭发动机，由SpaceX制造。

src: Aerojet MR-510 series arcjet engines are currently used on Lockheed Martin A2100 satellites using hydrazine as a propellant.
zh: Aerojet MR-510系列电弧推力器目前用于使用肼类推进剂的洛克希德·马丁A2100卫星。

src: A 1970s low-TWR vacuum engine, the NERVA (Nuclear Engine for Rocket Vehicle Applications) is designed for orbital tugs and large rocket upper stages.
zh: 一款20世纪70年代的低TWR真空发动机，NERVA（核动力火箭飞行器应用计划）专为轨道拖船和大型火箭上面级设计。

src: A later 1970s atomic engine with relatively low TWR but high ISP and a power generation of 4200 MW. Derived from the Phoebus 2A ground demonstrator, tested in 1968.
zh: 一款20世纪70年代后期的核动力发动机，TWR相对较低但比冲极高，发电功率达4200 MW。衍生自1968年测试的Phoebus 2A地面验证机。

src: A first stage solid rocket motor used on many sounding rockets including Nike-Deacon, Nike-Cajun, Nike-Apache, Nike-Aerobee170, Nike-Aerobee350, and more.
zh: 一种固体火箭第一级发动机，用于包括耐克-执事、耐克-卡津、耐克-阿帕奇、耐克-Aerobee170、耐克-Aerobee350等多种探空火箭。

src: A staged combustion kerolox booster engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was the basis for the NK-15 used on the N1, and the NK-33 used today.
zh: 由库兹涅佐夫为科罗廖夫的GR-1项目设计的分级燃烧液氧煤油助推器发动机。它是N1所用NK-15以及当今使用的NK-33的基础。

src: A staged combustion kerolox upper/vacuum engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was reused (as NK-19) on the N1 and upgraded for the N1F with restart capability as NK-31.
zh: 由库兹涅佐夫为科罗廖夫的GR-1项目设计的分级燃烧液氧煤油上面级/真空发动机。该型号在N1上复用（称为NK-19），后为N1F升级为具备二次启动能力的NK-31。

src: Originally designed and built for the N1F, the NK-43 is a derivative of the NK-33 with a longer bell and restart capability for use on upper stages.
zh: NK-43最初为N1F设计并建造，是NK-33的衍生型号，具有更长的喷管延伸段并具备重启能力，适用于上面级。

zh_samples: 首款大型栅极离子推力器，NASA太阳能技术应用就绪计划（NSTAR）曾用于深空1号和黎明号航天器，以支持在小行星带的长期任务。
通灵机16是一款多功能轻型天线，适用于中程通信、远程备用通信，以及窃听政府秘密行动。

src: The first large gridded ion thruster, the NASA Solar Technology Application Readiness (NSTAR) was used on the Deep Space 1 and Dawn spacecraft to allow for extended operations in the asteroid belt.
zh: 首款大型栅极离子推力器，NASA太阳能技术应用就绪计划（NSTAR）曾用于深空1号和黎明号航天器，以支持在小行星带的长期任务。
NuPIT脉冲感应推力器

src: NYRATH Open Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: NYRATH开式循环气核核动力火箭发动机

src: PIT Mk Va Pulsed Inductive Thruster
zh: PIT Mk Va脉冲感应推力器

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务
你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src: A Hall-effect ion thruster used on many commercial spacecraft for station keeping.
zh: 一种霍尔效应离子推力器，广泛用于商业航天器的轨道位置保持。

src: A pressure-fed vacuum hypergolic engine used for attitude control on the Space Shuttle.
zh: 一种挤压循环真空自燃推进剂发动机，用于航天飞机的姿态控制。

src: A pressure-fed hypergolic rocket engine, burning either MMH and NTO (R-42) or hydrazine and NTO (R-42DM). Used as an apogee kick motor for geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种挤压循环自燃推进剂火箭发动机，燃烧MMH/NTO（R-42）或肼/NTO（R-42DM）。用作地球同步卫星的远地点变轨发动机。

src: The RD-8 is a four-chamber, staged combustion, vacuum kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the second stage of the Zenit launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control.
zh: RD-8是一款四推力室、分级燃烧的真空液氧煤油游控发动机。用于天顶号系列运载火箭第二级进行双轴姿态控制。

src: An upper stage kerolox engine designed for the R-9 ICBM and later used on the Molniya, Voskhod. and Soyuz launchers.
zh: 一款专为R-9洲际弹道导弹设计的上面级液氧煤油发动机，后用于闪电号、上升号和联盟号运载火箭。

src: The RD-0110R is a four-chamber, gas generator, surface kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the first stage of the Soyuz-2-1V launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control.
zh: RD-0110R是一款四推力室、燃气发生器循环的地面级液氧煤油游控发动机。用于联盟-2-1V系列运载火箭第一级进行双轴姿态控制。

src: The vernier engine for the RD-0110 power plant. Four of them are used on the Block I upper stage of the Soyuz U and FG launch vehicle variants for attitude control.
zh: 用于RD-0110动力装置的游控发动机。四台并联用于联盟U和联盟FG运载火箭改型的I子级上面级进行姿态控制。

src: A 1980s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120 is a fuel-rich staged combustion engine developed to power the core stage of the Energia launcher.
zh: 一款20世纪80年代的中TWR大气与真空两用发动机。RD-0120是一款富燃分级燃烧发动机，专为能源号运载火箭芯级提供动力而研制。

src: The RD-120 is a staged combustion vacuum kerolox engine used as the main power plant on the Zenit launch vehicle family second stage.
zh: RD-120是一款分级燃烧真空液氧煤油发动机，用作天顶号系列运载火箭第二级的主动力装置。

src: An upper stage Kerosene/LOX engine designed for new versions of the Soyuz-2 launchers. It will also be used with the Angara family of launchers.
zh: 一款专为新版联盟-2运载火箭设计的上面级液氧/煤油发动机。它也将用于安加拉系列运载火箭。

src: The RD-180 is a two-chamber derivative of the four-chamber RD-170/171 and it powers the first stage of the Atlas V.
zh: RD-180是四推力室RD-170/171的双推力室衍生型号，为宇宙神V的第一级提供动力。

src: A staged combustion hypergolic vacuum rocket engine used as a power plant on the second stage of the Proton launch vehicle family. Features a one-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一种分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机，用作质子号系列运载火箭第二级的动力装置。配备单轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。

src: A gas generator vernier engine cluster found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher.
zh: 一种燃气发生器循环游控发动机机组，安装在UR-200的第二级和UR-500/质子号系列运载火箭的第三级。

src: A Soviet pressure-fed vacuum engine. A pair of RD-0225s were used as maneuvering engines on the Almaz space stations.
zh: 苏联的一款挤压循环真空发动机。一对RD-0225s曾用作金刚石空间站的机动发动机。

src: A gas-generator upper stage vernier engine developed for the UR-100N second stage, designed to be used alongside the RD-0235. This represents 1/4th of an RD-0236.
zh: 专为UR-100N第二级研制的燃气发生器循环上面级游控发动机，设计与RD-0235配合使用。本部件相当于RD-0236的四分之一。

src: The RD-0242M2 is a deeply-throttleable derivative of the RD-0242M1 upper stage engine engine. Modified to use monomethyl hydrazine (MMH) instead of unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine (UDMH).
zh: RD-0242M2是RD-0242M1上面级发动机的大范围深度节流衍生型号。改用一甲基肼（MMH）替代偏二甲肼（UDMH）。

src: A staged combustion hypergolic booster engine designed to replace the RD-250 engines used on the R-36. It was also used for the MR-UR-100.
zh: 一种分级燃烧自燃推进剂助推器发动机，旨在替代R-36上使用的RD-250发动机。它也曾用于MR-UR-100。

src: RD-600 Open Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: RD-600开式循环气核核动力火箭发动机

src: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the first stage of the R-16, R-36, and Tsyklon rockets.
zh: 一种泵压式自燃推进剂游控推力器，用于R-16、R-36和旋风号火箭的第一级。

src: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the second stage of the R-16 and R-36 ICBM, and the Tsyklon (Cyclone) launch vehicle series for attitude control.
zh: 一种泵压式自燃推进剂游控推力器，用于R-16和R-36洲际弹道导弹的第二级，以及旋风号系列运载火箭进行姿态控制。

src: A gas generator hypergolic engine for the LK lander. It serves as the main engine of the LK lander, used for final descent to the moon, and takeoff to lunar orbit.
zh: 用于LK登月舱的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为LK登月舱的主发动机，用于月表最终下降和起飞进入月球轨道。

src: A gas generator hypergolic engine for the LK lander. It serves as the backup engine of the LK lander. It has limited throttling capability, and is only to be used for takeoff or abort.
zh: 用于LK登月舱的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为LK登月舱的备用发动机。节流范围有限，仅用于起飞或中止任务。

src: A French solid rocket engine developed for the MSBS M1 ballistic missile, and later used as the second stage of the Diamant BP.4 launch vehicle, replacing the Topaze.
zh: 法国为MSBS M1弹道导弹研制的固体火箭发动机，后取代黄玉发动机用作钻石BP.4运载火箭的第二级。

src: A reusable fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed in the early 1970s to test technologies for the RS-25 SSME.
zh: 一种可重复使用的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。于20世纪70年代初研制，用于验证RS-25航天飞机主发动机（SSME）的相关技术。

src: Rocketdyne's LH2/LOX full flow staged combustion engine proposal for next generation reusable launch vehicle boosters.
zh: 洛克达因为下一代可重复使用运载火箭助推器提议的液氢/液氧全流量分级燃烧发动机。

src: A small French solid rocket motor used as the second stage of the Rubis sounding rocket and third stage on the Diamant A launch vehicle.
zh: 一种小型法国固体火箭发动机，用作红宝石探空火箭的第二级和钻石A运载火箭的第三级。

src: A small maneuvering engine used on the Soviet 1MV and 2MV spacecraft busses and KAUR-2 comsat bus. Used on early Venera, Mars, Zond, and Molniya satellites.
zh: 一种用于苏联1MV和2MV航天器平台以及KAUR-2通信卫星平台的小型机动发动机。曾用于早期的金星、火星、探测器和闪电号卫星。

src: A small gas-generator vacuum engine, developed as an upper stage for the R-14 to create the Kosmos-3 launch vehicle. Also known as the 11D49 or DU-49.
zh: 一种小型燃气发生器循环真空发动机，作为R-14的上面级研制，从而衍生出了宇宙-3号运载火箭。亦称11D49或DU-49。

src: A low-bypass augmented turbofan used by the MiG-31 and Su-47. 152kN wet, 93.2kN dry. OPR 21.2, SFC 0.72/1.86 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.9.
zh: 用于MiG-31和Su-47的低涵道比加力涡扇发动机。加力152 kN，无加力93.2 kN。总压比21.2，静态油耗0.72/1.86 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.9马赫。
“蓝宝石”ASSa.7 Mk.203涡喷发动机

src: A small solid fueled booster taken from the AIM-7 Sparrow missile. It was used as the third stage on the Aerobee 300 and 300A sounding rockets.
zh: 源自AIM-7“麻雀”导弹的小型固体助推器。曾作为“金龟子”300和300A探空火箭的第三级使用。

src: A small but powerful solid fueled booster used as the first stage for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 一款紧凑但强力的小型固体助推器，用作“金龟子”系列探空火箭的第一级。

src: A small pressure-fed sustainer for the WAC Corporal and Aerobee sounding rockets. Used after a small solid booster.
zh: 用于“下士”WAC和“金龟子”探空火箭的小型挤压循环持续推力发动机。在小型固体助推器工作后启动。
阿金纳-D二级推进系统
AJ10-137（服务推进系统）

src: The Aerojet AJ10-137 was used as the Service Propulsion System on the Apollo CSM. It was designed to operate for up to 750 seconds and could restart 50 times.
zh: Aerojet AJ10-137曾用作阿波罗CSM上的服务推进系统。其设计运行时间最长达750秒，并可重新启动50次。

src: A low thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine used on the Space Shuttle for orbital insertion, maneuvering, and deorbiting. Currently used by the Orion MPCV.
zh: 用于航天飞机轨道入轨、变轨和脱轨的小推力挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。目前用于“猎户座”MPCV。

src: The AJ-60A is an SRB produced by Aerojet Rocketdyne. They are currently used as strap-on boosters on United Launch Alliance's Atlas V rocket.
zh: AJ-60A是由Aerojet Rocketdyne生产的固体火箭助推器。目前在联合发射联盟的“宇宙神V”火箭上作为捆绑助推器使用。

src: AJ-260 FL Radial Solid Rocket Booster
zh: AJ-260 FL径向固体火箭助推器

src: AJ-260 SL Radial Solid Rocket Booster
zh: AJ-260 SL径向固体火箭助推器

src: A first stage solid rocket motor used on the early X-1 and X-2 Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 用于早期X-1和X-2“侦察兵”运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机。

src: A first stage solid rocket motor developed from Algol I and used on the Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 由“大陵五I”发展而来并用于“侦察兵”运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机。

src: The final development version of the first stage solid rocket motor used on the Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 用于“侦察兵”运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机的最终研发版本。

src: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this successor was used on Scout and Delta to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Average thrust 28.48 kN, burn time 22 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机。作为由“牵牛星”发展而来的后继型号，它在“侦察兵”和“德尔塔”上用于远地点圆化轨道或实施最终有效载荷推冲。平均推力28.48 kN，燃烧时间22秒。

src: The Antares solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the Scout launch vehicle.
zh: “心宿二”固体火箭发动机曾用作“侦察兵”运载火箭的第三级。

src: The Antares II solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the majority of the Scout launch vehicle launches.
zh: “心宿二II”固体火箭发动机曾用作绝大多数“侦察兵”运载火箭发射任务的第三级。

src: A German pressure-fed vacuum engine burning Aerozine50 and NTO. It was used on the stage of the same name on the Europa I and II launch vehicles.
zh: 一款燃烧Aerozine50和NTO的德国挤压循环真空发动机。它曾用于“欧罗巴”I和II运载火箭上的同名级段。

src: A small hypergolic engine developed for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars. Ultimately never used in space, as the R-4D was chosen for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars was cancelled.
zh: 一款为阿波罗计划和“旅行者火星”开发的小型自燃推进剂发动机。由于阿波罗计划最终选用了R-4D，且“旅行者火星”被取消，它从未在太空飞行中使用过。

src: A second stage solid rocket motor used on the Nike-Cajun sounding rocket.
zh: 用于“耐克-卡津”探空火箭的第二级固体火箭发动机。

src: The Castor 1 was first used for a suborbital launch of a Scout X-1 rocket in 1960. Castor 1 stages were also used as strap-on boosters for vehicles with Thor first stages, including the Delta-D.
zh: “卡斯托1”于1960年首次用于“侦察兵”X-1火箭的亚轨道发射。“卡斯托1”级段还曾作为捆绑助推器用于以“雷神”为第一级的运载器，包括“德尔塔-D”。

src: A strap-on booster, improved from the Castor 4A and first tested May 1992. Its 30% performance increase would improve capacity of Atlas IIAS, H-II, and other vehicles. First flight 2001.
zh: 一款由“卡斯托4A”改进而来的捆绑助推器，于1992年5月首飞测试。其性能提升了30%，可增强“宇宙神IIAS”、“H-II”等火箭的运载能力。首飞于2001年。

src: A steel casing solid rocket motor used in pairs by the Ariane 5 launch vehicle for the initial phases of the flight.
zh: 一种钢制壳体固体火箭发动机，在“阿里安5”运载火箭的初始飞行阶段成对使用。

src: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application.
zh: 巨大的Rocketdyne F-1发动机。有史以来制造的体型最大、推力最强的火箭发动机之一。请确保根据任务需求启用滚转能力或禁用万向节。
FARAD脉冲感应推力器

src: Developed from Altair-III (FW-4S), the FW-5 was a small apogee kick motor used for most Hughes HS-333 satellite busses, including Anik, Westar and Marisat.
zh: 由“牵牛星-III”（FW-4S）发展而来的FW-5是一款小型远地点冲量发动机，用于包括Anik、Westar和Marisat在内的大多数休斯HS-333卫星平台。

src: A small solid kick motor, used as the third stage on all but the last Vanguard launch. Burn time 33 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，用于除最后一次发射外的所有“先锋”火箭第三级。燃烧时间33秒。

src: HERMeS (Hall Effect Rocket with Magnetic Shielding) is a an experimental Hall effect ion thruster. It was later developed into AEPS, the planned propulsion system for the Lunar Gateway.
zh: HERMeS（带磁屏蔽的霍尔效应火箭）是一款实验性霍尔效应离子推力器。后来发展为AEPS，即计划用于“月球门户”的推进系统。

src: The Rocketdyne HG-3 engine, which served as a stepping stone between the J-2 and RS-25. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application.
zh: Rocketdyne HG-3发动机，曾作为J-2和RS-25之间的过渡产物。请确保根据任务需求启用滚转能力或禁用万向节。

src: A hydrolox gas generator upper stage engine, directly descended from the HM4 testbed engine and used on the upper stages of the Ariane launch vehicle family.
zh: 一款氢氧气动循环（燃气发生器循环）上面级发动机，直接脱胎于HM4试验平台发动机，并用于“阿里安”运载火箭家族的上面级。

src: A gridded ion thruster developed for the Transport and Energy Module, Russia's planned nuclear-electric tug.
zh: 一款为“运输和能源模块”（俄罗斯计划中的核电推拖船）开发的栅极离子推力器。

src: The Rocketdyne J-2 rocket engine was the first large hydrolox engine. Five powered the S-II stage on the Saturn V and one was used on the S-IVB stage of the Saturn IB and V.
zh: Rocketdyne J-2火箭发动机是首款大型氢氧发动机。土星五号的S-II级使用五台该发动机提供动力，土星IB和土星五号的S-IVB级也使用了一台。

src: A aerospike engine using proven technology from the J-2 and introducing an aerospike nozzle to the developing J-2S machinery.
zh: 一款气动塞式发动机，采用了源自J-2的成熟技术，并为研制中的J-2S机构引入了气动塞式喷管。

src: A pressure-fed kerosene/LOX engine used in the second stage of the Falcon 1 launcher.
zh: 一款用于“猎鹰1号”运载火箭第二级的挤压循环煤油/液氧发动机。

src: A methalox derivative of the original pressure-fed Kestrel engine used on the upper stage of the Falcon 1 launch vehicle. Features multi-ignition capability and a limited throttling range.
zh: 衍生自最初挤压循环“茶隼”发动机的甲烷氧版本，用于“猎鹰1号”运载火箭上面级。具备多次点火能力和有限的节流范围。

src: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for the return stage of the E-8-5 lunar sample return probes. With only one ignition, a very precise trajectory is required.
zh: 一款为E-8-5月球采样返回探测器返回级设计的苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。仅可单次点火，需要极高精度的轨道。

src: A Soviet pressure-fed hypergolic vacuum engine designed for Salyut-6 and Saylut-7. Also used on Mir and Zvezda.
zh: 一款为礼炮6号和礼炮7号设计的苏联挤压循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。也用于和平号和星辰号。

src: The vernier and landing engine for the LK-700S. Three were to be used as verniers on the TLI and Lunar injection stages, while another three would enable a controlled final descent for the LK-700S.
zh: 用于LK-700S的游标与着陆发动机。其中三台计划在奔月注入和环月注入级段作为游标发动机使用，另外三台则可为LK-700S提供受控的最终下降推进。

src: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine. Designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Mars and Venera 3MV, 4MV and 5MV spacecraft buses.
zh: 一款苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。设计用于“火星”以及“金星”3MV、4MV和5MV飞船平台的推进系统。

src: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. Developed with the assistance of Rocketdyne to power the upper stage of the N-I rocket.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。在Rocketdyne的协助下开发，用于为N-I火箭的上面级提供动力。

src: Light-Bulb Closed Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: “灯泡”闭式循环气冷堆原子火箭发动机
登月舱上升级发动机（LMAE）

src: A pressure-fed engine used for the ascent module of the Apollo lunar lander.
zh: 一款用于阿波罗登月舱上升级的挤压循环发动机。
登月舱下降级发动机（LMDE）

src: A LOX/Kerosene gas generator engine designed for booster applications. Three gimbaled engines would have been used in the Navaho booster.
zh: 一款为助推应用设计的液氧/煤油燃气发生器循环发动机。“纳瓦霍”助推器本应采用三台带万向节的该型发动机。

src: The LR91 powered the second stage of Titan launchers. Exhaust from the gas generator provided roll control.
zh: LR91曾为“大力神”运载火箭的第二级提供动力。来自燃气发生器的废气提供了滚转控制。

src: The first stage of the Minuteman ICBM, used in various proposed NASA launch vehicles as a solid booster. Burn time 75 seconds.
zh: “民兵”洲际弹道导弹的第一级，在NASA提出的多型运载火箭方案中被用作固体助推器。燃烧时间75秒。

src: A small solid kick motor developed as a braking motor for the Ranger Block II rough lander. Repeated failures of the Ranger spacecraft meant the rough lander was never able to be deployed.
The Star 13 was developed in the mid-1960s as the braking motor for the AIMP program, and was used on Explorer 33 and 35.
zh: Star 13于1960年代中期研制，用作AIMP计划的制动发动机，曾用于探索者33号和35号。

src: A small pressure-fed sustainer for MR-1 Meteo sounding rockets, developed in response to the American Aerobee. Used after a small solid booster.
zh: 用于MR-1气象探空火箭的小型挤压循环主发动机，旨在对标美国的“金雀花”。在小型固体助推器耗尽分离后启动。

src: A gas generator cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Fregat upper stage series.
zh: 一种燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于“弗雷加特”（Fregat）上面级系列。

src: A staged combustion cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Briz upper stage series.
zh: 一种分级燃烧循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于“微风”（Briz）上面级系列。

src: The ullage motor of the Saturn V S-II stage. Attaches to the upper part of the S-II interstage in sets of 4 to 8.
zh: 土星5号 S-II 级的沉底发动机。以4到8台为一组安装在 S-II 级间段的上部。

src: Ullage motor for the S-IV and S-IVB. Can be jettisoned after use to save weight.
zh: 用于 S-IV 和 S-IVB 的沉底发动机。使用后可抛弃以减轻重量。

src: Los Alamos "Small Engine" Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯“小型发动机”核火箭发动机

src: The Los Alamos "Small Engine" was a compact nuclear thermal rocket derived from the PEWEE core. Designed to be used as a Space Shuttle upper stage, it has a unique folding nozzle to reduce length.
zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯“小型发动机”是一种源自 PEWEE 反应堆堆芯的紧凑型核热火箭。设计用作航天飞机的上面级，拥有独特的折叠喷管以缩短长度。
SNTP-PFE100 核火箭发动机

src: An early Soviet Hall Effect thruster, used on Soviet and Russian weather satellites.
zh: 一种早期的苏联霍尔效应推力器，用于苏联和俄罗斯的气象卫星。

src: The first ever operational ion thruster, the SPT-60 Hall Effect thruster was first used in 1971 on Soviet Meteor weather satellites.
zh: 有史以来第一款实用的离子推力器，SPT-60 霍尔效应推力器于1971年首次应用于苏联“流星”气象卫星。

zh_samples: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务
你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src: A Hall effect ion thruster used on many commercial spacecraft for station keeping.
zh: 一种霍尔效应离子推力器，用于许多专注效益航天器的轨道维持。

src: The SPT-140 is an enlarged SPT-100 created to power large, modern communications satellites.
zh: SPT-140 是 SPT-100 的放大版本，旨在为现代大型通信卫星提供动力。

src: The SR19 is an improved Minuteman second stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II.
zh: SR19 是一种改进型“民兵”第二级，为 LGM-30F “民兵 II”研发。

src: A mid-sized apogee kick motor used on ATS-1/2/3.
zh: 一种用于 ATS-1/2/3 的中型远地点变轨发动机。

src: The SR73 is an improved Minuteman third stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II.
zh: SR73 是一种改进型“民兵”第三级，为 LGM-30F “民兵 II”研发。

src: The Star 12A is a stretched Star 12 with improved propellant, for later, heavier satellites in the Keyhole series.
zh: Star 12A 是 Star 12 的加长型，采用了改进型推进剂，用于“锁眼”系列后期较重的卫星。

src: The Star 13A was developed in the mid-1960s as an apogee motor for Thor-Burner II.
zh: Star 13A 研发于1960年代中期，作为“雷神-燃烧室 II”的远地点发动机。

src: A small apogee kick motor used for geosynchronous satellites. It was used on the first geosynchronous satellite, Syncom 1.
zh: 一种用于地球同步卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机。曾用于第一颗地球同步卫星辛康1号（Syncom 1）。

src: A single STAR 15G motor, used in a variety of applications. This has a straight nozzle.
zh: 单台 STAR 15G 发动机，具有多种用途。配有直喷管。

src: A small apogee kick motor for satellites, introduced in 1968 on Delta 57. Max thrust 12.34kN, burn time 18 seconds.
zh: 一种用于卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机，于1968年随德尔塔57号首次亮相。最大推力 12.34kN，工作时间 18 秒。

src: An apogee kick motor developed by Morton Thiokol. Used by various small commsat busses.
zh: 由莫顿·塞奥科公司研发的远地点变轨发动机。用于多种小型通信卫星平台。

src: The STAR 37 is a vacuum solid rocket motor originally developed as a braking stage for the Surveyor lunar lander program. Later variants were used exclusively as apogee kick stages.
zh: STAR 37 是一种真空固体火箭发动机，最初作为“勘测者”登月探测器计划的制动级开发。后来的衍生型号专门用作远地点变轨级。

src: Developed for SpaceX Starlink satellites, this small but powerful hall effect thruster offers good thrust and moderate specific impulse. Uniquely, it was modified to run on Argon to reduce fuel costs.
zh: 为 SpaceX “星链”卫星研发，这款小巧而强劲的霍尔效应推力器具有出色的推力和适中的比冲。独特的是，它改用氩气作为推进剂以降低燃料成本。

src: The Space Transportation Booster Engine (STBE) was a late 1980s to early 1990s booster engine design using JP-4 and liquid oxygen as its propellants.
zh: 空间运输助推器发动机（STBE）是1980年代末至1990年代初的一项助推器发动机设计，使用 JP-4 和液氧作为推进剂。

src: The Space Transportation Booster Engine (STBE) was a 1990s proposal for a highly reliable low cost booster engine for both expendable and reusable launch vehicles.
zh: 空间运输助推器发动机（STBE）是1990年代提出的一种高可靠性、低成本助推器发动机方案，适用于一次性及可重复使用的运载火箭。
空间运输主发动机（STME）

src: A powerful hypergolic engine used in the launch abort system of the Dragon 2 capsule. Other potential applications include hypersonic deceleration and landing for crew and cargo modules.
zh: 一种强大的自燃推进剂发动机，用于龙飞船2号乘员舱的发射中止系统。其他潜在应用包括乘员舱和货运舱的高超音速减速与着陆。

src: A small apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat II series of geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于国际通信卫星II号系列地球静止卫星。

src: A small apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat III series of geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于国际通信卫星III号系列地球静止卫星。

src: A medium apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat IV and IVA series of geostationary satellites, as well as some early Comstar satellites.
zh: 一种中型远地点变轨发动机，用于国际通信卫星IV号和IVA系列地球静止卫星，以及部分早期的商星（Comstar）卫星。

src: A small apogee kick motor used for early SMS and GOES geostationary weather satellites.
zh: 一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于早期的 SMS 和 GOES 地球静止气象卫星。

src: A 100 kW Applied-Field MPD thruster in development at the University of Stuttgart Institute of Space Systems. It set a thruster efficiency record of 61.99% in 2019.
zh: 由斯图加特大学空间系统研究所研发的 100 kW 外加磁场磁等离子体动力（AF-MPD）推力器。它在2019年创下了61.99%的推力器效率纪录。

src: The Mercury retro motor, intended to deorbit the capsule. Place 3 on the Mercury Retropack. These were fired in sequence at five second intervals.
zh: 水星号制动发动机，用于使乘员舱脱轨返回。在水星号制动包上安装3台。这些发动机按5秒的间隔依次点火。

src: An early French solid rocket engine used for the first stage of the Topaze sounding rocket and second stage of the Diamant A and B launch vehicles.
zh: 一种早期法国固体火箭发动机，用于“黄玉”（Topaze）探空火箭的第一级，以及“钻石”（Diamant）A 型和 B 型运载火箭的第二级。

src: 4 segment strap-on booster for proposed Saturn IB derivatives. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于土星IB衍生方案的4分段捆绑助推器。工作时间 115 秒。

src: 5 Segment strap-on booster for Titan IIIC, IIID, IIIE, proposed for Saturn IB derivatives. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于大力神 IIIC、IIID、IIIE 及土星IB衍生方案的5分段捆绑助推器。工作时间 115 秒。

src: 5.5 segment strap-on booster for Titan 34D and Commercial Titan III. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于大力神 34D 和专注效益大力神 III 的5.5分段捆绑助推器。工作时间 115 秒。

src: Speculative 8 segment version of the UA107. Burn time 115s.
zh: UA107 的推想型8分段版本。工作时间 115 秒。

src: A Wasserfall derivative engine developed by German and French engineers after WW2 for the sounding rocket of the same name. It was the first French high altitude sounding rocket.
zh: 二战后由德法两国工程师基于“瀑布”（Wasserfall）防空火箭发动机研发，用于同名探空火箭。这是法国第一枚高空探空火箭。

src: Vulcain is a gas-generator sustainer engine that was previously used on Ariane 5 and is now used on Ariane 6.
zh: “火神”（Vulcain）是一款燃气发生器循环主推进级发动机，曾用于阿里安5号，现用于阿里安6号。

src: The first proper VASIMR engine built by Ad Astra, the VX-200SS (Steady State) is built for long-term operation at a wide range of ISP and thrust, with multiple propellant options.
zh: Ad Astra 公司制造的第一款真正的 VASIMR 发动机，VX-200SS（稳态型）专为在宽范围的比冲和推力下长时间运行而设计，具有多种推进剂选项。

src: The Waxwing was a small solid kick motor for circularizing payloads in orbit, used as a third stage on the Black Arrow launch vehicle in 1970-71. 29.4kN average thrust.
zh: “田鸡”（Waxwing）是一种用于载荷入轨圆化的小型固体发动机，在1970至1971年间作为“黑箭”运载火箭的第三级使用。平均推力 29.4kN。

src: A very early kerolox gas generator booster engine used on the Vanguard launch vehicle.
zh: 一种非常早期的液氧煤油燃气发生器循环助推器发动机，用于“先锋”号运载火箭。

src: A small rocket motor intended to be used on the XF8U-3 for increased performance. Cancelled after the prototype exploded during testing and the XF8U-3 was cancelled in favor of the F4H.
zh: 一种旨在用于 XF8U-3 以提高性能的小型火箭发动机。原型机在测试期间爆炸，且 XF8U-3 项目被取消以支持 F4H，随后该发动机也被取消。

src: Americanized version of the V-2 Model 39 (A-4). It was very similar to its predecessor, but was built using American SAE components rather than metric components, and featured several minor upgrades.
zh: V-2 型号39（A-4）的美制版本。它与前代产品非常相似，但改用美国 SAE 英制部件而非公制部件制造，并进行了多项小幅升级。

src: A LOX/Ammonia gas generator engine which powered the X-15 spaceplane. It was the first large rocket engine capable of throttling and restarting.
zh: 一款驱动 X-15 空天飞机的液氧/氨燃气发生器循环发动机。这是第一款具备节流和二次启动能力的大型火箭发动机。

src: Rocketdyne's pump-fed high performance upper stage engine for perigee/apogee stages, as well as transfer vehicles and lunar and Martian missions. It was tested extensively but has never flown.
zh: 洛克达因公司的泵压式高性能上面级发动机，用于近地点/远地点级，以及转移飞行器、月球与火星任务。它经过了广泛测试，但从未飞行过。

src: A linear aerospike engine developed for NASA's X-33 sub-scale SSTO technology demonstrator. Like the toroidal J-2T engines, the XRS-2200 used machinery derived from the J-2S.
zh: 专为 NASA 的 X-33 缩比 SSTO 技术验证机研发的线性气动塞式喷管发动机。与环形 J-2T 发动机一样，XRS-2200 采用了源自 J-2S 的机械部件。

src: A Chinese hydrolox gas generator sustainer engine. Used on the first stage of the Long March 5.
zh: 中国氢氧燃气发生器循环主发动机。用于长征五号第一级（芯一级）。
电气仪表设计局

src: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine. Derived from the Isayev S2.1100 Burya booster engine, the YF-3 is a vacuum variant created for the second stage of the DF-4 and Long March 1.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。衍生自伊萨耶夫S2.1100“风暴”助推器发动机，YF-3是为DF-4和长征一号第二级研制的真空型号。

src: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine. A YF-22 engine and YF-23 vernier form the YF-24 engine unit used on the second stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。一台YF-22发动机与一台YF-23游机组成了YF-24动力单元，用于DF-5、FB-1以及长征二号/三号/四号火箭的第二级。

src: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine with verniers. A YF-22 engine and YF-23 vernier form the YF-24 engine unit used on the second stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets.
zh: 一款带游机的中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。一台YF-22发动机与一台YF-23游机组成了YF-24动力单元，用于DF-5、FB-1以及长征二号/三号/四号火箭的第二级。

src: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine, created for the 3rd stage of the Long March 4. Later versions had restart capability.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机，为长征四号第三级研制。后期型号具备多次启动能力。

src: The first operational Chinese hydrolox gas generator vacuum engine. Used on the third stage of the Long March 3. Low performance and unreliable, it was replaced by the YF-75 after 13 flights.
zh: 中国首款投入实用的氢氧气动发生器真空发动机。用于长征三号第三级。因性能较低且可靠性不足，在执行13次飞行任务后被YF-75取代。

src: An early 50s turbojet which served as the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，曾作为Su-7、Su-9、Su-11、Tu-128以及Be-10水上飞机的动力装置。

src: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II.
zh: 阿塔101是二战后法国研制的最早一批喷气发动机之一。它曾用于许多早期法国喷气式飞机，包括秃鹰I/II、苍鹰I和神秘II。

src: The Chimera is a combined cycle ramjet tech demonstrator built by Hermeus. Based around retired J85 cores, it is intended to operate over a flight envelope from Mach 0 to Mach 5.
zh: 奇美拉是Hermeus公司制造的组合循环冲压发动机技术验证机。它基于退役的J85核心机研制，设计飞行包线覆盖马赫0至马赫5。

src: The D-18 was the largest high-bypass turbofan developed in the Soviet Union, created in the 1980s for the An-124 and An-225.
zh: D-18是苏联研制的最大高涵道比涡扇发动机，于20世纪80年代为An-124和An-225研制。

src: A large, 16 kW electric ducted fan. Very powerful for it's size, but fixed pitch propeller blades limit it to low speeds.
zh: 一款大型16 kW电动涵道风扇。就其尺寸而言动力十分强劲，但定距螺旋桨叶片限制了其飞行速度。

src: The EJ200 is a 1990s low-bypass turbofan, designed as a joint venture between many European companies for the Eurofighter Typhoon.
zh: EJ200是一款20世纪90年代的低涵道比涡扇发动机，由多家欧洲公司联合为台风战斗机研制。

src: The GEnx is a 2000s large, high-bypass turbofan, developed from the GE90 to power the B787. It is used in most 787 variants, as well as in the 747-8.
zh: GEnx是一款2000年代的大型高涵道比涡扇发动机，由GE90发展而来，旨在为B787提供动力。它用于大多数787型号以及747-8。

src: An early 1950s turbojet, developed from the earlier J35 by General Electric. It powered the F-86, FJ-2, B-36, B-45, and B-48.
zh: 一款1950年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，由通用电气在早期J35的基础上研制。它曾为F-86、FJ-2、B-36、B-45和B-48提供动力。

src: The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2.
zh: J57是一款功勋主力发动机，于1950年代初期设计，为B-52、大多数“百系列”战斗机乃至U-2提供动力。

src: Designed in the late 1950s, the J58 was redesigned and repurposed for one use: Mach 3+ aircraft like the A-12 / SR-71A/B / YF-12A. Also known by it's civilian designation, JT11.
zh: J58于1950年代末期设计，后经过重新设计并转用于单一用途：为A-12/SR-71A/B/YF-12A等3马赫以上飞机提供动力。亦称民用型号JT11。

src: Essentially a larger J57, the P&W J75 saw extensive military and civilian use. It was used on the F-105, F-106, F-107, XF8U-3, A-12, U-2, P6M, and the 707 and DC-8 as the JT4A.
zh: 普惠J75本质上是放大的J57，曾广泛应用于军用和民用领域。它用于F-105、F-106、F-107、XF8U-3、A-12、U-2、P6M，并以JT4A的代号用于707和DC-8。

src: The first US "Mach 2" engine, the J79 saw extensive service, powering the B-58, F-4, A-5, and F-104.
zh: 作为美国第一款“2马赫”发动机，J79服役广泛，曾为B-58、F-4、A-5和F-104提供动力。

src: Derived from the J79, the J93 was developed for Mach 3 performance to power the B-70 and F-108.
zh: J93衍生自J79，专为3马赫性能研制，用以驱动B-70和F-108。

src: The NK-12 was a large 1950s turboprop. Created to power the Tu-95, it is the largest turboprop to enter production. It powered the A-90, An-22, Tu-95, Tu-114, Tu-116, Tu-126, and Tu-142.
zh: NK-12是一款1950年代的大型涡轮螺旋桨发动机。专为驱动Tu-95而生，它是投产的最大涡轮螺旋桨发动机。曾为A-90、An-22, Tu-95、Tu-114、Tu-116、Tu-126和Tu-142提供动力。

src: The NK-25 was a 1970s low-bypass turbofan, developed from the earlier NK-22. It is the most powerful supersonic jet engine ever flown, and was used to power the Tu-22M3, Tu-160, Tu-160M and Tu-144LL.
zh: NK-25是一款1970年代的低涵道比涡扇发动机，由早期的NK-22发展而来。它是飞行动力最强劲的超音速喷气发动机，曾用于驱动Tu-22M3、Tu-160、Tu-160M和Tu-144LL。
北方1500/阿塔组合循环冲压发动机

src: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time.
zh: 一款60年代晚期的涡轮喷气发动机。为取代R-11和R-13而研制，R-25增加了极其强劲的“超功率”加力燃烧室，使其能够在短时间内将推力提升近一倍。

src: The RD-012 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the La-350 Burya cruise missile up to Mach 3.1.
zh: RD-012是一款超音速冲压发动机，旨在驱动La-350“风暴”巡航导弹达到3.1马赫。

src: The RJ47 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the SM-64 Navaho cruise missile up to Mach 2.75.
zh: RJ47是一款超音速冲压发动机，旨在驱动SM-64“纳瓦霍”巡航导弹达到2.75马赫。

src: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin.
zh: 一款1950年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。蓝宝石衍生自英国研制的第一款轴流式喷气发动机MetroVick F.2，曾为霍克猎手、汉德利·佩季胜利者和格罗斯特标枪提供动力。

src: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, Tu-14, and Il-28.
zh: 苏联生产的尼恩衍生型号，用于许多早期苏联喷气式飞机，包括MiG-15、MiG-17、Tu-14和Il-28。

src: The Welland was an early 1940s turbojet, developed from Frank Whittle's original jet engine, the W.1. It was used on the Meteor F.1, but was quickly replaced by later, more powerful jet engines.
zh: 韦兰德是一款1940年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，由弗兰克·惠特尔设计的首款喷气发动机W.1发展而来。它曾用于流星F.1，但很快被后期性能更强劲的喷气发动机取代。
阿利根尼弹道实验室（ABL）

严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。
一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

通信研究中心（CRC）
国防研究电信机构（DRTE）
大中央火箭公司（GCRC）

国家侦察局（NRO）
内华达山脉公司（SNC）
美国太空军（USSF）

zh_samples: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们
照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的

src: Used on the UR-100 second stage. One 15D13 and one 15D14 make up a DU-419/8D419 propulsion unit.
zh: 用于UR-100二级。一台 15D13 和一台 15D14 构成一个DU-419/8D419推进单元。

src: Modified 15D13, intended for use as the ascent/return engine on the LK-700S. More reliable, with restart capability.
zh: 15D13 的改进型，旨在用作LK-700S的上升/返回发动机。可靠性更高，具备再点火能力。

src: Sustainer engine of A-350Zh Anti-Ballistic Missile. Capable of rapid restart under high dynamic pressure for rapid upper atmosphere manuevers.
zh: A-350Zh反导拦截弹的巡航级发动机。具备在高动压下快速再点火的能力，用于高层大气的迅速机动。

zh: Model 39 的过渡性量产版本，用于A-4 B 系列/V-2

zh_samples: 气泵
严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。
一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

src: "Interkontinental" version of the Model 39c, for the A-9/A-10 upper stage. Decreased thrust and increased Isp for upper stage use, and special engine modifications to allow air-starting.
zh: Model 39c 的“洲际”版本，用于A-9/A-10上面级。降低了推力并提高了比冲以适应上面级使用，并经过特殊改装以支持空中点火。

src: Prototype engine, used on the Hermes A-3A (RV-A-8) test vehicle.
zh: 原型发动机，用于赫尔墨斯A-3A（RV-A-8）测试飞行器。

src: Uprated engine for the Hermes A-3B (SSM-A-16) missile.
zh: 用于赫尔墨斯A-3B（SSM-A-16）导弹的升推改进型发动机。

src: A RATO booster modified to be used on the WAC-Corporal for the US Army
zh: 经过改装供美国陆军“下士”火箭（WAC-Corporal）使用的火箭助推起飞（RATO）助推器

src: Developed for the Aerobee X-8, an improved WAC-Corporal for upper atmosphere research to replace the limited stocks of captured V-2s
zh: 为“火箭气象探测仪”（Aerobee）X-8研制，该火箭是改进型 WAC-Corporal，用于高层大气研究以替代数量有限的缴获V-2s

src: Improved XASR-1 with helium pressurization to improve performance.
zh: 改进型XASR-1，采用氦气增压以提高性能。

src: Developed as an upgrade to the XASR-1. Continued to be used until the 1980s for meteorlogical studies.
zh: 作为XASR-1的升级型号研制。一直使用至 20 世纪 80 年代用于气象研究。

src: Developed privately in collaboration with Rocketdyne. Turbopump system from XLR-32 added, allowing much higher performance. A.K.A RS-72
zh: 与洛克达因（Rocketdyne）合作私下研制。增加了源自XLR-32的涡轮泵系统，大幅提升了性能。亦称RS-72

src: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks.
zh: 由 TRW 研制的阿金娜（Agena）SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统使其能直接从阿金娜燃料箱抽取推进剂。

src: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks. HDA version.
zh: 由 TRW 研制的阿金娜（Agena）SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统使其能直接从阿金娜燃料箱抽取推进剂。HDA（高密度酸）版本。

src: Derived from the XLR67 used on the RASCAL missile, the Model 117 was intended to power an improved air to surface missile for the B-58 Hustler.
zh: 衍生自“拉斯考”（RASCAL）导弹上使用的XLR67，Model 117 旨在为B-58“盗贼”轰炸机配备的改进型空对地导弹提供动力。

src: Model 8001, Agena A Prototypes. Effectively a Model 117 with gimbal added, this engine was poorly optimized for upper stage use and only flew twice on the earliest Agena launches.
zh: Model 8001，阿金娜 A（Agena A）原型。实际上是增加了万向节的 Model 117，该发动机针对上面级工况的优化较差，仅在最早的两次阿金娜发射中飞行过。

src: Model 8048, Agena A. Switched to higher performance hypergolic fuels and featured an larger nozzle for better vacuum performance. Cavitating venturis improved thrust regulation.
zh: Model 8048，阿金娜 A（Agena A）。改用更高性能的自燃推进剂，并具有更大的喷管以获得更好的真空性能。空化文丘里管改善了推力调节。

src: Model 8081, Agena B. Increase burn time and a short nozzle extension increased performance for Agena B. Also featured a restart cartridge to allow restart in space.
zh: Model 8081，阿金娜 B（Agena B）。延长的燃烧时间和短喷管延伸段提高了阿金娜 B 的性能。还配备了再点火启动药筒以支持在轨重启。

src: Model 8096, Agena D. Improved injectors and a larger nozzle extension improved performance for Agena D. This was the most-produced variant of Agena, flying hundreds of times.
zh: Model 8096，阿金娜 D（Agena D）。改进的喷注器和更大的喷管延伸段提升了阿金娜 D 的性能。这是阿金娜产量最高的改型，飞行了数百次。

src: Higher expansion ratio nozzle prototype. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 大面积比喷管原型。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

src: Reusable Agena for STS, featuring much larger nozzle, a large number of restarts, and higher performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的可复用阿金娜，拥有更大的喷管、多次再点火能力和更高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

src: Improved reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight, fuel mix modified for better compatibility with shuttle, and turbopump material modified to remove restart limits.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的改进型可复用阿金娜。减轻了重量，修改了燃料配比以更好地适配航天飞机，并改进了涡轮泵材料以消除再点火限制。

src: Ultimate reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight and thrust to increase Isp, nearly unlimited restarts, and extremely long life.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的终极可复用阿金娜。降低了重量和推力以提高比冲，几乎不受限的再点火次数，以及极长的工作寿命。

src: Agena upgrade for proposed Atlas V upper stage. Tested, but cancelled when studies showed it would be more economical to use single engine centaur instead.

zh: 带加力燃烧室的 R-15，用于 MiG-25RB 并改装于许多早期改型。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：3.35。

src: Afterburning R-15, as used on the E-155M/MiG-25M. Cancelled in favor of MiG-31. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.51.
zh: 带加力燃烧室的 R-15，用于 E-155M/MiG-25M。后取消研制并改用 MiG-31。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：3.51。

src: R-25, as used on the MiG-21Bis and Su-15Bis. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.94.
zh: R-25，用于 MiG-21Bis 和 Su-15Bis。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.94。

src: Early R-79, as used on Project 48-1 prototype. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.75.
zh: 早期型 R-79，用于 48-1 工程原型机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.75。

src: R-79, as used on later Yak-41/141 prototypes. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.74.
zh: R-79，用于后期的 Yak-41/141 原型机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.74。

src: Planned R-79 upgrade. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.85.
zh: 计划中的 R-79 升级型。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.85。

src: RB.162, used as the liftjet for the Dornier 31. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.70.
zh: RB.162，用作多尼尔 31 的升力喷气发动机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：1.70。

src: RB.162, used as the liftjet for the Mirage IIIV. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.66.
zh: RB.162，用作幻影 IIIV 的升力喷气发动机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：1.66。

src: MA-5.2 booster engine. Both engines shared turbopumps due to NASA preferring that configuration. Used for Atlas-Centaur launches
zh: MA-5.2助推器发动机。鉴于NASA偏好该构型，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神-半人马座发射

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the (speculative, kerosene-burning) LR87-AJ-5 with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-5.
zh: （推想的煤油型）LR87-AJ-5 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-5 相同。

src: First stage engine of Titan II GLV. Modified for the Gemini program to reduce chances of failure and make the engine safer.
zh: 大力神 II GLV 的第一级发动机。为双子座计划进行了改进，以降低故障率并提高发动机安全性。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the LR87-AJ-7 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 LR87-AJ-7 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the (speculative, kerosene-burning) LR87-AJ-7 with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-7.
zh: （推想的煤油型）LR87-AJ-7 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-7 相同。

src: AJ23-136, First stage engine for Titan IIIA, IIIB and IIIC. Longer burn time and slightly higher performance for the stretched fuel tank of Titan III.
zh: AJ23-136，用于大力神 IIIA、IIIB 和 IIIC 的第一级发动机。燃烧时间更长且性能略有提升，以适配大力神 III 的加长储箱。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-9 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-9 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-9 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications. Uses nozzle extension for increased vacuum performance.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-9 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。使用喷管延伸段以提高真空性能。

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the (speculative, kerosene-burning) LR87-AJ-9 with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-9.
zh: （推想的煤油型）LR87-AJ-9 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-9 相同。

src: Speculative version of the LR87-AJ-11 without nozzle extension.
zh: LR87-AJ-11 的推想改型，无喷管延伸段。

src: AJ23-138, LR87-AJ-11 with a shortened nozzle extension for sea-level operation on booster-less Titan 3 variants like Titan 34D.
zh: AJ23-138，配有缩短喷管延伸段的 LR87-AJ-11，用于大力神 34D 等无助推器的大力神 3 改型的海平面工作。

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the LR87-AJ-11 with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-5.
zh: LR87-AJ-11 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-5 相同。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-11 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications. No nozzle extension.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-11 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。无喷管延伸段。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications. Uses shortened nozzle extension of the AJ23-138 for sea level use.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-11 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。使用 AJ23-138 的缩短喷管延伸段以在海平面工作。

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the (speculative, kerosene-burning) LR87-AJ-11 with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-11.
zh: （推想的煤油型）LR87-AJ-11 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-11 相同。

src: First stage engine for Titan IVA and IVB. Equipped with a nozzle extension to improve vacuum performance, since it was not needed at sea level.
zh: 用于大力神 IVA 和 IVB 的第一级发动机。配备喷管延伸段以提高真空性能，因为海平面不需要它。

src: Speculative LR87-AJ-11A with a shortened nozzle extension for sea-level operation.
zh: 推想的 LR87-AJ-11A，配有缩短喷管延伸段以在海平面工作。

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the LR87-AJ-11A with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-11A.
zh: LR87-AJ-11A 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-11A 相同。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11A but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-11A 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11A but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications. Uses shortened nozzle extension of the AJ23-138 for sea level use.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-11A 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。使用 AJ23-138 的缩短喷管延伸段以在海平面工作。

src: Speculative upper-stage version of the (speculative, kerosene-burning) LR87-AJ-11A with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-11A.
zh: （推想的煤油型）LR87-AJ-11A 的推想上面级改型，膨胀比与 LR91-AJ-11A 相同。

src: MA-0 and prototype MA-1 Atlas Booster engine, converted to burn kerosene. Used on Convair X12 and Atlas A
zh: MA-0 与原型 MA-1 宇宙神助推器发动机，改为燃烧煤油。曾用于康维尔 X12 和宇宙神 A。

src: MA-1 Atlas booster engine. Significantly upgraded and simplified, with both engines sharing turbopumps. Used on Atlas B/C
zh: MA-1 宇宙神助推器发动机。大幅升级并简化，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神 B/C。

src: MA-3 Atlas booster engine. Each engine had its own turbopump allow for engines to be quickly swapped. Developed for the USAF for Atlas D
zh: MA-3 宇宙神助推器发动机。每台发动机拥有独立的涡轮泵以便快速更换。为美国空军的宇宙神 D 研制。

src: MA-3 Atlas booster engine. Slightly upgraded for Atlas E/F
zh: MA-3 宇宙神助推器发动机。针对宇宙神 E/F 进行了小幅升级。

src: MA-5.1 booster engine. Both engines shared turbopumps due to NASA preferring that configuration. Used for Atlas-Agena launches
zh: MA-5.1 助推器发动机。因 NASA 更偏好该构型，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神-阿金纳发射。

src: Atlas MA-5A booster engine. Upgraded with RS-27 components to reduce cost and improve performance. Used on Atlas II
zh: 宇宙神 MA-5A 助推器发动机。采用 RS-27 部件升级以降低成本并提高性能。用于宇宙神 II。

src: AJ23-129, second stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built before May 1960.
zh: AJ23-129，用于 1960 年 5 月之前制造的大力神 I 洲际弹道导弹的第二级发动机。

src: AJ23-131, second stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built after May 1960.
zh: AJ23-131，用于 1960 年 5 月之后制造的大力神 I 洲际弹道导弹的第二级发动机。

src: AJ23-133, second stage engine of Titan II. Modified to burn Aerozine50 and Nitrogen Tetroxide to allow storage for long periods of time.
zh: AJ23-133，大力神 II 的第二级发动机。改装为燃烧 Aerozine50 和四氧化二氮，以便长期储存。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-5 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-5 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。

src: AJ23-135, second stage engine of Titan II GLV. Modified for the Gemini program to reduce chances of failure and make the engine safer.
zh: AJ23-135，大力神 II GLV 的第二级发动机。为双子座计划进行了改进，以降低故障率并提高发动机安全性。

src: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-7 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 推想配置，采用与 -AJ-7 相同的技术，但燃烧煤油和液氧，专用于民用领域。

src: AJ23-137, second stage engine for Titan IIIA, IIIB and IIIC. Longer burn time and slightly higher performance for the stretched fuel tank of Titan III.
zh: AJ23-137，用于大力神 IIIA、IIIB 和 IIIC 的第二级发动机。燃烧时间更长且性能略有提升，以适配大力神 III 的加长储箱。

src: AJ23-140, second stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Slightly improved performance.
zh: AJ23-140，用于大力神 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 和 IIIE 的第二级发动机。性能略有提升。

src: Second stage engine for Titan IVA and IVB. Slightly improved thrust.
zh: 用于大力神 IVA 和 IVB 的第二级发动机。推力略有提升。

src: Block I Phase II baseline LRBE.
zh: Block I Phase II 基准液体火箭助推发动机（LRBE）。

src: In development for use on Vega-E
zh: 正在研制中，拟用于织女星-E（Vega-E）。

src: Initial version of the M-1, generating 1.2 mlbf of thrust
zh: M-1 的初始版本，产生 120 万磅推力。

src: Production version of the M-1, generating 1.5 mlbf of thrust
zh: M-1 的生产版本，产生 150 万磅推力。

src: 1990s proposal to convert the M-1 into a sea level sustainer engine for super-heavy launch vehicles
zh: 20 世纪 90 年代的提案，将 M-1 改装为用于超重型运载火箭的海平面主发动机。

src: M-1, uprated to 1.8 mlbf. All M-1 components were designed to handle 1200 psi chamber to allow this upgrade.
zh: M-1，推力提升至 180 万磅。所有 M-1 部件均按承受 1200 psi 室压设计，以支持此升级。

src: Sea level M-1, but running at 1200 psi chamber pressure.
zh: 海平面版 M-1，但在 1200 psi 室压下运行。
用于猎鹰 9 号 Block 1（v1.0）。
用于猎鹰 9 号 v1.2（全推力版）。

src: Used on Falcon 9 v1.2 (Full Thrust and Block 5)
zh: 用于猎鹰 9 号 v1.2（全推力版与 Block 5）。

src: Also known as NAA75-65, XLR43-NA-1 is the USAF service designation. Used for early Navaho applications.
zh: 亦称 NAA75-65，XLR43-NA-1 为美国空军服役编号。用于早期纳瓦霍项目。

src: Main production variant for Redstone missile, very similar to USAF XLR43-NA-1 / NAA75-65, except with longer burn time.
zh: 红石导弹的主要生产改型，与美国空军的 XLR43-NA-1 / NAA75-65 非常相似，但燃烧时间更长。

src: Later production variant for Redstone missile, also used on Mercury-Redstone with stretched propellant tanks and extra HTP.
zh: 红石导弹的后期生产改型，也用于水星-红石，具有加长推进剂储箱和额外过氧化氢（HTP）。

src: A-6 engine converted to run Hydyne as fuel, used on Jupiter-C sounding rocket and Juno I launch vehicle.
zh: 改为使用 Hydyne 燃料的 A-6 发动机，用于丘比特-C 探空火箭和朱诺 I 运载火箭。

src: Developed as the first stage engine of the N-1 moon rocket. Gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 作为 N-1 登月火箭的第一级发动机研制。支持万向节，差动节流阀控制。

src: Developed as the first stage engine of the N-1 moon rocket. No gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 作为 N-1 登月火箭的第一级发动机研制。无万向节，差动节流阀控制。

src: Improved for N1F Block G. Relightable. Gimbal, throttle.
zh: 针对N1F的G级进行了改进。可二次启动。带万向节、节流阀。

src: Used on the UR-500 second stage. AKA 8D411
zh: 用于UR-500二级。亦称8D411

src: Developed as an upgrade to the NK-15, and then abandoned with the cancellation of the N-1. Revived following the fall of the USSR, now used on Soyuz 2.1v. Gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 作为NK-15的升级型研发，后因N-1项目的取消而被放弃。苏联解体后该项目复活，现用于联盟2.1v。配备万向节，支持差动节流阀。

src: Developed as an upgrade to the NK-15, and then abandoned with the cancellation of the N-1. Revived following the fall of the USSR, now used on Soyuz 2.1v. No gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 作为NK-15的升级型研发，后因N-1项目的取消而被放弃。苏联解体后该项目复活，现用于联盟2.1v。无万向节，支持差动节流阀。

src: Developed as the second stage engine of the N-1 moon rocket. No gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 作为N-1登月火箭的第二级发动机研发。无万向节，支持差动节流阀。

src: Developed as an upgrade to the NK-15, and then abandoned with the cancellation of the N-1. No gimbal, differential throttle.

src: Original vacuum version of NK-9 for the GR-1 rocket.
zh: 用于GR-1火箭的NK-9原始真空构型。

src: NK-9V rerated for N1 Block G use. Gimbal, throttle.
zh: 重新标定用于N1 G级的NK-9V。配备万向节，支持节流阀。

src: NK-9V rerated for N1 Block V use. No gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 重新标定用于N1 V级的NK-9V。无万向节，支持差动节流阀。

src: Improved for N1F Block V. No gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 针对N1F V级进行改进的版本。无万向节，支持差动节流阀。

src: Developed for R-9 ICBM, and later used as the first stage engine for GR-1, the N-1 predecessor.
zh: 专为R-9洲际弹道导弹研发，后来作为N-1前身GR-1的第一级发动机使用。

src: Speculative upgrade, assuming technologies from the NK-15 were integrated back into the NK-9
zh: 设想的升级型号，设想将NK-15的技术反哺回NK-9。

src: Speculative upgrade, assuming technologies from the NK-33 were integrated back into the NK-9
zh: 设想的升级型号，设想将NK-33的技术反哺回NK-9。

src: Speculative upgrade, assuming Aerojet purchased and upgraded NK-9s for their own use.
zh: 设想的升级型号，设想Aerojet收购并升级了NK-9s供自己使用。

src: Speculative version using Ammonia as propellant. No LOX-Augmentation on account of poor performance.
zh: 设想的使用氨作为推进剂的版本。由于性能不佳，未采用液氧补燃。

src: Speculative version using Methane-Ammonia mix as propellant. No LOX-Augmentation on account of poor performance.
zh: 设想的使用甲烷-氨混合推进剂的版本。由于性能不佳，未采用液氧补燃。

src: Low pressure NTR baseline, operating with a core temperature of 3200 K and thrust of 11klbf.
zh: 低压NTR基线型，核心温度3200 K，推力11 klbf。

src: Low pressure NTR upgrade, operating with a core temperature of 3600 K and thrust of 15klbf.
zh: 低压NTR升级型，核心温度3600 K，推力15 klbf。

src: Speculative version using Ammonia as propellant.
zh: 设想的使用氨作为推进剂的版本。

src: Speculative version using Methane-Ammonia mix as propellant.
zh: 设想的使用甲烷-氨混合物作为推进剂的版本。

src: RD-0410 version using Methane as propellant. Not much information is available, but carbon coking would have likely caused severe issues.

src: Production engine predicted performance. Carbon-Carbon turbines handle higher flow rates and inlet temperatures.
zh: 量产发动机预估性能。碳-碳复合材料涡轮可承受更高的流量和入口温度。

src: Simplified ORM-65 for the RP-318 rocket planes
zh: 用于RP-318火箭飞机的简化版ORM-65。

src: Attitude control thruster developed for the Space Shuttle.
zh: 为航天飞机研发的姿控推进器。

src: NTO variant of the baseline R-40A thruster.
zh: 基线型R-40A推进器的NTO改进型。
R-40A的专注效益版本。

src: NTO variant of the baseline R-40B thruster.
zh: 基线型R-40B推进器的NTO改进型。

src: NTO variant of the baseline R-42 thruster.
zh: 基线型R-42推进器的NTO改进型。

src: High performance version of the baseline R-42 thruster.
zh: 基线型R-42推进器的高性能版本。

src: NTO variant of the baseline R-42DM thruster.
zh: 基线型R-42DM推进器的NTO改进型。

src: 164:1 nozzle ratio version used on the Cassini probe.
